content: ### NHMP Constable / Junior Patrol Officer (BPS-07) Recruitment Overview

The **National Highways & Motorway Police (NHMP)**, operating under the Ministry of Communications, Government of Pakistan, has announced **80 regular posts for Constable / Junior Patrol Officer (BPS-07)** under the Federal Government’s **Balochistan Special Employment Initiative**.

All applications are invited digitally via the **National Job Portal (NJP)** at [njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk). Selected candidates will be appointed into the premier uniformed highway law enforcement service, entitled to regular BPS-07 salary along with NHMP special risk/patrol allowances.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Balochistan Local / Domicile Restriction:**
> - **Eligibility Scope:** This recruitment advertisement is strictly reserved for candidates holding a verified **Balochistan Local / Domicile Certificate**.
> - **No Nationwide General Merit:** Candidates from other provinces (Punjab, Sindh, KPK, Islamabad, AJK, or Gilgit-Baltistan) are **not eligible** for these 80 posts.
> - **Application Deadline:** The online registration window closes on **Thursday, 12 November 2026**.
### Quota Breakdown: 80 Junior Patrol Officer Slots
The 80 Constable / Junior Patrol Officer (BPS-07) positions are allocated within the Balochistan regional pool as follows:

| Category / Quota Stream | Vacancy Count | Eligible Gender | Domicile Requirement | Educational Standard |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Balochistan Open Merit** | **44** | Male & Female | Balochistan Province | Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / 2nd Div) |
| **Balochistan Women Quota** | **24** | Female Only | Balochistan Province | Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / 2nd Div) |
| **Balochistan Minority Quota** | **12** | Non-Muslim Candidates | Balochistan Province | Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / 2nd Div) |
| **Total Junior Patrol Officers** | **80** | **All Eligible Categories** | **Balochistan Only** | **Intermediate (BPS-07)** |

*(Note on Recruitment Round: These 80 posts form the frontline law enforcement component of NHMP's wider 94-post Balochistan Special Recruitment Package, which also includes 1 Assistant, 5 Photographers, 3 Stenotypists, 3 LDCs, and 2 Paramedics).*
### Mandatory Physical Fitness & Measurement Standards
Because Constable / Junior Patrol Officer is an active uniformed field policing designation, candidates must meet non-negotiable physical measurements and physical endurance standards:

#### 1. Physical Measurements (Balochistan Special Standards)
- **Minimum Height (Male):** **5 feet 6 inches (5' 6")** *(relaxed from the standard 5' 8" for other provincial quotas)*.
- **Minimum Height (Female):** **5 feet 3 inches (5' 3")** *(relaxed from 5' 4")*.
- **Chest Measurement (Male Candidates Only):** Minimum **33 inches** with normal breathing, expanding to **34.5 to 35 inches** upon full chest expansion (1.5" to 2" mandatory expansion).
- **Body Mass Index (BMI):** Height and weight must correspond to standard physical fitness medical charts.

#### 2. Physical Endurance & Running Tests
- **Male Candidates:**
  - **Running:** Complete **01 Mile (1.6 km) in 09 minutes**.
  - **Push-ups:** Minimum **10 repetitions in 01 minute**.
  - **Crunches / Sit-ups:** Minimum **10 repetitions in 01 minute**.
- **Female Candidates:**
  - **Running:** Complete **01 Mile (1.6 km) in 14 minutes** (walking or running).
### Educational Qualifications, Age Limits & Driving Requirements

- **Educational Qualification:** Intermediate (Higher Secondary School Certificate — FA / F.Sc / I.Com / ICS or equivalent) with at least **2nd Division (minimum 45% marks)** from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE).
- **Age Limit:** **18 to 25 Years** as of the closing date (12 November 2026). In line with uniformed police service recruitment regulations, **no upper age relaxation** is permitted for police constable cadres unless formally authorized under specific statutory clauses.
- **Driving License Requirement:** Candidates must hold a valid **Motorcar / Jeep and Motorcycle Driving License**. Candidates currently possessing only a learner permit must ensure their permanent license is processed prior to practical driving tests.
- **Computer Literacy:** Basic operating knowledge of computers and keyboard handling.
### Step-by-Step Selection Workflow

The NHMP recruitment process is structured across four progressive screening phases:
1. **Initial Online Scrutiny:** Preliminary verification of domicile, age, and academic qualifications submitted on NJP.
2. **Physical Measurement & Endurance Test:** Conducted at designated police training grounds in Balochistan (Quetta and regional centers). Physical measurement of height, chest, and timed 1-mile running trials.
3. **Written Aptitude Examination:** Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) covering General Knowledge, Pakistan Studies, Basic English, Islamic Studies (Ethics for minorities), and Motorway / Traffic Safety Rules.
4. **Practical Driving Test:** Demonstration of vehicle handling, reversing, parallel parking, and traffic signs comprehension before an NHMP driving evaluation board.
5. **Interview & Medical Screening:** Final viva voce followed by comprehensive medical examination at designated government civil hospitals before dispatch to the NHMP Training College.
### How to Apply Online on National Job Portal (NJP)

1. **Access NJP:** Go to the official federal portal at [https://njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk).
2. **Profile Completion:** Log in or register with your CNIC. Enter education details, height/measurements, and upload a recent photograph.
3. **Search Post:** Select **National Highways & Motorway Police** in the department drop-down.
4. **Choose Designation:** Select **Junior Patrol Officer (BPS-07) - Balochistan Quota**.
5. **Verify Details:** Ensure your Balochistan district of local/domicile is accurately specified.
6. **Submit:** Submit online before **12 November 2026**. No physical form submission is required.
### Anti-Fraud & Regulatory Warning

- **No Processing Fees:** NHMP does **NOT** charge any application or registration fee for submissions on the National Job Portal.
- **Merit-Only Recruitment:** NHMP adheres to zero-tolerance anti-corruption policies. Any candidate attempting to exert external influence, present fake driving licenses, or engage middlemen will be permanently disqualified and prosecuted under the Pakistan Penal Code.
- **Original Credentials:** Original Local/Domicile certificate, CNIC, Matric/Intermediate mark sheets, and valid Driving License are mandatory at physical testing centers.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can candidates from Sindh, Punjab, or KPK apply for these NHMP posts?**
No. This recruitment round is strictly restricted to candidates having a valid Balochistan Domicile / Local Certificate.

**Q2: What is the minimum height requirement for Balochistan candidates?**
Male candidates must be at least 5 feet 6 inches (5' 6"), and female candidates must be at least 5 feet 3 inches (5' 3").

**Q3: Is a driving license mandatory at the time of application?**
Yes. Candidates must possess a valid Car/Jeep and Motorcycle driving license as an essential qualification for Junior Patrol Officer duties.

**Q4: What is the last date to apply?**
The official deadline on the National Job Portal is **12 November 2026**.
### Official Links & Verification Resources

- **Apply Online via National Job Portal:** [njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk)
- **National Highways & Motorway Police Official Website:** [nhmp.gov.pk](https://nhmp.gov.pk)
- **Related Law Enforcement Career Coverage:** [Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026](/jobs/punjab-police-jobs-2026-rajanpur-rahim-yar-khan-constables), [Sindh Courts BPS 1-4 Walk-in Schedule](/jobs/sindh-courts-bps-1-4-jobs-2026)

content: ### Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Regular Recruitment Overview (32 Vacancies)

The **Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA)**, Government of Pakistan, has officially announced 32 regular public service vacancies across six administrative and support staff cadres through the **National Job Portal (NJP)** at [njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk).

All advertised positions are situated at the Ministry Headquarters in Islamabad (or designated provincial liaison stations) and offer regular career employment under Federal Government Basic Pay Scales ranging from **BPS-01 to BPS-14**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Provincial Domicile Restriction — Balochistan Quota Only:**
> - **Recruitment Scope:** This recruitment round is **not** an all-Pakistan open merit drive. All 32 advertised posts are strictly reserved for candidates possessing a valid **Balochistan Local / Domicile Certificate** under the Federal Government's special Balochistan Employment Initiative.
> - **Eligibility Verification:** Applicants from other provinces (Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, ICT, AJK, or Gilgit-Baltistan) are **not eligible** for these specific 32 vacancies and should not apply.
> - **Application Window:** Online submissions close on **Monday, 30 November 2026**.
### Detailed Vacancy Breakdown & Quota Distribution

| Post Designation | BPS Scale | Number of Posts | Domicile / Quota | Minimum Education | Key Technical Skill / Condition |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Stenotypist** | BPS-14 | 05 | Balochistan (Merit/Women/Minority) | Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / Equivalent) | Shorthand: 80 w.p.m.; Typing: 40 w.p.m.; Computer literate |
| **Upper Division Clerk (UDC)** | BPS-13 | 03 | Balochistan | Intermediate | Basic IT Training Course (NITB) within probation |
| **Lower Division Clerk (LDC)** | BPS-11 | 02 | Balochistan | Matriculation | Typing Speed: 30 w.p.m.; Basic IT Training Course (NITB) |
| **Driver** | BPS-04 | 02 | Balochistan | Primary Pass | Valid LTV/HTV Driving License with traffic rules knowledge |
| **Naib Qasid** | BPS-01 | 18 | Balochistan | Primary Pass | Physically fit for office support duties |
| **Sanitary Worker** | BPS-01 | 02 | Balochistan (Minority quota) | Primary Pass / Literate | Sanitation and housekeeping duties |
| **Total Positions** | — | **32** | **Balochistan Quota** | **Primary to Intermediate** | **Regular Federal Service** |
### Cadre-Wise Eligibility & Educational Criteria

#### 1. Stenotypist (BPS-14) — 05 Posts
- **Minimum Qualification:** Intermediate (12 years of education) from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE).
- **Skill Requirements:** Minimum shorthand speed of **80 words per minute** and typing speed of **40 words per minute**. Candidates must demonstrate working proficiency in computer software (MS Word, Excel, and Windows).
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (+ 5 years general age relaxation = maximum **30 years**).

#### 2. Upper Division Clerk - UDC (BPS-13) — 03 Posts
- **Minimum Qualification:** Intermediate (FA, F.Sc, I.Com, or equivalent) from an accredited board.
- **Mandatory Condition:** Selected candidates must successfully undergo a 3-week Basic IT Training Course (including MS Office) conducted by the National Information Technology Board (NITB) before the end of their probation period.
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (+ 5 years relaxation = maximum **30 years**).

#### 3. Lower Division Clerk - LDC (BPS-11) — 02 Posts
- **Minimum Qualification:** Matriculation (Secondary School Certificate) from a recognized board.
- **Skill Requirements:** Minimum English typing speed of **30 words per minute** on a computer keyboard. Completion of a 3-week NITB IT Training Course is required prior to confirmation.
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (+ 5 years relaxation = maximum **30 years**).

#### 4. Driver (BPS-04) — 02 Posts
- **Minimum Qualification:** Primary pass with reading/writing knowledge of Urdu.
- **License Requirement:** Must possess a valid, authenticated LTV or HTV driving license with a clean driving history and sound knowledge of national traffic regulations.
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 30 years (+ 5 years relaxation = maximum **35 years**).

#### 5. Naib Qasid (BPS-01) — 18 Posts & Sanitary Worker (BPS-01) — 02 Posts
- **Minimum Qualification:** Primary pass from a recognized school.
- **Duties:** Office document dispatch, file carrying, general administrative assistance, and cleanliness maintenance.
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (+ 5 years relaxation = maximum **30 years**).
### Age Limit & Federal Age Relaxation Rules

The baseline recruitment age is **18 to 25 years** as of the closing date (30 November 2026). In accordance with the Federal Government Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules:
- **General Age Relaxation:** 5 years across-the-board upper age relaxation is granted to all candidates (raising the cutoff to 30 years, and 35 years for Drivers).
- **Scheduled Castes, Buddhist Community & Recognized Tribes:** Up to 3 additional years of relaxation.
- **Disabled Candidates:** Up to 10 years upper age relaxation for designated quotas upon production of a valid disability assessment certificate.
- **Armed Forces Personnel:** Released or retired armed forces officers/personnel are granted up to 15 years or the number of years served, whichever is less.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure on NJP

All applications must be submitted digitally through the Federal Government's centralized recruitment gateway. No physical applications or hard copies will be entertained at this stage:
1. **Access the Portal:** Visit the official National Job Portal at [https://njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk).
2. **Account Registration:** Register an account using your 13-digit Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) number and active mobile phone number.
3. **Build Candidate Profile:** Enter your personal information, address, educational qualifications, typing/shorthand skills, and upload an updated passport-size photograph.
4. **Select Employer:** Search for **Ministry of Foreign Affairs** in the organization directory.
5. **Apply for Specific Post:** Select your desired vacancy (e.g., Stenotypist, UDC, LDC, Driver, Naib Qasid) and confirm your Balochistan domicile details.
6. **Submit Application:** Review your entered data carefully before final submission. Note down your unique NJP Application Tracking ID for future reference.
### Anti-Scam Notice & Transparent Recruitment Standards

- **Zero Application Fee:** The National Job Portal does **NOT** charge any application fee, processing fee, or security deposit for Ministry of Foreign Affairs posts. Beware of fraudulent agents claiming to process applications for money.
- **Original Documents at Interview:** Candidates qualifying the preliminary screening or skill tests will be called for interviews and must present original CNIC, Domicile/Local certificate, Educational DMCs/Degrees, and experience certificates.
- **Dual Applications:** Candidates possessing multiple qualifications may apply for more than one position separately through their NJP dashboard.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can candidates with a Punjab, Sindh, or KP domicile apply for these MoFA posts?**
No. All 32 vacancies announced in this batch are strictly earmarked for candidates holding a verified Balochistan Domicile / Local Certificate under the federal quota.

**Q2: What is the last date to submit the application?**
The last date for online application submission on the National Job Portal is **30 November 2026**.

**Q3: Do I need to send physical copies of certificates to the Foreign Office in Islamabad?**
No. Applications are accepted strictly online via `njp.gov.pk`. Shortlisted candidates will be instructed to bring physical documents at the time of practical skill tests and formal interviews.

**Q4: Is any application fee required for MoFA jobs on NJP?**
No. Applying on the National Job Portal is completely free of cost.
### Official Links & Verification Resources

- **Apply Online via National Job Portal:** [njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk)
- **Ministry of Foreign Affairs Official Website:** [mofa.gov.pk](https://mofa.gov.pk)
- **Related Verified Federal Job Coverage:** [NEPRA Support Staff Jobs 2026](/jobs/nepra-support-staff-jobs-2026), [Cabinet Division Driver Jobs 2026](/jobs/cabinet-division-driver-jobs-bps-04-2026)

content: # Punjab Police Constable Jobs 2026: 1,170 Vacancies for Rajanpur & Rahim Yar Khan (BPS-07)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Recruitment Notice & Distinct District Allocation:**
> - **Issuing Authority:** Inspector General of Police (IGP) Punjab / District Police Officers (DPO) Rajanpur & Rahim Yar Khan
> - **Scale of Pay:** Basic Pay Scale 07 (BPS-07)
> - **Application Window:** 12 October 2026 to **31 October 2026**
> - **Total Vacancies:** **1,170 Posts** across two targeted southern Punjab districts:
>   - **Rahim Yar Khan:** 718 Constables / Lady Constables + 1 Driver Constable
>   - **Rajanpur (Settled + Tribal / De-excluded Areas):** 300 Constables / Lady Constables + 1 Driver Constable
>   - **Tehsil Rojhan (Special Sub-Quota):** 150 Constables / Lady Constables
> - **Application Fee:** Rs. 300 (payable in cash at respective District Police Lines upon form submission)
> - **Submission Mode:** Strictly in-person at District Police Lines
## Distinct Regional Eligibility & Relaxation Framework
This district-specific recruitment drive features specialized academic and age relaxation terms officially granted to address staffing needs in the border and tribal corridors of Southern Punjab:

| REGION / JURISDICTION | CADRES ANNOUNCED | MINIMUM ACADEMIC ELIGIBILITY | AGE LIMIT (AS OF 31 OCT 2026) | QUOTAS RESERVED |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rahim Yar Khan (Settled)** | Constable / Lady Constable | Matriculation (SSC) with **50% marks** | **18 to 22 Years** | 15% Women, 5% Minorities, 10% Ex-Army |
| **Rajanpur (Settled)** | Constable / Lady Constable | Matriculation (SSC) with **50% marks** | **18 to 22 Years** | 15% Women, 5% Minorities, 10% Ex-Army |
| **Rajanpur (Tribal / De-excluded)** | Constable / Lady Constable | Matriculation (SSC) **Pass** (No % cutoff) | **18 to 25 Years** | 15% Women, 5% Minorities, 10% Ex-Army |
| **Tehsil Rojhan (Rajanpur)** | Constable / Lady Constable | Matriculation (SSC) with **33% marks** | **18 to 30 Years** (Relaxed) | 15% Women, 5% Minorities, 10% Ex-Army |
| **Driver Constables (Both Dists)** | Driver Constable (BPS-07) | Matric Pass + Valid LTV License + 2 Yrs Exp | **21 to 30 Years** | Open Merit / Ex-Army Quota |
## Physical Measurement & Endurance Standards
Applicants must satisfy rigorous physical measurements and timed endurance benchmarks:

### 1. Physical Measurements
- **Male Height (Settled & Rojhan):** Minimum **5 feet 7 inches** (170.18 cm)
- **Male Height (Rajanpur Tribal Area):** Relaxed to **5 feet 5 inches** (165.1 cm)
- **Female Height (Across all areas):** Minimum **5 feet 2 inches** (157.48 cm)
- **Male Chest (Settled & Rojhan):** **33 inches** unexpanded to **34.5 inches** expanded (minimum 1.5-inch expansion)
- **Male Chest (Rajanpur Tribal Area):** **31 inches** unexpanded to **32.5 inches** expanded

### 2. Timed Running Endurance Test
- **Male Candidates:** 1.6 kilometers (1 mile) in **7 minutes** flat.
- **Female Candidates:** 1.6 kilometers (1 mile) in **10 minutes** flat.
## Step-by-Step Application Procedure

1. **Download Application Form:** Visit the official Punjab Police website at [punjabpolice.gov.pk](https://punjabpolice.gov.pk/) and download the prescribed recruitment form for Constables/Driver Constables.
2. **Assemble Required Dossier:**
   - Completed application form.
   - Attested copies of Educational Certificates / Sanad (Matriculation showing marks percentage).
   - Attested copy of Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC).
   - Attested copy of District Domicile Certificate (must belong to Rahim Yar Khan or Rajanpur).
   - Character Certificate from head of educational institution last attended.
   - Eight (08) passport-sized photographs (blue background, attested on back).
   - For Driver Constables: Attested copy of valid LTV driving license and driving experience certificate.
   - For Ex-Army Candidates: Discharge certificate / pension book copy.
3. **Physical Submission:** Submit the complete file in person at the respective District Police Lines:
   - **Rahim Yar Khan:** Police Lines, Rahim Yar Khan.
   - **Rajanpur & Rojhan:** Police Lines, Rajanpur.
4. **Application Fee:** Pay **Rs. 300** cash at the submission counter and receive your official stamped submission diary slip.
5. **Deadline:** All files must be submitted before the closing bell on **Saturday, 31 October 2026**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Critical Candidate Safeguards:**
> - Applications submitted by mail, courier, or online will **not** be entertained.
> - Candidates applying for multiple cadres (e.g., General Constable and Driver Constable) must submit separate forms with separate fee slips.
> - Incomplete dossiers or candidates failing height/chest measurements will be disqualified on spot without fee refund.
## Recruitment Schedule & Selection Stages

The recruitment proceeds through five transparent stages supervised by the Recruitment Board:
1. **Stage 1 (Initial Scrutiny):** Document verification and physical measurement (Height & Chest).
2. **Stage 2 (Physical Endurance):** Timed 1.6 km running test.
3. **Stage 3 (Written Examination):** 100-mark screening test comprising English, Urdu, General Knowledge, Mathematics, and Islamic/Ethics Studies.
4. **Stage 4 (Interview & Psychological Assessment):** Oral interview assessing personality, communication, and departmental aptitude.
5. **Stage 5 (Medical Examination & Police Verification):** Comprehensive physical fitness clearance through District Health Authority and background character verification.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can candidates from other Punjab districts apply for Rajanpur or Rahim Yar Khan?**
No. Only permanent residents holding a verified Domicile and CNIC of District Rahim Yar Khan or District Rajanpur (including Tehsil Rojhan and tribal areas) are eligible.

**Q2: What is the age limit for Tehsil Rojhan applicants?**
Candidates with domicile of Tehsil Rojhan benefit from an upper age limit of 30 years (18 to 30 years), compared to 22 years for settled districts.

**Q3: Can female candidates apply for Driver Constable?**
No. Driver Constable positions require male applicants with valid LTV licenses. Female candidates are invited to apply for the 15% reserved Lady Constable positions.

**Q4: What is the deadline to submit the application form?**
The final deadline for physical submission at the respective District Police Lines is **Saturday, 31 October 2026**.
## Official Verification Links

- **Official Punjab Police Portal:** [punjabpolice.gov.pk](https://punjabpolice.gov.pk/)
- **Government of Punjab Official Portal:** [punjab.gov.pk](https://punjab.gov.pk/)
- **Related CareerDost Guides:** [Sindh Government Jobs 2026 Guide](/jobs/sindh-government-jobs-2026-spsc-sts-vacancies-apply-online), [Bank of Punjab Jobs 2026](/jobs/bank-of-punjab-jobs-2026-sukkur-relationship-manager-agri)

content: # NEPRA Jobs 2026: Driver, Security Guard, Aaya and Dispatch Rider
## Regulatory Support Staff Recruitment & Vacancy Overview

The **National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA)**, the statutory federal regulator responsible for power generation, transmission, and distribution across Pakistan, has officially announced **4 regular support staff vacancies**.

As verified on the **National Jobs Portal (NJP)** under advertisement reference **PID(I) 3777/26**, these positions are reserved exclusively under the **Balochistan Provincial Quota / Balochistan Initiative**. Successful candidates will join NEPRA's permanent support cadre under the **Special Pay Group** at its corporate headquarters in Islamabad.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Key Verified Facts (NEPRA Balochistan Requisitions on NJP):**
> - **Recruiting Authority:** National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA), Government of Pakistan.
> - **Advertisement Reference:** PID(I) 3777/26.
> - **Pay Structure:** **Special Pay Group** (Regular regulatory pay scale + standard allowances).
> - **Total Vacancies:** **04 Regular Positions** (Driver: 1, Security Guard: 1, Aaya: 1, Dispatch Rider: 1).
> - **Mandatory Domicile:** **Balochistan Province exclusively.** Candidates from other provinces are not eligible.
> - **Age Ceiling:** Maximum **30 years**, with **10 years general age relaxation** explicitly granted on NJP (allowing eligible candidates up to **40 years** to apply).
> - **Gender Specification:** The position of **Aaya** is strictly restricted to **Female candidates** as officially specified on NJP Requisition 9872.
> - **Application Channel:** Strictly online through [njp.gov.pk](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/search).
> - **Application Fee:** **Rs. 0 (Free)** via NJP.
> - **Application Deadline:** **19 November 2026** (Online portal closes at 23:59 PKT).
## Cadre-Wise Breakdown, Qualifications & Licence Matrix
The table below outlines the four support staff positions open for Balochistan domicile holders:

| Post Title | Grade | NJP Requisition ID | Vacancies | Minimum Education | Mandatory Licence / Skills | Gender Criteria | Maximum Age | Closing Date |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Driver** | Special Pay Group | **Job ID 9874** | 01 Post | Primary or equivalent | Valid **LTV driving licence** | All | 30 Yrs (+10 Yrs relaxation) | 19 Nov 2026 |
| **Security Guard** | Special Pay Group | **Job ID 9873** | 01 Post | Primary or equivalent | Physically fit, vigilant security conduct | All | 30 Yrs (+10 Yrs relaxation) | 19 Nov 2026 |
| **Aaya** | Special Pay Group | **Job ID 9872** | 01 Post | Primary or equivalent | Institutional housekeeping & support | **Female Only** | 30 Yrs (+10 Yrs relaxation) | 19 Nov 2026 |
| **Dispatch Rider** | Special Pay Group | **Job ID 9871** | 01 Post | Matric or equivalent | Valid **motorcycle driving licence** | All | 30 Yrs (+10 Yrs relaxation) | 19 Nov 2026 |
## Detailed Job Responsibilities & Operational Functions

### 1. Driver (Special Pay Group — NJP Job ID 9874)
- **Official Transport:** Safely operate NEPRA authority sedans, operational vans, and staff transport vehicles for official business.
- **Vehicle Inspection:** Conduct daily maintenance checks on engine oil, radiator coolant, brake fluid, battery health, and tire pressure.
- **Logbook Maintenance:** Accurately maintain vehicle journey logbooks, fuel vouchers, meter readings, and trip timings.
- **Road Safety Compliance:** Strict adherence to traffic laws, speed limits, and authority parking guidelines.

### 2. Security Guard (Special Pay Group — NJP Job ID 9873)
- **Premises Security:** Guard NEPRA headquarters gates, entrances, parking bays, and perimeter barriers.
- **Access Control & Visitor Screening:** Inspect incoming visitors, verify identification credentials, check entry passes, and operate metal detection equipment.
- **Patrol & Incident Reporting:** Conduct regular foot patrols across authority buildings and report safety hazards or irregularities immediately to security supervisors.
- **Emergency Response:** Assist during fire drills, emergency evacuations, and perimeter lockdowns.

### 3. Aaya (Special Pay Group — NJP Job ID 9872)
- **Dedicated Female Cadre:** In accordance with NJP Requisition 9872, this post is specifically designated for female personnel.
- **Office Housekeeping:** Maintain clean, sanitary conditions in executive washrooms, ladies' common areas, and designated meeting rooms.
- **Staff Support:** Provide basic office hospitality and domestic support to female executives and administrative officers.
- **Care & Cleanliness:** Ensure hygiene standards and supply replenishment in office facilities.

### 4. Dispatch Rider (Special Pay Group — NJP Job ID 9871)
- **Official Mail Delivery:** Promptly deliver official letters, regulatory notifications, court notices, and inter-ministerial files across federal offices in Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
- **Motorcycle Maintenance:** Maintain the official motorcycle in clean, roadworthy mechanical condition, ensuring regular servicing and safety checks.
- **Dispatch Documentation:** Securely obtain signatures, receipt stamps, and delivery acknowledgments in official delivery dispatch registers.
- **Secure Custody:** Guarantee the safety and confidentiality of documents during transit.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (NJP)
Candidates must apply online via the National Jobs Portal:

1. **Navigate to NJP Search:** Visit [https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/search](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/search) or access the direct vacancy pages ([9874 - Driver](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9874), [9873 - Security Guard](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9873), [9872 - Aaya](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9872), [9871 - Dispatch Rider](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9871)).
2. **Log In / Register:** Sign in with your CNIC. First-time users can register with their basic details and mobile number.
3. **Profile Setup:** Enter personal details and select **Balochistan** as your domicile province.
4. **Record Education & Licences:**
   - For **Driver**, enter your Primary school certificate and valid LTV licence details.
   - For **Dispatch Rider**, enter your Matriculation certificate and valid motorcycle driving licence details.
   - For **Aaya**, confirm female gender selection in your profile.
5. **Apply for Vacancy:** Select the relevant NEPRA post under PID(I) 3777/26 and click **Apply Now**.
6. **No Paper Challans:** Applying via NJP is free of charge. No physical documents need to be mailed at this stage.
7. **Deadline:** Submit your application before **19 November 2026** at 23:59 PKT.

### Who can apply for NEPRA support staff jobs?
Only candidates possessing a valid **domicile certificate of Balochistan province** are eligible to apply under this dedicated quota recruitment (PID(I) 3777/26).

### What is the age limit for NEPRA support staff jobs?
The basic age limit is 30 years as of the closing date. However, the official NJP portal listings specify a **10-year general age relaxation**, allowing eligible candidates up to **40 years** of age to apply.

### Can male candidates apply for the post of Aaya?
No. The official NJP requisition (Job ID 9872) explicitly specifies **Gender: Female** for the Aaya vacancy.

### What licences are required for Driver and Dispatch Rider?
- **Driver (Job ID 9874):** Requires a valid Light Transport Vehicle (LTV) driving licence.
- **Dispatch Rider (Job ID 9871):** Requires a valid motorcycle driving licence.

### What is the closing date to apply?
The online application window closes on **19 November 2026**.

### Is there an application fee?

content: # NTC Jobs 2026: Assistant Private Secretary and Assistant Divisional Engineer
## Federal Employment Notice & Corporation Overview

The **National Telecommunication Corporation (NTC)**, the official telecommunications service provider for the Government of Pakistan, armed forces, and public sector organizations, has officially invited online applications for **two permanent regular civil vacancies**.

As verified directly on the official **National Jobs Portal (NJP)** on 28 October 2026 under the federal government's Balochistan employment initiatives, these vacancies include one officer-level position of **Assistant Divisional Engineer (BPS-17)** and one executive secretarial post of **Assistant Private Secretary (BPS-16)**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Key Verified Facts (NTC Balochistan Requisitions on NJP):**
> - **Recruiting Authority:** National Telecommunication Corporation (NTC), Government of Pakistan.
> - **Mandatory Domicile:** **Balochistan Province exclusively.** Candidates holding domiciles from Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Islamabad Capital Territory, AJK, or Gilgit-Baltistan are **not eligible** for this specific quota advertisement.
> - **Total Vacancies:** **02 Regular Positions** (01 Engineer + 01 APS).
> - **Pay Scales:** Basic Pay Scales **BPS-17** and **BPS-16** (with standard federal civil service allowances and pension benefits).
> - **Application Channel:** Strictly online through [njp.gov.pk](https://www.njp.gov.pk/index.php/jobs/9860).
> - **Application Fee:** **Rs. 0 (Free of charge)** via National Jobs Portal.
> - **Application Deadline:** **17 November 2026** (Online portal closes at 23:59 PKT).
## Cadre-Wise Breakdown & Eligibility Matrix
The two vacancies carry distinct professional qualifications, technical requirements, and age ceilings:

| Post Title | Grade | NJP Requisition ID | Vacancies | Minimum Qualification | Mandatory Accreditations | Maximum Age Limit | Closing Date |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Assistant Divisional Engineer** | **BPS-17** | **Job ID 9860** | 01 Post | Bachelor's Degree in relevant Engineering field | **Valid PEC Registration** mandatory | **35 Years** (Federal rules applied) | 17 Nov 2026 |
| **Assistant Private Secretary (APS)** | **BPS-16** | **Job ID 9861** | 01 Post | Recognized Bachelor's or Associate Degree | Complete list of accepted disciplines verified | **33 Years** (Federal rules applied) | 17 Nov 2026 |
## 1. Assistant Divisional Engineer (BPS-17 — NJP Job ID 9860)
### Accepted Engineering Disciplines

Applicants must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree (BE / BS / BSc Engineering) recognized by HEC and must be registered as a **Professional Engineer with the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC)** in any of the following disciplines:

- BS / BE Computer Engineering
- BS / BE Electrical Engineering (General / Power / Electronics / Telecom)
- BS / BE Telecommunication Engineering
- BS / BE Electronics Engineering
- BS / BE Computer Systems Engineering
- BE Software Engineering
- BE Mechanical Engineering
- BE Data Science / Computer Science
### Core Technical Duties & Key Responsibilities
The Assistant Divisional Engineer assists in the management, planning, and operation of NTC's national ICT infrastructure:

1. **National Data Centre Operations:** Manage server racks, enterprise blade servers, storage area networks (SAN), and critical data centre power systems including rectifiers, battery banks, and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS).
2. **Cloud & Virtualization Platforms:** Oversee enterprise cloud infrastructure, virtualization clusters, software-defined networks, and cybersecurity appliances.
3. **Next Generation Networks (NGN):** Operate voice and broadband packet-switched architecture, softswitches, and Multi-Service Access Gateways (MSAGs).
4. **Transmission & Optical Networks:** Maintain high-capacity Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM), Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH), Layer-2 & Layer-3 core switches, microwave links, and Radio Access Networks (RAN).
5. **Outside Plant (OSP) Infrastructure:** Plan and supervise optical fiber networks (FTTX, GPON) and copper cable access networks.
## 2. Assistant Private Secretary (BPS-16 — NJP Job ID 9861)
### Verified Accepted Academic Qualifications
In accordance with NJP Requisition 9861, candidates must hold an authentic 14-year or 16-year degree in one of the specific approved fields:

- **Standard Bachelor Degrees:** Bachelor of Arts (BA), Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com 2 years), Bachelor of Science (BSc), B.Ed (1.5 / 2.5 Years), B.Tech (Pass).
- **Four-Year BS Degrees:** BS Accounting & Finance, BS Banking & Finance, BS Business Administration, BS Commerce, BS Management, BS Marketing, BS Public Administration, BS Computer Science (BSCS), BS Social Work, BS Arabic, BS Translation & Interpretation, BS Aviation Management.
- **Associate Degrees:** Associate Degrees in Accounting & Finance, Artificial Intelligence, Business Administration & Commerce, Computer Science, Computer Networking, Cybersecurity, Data Sciences, Digital Marketing, English, Graphic Design, Information Technology Management, Media Communication, Public Administration, or Software Engineering.
- **Religious / Specialized Diplomas:** Shahadat-ul-Aliya, Advanced Diploma in IT (ADIT), or Advanced Diploma in Software Engineering.

> [!NOTE]
> Candidates should verify that their exact degree title matches the approved NJP profile options prior to finalizing their submission.
### Core Secretarial Duties & Daily Functions
The Assistant Private Secretary supports senior NTC executive management:

1. **Office Correspondence:** Draft, type, receive, register, and dispatch official government letters, ministerial summaries, and internal memoranda.
2. **File Tracking & Registry:** Maintain official registers, case files, and document movement logs in compliance with Secretariat Instructions.
3. **Executive Scheduling:** Manage the senior officer's engagement diary, coordinate appointments, and set meeting reminders.
4. **Meeting Logistics:** Prepare formal agendas, circulate notices, take verbatim notes, draft official meeting minutes, and track implementation of decisions.
5. **Confidential Custody:** Maintain classified files and ensure secure custody of sensitive corporate and governmental telecommunications records.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (NJP)
Applications must be submitted exclusively via the National Jobs Portal:

1. **Access Verified Listings:** Navigate directly to the official vacancy pages: [Assistant Divisional Engineer (Job ID 9860)](https://www.njp.gov.pk/index.php/jobs/9860) or [Assistant Private Secretary (Job ID 9861)](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9861).
2. **Sign In or Register:** Enter your CNIC number and password. New candidates can create an account using an active mobile number.
3. **Profile Completion:** Complete personal details and confirm that your **Balochistan domicile** is correctly indicated.
4. **Upload Academic & Accreditation Records:** For BPS-17, ensure your PEC registration number and engineering degree details are entered. For BPS-16, select your matching degree discipline.
5. **Submit Application:** Click **Apply Now** for your desired position. No postal documents or physical challans are required at this stage.
6. **Closing Date:** Complete your online submission before **17 November 2026** at 23:59 PKT.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### Is Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) registration mandatory for Assistant Divisional Engineer?
Yes. The official NJP requisition explicitly states that candidates applying for the BPS-17 Assistant Divisional Engineer post must hold a recognized Bachelor's degree in engineering and active registration with the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC).

### Can candidates from Punjab, Sindh, or KP apply for these NTC jobs?
No. Both posts are advertised strictly under the federal provincial quota for candidates possessing an authentic **domicile of Balochistan**.

### What is the upper age limit for these positions?
- **Assistant Divisional Engineer (BPS-17):** Maximum 35 years.
- **Assistant Private Secretary (BPS-16):** Maximum 33 years.
Both age limits are inclusive of standard federal government age-relaxation rules.

### Is there an application fee for NTC jobs on NJP?
No. Applying through the official National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk) is completely free of charge.

### When is the deadline to apply online?
The deadline to submit online applications via the National Jobs Portal is **17 November 2026**.
## Official Sources & Direct Verification Links

- **Official Application Portal:** [National Jobs Portal — Job ID 9860 (Engineer)](https://www.njp.gov.pk/index.php/jobs/9860) | [Job ID 9861 (APS)](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9861)
- **Recruiting Corporation:** [National Telecommunication Corporation (NTC)](https://ntc.net.pk/)
- **Accreditation Authority:** [Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC)](https://pec.org.pk/)

## Federal Project Recruitment & Ministry Overview

The **Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives**, Government of Pakistan, has officially announced **2 executive project positions** on a contract basis under the **Project Pay Scale (PPS-6)**, located at the ministry's federal headquarters in Islamabad.

As verified directly on the official **National Jobs Portal (NJP)** on 27 October 2026, these vacancies include one post of **Accountant** (Equivalent to PPS-6) and one post of **Assistant Private Secretary - APS** (Equivalent to PPS-6).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Critical Quota & Merit Distinction (Nationwide Open Opportunity):**
> Unlike the provincial Balochistan-quota jobs announced under special packages, these Ministry of Planning vacancies are **Nationwide / Open Merit positions**. Qualified male and female candidates from all provinces and territories of Pakistan (**Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Islamabad Capital Territory, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan**) are eligible to apply.

> [!WARNING]
> **Urgent Deadline Alert:** Applications for these positions close on **02 November 2026** (only a 5-day application window remains from 28 October). Candidates should submit their online profiles promptly via the National Jobs Portal.

The two project vacancies carry the following specifications:

| **Accountant** | **PPS-6** (Contract) | **Job ID 9842** | 01 Post | **Nationwide / Merit** | B.Com / Associate Degree / BS Accounting & Finance / ACCA / MBA Finance | 1+ Year in cash book handling & AGPR reconciliation | 45 Years | **02 Nov 2026** |

## Job Roles & Official Duties

### 1. Accountant — Equivalent to PPS-6 (NJP Job ID 9842)
- **NIS Preparation:** Prepare New Item Statements (NIS) for development projects in coordination with planning officers.
- **Cash Book & Bill Processing:** Maintain official project cash books, handle cash receipts and payments, and verify vendor bills under public financial rules.
- **AGPR Reconciliation:** Reconcile monthly and quarterly accounts directly with the Accountant General Pakistan Revenues (AGPR).
- **Audit Compliance:** Maintain complete documentation for internal and external audits under the Project Director (PD).

### 2. Assistant Private Secretary (APS) — Equivalent to PPS-6 (NJP Job ID 9840)
- **Executive Secretariat Support:** Attend telephone communications, maintain call logs, and arrange official executive engagements.
- **Diary & Meeting Coordination:** Maintain the Officer's engagement diary, prepare briefs and papers for high-level meetings and inter-ministerial committees.
- **Shorthand & Transcription:** Take verbatim shorthand dictation, render accurate transcripts, and draft confidential ministerial memos.
- **Classified Document Movement:** Maintain classified document logs, ensure timely movement of files, and manage visitor appointments professionally.

1. **Visit NJP Requisitions:** Access the official NJP portal at [https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search) or directly visit [Job ID 9842 (Accountant)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/9842) and [Job ID 9840 (APS)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/9840).

5. **No Application Fee:** There is no fee required to apply on the National Jobs Portal. Do not deposit any money into third-party accounts.
6. **Urgent Deadline:** Ensure your submission is completed before **02 November 2026** at 23:59 PKT.

Candidates with a recognized Bachelor's degree (BA, B.Com, BSc, BS Accounting, ACCA, etc.) holding a domicile from **any province of Pakistan** (Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan, ICT, AJK, GB) are eligible to apply on open merit.

### What is the nature of employment for PPS-6 posts?
These are project-based contract appointments under the federal government's Standard Project Pay Scale (PPS-6), offering attractive lump-sum project salaries.

### What is the upper age limit?
- **Accountant (PPS-6):** Maximum 45 years.
- **Assistant Private Secretary (PPS-6):** Maximum 50 years.

The application deadline is **02 November 2026**.

No. Applying through the official National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk) is completely free.

## Higher Education Commission Recruitment Overview

The **Higher Education Commission (HEC)**, the apex federal body regulating and funding tertiary education in Pakistan, has officially announced **2 regular civil vacancies** reserved exclusively under the **Balochistan Provincial Quota / Balochistan Initiative**.

Qualified candidates holding an authentic domicile of Balochistan are eligible to apply through the centralized portal.

> **Verified Recruitment Facts (HEC Balochistan Requisitions on NJP):**
> - **Recruiting Authority:** Higher Education Commission (HEC), Government of Pakistan.
> - **Mandatory Domicile:** **Balochistan exclusively.** Applicants from Punjab, Sindh, KP, Islamabad, AJK, or GB are not eligible for this quota advertisement.

> - **Pay Scales:** Basic Pay Scales **BPS-16** and **BPS-11** (+ regular federal government allowances).

The two vacancies announced by the Higher Education Commission carry the following specific qualifications and experience standards:

| Post Title | Grade | NJP Requisition ID | Vacancies | Minimum Education | Experience / Skills Required | Age Bracket | Application Deadline |

| **Accountant** | BPS-16 | **Job ID 9925** | 01 Post | B.Com / BBA / Associate Degree in Commerce (HEC Recognized) | 3 Years service experience in accounting in Government / Semi-Govt / Autonomous body | 21 to 40 Years | 10 Nov 2026 |
| **Lower Division Clerk (LDC)** | BPS-11 | **Job ID 9926** | 01 Post | Secondary School Certificate / Matriculation | Minimum 30 wpm typing speed; 3-week NITB IT course mandatory post-hiring | 18 to 35 Years | 10 Nov 2026 |
## Detailed Job Responsibilities & Skills

### 1. Accountant (BPS-16 — NJP Job ID 9925)
- **Financial Ledger Management:** Maintain cash books, journal registers, grant disbursement records, and financial ledgers for HEC development and recurring accounts.
- **Audit & AGPR Reconciliation:** Prepare monthly and annual reconciliation statements with the Accountant General Pakistan Revenues (AGPR) and scheduled banks.
- **Billing & Vouchers:** Scrutinize procurement bills, travel vouchers, project funding disbursements, and scholarship allocations in compliance with Public Procurement Regulatory Authority (PPRA) and federal financial rules.
- **Tax Compliance:** Handle withholding tax deductions, sales tax adjustments, and generate official compliance returns.

### 2. Lower Division Clerk - LDC (BPS-11 — NJP Job ID 9926)
- **Clerical & Registry Work:** Maintain file registers, diary registers, and inward/outward dak in assigned HEC divisions.
- **Typing & Word Processing:** Prepare official notes, notifications, office memorandums, and meeting minutes at a minimum certified speed of 30 wpm.
- **Mandatory IT Training:** As stipulated in federal establishment rules, selected LDC appointees must successfully complete a mandatory **3-week Basic IT Training Course (including MS Office)** conducted by the National Information Technology Board (NITB) within their probationary period.

1. **Visit NJP Listing:** Navigate to [https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/balochistan](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/balochistan) or directly access [Job ID 9925 (Accountant)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/9925) and [Job ID 9926 (LDC)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/9926).

### What is the qualification required for HEC Accountant (BPS-16)?
Candidates must hold a B.Com (2 or 3 years), BBA, or Associate Degree in Commerce/Business Administration from an HEC-recognized university, along with 3 years of relevant accounting service experience in a government, semi-government, or autonomous organization.

### What is the age limit for HEC Balochistan jobs?
- **Accountant (BPS-16):** 21 to 40 years.
- **Lower Division Clerk (BPS-11):** 18 to 35 years.
Both age limits include standard federal government age relaxation.

### Is IT training mandatory before applying for LDC?
No. The 3-week basic IT training course from NITB is conducted **after recruitment** during the probationary period, as per federal establishment guidelines.

### When is the last date to apply online?
The deadline to apply via the National Jobs Portal is **10 November 2026**.

### Is there an application fee?
No. Application through the National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk) is completely free of charge.

## Executive Summary & Power Sector Initiative Overview

On **26 October 2026**, the **Central Development Working Party (CDWP)**, chaired by Federal Minister for Planning, Development & Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal, granted **approval in principle** for the installation of a high-capacity **Pilot Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)** at the **220 kV Jhimpir-I Grid Station** located in Thatta District, Sindh. With a total project valuation of **Rs. 4,394.720 million**, the initiative represents Pakistan's premier utility-scale pilot for large-scale grid energy storage.

Situated at the heart of the **Gharo-Jhimpir wind corridor**—which hosts the vast majority of Pakistan's installed wind generation capacity—the pilot BESS project is engineered to tackle the acute operational challenges of intermittent renewable energy. By storing excess generation during peak wind periods and injecting power during system stress, the facility will provide critical **grid stabilization, frequency regulation, and voltage support** for the National Transmission & Despatch Company (NTDC) power network.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Verified CDWP Power Sector Facts & Clear Scope Boundaries (27 October 2026):**
> - **Official Authority & Release:** CDWP / Press Information Department (PID PR No. 403), 26 October 2026.
> - **Grid Station Location:** 220 kV Jhimpir-I Grid Station, Thatta District, Sindh.
> - **Approved Project Valuation:** **Rs. 4,394.720 Million** (Approved in Principle).
> - **Core Utility Objectives:** Power grid stabilization, dynamic frequency containment, ramp-rate mitigation, and seamless integration of renewable wind/solar energy into the national grid.
> - **What This Project IS NOT:** This is strictly an **industrial high-voltage grid infrastructure utility project**. It is **NOT** a residential solar program, household battery distribution scheme, or consumer subsidy grant.
> - **Unverified Metrics Excluded:** Storage capacity in Megawatt-hours (MWh), precise battery chemistry (lithium-ion vs. flow battery), EPC contractor bidding schedules, and final commercial operation dates (COD) were **not disclosed** in the official PID release and are not invented here.
## The Strategic Role of Jhimpir-I in Pakistan's Renewable Transition
The Thatta-Jhimpir wind corridor experiences rapid fluctuations in wind velocity, generating sharp generation ramps that strain conventional thermal and hydel spinning reserves:

1. **Mitigating Wind Curtailment:** During night-time periods of high wind and low system demand, grid operators often curtail wind farms to prevent transmission line overloads. The BESS will absorb this surplus clean electricity instead of wasting it.
2. **Dynamic Frequency Control:** Grid-scale battery systems respond within milliseconds to frequency anomalies, providing black-start capability and replacing slower thermal peaking plants.
3. **Decarbonizing National Energy Mix:** By successfully proving utility-scale battery integration, the Jhimpir-I pilot will serve as a technical blueprint for future renewable energy storage across Balochistan and Punjab.
## CDWP Power & Infrastructure Approvals Comparison

| Project Name | Sector & Sub-Sector | Approved Value | Strategic Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pilot BESS (Jhimpir-I Grid Station)** | **Power (Transmission & Storage)** | **Rs. 4,394.720 Million** | **Grid Stabilization & Renewable Wind Integration in Sindh** |
| **PM Solar Scheme for Merged Districts** | Power (Off-Grid Solarization) | Rs. 13,323.000 Million | Off-Grid Household Solar Solutions (Referred to ECNEC) |
| **National Highway N-45 Widening (Sec-I)** | Transport & Communications | Rs. 17,012.323 Million | Upgrade Chakdara–Timergara 39km Corridor (Referred to ECNEC) |
| **Overhead Bridge Shahdara N-5** | Transport (Urban Congestion) | Rs. 7,492.050 Million | 8-Lane Flyover & Connecting Link Roads at Imamia Colony |
## Technical Roadmap & Public Guidance
Following CDWP in-principle clearance, the Jhimpir-I BESS project enters the administrative and technical implementation cycle:

- **ECNEC Ratification & Financing:** Submission of the finalized PC-I to the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) for formal financial sanctioning.
- **International Competitive Bidding (ICB):** The National Transmission & Despatch Company (NTDC) will issue international tenders for procurement, engineering, and installation of specialized containerized battery storage enclosures, power conversion systems (PCS), and supervisory control software.
- **Consumer Scam Alert:** Citizens should be wary of deceptive ads offering "Government Battery Connections" or "Jhimpir Solar Subsidies". As an industrial transmission asset, no public registration or citizen application forms exist.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What is the Jhimpir-I Battery Energy Storage Project?
It is a utility-scale pilot project approved in principle by the CDWP on 26 October 2026 to install a modern Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at the 220 kV Jhimpir-I Grid Station in Sindh at an estimated cost of Rs 4.394 billion.

### What is the primary purpose of the battery system at Jhimpir?
The facility will stabilize the national electricity transmission grid, regulate frequency, and enable the seamless absorption of intermittent wind and solar energy generated in the Jhimpir corridor.

### Can homeowners in Sindh apply for solar batteries under this project?
No. The project is an industrial high-voltage grid installation operated by transmission utilities. It is not a household solar or consumer battery distribution scheme.

### When will the Jhimpir-I BESS project be completed?
The project has received in-principle approval from the CDWP. Detailed engineering timelines, procurement tenders, and commissioning dates will be notified following formal ECNEC ratification.

### Where is the Jhimpir-I Grid Station located?
The 220 kV Jhimpir-I Grid Station is situated in Thatta District, Sindh, within Pakistan’s designated southern renewable wind energy corridor.

content: # Daanish Schools Expansion 2026: CDWP In-Principle Approval for Sindh & Multi-Region Setup
## Executive Summary & CDWP Approval Overview

On **26 October 2026**, the **Central Development Working Party (CDWP)**, convened under the chairmanship of Federal Minister for Planning, Development & Special Initiatives and Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission Ahsan Iqbal, granted **approval in principle** for the multi-regional expansion of the **Daanish Schools network**. In an important strategic milestone for educational equity in southern Pakistan, **Sindh** has been formally included among the recipient provinces and territories alongside Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK), Gilgit-Baltistan (GB), Balochistan, and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP).

The multi-region establishment project was approved at an initial baseline allocation of **Rs. 122.400 million**, accompanied by explicit instructions from the Planning Commission to **rationalize project costs** and refine technical parameters before full-scale capital rollout. In parallel, the CDWP separately approved in principle dedicated capital projects for a flagship Daanish School in **ICT, Kuri, Islamabad (valued at Rs. 7,357.233 million)** and a Daanish School in **District Kan Mehterzai, Qila Saifullah, Balochistan (valued at Rs. 4,527.838 million)**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Verified CDWP Approval Facts & Project Status (27 October 2026):**
> - **Forum & Meeting Date:** Central Development Working Party (CDWP), Islamabad — 26 October 2026 (PID PR No. 403).
> - **Project Scope:** Establishment of Daanish Schools across Sindh, Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, AJK, and Gilgit-Baltistan.
> - **Financial Baseline:** Rs. 122.400 million (Subject to mandatory cost rationalization).
> - **Approval Type:** **IN PRINCIPLE ONLY.** Detailed site allocations, structural PC-I revisions, and provincial coordination remain underway.
> - **Current Admissions Status:** **NO ADMISSIONS ARE OPEN IN SINDH.** Specific campus locations, opening dates, and student entry examinations have **NOT** been announced for Sindh.
> - **Public Advisory:** Beware of fraudulent social media pages offering advance admissions, registration vouchers, or test dates for Sindh Daanish Schools. Official announcements will be released exclusively through the Federal Ministry of Education and provincial education departments.
## Understanding the Daanish School Model & Federal Vision

Originally pioneered in Punjab, Daanish Schools are purpose-built, government-funded residential educational institutions designed to break generational poverty by offering marginalized children world-class education:

1. **Target Demographics:** Admission is strictly reserved for the most underprivileged, orphaned, or low-income students who demonstrate exceptional academic aptitude.
2. **Comprehensive Boarding Facility:** Selected students receive **100% free education**, state-of-the-art boarding and hostel facilities, balanced nutrition, modern computer laboratories, books, uniforms, and sports amenities.
3. **Federal Alignment with URAAN Pakistan:** The national expansion into Sindh and remote regions aligns with the federal government's *URAAN Pakistan* human capital modernization framework, aiming to bridge the stark urban-rural educational divide.
## CDWP Meeting Summary: Key Education Initiatives at a Glance

| Initiative / Project | Geographic Scope | Approved Cost | Forum Recommendation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Daanish Schools Multi-Region Setup** | **Sindh, Balochistan, KP, AJK & GB** | **Rs. 122.400 Million** | **Approved in Principle** (Cost Rationalization Instructed) |
| **Daanish School ICT** | Kuri, Islamabad Capital Territory | Rs. 7,357.233 Million | Approved in Principle |
| **Daanish School Kan Mehterzai** | District Qila Saifullah, Balochistan | Rs. 4,527.838 Million | Approved in Principle (Technical Review Committee) |
| **PM Youth Development Centers** | Nationwide Multi-Province | Rs. 4,144.854 Million | Approved in Principle (Third-Party Validation) |
| **PM Talent Hunt Sports League** | Nationwide Phase-I | Rs. 3,988.056 Million | Approved (Pakistan Sports Board Steering Committee) |
## Next Regulatory Steps for Sindh Implementation
Before ground is broken or student admissions commence in Sindh, the project must navigate standard federal-provincial planning milestones:

- **Cost Rationalization Review:** The Ministry of Federal Education & Professional Training must submit a refined financial and architectural breakdown aligning with CDWP directives.
- **District Land Allocation:** The Government of Sindh (School Education & Literacy Department) will identify and transfer state-owned land parcels in historically underserved rural districts.
- **Governance Framework:** Formulation of provincial management boards and academic standards modeled on the autonomous Daanish Schools Authority.
- **Entrance Examination Schedule:** Once infrastructure is operational, public admissions notices with clear socio-economic eligibility criteria will be published in regional and national dailies.
## Anti-Scam Advisory for Parents and Guardians
Following national media coverage of the CDWP meeting, unscrupulous elements may attempt to solicit money under the guise of school registrations:

- **No Application Fees:** Legitimate admissions into Daanish Schools are entirely free of cost; no application forms are sold by private vendors.
- **No Admissions Agents:** The federal government does not appoint private consultants, political intermediaries, or third-party WhatsApp groups to sell seats.
- **Verify Direct Sources:** Always verify educational updates through official government portals (`mofept.gov.pk` and `planning.gov.pk`) or verified CareerDost coverage.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What did the CDWP approve regarding Daanish Schools on 26 October 2026?
The CDWP approved in principle the establishment of Daanish Schools across Sindh, Balochistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, AJK, and Gilgit-Baltistan with a preliminary budget of Rs. 122.400 million, subject to cost rationalization.

### Have admissions opened for Daanish Schools in Sindh?
No. The project is at the preliminary planning and cost-rationalization stage. No admissions, application forms, or academic schedules have been announced for Sindh.

### In which districts of Sindh will Daanish Schools be constructed?
Specific district locations in Sindh have not yet been officially finalized. The locations will be determined in consultation between the Federal Ministry of Education and the Government of Sindh.

### Is Daanish School education free for students?
Yes. Daanish Schools operate on a fully sponsored social welfare model providing free tuition, books, uniforms, boarding, and meals for deserving, low-income students who pass the merit entrance assessment.

### When will construction begin?
Construction schedules will be announced once the revised PC-I clears cost rationalization and land allocation is completed by the provincial authorities.

### Strategic Executive Hiring at National Bank of Pakistan
The **National Bank of Pakistan (NBP)**, the nation's premier commercial and state-owned financial institution, has published a fresh batch of senior lateral opportunities on its official digital recruitment portal (`nbp.rozeegpt.ai`). Published on 25 October 2026, this intake invites seasoned banking, audit, IT infrastructure, human resources, and recovery specialists to join high-impact strategic teams at its Karachi Head Office and Hyderabad Regional Wing.

### Positions Available in the 25 October 2026 Batch
1. **Unit Head – External Audit (AGP) (AVP) — Karachi:** Liaises with the Auditor General of Pakistan (AGP) audit inspection teams, manages bank compliance records, and coordinates timely resolution of government audit observations.
2. **Unit Head – NOCs & Permissions (AVP) — Karachi:** Oversees regulatory clearances, institutional permissions, and statutory approvals in accordance with State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) and banking court requirements.
3. **Unit Head – Fraud Cases (VP) — Karachi:** Investigates high-value operational and financial fraud cases, analyzes fraudulent transaction patterns, and formulates preventive fraud risk frameworks.
4. **Systems Administrator (AVP) — Karachi:** Manages mission-critical server environments, operating system security, enterprise directory architectures, and high-availability core banking computing clusters.
5. **Unit Head – HR Information System (HRIS) (AVP) — Karachi:** Leads human capital management software operations, digital employee databases, and automated HR workflow integration.
6. **Unit Head – HR Analytics (AVP) — Karachi:** Formulates workforce analytics, predictive attrition modeling, compensation metrics, and productivity dashboards for senior executive leadership.
7. **Regional SAM Coordinator – Small & Medium Recovery Wing (South) (AVP) — Hyderabad:** Spearheads non-performing loan (NPL) recovery operations, legal workout plans, and asset settlements across southern regional SME portfolios.

### Quick Summary Table
- **Institution:** National Bank of Pakistan (NBP)
- **Published Date:** 25 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **Friday, 06 November 2026**
- **Target Career Levels:** Assistant Vice President (AVP) & Vice President (VP)
- **Employment Type:** Regular / Contractual Banking Staff

- **Minimum Experience:** 5 to 8+ years of post-qualification specialized experience
- **Official ATS Portal:** [nbp.rozeegpt.ai](https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/)
- **Corporate Website:** [nbp.com.pk](https://www.nbp.com.pk/)

### General Qualifications & Eligibility Criteria
- **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree (16 years of education) in Business Administration (MBA/BBA), Banking, Finance, Accounting (CA / ACCA / CMA), Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or Law from an HEC-recognized institution or reputable foreign university.
- **Experience:**
  - **AVP Roles:** Minimum 5 to 6+ years of relevant experience in a commercial bank, financial institution, or large corporate setting.
  - **VP Roles:** Minimum 7 to 8+ years of progressive track record with proven team leadership and specialized functional expertise.
- **Skill Sets:** In-depth familiarity with State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) Prudential Regulations, Basel frameworks, IFRS standards, and modern corporate governance practices.

### How to Apply Online on NBP Rozee Portal
1. Visit the direct enterprise recruitment portal: [nbp.rozeegpt.ai](https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/).
2. Review the list of active openings posted on 25 October 2026 and select the role matching your qualifications.
3. Click **Apply** next to your desired position to open the structured candidate profile form.
4. Enter your personal details, academic history, professional banking appointments, and upload your current CV.
5. Submit your application online before **Friday, 06 November 2026**. Shortlisted executives will be contacted directly for panel interviews.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
**Q1: Is `nbp.rozeegpt.ai` an officially authorized portal of NBP?**
Yes. NBP officially partners with Rozee.pk (Naseeb Networks / Monami Tech) for cloud-based applicant tracking and recruitment operations. All job listings posted under `nbp.rozeegpt.ai` are verified and authorized directly by NBP Human Resources Management Group.

**Q2: What is the application deadline for this batch?**
The deadline for all 7 positions listed in the 25 October batch is **Friday, 06 November 2026**.

**Q3: Are all roles based in Karachi?**
Six of the roles are located at the NBP Head Office in Karachi, while the **Regional SAM Coordinator (Small & Medium Recovery Wing South)** is stationed in **Hyderabad**.

### Federal Audit Career: Auditor General of Pakistan (AGP)
The **Department of the Auditor General of Pakistan (DAGP)**, the Supreme Audit Institution mandated under Articles 168–171 of the Constitution to safeguard public finances, has initiated recruitment for **31 Junior Auditor (BPS-11)** positions. Advertised under Job ID `9878` on the National Jobs Portal, this recruitment drive is specifically dedicated to eligible young graduates holding a **Balochistan domicile**.

### Key Information Table
- **Department:** Auditor General of Pakistan (AGP)
- **Field Directorate:** Office of the Director General Audit Balochistan
- **NJP Job ID:** 9878
- **Designation:** Junior Auditor
- **Scale of Pay:** BPS-11
- **Number of Posts:** 31
- **Domicile Restriction:** Balochistan
- **Academic Requirement:** Bachelor's (Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, IT)
- **Technical Skill:** Typing speed of 30 words per minute
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 30 years (inclusive of federal relaxation)
- **Application Deadline:** **09 November 2026**
- **Official Verification Link:** [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9878](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9878)

### Professional Scope & Work Environment in AGP
Unlike account-keeping roles in provincial line offices, Junior Auditors in the Auditor General's department perform oversight and external audit functions designed to detect irregularities, ensure statutory compliance, and uphold financial integrity across government expenditures:
1. **Assisting Audit Inspection Teams:** Accompanying Senior Auditors and Assistant Directors during field audit inspections of federal and provincial departments in Balochistan.
2. **Expenditure & Procurement Examination:** Reviewing public procurement tenders, purchase orders, delivery vouchers, and contract agreements against Public Procurement Regulatory Authority (PPRA) guidelines.
3. **Audit Paragraph Documentation:** Assisting in drafting preliminary audit observations (Audit Memos) and maintaining documentary evidence for audit paras.
4. **Public Accounts Committee (PAC) Record Compilation:** Organizing records, maintaining files of departmental responses, and compiling compliance reports for review by parliamentary committees.
5. **Audit Office Automation:** Utilizing AGP's specialized Audit Management Information System (AMIS) for digital work-paper archiving.

### Minimum Eligibility Requirements
- **Educational Background:** At least 2nd Class or Grade "C" Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B.Com), Banking & Finance, Accounting, Business Administration (BBA), or Information Technology (BS-IT / Computer Science) from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Typing Benchmark:** A demonstrated typing speed of **30 words per minute (wpm)** on computer.
- **Domicile:** Valid Balochistan Domicile / Local Certificate along with CNIC.
- **Age Bracket:** 18 to 25 years, plus 5 years general age relaxation (up to **30 years** on the cutoff date of 9 November 2026).

### Step-by-Step Application Procedure on NJP
1. Visit the verified listing on the National Jobs Portal: [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9878](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9878).
2. Sign in to your verified candidate account or register using your mobile and CNIC.
3. Ensure your profile records your Bachelor's degree marks, degree specialization, and typing skill.
4. Click **Apply Now** for *Auditor General of Pakistan — Junior Auditor (Job ID 9878)*.
5. Review your submitted details and save your application confirmation before **09 November 2026**.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
**Q1: How does this AGP post differ from the CGA Junior Auditor vacancy?**
While both posts carry BPS-11 and require Balochistan domicile, CGA Junior Auditors work on pre-audit and day-to-day accounts compilation in government accounts offices, whereas AGP Junior Auditors perform post-audit and external oversight of public expenditures under the Auditor General of Pakistan.

**Q2: What is the application deadline for this AGP vacancy?**
The application deadline for AGP Job ID 9878 is **Monday, 09 November 2026**.

**Q3: Is there any written or typing test?**
Yes. Shortlisted applicants will be subjected to an initial screening/written test followed by a mandatory typing test of 30 wpm before interviews.

- **Official Notification Source:** [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9862](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9862)

### Core Job Responsibilities of a Junior Auditor
Selected candidates will be posted at the Accountant General (AG) Balochistan office in Quetta and designated District Accounts Offices (DAOs) across Balochistan. As specified in official government accounting rules, core duties include:
1. **Pre-Audit & Voucher Scrutiny:** Initial scrutiny and verification of claims, government contractor bills, supplier invoices, public works payment orders, and travel allowance bills.
2. **Bookkeeping & Cash Registers:** Recording initial entries in work registers, maintenance of public ledger accounts, and updating cash books for departmental spending.
3. **Monthly Civil Accounts:** Assisting Assistant Accounts Officers (AAOs) and Senior Auditors in compiling monthly consolidated civil accounts statements and civil reconciliation registers.
4. **Pension & General Provident (GP) Fund Processing:** Sorting, verifying, and checking retirement benefit claims, family pension dockets, and GP fund advance settlements.
5. **Draft Objection Memorandums:** Preparing preliminary audit objection notes and compiling voucher files for supervisory review.

### Eligibility & Educational Criteria
Applicants must strictly satisfy the following minimum benchmarks as notified in the federal recruitment rules:
- **Educational Qualification:** 2nd Class or Grade "C" Bachelor's Degree (14 years of education) or Associate Degree Program (ADP) in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, Banking, Business Administration (BBA), or Information Technology (BS/BSc IT) from an HEC-recognized college or university.
- **Computer Literacy:** Sound foundational knowledge of computer office packages (MS Word, MS Excel, accounting software).
- **Mandatory Typing Speed:** Minimum **30 words per minute (wpm)** on a standard computer keyboard. A formal typing and computer literacy screening test will be administered prior to candidate interviews.
- **Domicile:** Valid Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) and Local/Domicile Certificate of Balochistan.

### Age Limit & Federal Age Relaxation Rules
- **Prescribed Age:** 18 to 25 years.
- **General Federal Relaxation:** 05 years across-the-board age relaxation granted under Federal Government rules, extending the effective maximum age to **30 years** on the closing date.
- **Further Relaxations:** Candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, recognized tribes of Balochistan, and disabled persons are eligible for further relaxation as per applicable Federal Government notifications.

### Step-by-Step Application Guide on NJP Portal
Applications must be submitted purely online through the official National Jobs Portal. Physical CVs or paper forms sent by mail will not be entertained.
1. **Portal Access:** Navigate directly to the official recruitment listing at [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9862](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9862).
2. **Account Creation:** If you are a new applicant, register using your valid CNIC number, personal mobile number, and active email address.
3. **Profile Setup:** Fill in your educational background, graduation marks/division, typing speed credentials, and upload your recent passport-sized photograph along with scanned copies of your Balochistan domicile and CNIC.
4. **Apply for Job Code 9862:** Search for *Controller General of Accounts — Junior Auditor (Job ID 9862)* and click **Apply Now**.
5. **Submission & Tracking:** Verify your preview form and submit. Note your tracking application ID. No challan fee is required for applying through NJP.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
**Q1: Can candidates with a Punjab, Sindh, or KP domicile apply for this CGA opening?**
No. These 39 Junior Auditor positions are strictly notified under the provincial Balochistan quota. Only individuals holding an official Balochistan domicile or local certificate are legally eligible.

**Q2: Is a typing speed of 30 wpm compulsory for selection?**
Yes. Candidates who pass the initial academic screening will be required to demonstrate a minimum typing speed of 30 words per minute on computers before being called for final interview panels.

**Q3: What is the last date to apply?**
The deadline to complete and submit online forms on the National Jobs Portal is **Thursday, 26 November 2026**.

**Q4: Where will appointed Junior Auditors be stationed?**
Appointed Junior Auditors will serve within the administrative jurisdiction of the Accountant General Balochistan in Quetta and regional District Accounts Offices across Balochistan.
