content: # Punjab Last Mile Water Supply Project 2026: 5,000+ Filtration Plants & Priority Districts
## Executive Summary & Cabinet Approval Overview

On **25 October 2026**, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz formally approved the **Last Mile Water Supply Project** during a high-level review session of the **Punjab Saaf Pani Authority** in Lahore. Asserting that the provision of clean, contaminant-free drinking water is a fundamental public right for every citizen, the Chief Minister established a firm operational target: completing the installation of **more than 5,000 water filtration plants** across the province by **June 2027**.

The initiative represents a focused intervention to eliminate waterborne diseases and address critical groundwater contamination in peripheral, underserved communities. Under the approved phase, immediate priority is allocated to the severely affected districts of **Chakwal**, **Rawalpindi**, and **Rajanpur**, where geological constraints, extreme salinity, arsenic, and flood-damaged infrastructure have historically compromised access to potable drinking water.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Verified Project Scope & Operational Facts (October 2026):**
> - **Approval Authority:** Chief Minister Punjab, Maryam Nawaz (Lahore, 25 October 2026).
> - **Executing Authority:** Punjab Saaf Pani Authority (Government of the Punjab).
> - **Infrastructure Scale:** Target of **more than 5,000 modern water filtration plants**.
> - **Mandatory Completion Deadline:** **June 2027**.
> - **Priority Rollout Districts:** **Chakwal**, **Rawalpindi**, and **Rajanpur**.
> - **Administrative Accountability:** Respective District **Deputy Commissioners (DCs)** are officially tasked with direct oversight, plant uptime tracking, and daily maintenance verification.
> - **Household Connection Status:** **APPROVAL & PLANNING STAGE.** The project establishes community water filtration plants and dispensing centers. Household tap connection piping has **NOT** commenced, and **NO** household connection fees or forms exist. Beware of fraudulent local contractors claiming to sell connection licenses.
## Priority Target Districts: Geological & Water Quality Context
The selection of Chakwal, Rawalpindi, and Rajanpur addresses distinct water vulnerability profiles across upper and southern Punjab:

1. **Chakwal (Potohar Plateau):** Characterized by deep, hard-rock aquifers and severe seasonal depletion. Many rural union councils suffer from high total dissolved solids (TDS) and excessive mineral hardness, forcing families to travel long distances for potable water.
2. **Rawalpindi (Peri-Urban & Hilly Belts):** Rapid urbanization and industrial runoff have stressed suburban aquifers, while hilly rural union councils face logistical hurdles in securing continuous gravity-fed or piped municipal supply.
3. **Rajanpur (Southern Punjab & Indus River Basin):** A vulnerable district subject to recurrent hill torrents and seasonal flooding, Rajanpur suffers from extensive groundwater brackishness, high arsenic prevalence, and microbial contamination that pose acute risks to maternal and child health.
## Governance Model: Direct Deputy Commissioner Oversight
Learning from the maintenance failures and non-functional plants of past decades, Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has instituted an institutional accountability framework:

- **Deputy Commissioner Monitoring:** Direct operational responsibility for the continuous functionality, membrane replacement, and filter maintenance of all plants is assigned to the respective district Deputy Commissioner.
- **Saaf Pani Authority Quality Testing:** Dedicated water quality testing units will perform periodic biochemical testing to ensure compliance with World Health Organization (WHO) and Punjab Environmental Quality Standards.
- **Solarized Power Backups:** To counteract rural load shedding and ensure an uninterrupted water supply, filtration units are engineered to incorporate dedicated solar power generation modules.
- **Centralized Grievance Registry:** Citizens will be provided a direct hotline and mobile portal to report non-operational filtration units directly to the Chief Minister's inspection teams.
## Project Summary at a Glance

| Metric / Parameter | Approved Project Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Project Title** | Last Mile Water Supply Project (Punjab Saaf Pani Authority) |
| **Approving Authority** | Chief Minister Punjab (Maryam Nawaz) |
| **Total Filtration Units** | **5,000+ Modern Filtration Plants** |
| **Initial Focus Districts** | **Chakwal, Rawalpindi & Rajanpur** (Phased Province-Wide Expansion) |
| **Completion Deadline** | **June 2027** |
| **Service Model** | Community Clean Water Dispensing & Purification Stations |
| **Household Connection Fees** | **None** (Public drinking water points provided free of charge) |
| **Monitoring Authority** | District Deputy Commissioners & Saaf Pani Authority |
## Citizen Advisory: Scam Prevention & Household Pipeline Clarification
Because clean water is a high-demand necessity in rural and peri-urban Punjab, fraudulent agents often attempt to exploit government announcements:

- **No Home Connection Fees:** The Last Mile Water Supply Project installs public community filtration plants to supply clean water. The government has **not** authorized any private entity or agent to collect money for "exclusive pipeline hookups" or "meter reservations".
- **Beware of Fake Saaf Pani Forms:** No individual application forms, registration tokens, or bank deposit vouchers are required to access clean water from these facilities.
- **Report Extortion:** If any local contractor, municipal staff member, or middleman demands payment for water access or plant installation on your community land, report the incident immediately to the local Deputy Commissioner’s complaint cell or Punjab Citizen Portal.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What is the Punjab Last Mile Water Supply Project?
It is a provincial public health initiative approved on 25 October 2026 by Punjab CM Maryam Nawaz to install over 5,000 clean water filtration plants across vulnerable and water-stressed areas of Punjab by June 2027.

### Which districts are prioritized in the initial rollout?
The Punjab government has explicitly designated the water-affected belts of **Chakwal**, **Rawalpindi**, and **Rajanpur** as high-priority target districts under the approved plan.

### Can citizens apply for private household tap connections under this scheme?
No. The project is focused on establishing community water filtration plants where citizens can collect purified water. Private household piping connections and private home meters are not part of this initial procurement phase.

### Is there any fee or card required to fetch water from these plants?
No. Provision of potable water from public filtration plants under the Saaf Pani Authority is free of cost. Beware of anyone soliciting fees, subscription cards, or tokens.

### Who is responsible if a filtration plant breaks down in a village?
The Punjab government has explicitly placed administrative and monitoring responsibility upon the respective district **Deputy Commissioner (DC)** to ensure timely filter maintenance and plant functionality.

### When will the 5,000+ plants become fully operational?
Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has set a firm deadline of **June 2027** for the completion and operationalization of all 5,000+ filtration plants across the province.

content: # PM Youth Chromebooks Scheme 2026: IBCC Online Portal, Eligibility & Sindh Board Schedule
## Official Launch & Centralized IBCC Application Portal

Under the **Prime Minister’s Youth Chromebook Scheme**, the federal government has operationalized a centralized digital verification and application portal for high-achieving students across Pakistan. The system is managed and executed directly by the **Inter Boards Coordination Commission (IBCC)** under the **Ministry of Federal Education & Professional Training** at [pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk](https://pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk/).

The scheme is structured to provide modern **Chromebooks** to top-performing students of **Government and Public Schools** based on merit established in their respective Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) annual examinations. The centralized portal allows students to verify their board records, review pre-populated academic scores, upload attested documentation, and obtain an official registration slip.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Verified Official IBCC Portal Guidelines (October 2026):**
> - **Primary Application Portal:** [pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk](https://pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk/) (Active & Live).
> - **Executing Authority:** Inter Boards Coordination Commission (IBCC), Ministry of Federal Education & Professional Training, Government of Pakistan.
> - **Institutional Requirement:** Only students currently or previously enrolled in **Government / Public Schools** are eligible. Private school students are not eligible under this scheme.
> - **Notice for Students of Sindh:** Registration for students of Sindh will open on the same portal following the formal announcement of the **Class 9th (SSC-I) Annual Examination 2026 results** by all respective educational boards of Sindh.
> - **Single Submission Rule:** Only one application is permitted per eligible student. Information submitted cannot be edited once finalized.
> - **Deadline Status:** Applications are processed based on respective board gazette schedules; no artificial closing date applies.
## Province-Wise Eligibility Criteria & Grade Thresholds
Eligibility is determined strictly through verified academic data supplied directly to IBCC by respective educational boards:

| Provinces & Regions | Eligible Academic Classes | Selection Benchmark |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa & Balochistan** | **Grade 9 (SSC-I) Only** | Top-performing students from Government/Public Schools based on Annual Examinations 2026 |
| **Islamabad (FBISE), AJK (Mirpur Board) & Gilgit-Baltistan** | **Grade 9 (SSC-I) & Grade 10 (SSC-II)** | Top-performing students from Government/Public Schools based on Annual Examinations 2026 |

> [!NOTE]
> Selection is strictly merit-based and restricted to the top scorers whose records appear in the gazette lists officially transmitted by the examination boards to the IBCC central repository.
## Important Notice for Students of Sindh

Students registered with educational boards across Sindh (including BISE Karachi, BISE Hyderabad, BISE Sukkur, BISE Larkana, BISE Mirpurkhas, and BSEK Karachi) should note the official scheduling policy published on the IBCC portal:

- **Schedule Dependency:** Registration for Sindh candidates will be activated on [pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk](https://pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk/) immediately after all examination boards across Sindh formally announce their **Class 9th (SSC-I) Annual Examination 2026 results**.
- **Data Integration:** Once the boards declare results, the verified gazette of top performers will be ingested into the IBCC database, allowing Sindh candidates to fetch their records using their B-Form or roll numbers.
- **Equal Access:** Sindh candidates will receive a dedicated window to apply once their results are officially published.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure on the IBCC Portal
Eligible candidates whose results are declared can complete their application through the following verified steps:

1. **Locate Your Board Record:**
   - Visit the official portal: [pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk](https://pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk/).
   - Select your educational board from the dropdown (e.g., BISE Lahore, BISE Gujranwala, BISE Rawalpindi, BISE Peshawar, BBISE Quetta, FBISE Islamabad, etc.).
   - Enter your **CNIC / B-Form number, Roll number, or Board Registration number** (enter digits only, without dashes).
   - Select your exact **Date of Birth** (Day, Month, Year) matching your official board record.
   - Click **Find my record**.
2. **Verify Academic Profile:**
   - The system checks your details against the official list submitted by your board.
   - Your name, father's name, school name, and examination marks will appear on the verification screen.
3. **Upload Mandatory Attested Documents:**
   - Ensure all documents are clear, legible, and within the 300 KB limit before uploading.
4. **Submit & Download Slip:**
   - Carefully review all details on the summary screen.
   - Submit the application and download the official registration confirmation slip containing your unique reference number.
## Mandatory Documentation & File Requirements
Before initiating the application, students must have the following documents ready in digital format:

- **Recent Colour Photograph:** Front-facing with a plain background (JPG or PNG, up to 300 KB).
- **Mark Sheet:** Official SSC-I (9th) or SSC-II (10th) mark sheet issued by the board (JPG, PNG, or PDF, up to 300 KB).
- **Attested B-Form / CNIC:** Attested copy of the student’s computerized NADRA B-Form or CNIC (JPG, PNG, or PDF, up to 300 KB).
- **Attested Father / Guardian CNIC:** Attested copy of the father’s or legal guardian’s CNIC (JPG, PNG, or PDF, up to 300 KB).

> [!WARNING]
> Ensure all scans are clearly readable. Submitting false, forged, or mismatched information will cancel the Chromebook allocation and may lead to administrative action.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What is the official website for the PM Youth Chromebook Scheme?
The verified official portal is managed by the Inter Boards Coordination Commission at [pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk](https://pmychromebooks.ibcc.edu.pk/).

### Are private school students eligible for this scheme?
No. Under official scheme guidelines, only students currently or previously enrolled in Government / Public Schools are eligible.

### What should I do if the portal displays "Record not found"?
First verify your entry by trying your board roll number or registration number instead of your B-Form number. If your record is still not found and you are a top-performing student in a government school, contact your educational board's focal person.

### When will registration open for students of Sindh boards?
Registration for Sindh students will open on the same IBCC portal as soon as all examination boards across Sindh formally declare their Class 9th Annual Examination 2026 results.

### Can I edit my application after submission?
No. Only one application per student is permitted, and forms cannot be modified once submitted. Review all details on the review screen before confirming.

- **Supervising Ministry:** [Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training](https://mofept.gov.pk/)

content: # Bank AL Habib Relationship Manager Jobs 2026 — Eligibility, Experience & Online Apply
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

**Bank AL Habib Limited (BAHL)**, operating one of Pakistan’s largest branch banking footprints with over 1,100 locations across the country, has officially announced dedicated recruitment for **Relationship Managers (RM) and Senior Relationship Managers (SRM)** in commercial banking. Verified live on **25 October 2026** on the official [Bank AL Habib Current Openings portal](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings), this career drive targets experienced liability sales specialists across **Pan-Pakistan locations**, with a reported application review window extending through **30 November 2026**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Recruitment Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Bank:** Bank AL Habib Limited (BAHL)
> - **Announced Positions:** Relationship Manager (RM) and Senior Relationship Manager (SRM)
> - **Operational Cadres:** Branch Banking & Commercial Liabilities Division
> - **Duty Locations:** Pan-Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Sukkur, Hyderabad, Peshawar, Quetta)
> - **Academic Qualification:** Graduate with at least 14 years of education from an HEC-recognized university (Master's / MBA preferred)
> - **Experience Requirements:** Minimum **2 years** for Relationship Manager; minimum **5 years** for Senior Relationship Manager in branch liabilities sales
> - **Age Limit:** Maximum **35 years** as of application date
> - **Application Cutoff:** Active intake / rolling review closing **30 November 2026**
> - **Application Portal:** Exclusively online at [bankalhabib.com/current-openings](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings).
## Quick Facts Table: Bank AL Habib RM Recruitment 2026

| ATTRIBUTE | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Employer Bank** | Bank AL Habib Limited (BAHL) |
| **Job Positions** | Relationship Manager (RM) & Senior Relationship Manager (SRM) |
| **Department** | Branch Banking / Commercial Liabilities Sales |
| **Geographic Scope** | Pan-Pakistan Commercial Branch Network |
| **Minimum Education** | Bachelor’s Degree (14 or 16 Years) from an HEC-recognized university |
| **Experience Bracket** | 2 Years (RM) | 5 Years (Senior RM) in Liabilities Sales |
| **Upper Age Limit** | Up to 35 Years |
| **Employment Status** | Permanent / Full-Time Regular Banking Officer |
| **Salary & Compensation** | Highly competitive executive salary + performance bonuses + staff financing & medical |
| **Application Deadline** | **30 November 2026** (Rolling Intakes) |
| **Official Application Link** | [bankalhabib.com/current-openings](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings) |
## Core Responsibilities & Portfolio Management Expectations
Relationship Managers at Bank AL Habib spearhead commercial growth, High-Net-Worth Individual (HNWI) retention, and branch balance sheet expansion:

1. **Deposit Mobilization & CASA Growth:** Formulate tactical outreach plans to acquire low-cost Current and Savings Account (CASA) balances from corporate clients, traders, institutions, and affluent retail customers.
2. **High-Net-Worth Client Relationship Management:** Build and nurture enduring relationships with business families, corporate executives, and institutional treasuries to maximize client retention and wallet share.
3. **Cross-Selling Banking Products:** Proactively market Alternative Delivery Channels (ADC), internet banking, payroll management solutions, trade finance instruments, and consumer credit facilities.
4. **Branch Performance Alignment:** Work closely with the Branch Manager and Regional Heads to meet branch profitability targets, service benchmarks, and customer acquisition quotas.
5. **Compliance & AML Safeguards:** Ensure all account opening documentation, source of funds verifications, and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) clearances adhere strictly to State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) and BAHL compliance standards.
## Tier-Wise Eligibility & Experience Standards
Bank AL Habib has clearly delineated requirements for both relationship management tiers:

### 1. Relationship Manager (RM)
- **Experience:** Minimum **2 years** of proven liabilities sales and relationship management experience in a scheduled commercial branch banking environment.
- **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (14 years of education minimum) in Business, Commerce, Economics, or related fields.
- **Age Ceiling:** Maximum 35 years.
- **Skills:** Strong communication, presentation skills, understanding of local business dynamics, and a demonstrable customer portfolio.

### 2. Senior Relationship Manager (SRM)
- **Experience:** Minimum **5 years** of consistent track record in commercial liabilities sales, large deposit acquisition, and institutional relationship management.
- **Education:** 16-year Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (MBA, MS Finance, M.Com) preferred.
- **Age Ceiling:** Maximum 35 years.
- **Leadership Skills:** Ability to mentor junior branch sales officers and drive cluster sales campaigns.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (Bank AL Habib Portal)
Candidates meeting the criteria must submit their applications digitally:

1. **Visit Careers Portal:** Navigate to [bankalhabib.com/current-openings](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings).
2. **Locate Vacancy:** Filter by *Branch Banking* or *Commercial Banking* and select *Senior Relationship Manager / Relationship Manager*.
3. **Complete Applicant Profile:** Input your primary email address, CNIC number, and contact information.
4. **Employment History:** Provide an accurate summary of your banking career, detailing current bank name, branch assignment, grade, and current portfolio volume.
5. **Upload Resume:** Attach your comprehensive, updated CV in PDF format (maximum 2 MB).
6. **Select Region:** Choose your preferred city and regional cluster for interview scheduling.
7. **Submit Form:** Verify your data and finalize submission before **30 November 2026**.

> [!NOTE]
> Bank AL Habib Limited strictly conducts recruitment on merit with zero processing fees. Only shortlisted candidates meeting the experience threshold will receive interview calls.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Bank AL Habib Relationship Manager jobs?**
Applications for the ongoing commercial batches are officially being reviewed through **30 November 2026**.

**Q2: Can fresh graduates apply for the Relationship Manager role?**
No. The Relationship Manager position requires a minimum of **2 years** of branch liabilities sales experience. Fresh graduates should instead apply for the [Bank AL Habib Fresh Graduate & BSO Vacancies](/jobs/bank-al-habib-jobs-2026-karachi-fresh-graduates-apply-online).

**Q3: What is the age limit for Senior Relationship Managers?**
The maximum age limit is **35 years** as of the date of application.

**Q4: Where will appointed Relationship Managers be posted?**
Postings are available across Pakistan in major metropolitan commercial hubs including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Sukkur, and Peshawar.

content: # Samba Bank Universal Teller Jobs 2026 — Eligibility, Experience & Online Application
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

**Samba Bank Limited**, a subsidiary of the prominent Saudi National Bank (SNB) operating a nationwide commercial branch network across Pakistan, has officially announced career opportunities for the position of **Universal Teller**. Verified directly on **25 October 2026** from the official [Samba Bank Careers Portal](https://www.samba.com.pk/career), this recruitment intake seeks energetic banking operations professionals for **All Cities / Multiple Nationwide Locations** to manage front-line branch cash services and customer transactions.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Recruitment Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Bank:** Samba Bank Limited
> - **Job Title:** Universal Teller (Branch Operations Group)
> - **Duty Locations:** All Cities / Multiple Locations Nationwide (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, and other branch hubs)
> - **Educational Criteria:** Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (14 or 16 Years) from an HEC-recognized university in Commerce, Business Administration, Accounting, or Economics
> - **Experience Required:** Minimum **1+ year** of relevant commercial banking experience in cash handling, teller operations, or front-desk customer service
> - **Employment Type:** Permanent / Full-Time Regular Banking Career
> - **Application Cutoff:** **Saturday, 31 October 2026**
> - **Application Fee:** Rs. 0 (Samba Bank strictly does not charge any application or recruitment fees)
> - **Application Channels:** Direct submission via email to `careers@samba.com.pk` and through the official portal at [samba.com.pk/career](https://www.samba.com.pk/career).
## Quick Facts Table: Samba Bank Universal Teller Recruitment 2026

| ATTRIBUTE | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Employer Bank** | Samba Bank Limited |
| **Designated Role** | Universal Teller |
| **Functional Group** | Branch Operations & Retail Banking Division |
| **Job Locations** | All Cities / Nationwide Branch Network |
| **Minimum Education** | Bachelor’s Degree (14 or 16 Years) from an HEC-recognized institution |
| **Required Experience** | Minimum 1+ Year in Commercial Banking Cash & Teller Services |
| **Core Competencies** | Cash Balancing, SBP AML/KYC Compliance, MS Office, Customer Care |
| **Maximum Age Limit** | Up to 32 Years |
| **Employment Status** | Permanent / Regular Commercial Bank Cadre |
| **Application Deadline** | **Saturday, 31 October 2026** |
| **Official Portal Link** | [samba.com.pk/career](https://www.samba.com.pk/career) |
## Core Operational Responsibilities & Compliance Focus
The Universal Teller acts as the primary operational face of Samba Bank, balancing transactional efficiency with strict regulatory compliance:

1. **Cash Receipts & Disbursements:** Accurately process cash deposits, withdrawals, cheques, and foreign currency exchange transactions in compliance with branch authorization limits.
2. **Daily Vault & ATM Balancing:** Balance cash drawers, reconcile day-end cash counts against General Ledger (GL) reports, and support Automated Teller Machine (ATM) replenishment and cassette audits.
3. **Remittance & Instrument Issuance:** Issue Demand Drafts (DD), Pay Orders (PO), and telegraphic transfers while verifying customer signatures and account authorization.
4. **Regulatory & AML/KYC Compliance:** Strictly adhere to State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter Financing of Terrorism (CFT), and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) procedures before executing high-value or suspicious transactions.
5. **Customer Service Excellence:** Maintain prompt turnaround times, resolve routine account inquiries, and cross-sell electronic banking channels (internet and mobile banking).
## Detailed Eligibility Criteria
Candidates applying for Universal Teller positions across nationwide branches must satisfy the following verified standards:

- **Academic Qualification:** Bachelor’s degree (B.Com, BBA, BS, or equivalent) from a recognized university. Candidates with backgrounds in Commerce, Finance, Economics, or Accounting are preferred.
- **Commercial Banking Experience:** At least **1 year** of hands-on experience as a branch cashier, teller, or customer service representative in a scheduled commercial bank or reputable microfinance institution.
- **Technical & Soft Skills:** Sound numerical aptitude, rapid cash-counting accuracy, proficiency in Core Banking Systems (CBS), and good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- **Integrity & Clean Record:** Impeccable professional record with no disciplinary issues or adverse regulatory credit bureau (eCIB) defaults.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (Samba Bank)
Applications can be submitted through either of the two official channels before **31 October 2026**:

### Method 1: Email Submission to Samba Recruitment Team
1. Prepare an updated resume in PDF format (maximum 2 MB).
2. Format email subject line as: `Application for Universal Teller – [Your Preferred City]` (e.g., `Application for Universal Teller – Karachi`).
3. Attach your CV along with a concise professional cover note summarizing your current bank experience, total cash handling years, and notice period.
4. Send your application to the official recruitment desk: **`careers@samba.com.pk`**.

### Method 2: Online Submission via Samba Careers Portal
1. Visit [samba.com.pk/career](https://www.samba.com.pk/career).
2. Search for the *Universal Teller (All Cities)* job opening.
3. Fill in the online candidate form with personal information, academic grades, and prior banking details.
4. Upload your resume and submit.

> [!TIP]
> Candidates currently serving as cash officers or contract tellers in other commercial banks seeking permanent placement are encouraged to apply early before the 31 October deadline.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Samba Bank Universal Teller jobs?**
The official application deadline is **Saturday, 31 October 2026**.

**Q2: Are fresh graduates eligible for the Universal Teller position?**
Samba Bank officially specifies a minimum of **1+ year** of relevant commercial banking experience in teller or cash operations for this role.

**Q3: Which cities have Universal Teller openings?**
Openings are advertised for **All Cities** across Samba Bank’s nationwide network, including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, and other regional branches.

**Q4: Does Samba Bank charge an application fee?**
No. Samba Bank never charges any application, testing, or processing fee at any stage of recruitment.

content: # Sindh Government Jobs 2026 — Latest Vacancies, SPSC, STS & Online Apply Links
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Directory

The **Government of Sindh** has notified major public sector employment updates across provincial commissions, testing services, judicial secretariats, and administrative departments for 2026. Verified directly on **25 October 2026** across official government portals—including the **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)**, **SIBA Testing Services (STS)**, and the **Sindh Job Portal**—this comprehensive guide provides job seekers with a verified directory of open provincial vacancies across Karachi, Hyderabad, Jamshoro, Sukkur, Larkana, and Mirpurkhas.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Recruitment Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Lead Recruitment Authorities:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), SIBA Testing Services (STS), and Government of Sindh Secretariats
> - **Major Active Drive:** SPSC Combined Competitive Examination (CCE-2026) under Advertisement No. 06/2026 with historic age and attempt reforms
> - **CCE-2026 Application Deadline:** Officially extended to **Wednesday, 11 November 2026**
> - **Judicial & Testing Projects:** High Court of Sindh and District Courts screening and shorthand tests active via STS at [apply.sts.net.pk](https://apply.sts.net.pk/)
> - **Education & Project Roles:** Reform Support Unit (RSU) Social Safeguard and Learning Specialists (PPS-8/PPS-9)
> - **Application Portals:** SPSC ([spsc.gov.pk](https://www.spsc.gov.pk/)), STS ([apply.sts.net.pk](https://apply.sts.net.pk/)), and Sindh Portal ([sindh.gov.pk](https://www.sindh.gov.pk/))
> - **Important Note on Closed Vacancies:** SPSC Advertisement No. 05/2026 (Medical Officers BPS-17) closed on **23 October 2026** and is no longer accepting new applications.
## Verified Active Vacancies Directory: Sindh Government 2026

| **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)** | Combined Competitive Examination (CCE-2026) | BPS-17 / Provincial Cadres | All Sindh / Secretariat & Field | **11 November 2026** | [spsc.gov.pk](https://www.spsc.gov.pk/) | **OPEN (Extended)** |
| **High Court of Sindh (via STS)** | Personal Assistants & Shorthand Evaluations | Judicial Cadre | Karachi & Regional Benches | Rolling Testing Schedule | [apply.sts.net.pk](https://apply.sts.net.pk/) | **OPEN (Active)** |

## 1. SPSC CCE-2026: Historic Examination Reforms & Extended Deadline

Following official amendments to the *SPSC Recruitment Management Regulations 2023* published in the Sindh Government Gazette and notified in **Advertisement No. 06/2026** on 23 October 2026, the SPSC CCE-2026 examination has undergone landmark policy modifications:

- **Extended Application Cutoff:** Candidates can now apply online until **11 November 2026**.
- **Upper Age Limit:** Relaxed to **33 years** for general candidates, expanding eligibility to thousands of previously age-barred applicants. Lower age limit remains unchanged at **21 years**.
- **Five Maximum Attempts:** Candidates are granted a maximum of **5 attempts** under a notified 3-year transition window.
- **Screening Qualifying Threshold:** Revised downwards to **33% (66 marks out of 200)**, replacing the earlier 50% threshold.
- **Negative Marking:** Fixed at **0.25 marks deducted** for each incorrect response in the 100-question screening test.
- **Existing Applicants:** Candidates who successfully registered under Advertisement 04/2026 do not need to submit fresh applications, but may rectify document deficiencies on the portal before the 11 November deadline.
- **Postponed Screening Date:** The preliminary screening test is officially scheduled for **Saturday, 28 November 2026** across divisional centers (Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana) per SPSC public notice dated 26 October 2026.
## 2. SIBA Testing Services (STS) Judicial & Public Sector Projects
SIBA Testing Services (STS), operated by Sukkur IBA University, manages specialized recruitment testing across Sindh:

- **Sindh High Court Personal Assistants:** Active evaluation schedules for candidates who qualified initial typing and shorthand benchmarks.
- **District Courts Recruitment:** Screening for ministerial cadres (Junior Clerks, Assistants, Process Servers, and Bailiffs) across judicial divisions including Mirpurkhas and Sukkur.
- **Admit Card Downloads:** Applicants must visit [apply.sts.net.pk](https://apply.sts.net.pk/) to download computerized roll number slips and verify test center reporting times.
## 3. Step-by-Step Guide to Applying for Sindh Government Jobs

### A. Applying via SPSC Portal (spsc.gov.pk)
1. Visit [spsc.gov.pk](https://www.spsc.gov.pk/) and create or log in to your candidate account.
2. Download the auto-generated 1Link 1Bill fee challan (Rs. 1,000 for CCE-2026).
3. Pay fee via ATM, internet banking, EasyPaisa, or JazzCash using the 1Bill consumer number.
4. Fill personal data, upload CNIC, domicile, PRC (Form-D), and degree transcript scans.
5. Select your examination center (Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana) and submit before **11 November 2026**.

### B. Applying via STS Candidate Portal (apply.sts.net.pk)
1. Register at [apply.sts.net.pk](https://apply.sts.net.pk/) using your CNIC number.
2. Select your desired project and complete academic qualifications.
3. Generate the ABL / authorized bank deposit voucher and pay at designated branches or 1Link.
4. Upload paid slip copy and submit the digital application.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Official Verification Notice:** The Government of Sindh and SPSC do not accept manual paper applications or cash payments. Beware of fraudulent agents claiming to guarantee interview appointments. Always verify job advertisements against official government gazettes.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SPSC CCE-2026?**
The official online application deadline has been extended to **Wednesday, 11 November 2026** under SPSC Advertisement No. 06/2026.

**Q2: What is the new passing percentage for SPSC CCE screening?**
The qualifying threshold is officially reduced to **33% (66 marks out of 200)**, with a negative marking deduction of 0.25 per incorrect answer.

**Q3: Is SPSC Advertisement 05/2026 (Medical Officers) still open?**
No. SPSC Advertisement No. 05/2026 closed on **23 October 2026**. Only Advertisement 06/2026 remains open.

**Q4: Can government servants apply for age relaxation in Sindh jobs?**
Yes. Continuous Sindh government servants are entitled to upper age relaxation in accordance with Sindh Civil Servants Rules upon uploading a Departmental Permission Certificate (DPC).

**Q5: Which testing service conducts Sindh judicial examinations?**
SIBA Testing Services (STS) at [apply.sts.net.pk](https://apply.sts.net.pk/) handles screening and shorthand testing for the High Court of Sindh and District Courts.

content: # PHSA LHV First Merit List 2026 — Official PDF Download, District & Quota-Wise Lists
## Executive Summary & Official Admission Notice

The **Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA)**, Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, has officially announced the **First Merit List for Lady Health Visitor (LHV) Admissions for the 2026–2028 Academic Session**. Notified officially on **23 October 2026** and verified live on **25 October 2026** on the [PHSA Official Notices Portal](https://phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions), the merit lists determine provisional admission selections across all affiliated Public Health Schools in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Admission Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Issuing Authority:** Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA), Health Department KPK
> - **Academic Program:** Lady Health Visitor (LHV) Diploma (2-Year Government Healthcare Training)
> - **Merit List Release Date:** **23 October 2026**
> - **Merit Validity & Final Submission Deadline:** **Tuesday, 3 November 2026**
> - **Affiliated Institutions:** Public Health Schools in Hayatabad (Peshawar), Nishterabad (Peshawar), Abbottabad, and D.I. Khan
> - **Available Quota PDF Lists:** District-Wise Open Merit, Self-Finance, Minority Quota, and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) Quota
> - **Official Download Portal:** [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions](https://phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions)
> - **Immediate Next Action:** Selected candidates must submit original documents, medical fitness certificates, and admission fees at their allocated Public Health School before the deadline to confirm their seats.
## Quick Facts Table: PHSA LHV Merit List 2026

| ATTRIBUTE | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Issuing Authority** | Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA), KPK |
| **Course / Program** | Lady Health Visitor (LHV) 2-Year Diploma Program |
| **Academic Session** | 2026 – 2028 Batch |
| **Official Release Date** | 23 October 2026 |
| **Admission Confirmation Cutoff** | **Tuesday, 3 November 2026** |
| **Participating Centers** | PHS Hayatabad, PHS Nishterabad, PHS Abbottabad, PHS D.I. Khan |
| **Merit Status Displayed** | Selected Candidates List & Waiting List with Aggregate Scores |
| **Document Verification** | Mandatory in-person submission of original credentials at allocated school |
| **Official Portal Link** | [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions](https://phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions) |
## Participating Public Health Schools & Quota Breakdown
The 23 October 2026 admission release provides comprehensive seat allocations across four premier public health training institutions in the province:

1. **Public Health School, Hayatabad (Peshawar):** Accommodates candidates from central Khyber Pakhtunkhwa districts, Peshawar division, and merged tribal districts.
2. **Public Health School, Nishterabad (Peshawar):** Offers specialized primary healthcare and maternal-child health clinical training.
3. **Public Health School, Abbottabad:** Caters to female candidates from Hazara division (Abbottabad, Mansehra, Haripur, Battagram, Torghar, Upper/Lower Kohistan).
4. **Public Health School, D.I. Khan:** Covers southern districts including D.I. Khan, Tank, Bannu, Lakki Marwat, and adjoining tribal areas.

### Quota Classifications Published:
- **District-Wise Open Merit:** Allocated strictly based on academic aggregate (Matric Science marks / FSc Pre-Medical weightage) according to district population quotas.
- **Self-Finance Quota:** Designated seats for candidates opting for the institutional self-finance fee structure.
- **Minority Quota:** Reserved percentage for non-Muslim Pakistani female candidates.
- **Disability / Special Quota:** Designated seats for candidates certified by the authorized Provincial Disability Assessment Board.
## How to Download Official PHSA LHV Merit List PDFs
Follow these verified instructions to view and download your institution's merit list:

1. **Open Official Portal:** Visit the official PHSA website at [phsa.edu.pk](https://phsa.edu.pk).
2. **Navigate to Public Notices:** Click on the *Public Notices* tab and select the category *LHVs Admission 2026 Updates* (or navigate directly to [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions](https://phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions)).
3. **Locate Notice:** Open the official notification titled **"LHV Admission First Merit List (Session 2026–2028)"**.
4. **Select Institution & Quota PDF:** Click on the specific download link corresponding to your designated Public Health School (Hayatabad, Nishterabad, Abbottabad, or D.I. Khan) and your applied quota.
5. **Check Merit Status:** Search using your Roll Number, Candidate Name, or Father’s Name. Confirm whether your status is marked **Selected** or **Waiting** alongside your calculated aggregate score.
## Instructions for Selected Candidates & Document Verification
Candidates whose names appear in the **Selected** category must complete mandatory formalities before the strict **3 November 2026** cutoff:

- **Reporting to Allocated School:** Report physically to the Principal's Office of the assigned Public Health School between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM on official working days.
- **Original Documents Required:**
  - Original Secondary School Certificate (Matriculation) with detailed marks sheet (DMC).
  - FSc Pre-Medical Certificate / DMC (if applicable).
  - Original Domicile Certificate of the applicant.
  - Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) or NADRA Smart Card / B-Form.
  - Father's / Guardian's CNIC photocopy.
  - 06 recent passport-size photographs with blue/white background.
  - Medical Fitness Certificate issued by a Medical Superintendent (MS) of a Government District Headquarters (DHQ) Hospital.
  - Prescribed Affidavit on judicial stamp paper (attested by an Oath Commissioner).
- **Payment of Admission Fee:** Submit the prescribed admission fee challan at the authorized bank branch before **3 November 2026**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Forfeiture of Seat:** If a selected candidate fails to deposit the prescribed admission fee and submit verified original documents by **3 November 2026**, her admission offer will stand automatically cancelled, and the vacant seat will be awarded to the next candidate on the waiting list in the Second Merit List.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: When was the PHSA LHV First Merit List 2026 officially published?**
The list was officially published by the Provincial Health Services Academy on **23 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the deadline to confirm admission and submit fees?**
Selected candidates must complete document verification and pay admission dues on or before **Tuesday, 3 November 2026**.

**Q3: Where can candidates download the district-wise merit list PDFs?**
The official PDF lists are available on the PHSA Admissions portal at [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions](https://phsa.edu.pk/notice-details?seg=admissions).

**Q4: Will a second merit list be issued by PHSA?**
Yes. Vacant seats remaining after the 3 November 2026 deadline will be filled through the Second Merit List from candidates currently on the Waiting List.

**Q5: Is this an employment recruitment list?**
No. This is an academic admission merit list for the 2-Year Lady Health Visitor (LHV) Diploma Training Program across public health schools in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

> - **Designated Duty Stations:** Sukkur (Sindh), Gujranwala (Punjab), and Shakargarh (Punjab)
> - **Minimum Education:** Bachelor’s Degree (14 or 16 Years) from an HEC-recognized university
> - **Experience Required:** 2 to 4 years of banking experience in agricultural credit / rural financing
> - **Upper Age Limit:** Up to 55 years as of the application date
> - **Application Cutoff:** **Sunday, 1 November 2026**
> - **Application Portal:** Exclusively online at [bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs](https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs).

## Core Job Responsibilities & Operational Scope
The Relationship Manager — Agri in Sukkur serves as the anchor for agricultural lending and commercial agribusiness outreach across upper Sindh’s farming belts:

1. **Agricultural Loan Sourcing:** Proactively identify, market, and originate agricultural finance facilities for progressive growers, dairy farmers, and agri-traders across the Sukkur, Khairpur, and Rohri agriculture clusters.
2. **Government Farm Schemes:** Promote and manage government-subsidized credit initiatives, including Kisan credit packages, farm mechanization financing (tractors and solar tube-wells), and crop production inputs.
3. **Credit Proposal Formulation:** Conduct thorough on-site farm inspections, verify land revenue records (Form-VII / Khasra passbooks), prepare credit evaluation proposals, and route them within established turnaround times.
4. **Portfolio Monitoring & Recovery:** Monitor crop seasonal cycles (Kharif and Rabi harvests), track loan repayments, and maintain portfolio quality with minimal non-performing loans (NPLs).
5. **Client Relationship Development:** Foster long-term banking relationships with farm input dealers, grain market commission agents, and rural enterprises to mobilize low-cost deposit balances.
## Comprehensive Eligibility Criteria
Candidates applying for the Sukkur posting must meet the official criteria specified by The Bank of Punjab:

- **Educational Background:** Minimum Bachelor’s degree (14 or 16 years of education) from an HEC-recognized local or foreign university. Degrees in Agriculture Sciences, Agribusiness, Business Administration, Economics, or Banking & Finance are preferred.
- **Professional Experience:** At least **2 to 4 years** of direct commercial banking experience in agricultural credit, rural microfinance, or agri SME portfolio management. Candidates with strong familiarity with upper Sindh's agricultural geography and farming practices will have a strong advantage.
- **Age Bracket:** Candidates up to **55 years of age** as of the closing date are eligible, accommodating seasoned agricultural credit officers.
- **Technical Skills:** Sound knowledge of State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) Prudential Regulations for Agricultural Financing, land title verification procedures, and basic computer proficiency.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (BOP Portal)
Applications are accepted solely through BOP’s web portal. Follow these instructions before the deadline:

1. **Open Official Portal:** Visit [bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs](https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs).
2. **Locate Vacancy:** Search for *Relationship Manager — Agri* listed under the *Consumer Banking Group*.
3. **Select Duty Station:** In the application form, clearly select **Sukkur** (or Gujranwala / Shakargarh if preferred).
4. **Complete Profile & History:** Input personal bio-data, academic records, and detailed banking employment history including your current employer, branch, and portfolio size.
5. **Upload Resume:** Attach your updated CV in PDF format.
6. **Final Submission:** Confirm that all entries match your educational certificates and CNIC, and submit the application before **1 November 2026**.

> [!NOTE]
> Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by The Bank of Punjab for assessment and interviews. No TA/DA is admissible for interview attendance.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for BOP Relationship Manager Agri in Sukkur?**
The official closing date is **Sunday, 1 November 2026**.

**Q2: Is this position permanent or contract-based?**
This is a regular, full-time banking position in **Band-10 to Band-09** within The Bank of Punjab.

**Q3: Is banking experience mandatory for this role?**
Yes. BOP requires a minimum of **2 to 4 years** of relevant banking experience in agricultural credit or farm finance.

**Q4: Can candidates from Sindh apply for the Sukkur vacancy?**
Yes. Candidates possessing the required educational qualifications and agricultural banking experience are encouraged to apply for the Sukkur posting.

**Q5: Does BOP charge an application processing fee?**
No. Applying through the official BOP Careers portal is completely free of charge.

content: # Bank AL Habib Jobs 2026 Karachi — Fresh Graduate Vacancies, Eligibility & Online Apply
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

**Bank AL Habib Limited (BAHL)**, one of Pakistan's most respected private commercial banking networks with over 1,100 branches nationwide, has officially announced fresh recruitment opportunities for 2026 across **Karachi and its nationwide network**. Verified directly from the official [Bank AL Habib Current Openings portal](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings) on **25 October 2026**, the ongoing intake features multiple specialized entry-level openings tailored for **fresh university graduates**, alongside lateral career pathways for experienced commercial bankers.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Recruitment Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Institution:** Bank AL Habib Limited (BAHL)
> - **Key Vacancies:** Branch Sales Officer (BSO), Phone Banking Officer (Call Center / ADC), General Banking Trainee, Relationship Manager (RM), and Senior Relationship Manager (SRM)
> - **Primary Locations:** Karachi (Head Office & Centralized Phone Banking Hub) and Nationwide Branch Network
> - **Eligibility for Fresh Graduates:** Minimum Bachelor's Degree (14 or 16 Years of Education) in Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or related disciplines
> - **Experienced Hires:** 2 to 5 years of liabilities sales experience for RM and Senior RM roles
> - **Application Window:** Active now; rolling recruitment with specific commercial intakes closing **30 November 2026**
> - **Application Fee:** Rs. 0 (Bank AL Habib never charges any application or processing fees at any stage)
> - **Application Method:** Exclusively online via [Bank AL Habib Current Openings](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings).
## Quick Facts Table: Bank AL Habib Recruitment 2026

| ATTRIBUTE | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Bank / Employer** | Bank AL Habib Limited (BAHL) |
| **Announced Positions** | Branch Sales Officer (BSO), Phone Banking Officer (ADC), General Banking, RM & Senior RM |
| **Duty Locations** | Karachi (Centralized Operations & ADC Call Center) and Pan-Pakistan Branches |
| **Minimum Education** | Bachelor’s Degree (14 or 16 Years) from an HEC-recognized university |
| **Target Candidates** | Fresh Graduates (Entry-Level) & Banking Professionals (Lateral Tracks) |
| **Experience Bracket** | 0 Years (Fresh) for BSO & Phone Banking; 2–5 Years for RM/SRM |
| **Age Ceilings** | Fresh roles up to 28–30 Years; Experienced commercial roles up to 35 Years |
| **Employment Type** | Regular / Full-Time Commercial Banking Career |
| **Salary & Benefits** | Market-competitive salary, provident fund, gratuity, medical coverage, and staff financing |
| **Closing Cutoff** | Rolling intake / 30 November 2026 for specific commercial batches |
| **Official Portal Link** | [bankalhabib.com/current-openings](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings) |
## Entry-Level & Fresh Graduate Career Tracks
Bank AL Habib has strategically structured its front-line and digital banking operations to onboard ambitious graduates without requiring prior banking background:

### 1. Branch Sales Officer (BSO) — Retail & Consumer Banking
- **Role Focus:** Primary driver for retail branch deposit mobilization, acquiring new-to-bank (NTB) customers, promoting current and savings accounts (CASA), and cross-selling consumer finance products.
- **Eligibility:** Fresh graduates holding a 14-year or 16-year Bachelor’s degree (B.Com, BBA, BA, BS, or equivalent) from an HEC-recognized institution with a minimum 2nd Division or 2.5 CGPA.
- **Core Competencies:** Confident interpersonal communication in Urdu and English, positive sales aptitude, energetic client interaction, and adherence to branch compliance standards.
- **Locations:** Karachi branch clusters, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Lahore, Islamabad, and other provincial hubs.

### 2. Phone Banking Officer — Alternative Delivery Channels (ADC) Call Center
- **Role Focus:** Stationed at Bank AL Habib's centralized contact center in Karachi, officers handle inbound customer inquiries, resolve digital banking issues, assist with internet/mobile banking setups, and execute ADC service requests.
- **Eligibility:** Minimum 14 or 16 years of education in any discipline. Fresh graduates with pleasant telephone etiquette, active listening skills, and fluency in English and Urdu are highly encouraged to apply.
- **Location:** Centralized ADC Facility, Karachi.
- **Working Hours:** Rotational shift schedules (with dedicated safe transportation allowances and night allowances where applicable).

### 3. General Banking & Operations Trainee Roles
- **Role Focus:** Branch counter operations, clearing, remittance processing, account opening document verification, and Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance.
- **Eligibility:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, or Mathematics.
## Experienced Banking Openings: Relationship Manager & Senior RM
In addition to fresh graduate opportunities, Bank AL Habib is actively conducting lateral recruitment across Pakistan for proven liabilities specialists:

### 1. Relationship Manager (RM) — Branch Banking
- **Experience Required:** Minimum **2 years** of direct liabilities sales and portfolio management experience in branch banking.
- **Key Responsibilities:** Managing High-Net-Worth Individual (HNWI) portfolios, driving low-cost deposit growth, and ensuring cross-sales of trade and cash management services.
- **Qualification:** Graduate with at least 14 years of education (Master’s or MBA preferred).
- **Upper Age Limit:** Up to 35 years.

### 2. Senior Relationship Manager (SRM) — Commercial Banking
- **Experience Required:** Minimum **5 years** of demonstrated liabilities sales experience with established commercial relationships.
- **Key Responsibilities:** Expanding institutional and commercial deposit portfolios, assisting the Branch Manager in meeting overall cluster balance sheet targets, and mentoring junior sales officers.
- **Application Deadline:** Rolling review through **30 November 2026**.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (Bank AL Habib)
All applications must be submitted digitally via the official career portal. Follow these verified steps:

1. **Visit Official Careers Portal:** Navigate to [bankalhabib.com/current-openings](https://www.bankalhabib.com/current-openings).
2. **Browse Job Categories:** Select *Current Openings* and filter by location (*Karachi* or *Nationwide*) and role (*Branch Banking*, *ADC / Phone Banking*, or *Commercial Banking*).
3. **Create Candidate Profile:** Click *Apply Online* for your desired role. Create a profile using your primary email address and CNIC number.
4. **Upload CV & Academic Records:** Upload an updated, professional resume in PDF format (maximum 2 MB). Input your matriculation, intermediate, graduation, and post-graduation marks.
5. **Select Preferred Branch / City:** Clearly specify *Karachi* or your preferred city of residence for interview and placement scheduling.
6. **Submit Application:** Review all entries and submit. Note your applicant reference number for future communication.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Fraud Alert:** Bank AL Habib Limited does not charge any test fee, registration fee, or interview processing fee. Do not send money to any individual or unofficial bank account claiming to offer Bank AL Habib employment.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can fresh graduates with no prior banking experience apply for Bank AL Habib in 2026?**
Yes. Fresh graduates are explicitly eligible and encouraged to apply for **Branch Sales Officer (BSO)** and **Phone Banking Officer** positions. Training is provided upon induction.

**Q2: What is the minimum qualification required for entry-level roles?**
A minimum of 14 years of education (B.Com, BBA, BA, BSc, or BS) from an HEC-recognized university with at least a 2nd Division or 2.5 CGPA is required.

**Q3: Where is the Phone Banking Officer role based?**
The Phone Banking Officer position is based at Bank AL Habib's centralized contact center in **Karachi**.

**Q4: What is the last date to apply for Bank AL Habib Jobs 2026?**
Bank AL Habib operates rolling recruitment across its branch network. Specific commercial batches, including Relationship Manager tracks, accept applications through **30 November 2026**. Early submission is strongly recommended.

**Q5: Is there any written test or interview fee?**
No. Bank AL Habib never charges any fee at any stage of recruitment. The application process is 100% free.

content: # NTS GAT General VIII 2026 Registration — Last Date, Eligibility, Fee & Online Application
## Examination Overview & Official Schedule Notice
The **National Testing Service (NTS)** has officially announced the registration schedule for the **Graduate Assessment Test GAT-General-VIII (2026-VIII)**.

Serving as the standardized national evaluation benchmark recognized by the **Higher Education Commission (HEC)** of Pakistan, the GAT-General test is a mandatory admission requirement for candidates seeking enrollment into **MS, M.Phil, LLM, and equivalent 18-year postgraduate degree programs** across chartered public and private universities in Pakistan. Test scores also serve as eligibility criteria for HEC scholarships and specialized institutional development grants.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official GAT-VIII Schedule (Verified 24 October 2026):**
> - **Administering Body:** National Testing Service (NTS), Pakistan
> - **Test Title:** Graduate Assessment Test GAT-General-VIII (Series 2026-VIII)
> - **Target Degree Levels:** MS, M.Phil, LLM, and 18-Year Postgraduate Academic Admissions
> - **Registration Window:** Open now; final online submission deadline is **Monday, 30 November 2026**
> - **E-Roll Number Slips Issuance:** **Tuesday, 08 December 2026**
> - **National Test Date:** **Sunday, 13 December 2026**
> - **Result Declaration Date:** **Monday, 21 December 2026**
> - **Standard Registration Fee:** **Rs. 1,810/-** (Late Fee: **Rs. 2,510/-**)
> - **Score Validity:** Valid for **Two (2) Years** from the test announcement date.
## Quick Facts Table: NTS GAT-General 2026-VIII

| ATTRIBUTE | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Test Conducting Body** | National Testing Service (NTS) |
| **Examination Title** | GAT-G-VIII (Graduate Assessment Test GAT-General-VIII - 2026) |
| **Announcement Date** | Monday, 12 October 2026 |
| **Online Registration Deadline** | **Monday, 30 November 2026** |
| **E-Roll Number Slips** | Tuesday, 08 December 2026 |
| **Examination Date** | **Sunday, 13 December 2026** |
| **Result Gazette Date** | Monday, 21 December 2026 |
| **Registration Fee** | Rs. 1,810/- (Normal) \| Rs. 2,510/- (Late Fee) |
| **Minimum Eligibility** | 16 Years of Education (BS 4-Year / MA / MSc / Equivalent) |
| **Passing Benchmark** | 50% Cumulative Score (University requirements may vary) |
| **Score Validity** | 2 Years Valid for HEC & University Admissions |
| **Official Portal Link** | [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/) |
## GAT-General Test Categories & Paper Pattern

The GAT-General paper consists of **100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)** to be attempted in **120 minutes (2 hours)**. To maintain academic fairness, NTS administers four tailored subject categories matching the candidate's degree background:

### 1. GAT™-A (Business & Engineering Technology)
- **Applicable Fields:** Business Education, MBA, BBA (Hons), Commerce, and all Engineering & Technology disciplines (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Chemical, Computer Engineering).
- **Paper Distribution:**
  - English (Verbal Reasoning): **35%** (35 Questions)
  - Analytical Reasoning: **30%** (30 Questions)
  - Quantitative Reasoning (Mathematics): **35%** (35 Questions)

### 2. GAT™-B (Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences)
- **Applicable Fields:** Arts, Humanities, Fine Arts, English Literature, Languages, Journalism, Economics, Political Science, International Relations, Psychology, Sociology, and Public Administration.
- **Paper Distribution:**
  - English (Verbal Reasoning): **50%** (50 Questions)
  - Analytical Reasoning: **20%** (20 Questions)
  - Quantitative Reasoning: **30%** (30 Questions)

### 3. GAT™-C (Agriculture, Biological & Physical Sciences)
- **Applicable Fields:** Agricultural Sciences, Veterinary Medicine, Botany, Zoology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, and Information Technology.
- **Paper Distribution:**
  - English (Verbal Reasoning): **40%** (40 Questions)
  - Analytical Reasoning: **25%** (25 Questions)
  - Quantitative Reasoning: **35%** (35 Questions)

### 4. GAT™-D (Religious Studies / Madrassa Graduates)
- **Applicable Fields:** Candidates holding *Shahadat-ul-Aalmiya* from recognized Wafaq councils with an official HEC equivalency letter to 16 years of education seeking admission to M.Phil/MS in Islamic Studies.
- **Paper Distribution:**
  - English (Verbal Reasoning): **50%** (50 Questions)
  - Analytical Reasoning: **20%** (20 Questions)
  - Quantitative Reasoning: **30%** (30 Questions)
## Step-by-Step Online Registration Procedure
Registration for GAT-General is conducted entirely through the NTS online candidate portal:

1. **Portal Access:** Navigate to the official NTS portal at [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/).
2. **Candidate Profile Creation:** Log in with your CNIC and password (or click 'Sign Up' if new to NTS).
3. **Select Active Test:** Click on *Open Applications* and select **GAT-General-VIII (2026-VIII)**.
4. **Choose Test Category:** Select the appropriate category (GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, or GAT-D) corresponding strictly to your undergraduate degree discipline.
5. **Select Preferred Examination Center:** Choose your primary test city (Islamabad/Rawalpindi, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Faisalabad, Sukkur, Hyderabad, Abbottabad, Bahawalpur, D.I. Khan, etc.).
6. **Upload Photograph:** Upload a recent, clear passport-size photograph with a white or light blue background (max 30KB).
7. **Generate 1Bill Invoice:** Download the automated deposit slip containing the unique 1Bill Consumer Number.
8. **Pay Test Fee:** Pay the **Rs. 1,810/-** registration fee via any bank ATM, internet banking portal, mobile app (EasyPaisa / JazzCash), or TCS express centers.
9. **Confirm Submission:** After payment, check your NTS dashboard. Payment verification updates automatically within 24 to 48 hours. No physical documents need to be mailed to NTS for GAT-General.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to register for GAT General VIII 2026?**
The last date for online registration is **Monday, 30 November 2026**.

**Q2: What is the official test date for GAT-2026-VIII?**
The examination will be held nationwide on **Sunday, 13 December 2026**.

**Q3: How much is the registration fee for GAT General?**
The standard test fee is **Rs. 1,810/-**. If registering during the designated late-fee window, the fee is **Rs. 2,510/-**.

**Q4: For how long is the GAT General score valid?**
The GAT-General score card remains officially valid for **two (2) years** from the date of result announcement.

**Q5: What is the minimum score required to pass GAT?**
The baseline passing mark set by NTS and HEC is a cumulative **50% score** (50 marks out of 100). Individual universities and degree departments may set higher cutoff thresholds for admission merit ranking.

**Q6: Do I need to mail hard copies of the application form to NTS?**
No. GAT-General applications are processed completely online through the NTS portal; physical dispatch of forms is not required.

content: # Punjab Child Protection Bureau Jobs 2026 — Nurse, Accountant, Child Attendant & Other Vacancies
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

The **Child Protection & Welfare Bureau (CPWB), Punjab**, operating under the administrative oversight of the **Home Department, Government of Punjab**, has officially announced an extensive recruitment campaign for **120 contract vacancies** across multiple professional, technical, and caregiving cadres.

Administered through the **National Testing Service (NTS)**, this recruitment drive offers opportunities for qualified medical, finance, religious, and childcare professionals to serve vulnerable, neglected, and destitute children across CPWB institutes in Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Sialkot, Bahawalpur, and Rahim Yar Khan.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Recruitment Verification (Verified 24 October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Department:** Child Protection & Welfare Bureau (CPWB), Home Department, Government of Punjab
> - **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
> - **Total Vacancies:** Exactly **120 Confirmed Positions** (Nurse, Accountant, Child Attendants, Religious Teacher, Dispenser)
> - **Employment Nature:** 1-Year Contract Basis (Extendable based on performance and budget)
> - **Application Fee:** **Rs. 550/-** payable via 1Link 1Bill
> - **Application Cutoff:** **Saturday, 31 October 2026**
> - **Application Procedure:** Complete online registration at [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/projectsnew.php), print the completed form, and dispatch it with verified credentials to NTS Lahore Office.
## Quick Facts Table: Punjab CPWB Jobs 2026

| RECRUITMENT PARAMETER | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Hiring Institution** | Child Protection & Welfare Bureau (CPWB), Punjab |
| **Administrative Parent** | Home Department, Government of Punjab |
| **Testing Authority** | National Testing Service (NTS) |
| **Total Vacancies** | **120 Posts** (111 Child Attendants + 9 Technical/Staff) |
| **Job Locations** | Lahore (Head Office) & Regional CPWB Centers across Punjab |
| **Gender Eligibility** | Male & Female (Cadre-specific quotas) |
| **Application Fee** | Rs. 550/- (Non-Refundable NTS Fee) |
| **Application Deadline** | **Saturday, 31 October 2026** |
| **Minimum Education** | Matriculation, Intermediate, Nursing Diploma, B.Com |
| **Official Portal** | [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/projectsnew.php) |
## Detailed Position Breakdown & Educational Eligibility

### 1. Child Attendant (Male & Female) — 111 Posts
- **Vacancies Distribution:** **26 Male** positions and **85 Female** positions.
- **Age Bracket:** 25 to 32 Years.
- **Educational Requirement:** Secondary School Certificate (Matriculation, at least 2nd Division) from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education.
- **Experience Advantage:** Candidates possessing 2 years of practical experience in child care, residential boarding management, or child rehabilitation units receive added selection preference.

### 2. Nurse (Female) — 03 Posts
- **Age Bracket:** 22 to 28 Years.
- **Educational Requirement:** 3-Year Diploma in General Nursing and 1-Year Diploma in Midwifery from a government-recognized nursing institute.
- **Professional Registration:** Mandatory active registration with the **Pakistan Nursing Council (PNC)**.
- **Computer Proficiency:** Practical knowledge of MS Office software is preferred.

### 3. Accountant — 04 Posts
- **Age Bracket:** 21 to 28 Years.

The printed form and attested documents must be delivered to the **NTS Lahore Office: Plot No. 201, FF Block, CCA, Phase IV, DHA, Lahore**.

content: # IRSA Jobs 2026 — 23 Vacancies for Engineers, Supervisors, GIS Analyst & Auditor | Apply via NTS
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

The **Indus River System Authority (IRSA)**, the apex federal water regulatory authority operating under the administrative control of the Government of Pakistan, has announced fresh contractual career opportunities under its flagship national development initiative: **"Installation of Telemetry System for Real-Time Discharge Monitoring at 27 Key Sites on Indus Basin Irrigation System (IBIS)"**.

Administered and processed through the **National Testing Service (NTS)**, this recruitment drive invites experienced engineering, spatial analysis, and financial professionals across Pakistan to support modern digital discharge monitoring across major barrage stations, canal headworks, and inter-provincial water distribution rim stations.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Quick Answer & Official Recruitment Verification (Verified 24 October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Organization:** Indus River System Authority (IRSA), Government of Pakistan
> - **Project Mandate:** Telemetry System for Real-Time Discharge Monitoring (IBIS 27 Sites)
> - **Testing & Screening Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
> - **Total Confirmed Positions:** Exactly **23 Vacancies** across 4 distinct cadres
> - **Employment Terms:** Federal Project Pay Scale (PPS-05 to PPS-07 Contract)
> - **Application Window:** Open now; final cutoff is **Monday, 26 October 2026**
> - **Application Mode:** Online submission on [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/projectsnew.php) followed by postal dispatch of printed form and credentials to NTS Headquarters, Islamabad.
## Quick Facts Table: IRSA Telemetry Recruitment 2026

| ATTRIBUTE | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Employer Authority** | Indus River System Authority (IRSA) |
| **Sponsoring Project** | Telemetry Real-Time Discharge Monitoring System (IBIS) |
| **Testing Agency** | National Testing Service (NTS) |
| **Total Vacancies** | **23 Confirmed Posts** |
| **Pay Scales Offered** | Project Pay Scales (PPS-05, PPS-06, PPS-07) |

| **Duty Stations** | 27 IBIS Telemetry Stations Nationwide (Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan) & IRSA HQ Islamabad |
| **Eligibility Bracket** | DAE (Electronics/Electrical), 16-Year Degrees in GIS/Finance |
| **Age Limits** | 30 to 35 Years (Cadre-specific ceilings) |
| **Official Portal Link** | [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/projectsnew.php) |
## Position Breakdown, Vacancies & Eligibility Criteria

### 1. GIS / Web GIS Analyst (PPS-07) — 01 Post
- **Monthly Remuneration:** **Rs. 157,500/-** per month.
- **Educational Qualification:** Master’s / 16-Year Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Remote Sensing (RS), Geomatics, Space Science, or Computer Science from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Experience Required:** Minimum 3 to 5 years of professional hands-on experience in Web GIS portal development, hydrological spatial mapping, satellite data integration, and database administration.
- **Upper Age Limit:** Up to 35 Years.

### 2. Senior Auditor (PPS-06) — 01 Post
- **Monthly Remuneration:** **Rs. 105,000/-** per month.
- **Educational Qualification:** 16-Year degree in Accounting & Finance, Commerce (M.Com, BBA Hons / MBA Finance) or CA Inter, CMA, or ACCA member.
- **Experience Required:** At least 3 years of post-qualification experience in project financial auditing, public procurement rules (PPRA), and expenditure verification in government or autonomous bodies.
- **Upper Age Limit:** Up to 35 Years.

### 3. Sub-Engineer — Electronics / Electrical (PPS-05) — 17 Posts
- **Monthly Remuneration:** **Rs. 70,000/-** per month.
- **Educational Qualification:** 3-Year Diploma of Associate Engineer (DAE) in Electronics, Electrical, or Telecommunication Engineering from a recognized Board of Technical Education.
- **Experience Required:** 1 to 2 years of practical experience in electronic sensor calibration, river gauging equipment maintenance, industrial instrumentation, or solar telemetry setups.
- **Upper Age Limit:** Up to 30 Years.

### 4. Supervisor — Electronics / Electrical (PPS-05) — 04 Posts
- **Monthly Remuneration:** **Rs. 70,000/-** per month.
- **Educational Qualification:** 3-Year Diploma of Associate Engineer (DAE) in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
- **Experience Required:** 2 to 3 years of supervisory field experience in battery bank monitoring, power distribution boards, automated gate sensor networks, and data transmission links.
- **Upper Age Limit:** Up to 32 Years.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide (NTS)
Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria must complete the standardized two-phase NTS application procedure:

1. **Register on NTS Candidate Portal:** Visit [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/projectsnew.php) and locate *Indus River System Authority (IRSA) — Telemetry Project*.
2. **Fill Digital Application:** Enter CNIC, personal bio-data, academic qualifications (Matric, DAE, Graduation), and relevant work experience.
3. **Select Post:** Choose your exact position (only one position per application form; candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate forms and fees).
4. **Generate Fee Challan / 1Bill Invoice:** Download the auto-generated 1Link 1Bill invoice for the NTS test processing fee.
5. **Pay Fee Electronically:** Pay via mobile banking apps, ATMs, EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or TCS express counters using the 1Bill consumer number.
6. **Print & Dispatch Form:** Print the finalized online application form, affix 2 recent passport-size photographs, attach attested photocopies of CNIC, Domicile, DAE/Degree certificates, experience letters, and the original paid deposit slip.
7. **Mailing Address:** Send via registered courier before the close of business on **26 October 2026** to:
   > **National Testing Service (IRSA Project)**
   > Plot 96, Street 4, Sector H-8/1, Islamabad.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for IRSA Jobs 2026?**
The last date for online registration and courier submission through NTS is **Monday, 26 October 2026**.

**Q2: How many total vacancies are announced in this IRSA recruitment drive?**
Exactly **23 vacancies** are officially advertised (1 GIS Analyst, 1 Senior Auditor, 17 Sub-Engineers, and 4 Supervisors).

**Q3: Can candidates with a DAE apply for Sub-Engineer posts?**
Yes. Candidates holding a 3-year DAE in Electronics, Electrical, or Telecommunication from a recognized Board of Technical Education are eligible.

**Q4: Where will appointed candidates be posted?**
Appointed staff will be stationed at telemetry monitoring stations across 27 key irrigation sites on the Indus Basin (including locations in Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan) and at the IRSA Head Office in Islamabad.

**Q5: Is physical mailing of the application mandatory?**
Yes. NTS requires candidates to print the submitted online application and mail it along with attested educational documents and the paid fee voucher to NTS Islamabad.
