content: # Pakistan Wheat Indicative Price 2027: Federal Government Sets Rs 4,500 Per 40kg Baseline for Rabi Season
## Official Announcement & Primary Source Verification
The **Federal Government of Pakistan** has officially announced an **indicative wheat support price of Rs 4,500 per 40kg** for the upcoming **2026–27 Rabi agricultural season**.

Broadcast by state media (**Radio Pakistan**) on **23 October 2026** and attributed directly to the **Prime Minister’s Office**, this economic policy announcement represents an increase of **Rs 1,000 per 40kg** over the previous national benchmark of **Rs 3,500 per 40kg**. The timely intervention is aimed at steering farmer planting intentions toward maximum wheat acreage, mitigating production input inflation, and safeguarding domestic food security ahead of nationwide winter sowing.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Critical Editorial & Farmer Advisory (Verified Facts 24 October 2026):**
> - **Indicative Benchmark vs. Guaranteed Public Procurement:** This announcement establishes an **indicative pricing baseline**. It does **not** constitute an open, unconditional commercial procurement guarantee that PASSCO or provincial food departments will purchase every single bag of grain produced at this price.
> - **No Government Procurement Currently Active:** Public wheat procurement operations take place post-harvest (March–May 2027) subject to separate operational quotas, storage capacity, and provincial purchase center notifications.
> - **No Citizen Registration or Portal:** There is **no registration portal, SMS code, or enrollment form** for the wheat support price. It is an open agricultural price signal, not a direct cash distribution scheme.
> - **No New Cash Relief Release:** This policy announcement does not release new fertilizer cash handouts or immediate agricultural disbursements.
> - **Sindh Provincial Programmes Are Separate:** The Sindh Government's **Benazir Hari Card** (providing Rs 4,000 per acre DAP subsidy for farmers cultivating up to 25 acres) operates under separate provincial financing and is independent of this federal price benchmark.
## Quick Facts: Pakistan Wheat Indicative Price 2027 at a Glance

| PRICING ATTRIBUTE | PREVIOUS BENCHMARK | ANNOUNCED 2027 BENCHMARK | VERIFIED DETAILS |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Indicative Price (per 40kg)** | Rs 3,500 | **Rs 4,500** | Net increase of Rs 1,000 per 40kg (+28.57%) |
| **Price per Kilogram** | Rs 87.50 / kg | **Rs 112.50 / kg** | Upward floor price for open grain trade |
| **Announcement Date** | Historical Rate | **23 October 2026** | Formally reported via Radio Pakistan |
| **Source Authority** | Federal Deliberations | **Prime Minister’s Office** | Coordinated with National Food Security |
| **Target Crop Season** | Previous Crop Cycles | **Rabi 2026–27 (Harvest 2027)** | Pre-sowing incentive for growers |
| **Policy Nature** | Market Baseline | **Indicative Price Signal** | Informs market floor, not guaranteed buyback |
| **Provincial Scope** | Nationwide | **All 4 Provinces & ICT** | Baseline for provincial food departments |
| **Registration Requirement** | None | **Zero Registration Required** | Beware of fraudulent fee-charging agents |
## Understanding the Difference: Indicative Price vs. Guaranteed Procurement
To prevent economic confusion and exploitation by predatory middlemen, farmers and market participants must clearly distinguish between agricultural pricing mechanisms:

### 1. What Is an Indicative Price?
An **indicative price** is an advance economic signal declared by the government prior to sowing. It informs farmers of the minimum remuneration authorities consider necessary to cover escalated input costs (fertilizer, diesel, electricity tariffs, and certified seed) while earning a sustainable livelihood. By announcing Rs 4,500 per 40kg ahead of November sowing, the government aims to encourage farmers to cultivate wheat rather than shifting acreage to competing cash crops (such as mustard, canola, or sunflower).

### 2. How Does It Differ from Guaranteed Procurement?
An indicative price does **not** automatically obligate state agencies to buy all harvested grain. Actual government procurement depends upon:
- Statutory approval by provincial cabinets (Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan).
- Operational wheat procurement targets (e.g., target tonnages set for PASSCO and provincial food departments).
- Budgetary releases for bank borrowing and storage procurement credit.
- The opening of designated purchase centers and gunny bag (bardana) distribution quotas closer to harvest in April 2027.
## Relationship to Provincial Wheat Programmes (Sindh Benazir Hari Card)
Growers must not confuse this federal commodity pricing signal with provincial direct farmer assistance programmes:

- **Sindh Benazir Hari Card DAP Relief:** The Government of Sindh provides targeted relief of **Rs 4,000 per acre** for DAP fertilizer purchases specifically to verified smallholders farming up to 25 acres through designated commercial banking branches. That programme operates under the provincial Agriculture Department and Form-VII land revenue verification (see our detailed guide: [Sindh Wheat Subsidy 2026 Benazir Hari Card](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-wheat-subsidy-benazir-hari-card-2026)).
- **Federal Indicative Price:** Covers all wheat growers nationwide as a general market benchmark, requiring no personal identification card, land threshold, or registration fee.
## Fraud & Scammer Advisory for Rural Communities

> [!WARNING]
> **Protect Yourself from Fraudulent Agricultural Schemes:**
> - **No Registration Fee:** Scammers frequently circulate WhatsApp messages asking farmers to pay Rs 500 to Rs 2,000 on Easypaisa or JazzCash to 'register for the Rs 4,500 wheat subsidy'. These are entirely fake.
> - **No Special Web Portal:** The Federal Government has not created any online portal for this price. Do not submit your CNIC, banking OTPs, or biometric details to unauthorized websites.
> - **Official Verification:** For authentic commodity notices, monitor [Radio Pakistan](https://radio.gov.pk/) and the Ministry of National Food Security & Research ([mnfsr.gov.pk](http://www.mnfsr.gov.pk/)).
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the new wheat price announced by the Federal Government?**
The Federal Government has announced an indicative price of **Rs 4,500 per 40kg** for the 2027 harvest, reflecting a Rs 1,000 per 40kg increase over the previous benchmark.

**Q2: Does this guarantee that every farmer will sell wheat at Rs 4,500?**
No. The figure is an indicative benchmark to guide open market baselines and cultivate acreage. Guaranteed state procurement depends upon individual provincial procurement policies notified prior to the 2027 harvest.

**Q3: When was the announcement made and by whom?**
The announcement was reported on **23 October 2026** by Radio Pakistan, citing the Prime Minister’s Office.

**Q4: Do farmers need to register anywhere to receive this price?**
No. There is no farmer registration, enrollment form, or verification fee associated with the indicative wheat price.

**Q5: How does this affect Sindh's Benazir Hari Card scheme?**
It has no direct connection. The Benazir Hari Card is a separate provincial subsidy providing Rs 4,000/acre DAP relief to registered smallholders in Sindh.

  - [Sindh Wheat Subsidy 2026–27: Benazir Hari Card DAP Relief](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-wheat-subsidy-benazir-hari-card-2026)
  - [Sindh Kisan Subsidy 2026: 25-Acre Registration & Payment Rules](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-kisan-subsidy-2026-eligibility-payments)

content: # Ministry of Planning Jobs 2026 — Accountant & APS PPS-6 Vacancies
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

The **Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives**, Government of Pakistan, has officially announced new contractual recruitment for two key executive support positions: **Accountant (PPS-06)** and **Assistant Private Secretary (APS, PPS-06)**.

Verified directly on the official **National Job Portal (NJP)** under Requisition IDs **9842** (Accountant) and **9840** (Assistant Private Secretary), these appointments are based at Islamabad to support federal development projects. Both positions offer federal project pay scales, structured public-sector experience, and merit-based selection.
## Quick Facts & Comparative Overview

| Attribute | Position A: Accountant | Position B: Assistant Private Secretary (APS) |
|---|---|---|
| **Hiring Ministry** | Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives | Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives |
| **Pay Scale / Grade** | **PPS-06 (Project Pay Scale-6)** | **PPS-06 (Project Pay Scale-6)** |
| **NJP Requisition ID** | **9842** | **9840** |
| **Vacancies Announced** | **01 Position** | **01 Position** |
| **Employment Type** | Federal Project Contract | Federal Project Contract |
| **Posting Date** | 19 October 2026 | 19 October 2026 |
| **Application Deadline** | **02 November 2026** | **02 November 2026** |
| **Duty Station** | Islamabad, Pakistan | Islamabad, Pakistan |
| **Minimum Qualification** | B.Com / Associate Degree / BBA / BS Accounting & Finance / ACCA / CA-Inter | BA / B.Com / BBA / BSc / Associate Degree (14–16 Years) |
| **Minimum Experience** | **01 Year** in Accounting / AGPR | **02 Years** in Secretarial / Administrative Support |
| **Age Limit** | **Max 45 Years** | **Max 50 Years** |
| **Official NJP Apply Link** | [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9842](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9842) | [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9840](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9840) |
## Position Profile A: Accountant (PPS-06) — NJP Requisition 9842

### Core Accounting Functions
The appointed Accountant will manage day-to-day project finance, accounting reconciliations, and statutory reporting:
1. **Preparation of NIS:** Formulating New Item Statements (NIS) for development projects in accordance with Planning Commission and Finance Division financial rules.
2. **Cash Book & Ledger Maintenance:** Managing project cash books, processing contractor/vendor invoices, and handling official cash receipts and disbursements.
3. **AGPR Reconciliation:** Conducting monthly and annual reconciliation of project accounts with the **Accountant General Pakistan Revenues (AGPR)**.
4. **Audit Compliance:** Assisting Project Directors during statutory internal audits, Auditor General of Pakistan (AGP) inspections, and preparing audit compliance reports.

### Eligibility Criteria for Accountant
- **Education:** B.Com (2 or 3 Years), Associate Degree in Commerce / Business Administration, BS Accounting & Finance, BBA, ACCA, CA-Inter, or MBA Finance from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Experience:** Minimum **01 year** of post-qualification experience in public sector project accounting, AGPR procedures, or corporate accounts.
- **Age Limit:** Maximum **45 years** as of the closing date.
## Position Profile B: Assistant Private Secretary (APS, PPS-06) — NJP Requisition 9840

### Secretarial & Administrative Mandate
The Assistant Private Secretary (APS) serves as the primary administrative and confidential assistant to executive project leadership:
1. **Official Correspondence:** Managing confidential and official correspondence, drafting official memoranda, and processing ministerial noting and summaries.
2. **Meeting & Calendar Coordination:** Scheduling high-level project meetings, preparing working papers, recording minutes of meetings, and tracking action items.
3. **Record Management:** Supervising diary, dispatch, filing registers, and ensuring secure custody of classified project files.
4. **Dictation & Secretarial Support:** Taking dictation, shorthand transcription, and fast computerized typing in English and Urdu.

### Eligibility Criteria for APS
- **Education:** Bachelor of Arts (BA), B.Com, BBA, BSc, or Associate Degree in Arts / English / Commerce / Public Administration (14 years minimum graduation) from an HEC-recognized institution.
- **Experience:** Minimum **02 years** of proven secretarial, administrative, or office management experience in government ministries, autonomous bodies, or reputable corporate organizations.
- **Age Limit:** Maximum **50 years** as of the closing date.
## Important Service Conditions & Terms

- **Contract Nature:** Appointments are purely on contract under the Federal Government Project Pay Scales (PPS) policy for the project execution period.
- **Quota & Domicile:** Both positions are filled on an open merit basis for Pakistani nationals.
- **No TA/DA:** No traveling allowance or daily allowance will be admissible for test or interview rounds.
- **Document Verification:** Candidates summoned for interviews must produce original educational degrees, transcripts, experience certificates, and valid CNIC.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Process on NJP

1. Visit the National Job Portal listings:
   - For Accountant: [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9842](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9842)
   - For Assistant Private Secretary: [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9840](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9840)
2. Log in with your NJP credentials or register a new profile using your CNIC.
3. Complete your profile details, ensuring that qualifications and experience dates strictly align with your certificates.
4. Select the desired position and submit your application online.
5. Both listings close on **02 November 2026**; early submission is advised to avoid last-minute portal congestion.

> [!NOTE]
> Candidates eligible for both positions must submit separate online applications through their respective NJP job links.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Ministry of Planning jobs?**
The application deadline for both Accountant and APS positions is **02 November 2026**.

**Q2: What is the maximum age limit for Assistant Private Secretary?**
The maximum age limit for APS is **50 years**, allowing seasoned administrative professionals to apply.

**Q3: Is experience with AGPR required for the Accountant post?**
Yes, familiarity with AGPR reconciliation, NIS preparation, and project cash books is a primary responsibility under the official job description.

**Q4: Can candidates apply through postal mail?**
No. Applications are accepted exclusively online through the National Job Portal (njp.gov.pk).

content: # PSEB Creative Lead Jobs 2026 — PPS-8 Government IT Vacancy
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Notice

The **Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB)**, an apex autonomous body operating under the **Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication (MoITT), Government of Pakistan**, has officially announced a high-profile creative vacancy for **Creative Lead (PPS-08)**.

Verified directly on the official [National Job Portal (NJP)](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9847) under **Job Requisition ID: 9847**, this recruitment drive invites experienced graphic designers, visual storytellers, and creative communication specialists to lead PSEB's national and international branding, promotional marketing campaigns, and digital media production.
## Quick Facts Table

| Attribute | Verified Official Detail |
|---|---|
| **Hiring Organization** | Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB) |
| **Ministry** | Ministry of Information Technology & Telecommunication (MoITT) |
| **Position Title** | **Creative Lead** |
| **Pay Scale / Grade** | **PPS-08 (Project Pay Scale-8)** |
| **Job Requisition ID** | 9847 (NJP) |
| **Employment Type** | Federal Project Contract |
| **Posting Date** | 23 October 2026 |
| **Application Deadline** | **05 November 2026 (11:59 PM PKT)** |
| **Vacancies Announced** | 01 Position (Open Merit) |
| **Duty Station** | Islamabad, Pakistan (PSEB Head Office) |
| **Minimum Education** | 16 Years Degree (Management Sciences, Marketing, Business Admin, or IT) |
| **Required Experience** | Minimum 04 Years in Professional Graphic Design, Animation, or Caricature |
| **Maximum Age Limit** | **45 Years** (Inclusive of general relaxation) |
| **Performance Incentive** | **3% Annual Increment** linked to KPI achievement |
| **Official Portal Link** | [njp.gov.pk/jobs/9847](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9847) |
## Core Job Responsibilities & Creative Mandate
As the Creative Lead at PSEB, the appointed officer will spearhead the visual identity and design execution across all corporate and government outreach channels:

1. **Digital & Print Design Execution:** Conceptualizing and developing layouts for websites, digital campaigns, social media channels, international trade show pavilions, print advertisements, corporate brochures, and magazines.
2. **Branding & Visual Identity Management:** Safeguarding and enhancing PSEB's brand guidelines across all stakeholder communications, ensuring visual alignment between Pakistan's national IT initiatives and global tech audiences.
3. **Marketing Collateral & Publications:** Designing comprehensive annual reports, sector white papers, government presentations, executive decks, and high-impact investor pitch materials.
4. **Creative Brainstorming & Concept Direction:** Leading creative brainstorms, pitching innovative design concepts, and translating strategic IT export goals into compelling visual narratives.
5. **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Collaborating closely with marketing, international trade delegation, and PR teams to deliver high-quality creative assets within tight project timelines.
6. **Annual Increment Policy:** Under official contract terms, a **3% annual salary increment** is awarded based on annual KPI milestones and performance appraisals.
## Educational Qualifications & Mandatory Skillset

### Minimum Educational Criteria
- **Degree Level:** Minimum 16 years of education from an HEC-recognized local or foreign university.
- **Accepted Disciplines:**
  - Management Sciences
  - Marketing or Business Development
  - Business Administration (BBA 4-Year / MBA)
  - Information Technology (BS IT / BS CS / Software Engineering)

### Technical Experience & Design Proficiency
- **Post-Qualification Experience:** At least **4 years** of hands-on professional experience in graphic design, digital animation, illustration, caricature, or visual brand identity.
- **Software Mastery:** Expert proficiency in **Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator / CorelDraw, and Adobe InDesign** is mandatory.
- **Typography & Layout Principles:** In-depth understanding of typography, color harmony, visual hierarchy, spatial balance, and print preparation standards.
- **Office Productivity:** Well-versed in MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel), internet tools, and project management applications.
## Relationship to Concurrent PSEB October Vacancies

Candidates should note that PSEB is currently executing two distinct hiring tracks on the National Job Portal:
- **Creative Lead (Job ID: 9847):** Focused exclusively on visual design, creative marketing, and brand architecture with an application deadline of **05 November 2026**.
- **HR & Research Openings (Job IDs: 9801/9802):** Covering Assistant Project Manager HR Skills (PPS-8), Research Consultant (PPS-8), and Assistant Project Officer HR Skills (PPS-7), which close earlier on **25 October 2026** (see CareerDost's coverage of [PSEB Government IT Jobs](/jobs/pseb-government-it-jobs-october-2026)).
Candidates possessing creative and design backgrounds are encouraged to apply specifically under this dedicated Creative Lead announcement.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Guide on NJP
Applications are processed strictly through the Federal Government's centralized portal:

1. Navigate to the official listing: [National Job Portal — PSEB Creative Lead (Job 9847)](https://www.njp.gov.pk/jobs/9847).
2. Click on **Login to Apply** (or **Sign Up** using your CNIC, mobile number, and verified email if new to NJP).
3. Complete or update your standardized NJP Resume Builder profile (education, employment history, and key software skills).
4. Select your degree discipline and input exact CGPA / percentage as validated by your degree transcripts.
5. Ensure your contact telephone and postal details are current.
6. Submit the electronic application before the closing time of **05 November 2026**.

> [!TIP]
> Prepare a digital portfolio or link to your Behance / Dribbble / online creative work to provide during subsequent interview rounds.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for PSEB Creative Lead?**
The last date for online application submission on NJP is **05 November 2026**.

**Q2: What is the pay scale for this position?**
The position is offered under Federal Project Pay Scale **PPS-08**, which includes performance-linked 3% annual increments.

**Q3: Is an online portfolio required?**
While the initial NJP application collects degree and experience details, candidates shortlisted for technical assessment and interviews will be evaluated on their creative portfolio.

**Q4: What is the maximum age limit?**
The maximum age limit is **45 years** as of the closing date of the advertisement.

content: # Meezan Bank Jobs 2026: Transaction Associates (Batch 01) — Nationwide Branch & Payroll Openings
## Official Recruitment Notice & Vacancy Overview

**Meezan Bank Limited**, Pakistan's premier Islamic commercial bank, has announced fresh career opportunities under **Transaction Associates (Batch No. 01 — Transaction Solutions)**. Verified directly on the official [Meezan Bank Oracle Cloud Recruitment Portal](https://fa-ewvh-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_3002/job/10699/) (Job Requisition ID: **10699**) on 23 October 2026, this nationwide hiring drive offers distinct career pathways for both **Intermediate diploma/certificate holders** and **University Graduates** across multiple cities in Pakistan.

The position functions within the bank's **Transaction Solutions** division, focusing primarily on client engagement, payroll corporate partner account facilitation, biometric authentication, and field-level documentation under strict Shariah-compliant banking standards.
## Quick Facts Table

| Attribute | Verified Official Detail |
|---|---|
| **Hiring Institution** | Meezan Bank Limited |
| **Recruitment Drive** | **Transaction Associates — Batch No. 01** |
| **Department** | Transaction Solutions |
| **Requisition ID** | 10699 |
| **Official Posting Date** | 22 October 2026 |
| **Application Deadline** | **03 November 2026 (18:59 UTC / 23:59 PKT)** |
| **Job Locations** | Multiple Cities Nationwide (Pakistan) |
| **Minimum Education** | Intermediate (FA / FSc / I.Com) or Bachelor's Degree (Graduates Preferred) |
| **Employment Arrangement** | **Permanent Scale** for Graduates; **Bank Contract** for Intermediate Holders |
| **Age Criteria** | 18 to 26 Years (as of 30 November 2026) |
| **Age Relaxation** | 2 Years (Up to 28 Years) for Hafiz-e-Quran, Dars-e-Nizami / Shahadat-ul-Alamiyah, & Differently-Abled |
| **Experience Level** | Fresh Candidates / Entry Level Welcome |
| **Official Portal Link** | [meezanbank.com/careers](https://www.meezanbank.com/careers/) |
## Intermediate vs. Graduate Eligibility & Employment Terms
A pivotal feature of this Meezan Bank recruitment drive is the structured career tier based on the candidate's educational level:

1. **Permanent Employment Track for Graduates:**
   - **Eligibility:** Candidates possessing an HEC-recognized Bachelor’s degree (BA, BSc, B.Com, BBA, BS 4-Year) in any discipline. Graduates with coursework or certification in **Islamic Finance** receive an added selection advantage.
   - **Compensation & Perks:** Market-competitive permanent salary scale, annual increments, performance-linked bonuses, Provident Fund, Gratuity, Subsidized Housing Finance facility, **Auto Financing at Zero Percent**, and comprehensive Health and Life Takaful coverage.

2. **Bank Contract Track for Intermediate Candidates:**
   - **Eligibility:** Candidates with completed Intermediate (FA, FSc Pre-Medical/Pre-Engineering, I.Com, or ICS).
   - **Compensation & Perks:** Market-competitive monthly salary package, performance bonuses, career progression opportunities, and comprehensive Health and Life Takaful coverage.
## Age Eligibility & Government-Recognized Relaxations
Candidates must be between **18 and 26 years of age as of 30 November 2026**.

A **2-year age relaxation (up to 28 years)** is officially granted to:
- **Hafiz-e-Quran** (holding recognized certification).
- Candidates who have completed **Dars-e-Nizami** or **Shahadat-ul-Alamiyah** and possess an official HEC equivalency letter.
- **Differently-abled individuals** holding a valid disability registration certificate.
## Key Job Responsibilities & Daily Functions

Transaction Associates within the Transaction Solutions team carry out frontline onboarding and relationship-building tasks:
- **Corporate Payroll Visits:** Conducting structured field visits to Meezan Bank’s designated Payroll Partner companies to facilitate on-site salary account opening for corporate employees.
- **Biometric Authentication:** Performing mandatory digital biometric verification via handheld biometric terminals and ensuring complete documentation in line with State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) AML/KYC regulations.
- **Discrepancy Resolution:** Collaborating directly with branch operations managers and customer onboarding units to rectify document discrepancies and expedite account activation.
- **Record Maintenance & Reporting:** Maintaining precise electronic logs of daily field visits, account applications initiated, and success rates.
- **Shariah & Regulatory Compliance:** Upholding Meezan Bank’s Islamic banking protocols and regulatory guidelines during all corporate interactions.
## Desired Skills & Core Competencies

- Strong verbal and written communication skills in Urdu and English.
- Customer-centric mindset with relationship-building capability.
- Willingness to undertake local field travel within assigned city zones.
- Fundamental comprehension of digital banking and customer onboarding workflows.
- High degree of integrity, professional grooming, and adherence to Islamic ethical conduct.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure
Candidates meeting the criteria must apply exclusively through the official Meezan Bank Oracle Cloud portal:

1. Visit the verified Meezan Bank Oracle Recruitment portal: [Job ID 10699 Requisition Page](https://fa-ewvh-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_3002/job/10699/).
2. Click on the orange **Apply Now** button.
3. Enter your active email address to create or log in to your Candidate Experience profile.
4. Upload your updated Resume/CV (PDF or DOCX format, max 5MB).
5. Complete the educational history section accurately (specifying Intermediate or Graduation details).
6. Fill in personal details, CNIC number, date of birth, and claim age relaxation if eligible (Hafiz-e-Quran / Dars-e-Nizami).
7. Review the declaration and submit before the cutoff deadline of **03 November 2026**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Only applications submitted through the official portal will be entertained. Meezan Bank does not charge any application processing or registration fee at any stage of recruitment.

content: # SSGC Gasification Plan: 46 Sindh Villages in Sanghar & Shikarpur to Get Gas Grid Connections (Rs 1.92B Project)
## Executive Summary & Official Project Verification

In line with Pakistan's statutory resource-benefit policy for communities residing near natural hydrocarbon fields, **Sui Southern Gas Company Limited (SSGC)** has outlined an expansive **Rs 1.922 billion infrastructure gasification plan** targeting **46 villages and rural towns** across **Sanghar and Shikarpur districts** in Sindh province.

Formally designated as the **Sixth Phase Gasification Programme**, the project addresses historic demands by rural residents living in the immediate vicinity of major natural gas production fields. The project requires laying **178.52 kilometres of gas distribution pipeline networks**, bringing piped natural gas to approximately **2,710 prospective domestic consumers** across both districts.

Funding for the multi-billion-rupee infrastructure initiative is structured under an established government-utility cost-sharing mechanism:
- **Federal Government Development Share (~92%):** Rs 1.776 billion (Rs 1,776 million).
- **SSGC Institutional Capital Share (~8%):** Rs 146.34 million.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Status: Planned Infrastructure (FY 2026–27 Implementation Schedule):**
> - **Executing Agency:** Sui Southern Gas Company Limited (SSGC).
> - **Total Outlay:** Rs 1,922.34 Million (Rs 1.922 Billion).
> - **Target Scope:** 46 Villages/Towns situated within a strict **5-kilometre radius** of producing gas fields in Sanghar and Shikarpur.
> - **Total Pipeline Network:** 178.52 Kilometres of high-grade steel and polyethylene distribution mains.
> - **Prospective Connections:** 2,710 Registered domestic meters.
> - **Factual Implementation Warning:** This project represents an approved engineering rollout and pipeline laying program scheduled across FY 2026–27. Physical pipe-laying and testing must precede individual household meter installations. Prospective consumers should **not** consider connections completed or pay unauthorized third-party middle-men.
## Quick Facts: SSGC Phase VI Gasification Programme

| PROJECT PARAMETER | SANGHAR DISTRICT (BOBI FIELD) | SHIKARPUR DISTRICT (HASSAN FIELD) | TOTAL CONSOLIDATED |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Associated Gas Field** | Bobi Gas Field | Hassan Gas Field | **2 Producing Fields** |
| **Eligible Villages/Towns** | **31 Villages** | **15 Villages** | **46 Villages & Towns** |
| **Pipeline Length (km)** | **132.40 km** | **46.12 km** | **178.52 Kilometres** |
| **Target Consumer Base** | **1,767 Households** | **943 Households** | **2,710 Consumers** |
| **Statutory Proximity** | Within 5 km Radius | Within 5 km Radius | **5 km Radial Policy** |
| **Total Phase Cost** | Pro-rata Allocation | Pro-rata Allocation | **Rs 1.922 Billion** |
| **Federal Funding** | ~92% Share | ~92% Share | **Rs 1.776 Billion** |
| **SSGC Funding** | ~8% Share | ~8% Share | **Rs 146.34 Million** |
| **Execution Schedule** | FY 2026–27 Rollout | FY 2026–27 Rollout | **Multi-Year Implementation** |
## District-by-District Coverage Analysis

### 1. Sanghar District (Bobi Gas Field Network)
Sanghar is one of Pakistan's key energy-producing basins, hosting extensive oil and gas processing complexes. Despite hosting the vital **Bobi gas field**, surrounding rural settlements have long depended on firewood and expensive LPG cylinders for domestic cooking.

Under SSGC's Phase VI program:
- **Coverage:** **31 villages and towns** situated within 5 km of the Bobi field.
- **Network Scope:** **132.40 kilometres** of distribution and transmission branch mains.
- **Household Reach:** Estimated **1,767 prospective domestic consumers** will be tied into the provincial distribution grid upon project completion.

### 2. Shikarpur District (Hassan Gas Field Network)
In Northern Sindh, communities located adjacent to the **Hassan gas field** in Shikarpur district have been slated for grid integration to fulfill statutory social uplift requirements.

Key parameters for Shikarpur:
- **Coverage:** **15 villages and towns**.
- **Network Scope:** **46.12 kilometres** of pipeline distribution lines.
- **Household Reach:** Approximately **943 prospective consumers** will receive metered natural gas supply.

## Statutory Background: The 5-Kilometre Gas Policy
Under Article 158 of the Constitution of Pakistan and the Federal Government's localized energy policy guidelines, local populations living within a **5-kilometre radius** of commercially producing wellheads carry priority rights to natural gas supply for domestic purposes.

Because laying extensive rural distribution mains involves high per-meter capital expenditures that cannot be fully amortized through domestic tariffs alone, the Federal Government finances approximately **92% (Rs 1.776 billion)** of the capital expenditure under special infrastructure development grants, with SSGC contributing **Rs 146.34 million** for technical design, pressure reduction stations, and metering infrastructure.

## Multi-Year Expansion Context (FY 2026 to FY 2029)
This Phase VI initiative forms part of SSGC's broader multi-year gasification roadmap running through FY 2028–29. Other ongoing and upcoming phases encompass rural villages in Matiari, Tando Muhammad Khan, Sujawal, and Ghotki near operational exploration blocks. The program aims to curb deforestation in rural Sindh, alleviate indoor air pollution from biomass combustion, and foster equitable socio-economic development across hydrocarbon-rich districts.
## Consumer Advisory & Safety Guidelines

> [!CAUTION]
> **Consumer Safety & Fraud Advisory:**
> 1. **No Cash to Agents:** SSGC does not appoint local village agents or private contractors to collect cash for 'gas sanction letters'. Official security deposits and meter fees are paid strictly through designated commercial bank challans or authorized digital banking channels following official notification.
> 2. **Pipeline Construction Phase:** Heavy excavation machinery and pipe welding crews will operate along designated village right-of-ways. Residents should maintain safe distances from pipeline trenches during construction.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Have domestic gas connections already been activated in these 46 villages?**
No. The project is currently in the approved engineering and procurement phase for FY 2026–27. Physical pipeline trenching, steel welding, testing, and pressure reduction station construction must occur before individual household service connections are commissioned.

**Q2: Which villages qualify under this specific project?**
Only villages and habitations falling within a certified 5-kilometre radius of the Bobi field in Sanghar and the Hassan field in Shikarpur are included under this Rs 1.922B package.

**Q3: How will residents apply for meters once pipelines are laid?**
Upon completion of distribution mains, SSGC will establish regional customer service facilitation desks where residents can submit formal domestic application forms with verified CNIC copies and proof of residence.

**Q4: Will industrial or commercial gas connections be allowed under this scheme?**
No. This specific government-subsidized capital allocation is strictly restricted to domestic rural household consumers to promote clean residential cooking energy.

content: # Sindh Flood Housing Phase III: €115 Million EIB Financing Ratified by Provincial Cabinet (SPHF Reconstruction Update)
## Executive Summary & Official Cabinet Ratification Verification

In a major advancement for the world's largest climate-resilient post-disaster housing reconstruction initiative, the **Sindh Provincial Cabinet**, presided over by Chief Minister **Syed Murad Ali Shah** on **20 October 2026**, officially ratified a foreign financing package amounting to **€115 million** (approximately Rs 34+ billion) provided by the **European Investment Bank (EIB)**.

This crucial capital injection is formally designated for **Phase III of the Sindh Flood Emergency Housing Reconstruction Project**, executed under the institutional framework of **Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF)**.

The financing package comprises two distinct structural components negotiated with international lending windows and vetted by Pakistan's Federal Economic Affairs Division (EAD):
1. **€100 Million Concessional Loan:** Soft-term developmental credit facility aimed at scaling construction material procurement and field technical validation.
2. **€15 Million Direct Grant Component:** Non-repayable technical assistance and community grant funding specifically earmarked for climate-resilience auditing, clean drinking water systems, and solar sanitation integration.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Status: Financing Arrangements Reported (Operating Programme Ongoing):**
> - **Approved Funding:** €115 Million total (€100M Concessional Loan + €15M Direct Grant).
> - **International Partner:** European Investment Bank (EIB Global window) in coordination with Pakistan's Economic Affairs Division (EAD).
> - **Executing Agency:** Sindh People’s Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF), Government of Sindh.
> - **Distinction of Cabinet Action:** The 20 October 2026 cabinet decision represents provincial government ratification and sovereign sub-loan counter-guarantee approval; it follows earlier preliminary financing negotiations and advances Phase III execution.
> - **Strict Consumer Advisory:** This development does **not** constitute an open public cash disbursement, general unconditional relief grant, or new online application registration portal. Funding flows exclusively to already mapped, biometrically validated flood-affected rural households.
## Quick Facts: Sindh Flood Housing Phase III EIB Package

| PARAMETER | DETAILS & VERIFIED METRICS |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Initiative Name** | Sindh Flood Emergency Housing Reconstruction Project (Phase III) |
| **Institutional Vehicle** | Sindh People’s Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) |
| **Approving Authority** | Sindh Provincial Cabinet (Ratified 20 October 2026) |
| **Total Financing Volume** | **€115 Million** (Euro Hundred and Fifteen Million) |
| **Loan Component** | **€100 Million** (Concessional, Long-Tenure Facility from EIB) |
| **Grant Component** | **€15 Million** (Non-Repayable Climate & Technical Assistance Grant) |
| **Geographic Coverage** | 24 Flood-Impacted Districts Across Sindh Province |
| **Disbursement Architecture** | Tranche-based mobile bank accounts linked with NADRA biometric CNIC |
| **Ownership Mandate** | Official Land Title Deeds (Sanads) registered in female heads of household |
| **Official Portal** | [sphf.gos.pk](https://sphf.gos.pk/) |
## Understanding the €115M EIB Financing Structure

### 1. The Global Partnership (EIB Global & Government of Pakistan)
The European Investment Bank (EIB) is the long-term lending institution of the European Union. Under its dedicated external branch, **EIB Global**, the bank committed over €160 million to Pakistan's post-2022 flood recovery framework, encompassing municipal infrastructure in Karachi and rural resilient housing in Sindh.

The €115 million package ratified on 20 October represents the provincial legal operationalization of Phase III funding. The federal Economic Affairs Division (EAD) serves as the primary borrower, with funds on-lent to the Government of Sindh under established subsidiary loan agreements.

### 2. Breakdown: Loan vs. Grant Elements
- **€100 Million Loan Element:** Channels directly into housing construction subsidies. Rather than hiring central contractors, SPHF utilizes an **owner-driven reconstruction (ODR)** model where beneficiaries construct their own homes according to pre-approved, hazard-resistant engineering designs.
- **€15 Million Grant Element:** Funds essential non-structural resilience elements, including water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) infrastructure, solar home lightning units, environmental screening, and engineering oversight by partner non-governmental organizations (PPOs).
## How SPHF Housing Grants Are Actually Disbursed
To prevent misinformation, CareerDost reiterates the established operational mechanism governing SPHF disbursements:

1. **Biometric Field Validation:** SPHF surveyors mapped damage coordinates using satellite imagery and NADRA CNIC biometric validation during the comprehensive damage assessment following the 2022 monsoon calamity.
2. **Female Title Deed Issuance:** Over 800,000 landless rural residents are being awarded formal land titles (*Sanads*). Crucially, the Sindh Government mandates that title deeds and bank accounts are issued in the name of the **female head of household**.
3. **Milestone-Based Tranches:** Payments are not handed out in cash lump sums. Direct bank transfers are released across four distinct construction verification stages:
   - **Tranche 1 (Mobilization & Layout):** Released upon site clearance and foundation layout approval.
   - **Tranche 2 (Plinth Level):** Released after field engineering teams verify raised plinth construction above historical flood lines.
   - **Tranche 3 (Wall Lintel Level):** Released upon completion of reinforced masonry walls and lintel beams.
   - **Tranche 4 (Roof & Completion):** Final tranche disbursed upon successful installation of durable roofing, door frames, and sanitary latrines.
## Fraud Prevention: Guarding Against Online Scams

> [!CAUTION]
> **Public Safety Advisory — Beware of Fake Flood Grant Portals:**
> Neither the Government of Sindh nor SPHF charges any 'registration fee', 'form fee', or 'agent processing fee'. Any WhatsApp groups, Telegram channels, or social media posts advertising 'Apply online for €115M Flood Cash Relief' or asking for CNIC photos and bank PIN codes are fraudulent scams. Official verifications occur strictly through SPHF field monitoring teams and the official portal [sphf.gos.pk](https://sphf.gos.pk/).
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can new flood-affected families register for Phase III grants now?**
No. SPHF Phase III funding is allocated to complete reconstruction for households already surveyed, cataloged, and verified under the post-2022 damage assessment database. No new open registration portal has been inaugurated.

**Q2: What is the monetary grant amount provided per home?**
Under the established SPHF owner-driven reconstruction guidelines, beneficiaries receive financial subsidies (typically up to Rs 300,000 paid in four verified milestone tranches) alongside building material support and technical oversight. For detailed tranche mechanics, read our [Complete SPHF Rs 300,000 Subsidy & Title Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-peoples-housing-flood-affectees-sphf-subsidy-guide-2026).

**Q3: Which districts benefit from Phase III?**
Phase III funding covers high-priority flood-affected districts across Southern, Central, and Northern Sindh, including Dadu, Khairpur, Mirpurkhas, Badin, Sanghar, Qambar Shahdadkot, Thatta, Sujawal, and Jacobabad.

**Q4: Why is EIB financing routed through SPHF rather than commercial builders?**
International development lenders mandate transparency, community ownership, and carbon-resilient reconstruction. SPHF's community-driven model with third-party digital monitoring ensures zero contractor kickbacks and direct economic empowerment for rural women homeowners.

content: # SPSC CCE 2026 Examination Reforms: Upper Age Limit Raised to 33, 5 Attempts Allowed & 33% Screening Cutoff
## Executive Summary & Official Cabinet Decision Verification

In a landmark policy intervention aimed at modernizing provincial civil service recruitment and addressing long-standing candidate grievances, the **Sindh Provincial Cabinet**, in its meeting held on **20 October 2026** under the chairmanship of Chief Minister **Syed Murad Ali Shah**, formally approved a comprehensive structural reform package for the **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC) Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)**.
The reform package fundamentally transforms candidate eligibility, qualifying thresholds, and examination administration for Sindh's flagship civil competitive examinations:

1. **Upper Age Limit Extension:** The general upper age limit has been enhanced from **30 years to 33 years** (providing a universal three-year relaxation for CCE aspirants).
2. **Permissible Attempt Increase:** The total number of lifetime attempts permissible for each candidate has been raised from **three (3) to five (5) attempts**.
3. **Lowered Screening Passing Benchmark:** The minimum qualifying marks threshold for the CCE preliminary screening test has been reduced from **40% down to 33%**, substantially widening the talent pool advancing to the written examination.
4. **Computer-Based Testing (CBT) Integration:** The cabinet sanctioned the rollout of automated, computer-based testing facilities for single-paper examinations with instant provisional score generation.
5. **FPSC Interview Alignment:** Interview and viva-voce marks are being restructured to conform with the Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC) weightage ratio, eliminating subjective evaluation anomalies.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Status: Cabinet Approval Reported (Regulatory Statutory Notification Pending):**
> - **Approving Authority:** Sindh Provincial Cabinet (Meeting chaired by CM Syed Murad Ali Shah on 20 October 2026).
> - **Applicability:** Specifically designated for the **Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)** and general single-paper screening workflows.
> - **Critical Clarification:** These reforms do **not** apply automatically or retroactively to existing, closed advertisements or specialized technical recruitments such as [SPSC Advertisement 05/2026](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-jobs-2026-54-vacancies) which closes on 23 October 2026.
> - **Implementation Path:** Enactment requires formal amendment of the Sindh Public Service Commission (CCE Rules & Regulations) by the Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) through an official Sindh Government Gazette notification.
## Quick Facts: SPSC CCE 2026 Reforms at a Glance

| REFORM PARAMETER | PREVIOUS REGULATIONS | APPROVED REFORM (OCTOBER 2026) | CANDIDATE IMPACT |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Upper Age Limit** | 30 Years | **33 Years** | Adds 3 years of eligibility for graduates across Sindh |
| **Maximum Attempts** | 3 Lifetime Attempts | **5 Lifetime Attempts** | Reduces career jeopardy for dedicated civil service aspirants |
| **Screening Qualifying Cutoff** | 40% (40 Marks out of 100) | **33% (33 Marks out of 100)** | Expands written exam qualification roster by ~25–35% |
| **Single-Paper Testing** | Manual OMR Sheet Only | **Computer-Based Testing (CBT)** | Eliminates manual checking delays; immediate transparency |
| **Interview Ratio** | Disproportionate Provincial Ratio | **Aligned with FPSC Standards** | Reduces discretionary marks skew during final merit ranking |
| **Grievance Protection** | Ad-hoc Review Committees | **Cabinet Reforms Committee Oversight** | Safeguards candidate rights and prevents arbitrary penalization |
## In-Depth Analysis: The 5 Approved Pillars of SPSC Reform

### 1. Upper Age Limit Raised to 33 Years
Under the previous Sindh Public Service Commission Competitive Examination Regulations, candidates could only sit for the CCE up to the age of 30 years (with narrow exceptions for government servants under specific tenure rules). Given recurring academic delays, university session disruptions, and past administrative pauses in SPSC examination cycles, thousands of Sindh graduates found themselves disqualified before exhausting their academic potential.

The Cabinet's decision to raise the age ceiling to **33 years** establishes parity with evolving provincial demands and gives candidates ample preparation time post-graduation. The SGA&CD is expected to draft corresponding amendments to the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules to anchor this change.

### 2. Attempt Ceiling Raised from 3 to 5 Attempts
Previously, SPSC enforced a strict three-attempt cap for CCE. An attempt was counted whenever an applicant appeared in even a single written paper. Under the new cabinet resolution, the limit is extended to **five (5) attempts**.

This adjustment acknowledges that competitive civil service examinations require high tactical mastery, essay refinement, and evolving current affairs analytical skills. Candidates who narrowly missed allocation on initial tries can now persevere without prematurely exhausting their civil service prospects.

### 3. Screening Test Cutoff Reduced to 33%
To manage high applicant volumes, SPSC conducts a mandatory 100-mark Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Screening Test. Formerly, candidates scoring below 40% were summarily disqualified, irrespective of departmental seat quotas.

The Cabinet lowered this qualifying threshold to **33%** specifically for the CCE screening phase. This will ensure that promising candidates who excel in analytical and subjective written components are not prematurely weeded out by tricky or ambiguously keyed single-paper objective tests.

### 4. Computer-Based Testing (CBT) for Single-Paper Exams
Single-paper recruitment tests for general posts (Lecturers, Municipal Officers, Town Officers, Medical Officers) have frequently faced administrative bottlenecks, OMR scanning queues, and paper leak allegations. The Cabinet approved transitioning high-frequency single-paper exams to **Computer-Based Testing (CBT)**.

Key CBT features under implementation:
- Dedicated high-capacity computer test centers in Hyderabad, Karachi, Sukkur, and Larkana.
- Randomized question banking to thwart examination room malpractice.
- Instant automated score computation and preliminary candidate printout upon session completion.

### 5. Interview Marks Alignment with FPSC Standards
One of the most persistent candidate protest demands addressed interview weightage. Historically, high discretionary marks in viva-voce examinations could dramatically overturn strong written examination scores. The Cabinet has resolved to adjust SPSC interview mark allocations to mirror the balanced proportion utilized by the Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC) in Islamabad, ensuring that substantive written examination performance remains the dominant determinant of final merit ranking.
## Implementation Roadmap: What Happens Next?
Candidates must understand the distinction between a **Cabinet Policy Decision** and a **Notified SPSC Regulation**:

1. **Cabinet Minutes Issuance:** The Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) receives the confirmed Cabinet resolution.
2. **Rules Drafting & Law Department Vetting:** Legal draftsmen amend the relevant clauses of the SPSC Regulations 2023 / 2026.
3. **Gazette Notification:** The Government of Sindh issues the official statutory regulatory order (SRO) in the Sindh Government Gazette.
4. **SPSC Operational Adoption:** The SPSC Full Commission ratifies the updated syllabus, eligibility filters, and online application portal software to accept applicants aged up to 33 with up to 5 attempts.
Candidates preparing for upcoming SPSC tests should monitor official commission announcements at [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk/).
## Relationship to Active Advertisements

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Distinction for Active SPSC Advertisements:**
> - **CCE Specificity:** The 33-year age limit and 5-attempt rules approved by the Cabinet are formulated for the **Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)**.
> - **Active Advertisement 05/2026 (54 Vacancies):** General gazetted positions advertised under Consolidated Advertisement 05/2026 (closing on **23 October 2026**) follow their respective departmental recruitment service rules. Do not assume age extension for ongoing ads unless SPSC explicitly publishes an addendum extending the deadline or criteria. Review our verified guide: [SPSC Jobs 2026 – 54 Government Vacancies Deadline Reminder](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-jobs-2026-54-vacancies).
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Has the SPSC already updated its online portal for the 33-year age limit?**
Not yet. The Sindh Cabinet has approved the policy reform. The online application portal at spsc.gov.pk will be updated once the Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) issues the formal Sindh Government Gazette notification.

**Q2: Does the 33% passing mark apply to the written subjective papers or only screening?**
The 33% reduction applies strictly to the **preliminary objective screening test** threshold. Subjective written examination qualifying criteria (individual subject cutoffs and aggregate minimums) remain subject to academic standards set in the CCE syllabus.

**Q3: Will previous attempts be reset under the 5-attempt rule?**
The official notification will specify attempt calculation modalities. Typically, candidates who had exhausted 3 attempts but remain within the eligible age bracket (under 33) will become eligible to utilize the 4th and 5th attempts in future CCE cycles.

**Q4: Does this reform cancel the upcoming CCE schedule?**
No. As previously reported on CareerDost, testing operations follow commission schedules. Candidates should review our companion report on the [SPSC CCE-2026 Screening Test Date & Instructions](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-cce-2026-screening-test-date).

content: # Askari Bank Jobs October 2026: Analyst Payment Screening & e-KYC, Operations & Branch Roles
## Executive Summary & Official Recruitment Verification

**Askari Bank Limited**, one of Pakistan's premier scheduled commercial banking institutions, has expanded its ongoing October 2026 recruitment drive by announcing a critical technical compliance and operations vacancy: **Analyst Payment Screening & e-KYC (Job ID: 18466)** based at its **Karachi Operations Group**.

Verified directly on the official [Askari Bank Careers Portal](https://careers.askaribank.com.pk/) on 22 October 2026, this role joins existing open vacancies across Karachi including Branch Manager (Job ID: 18419), Senior Officer CAD Operations (Job ID: 18430), and Officer Branch Operations (Job ID: 18220).
## Quick Facts Table

| Attribute | Verified Official Detail |
|---|---|
| **Hiring Institution** | Askari Bank Limited |
| **Newly Added Position** | **Analyst Payment Screening & e-KYC (Job ID: 18466)** |
| **Existing Active Roles** | Branch Manager, Sr. Officer CAD Operations, Officer Branch Operations |
| **Job Location** | Karachi, Sindh (Head Office / Operations Group) |
| **Business Unit** | Operations Transformation & IT |
| **Employment Type** | Full-Time, Permanent (Officer / Senior Officer Scale) |
| **Posting Date** | 21 October 2026 |
| **Application Deadline** | **Rolling Intake (Apply Promptly via Official Portal)** |
| **Minimum Education** | Bachelor's / Master's degree (16 years education in Business, Finance, Banking, or IT/CS) |
| **Experience Required** | 1 to 3 Years in Payment Operations, AML/CFT Screening, or Compliance |
| **Official Portal Link** | [careers.askaribank.com.pk](https://careers.askaribank.com.pk/) |
## Detailed Job Profile: Analyst Payment Screening & e-KYC (Job ID: 18466)

### Core Departmental Mandate
Operating within the **Operations Transformation & IT** wing under the Operations Group, the Analyst Payment Screening & e-KYC plays a frontline role in shielding the bank from financial crime, sanctions breaches, and regulatory non-compliance. The analyst operates sophisticated real-time transaction screening systems to inspect payment messages originating from or terminating in Askari Bank branches and digital endpoints.

### Key Responsibilities & Daily Functions
1. **Real-Time Payment Filtering:** Screening incoming and outgoing financial transactions across real-time settlement rails (Raast, RTGS/PRISM, 1Link, and international SWIFT MT/MX messages) against updated sanctions databases.
2. **Sanctions & PEP Adjudication:** Reviewing automated alerts against United Nations Security Council (UNSC), National Counter Terrorism Authority (NACTA), OFAC, and local Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) watchlists.
3. **e-KYC & Digital Onboarding Audit:** Validating electronic Know Your Customer (e-KYC) data and digital customer onboarding profiles in strict adherence to State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) AML/CFT/CPF operational guidelines.
4. **False Positive Disposition & Escalation:** Conducting root-cause investigation of system alert hits, documenting rationale for false positives, and promptly escalating genuine suspicious hits to the Compliance & Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Division.
5. **Regulatory Alignment & Audit Trail:** Maintaining comprehensive electronic logs of all screening decisions to support internal inspection, external statutory audit, and SBP regulatory reviews.

### Eligibility & Candidate Requirements
- **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree (14 to 16 years of education) in Banking & Finance, Business Administration (BBA/MBA), Commerce, Economics, or Computer Science / Information Systems from an HEC-recognized institution.
- **Experience:** Minimum 1 to 3 years of demonstrated experience in commercial banking operations, payment screening, transaction monitoring, or AML compliance units.
- **Technical Skills:** Familiarity with SBP AML/CFT regulations, core banking screening filters, Raast protocol basics, Excel analysis, and compliance audit procedures.

## Step-by-Step Official Application Instructions
1. Visit the official Askari Bank recruitment portal: [careers.askaribank.com.pk](https://careers.askaribank.com.pk/).
2. Navigate to 'Job Search' and enter **Job ID: 18466** or filter by Location: 'Karachi'.
3. Click on **Analyst Payment Screening & e-KYC** to open the full job specification.
4. Click 'Apply Now' and log in to your Askari Bank candidate account (or register a new profile).
5. Complete your academic details, employment history, CNIC, and upload an updated CV.
6. Submit your application online before the intake closes.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the application deadline for Job ID 18466?**
Askari Bank processes applications on a rolling intake basis. Candidates are advised to apply promptly through the official careers portal.

**Q2: Is this role open to fresh graduates?**
The Analyst Payment Screening role requires 1 to 3 years of prior experience in payment operations, AML screening, or banking compliance.

**Q3: Where is the job located?**
The position is based in Karachi, Sindh at the bank's Operations Transformation & IT department.

> - **University Affiliation (Important Verification):** Affiliated with **Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University (SMBBMU) Larkana** *(CareerDost clarifies that degree-awarding authority is SMBBMU Larkana, not LUMHS Jamshoro)*

### Eligibility & Academic Requirements

Candidates must fulfill the statutory eligibility criteria mandated by the PNMC and SMBBMU:
- **Educational Qualification:** Intermediate (FSc Pre-Medical) or equivalent qualification with a **minimum of 50% marks**.
- **Mandatory Subjects:** Biology, Physics, and Chemistry must be passed at the Higher Secondary level.
- **Age Limit:** **14 to 35 years** on the date of application submission.
- **Gender Eligibility:** Open merit for both male and female candidates.
- **Domicile:** Open to candidates holding a valid domicile from Sindh province.
### Institutional Fee Structure (BSN Generic)

According to the official schedule of fees published by NIAHS Hyderabad:
- **Admission Fee (One-Time):** PKR 35,000/-
- **Tuition Fee (Per Semester):** PKR 110,000/-
- **Clinical Training Fee (Per Semester):** PKR 15,000/-
- *Note:* Additional university enrollment, exam fees, and clinical laboratory charges apply as per SMBBMU guidelines.

1. Access the official NTS project portal at [https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/NIAH_Hyd_Aug2026_Online/NIAH.php](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/NIAH_Hyd_Aug2026_Online/NIAH.php).
2. Click on **Online Application Form** to sign up with your CNIC / B-Form and password.
3. Select **BS NURSING (GENERIC) (04 YEARS PROGRAM)**.
4. Complete the candidate bio-data, academic records, and upload a clear digital photograph.
5. Submit the form online and print the generated 1Bill fee invoice.
6. Deposit the NTS screening test processing fee through 1Link 1Bill participating banks, ATM, Mobile Banking Apps (EasyPaisa, JazzCash, etc.), or TCS Express Counters.
7. Hand-written applications are strictly rejected.
8. Keep your submitted form copy and paid deposit receipt safe for presentation at the NTS test center.

content: ### Institutional Admission Notice: Memon College of Nursing Karachi (Batch-X)

The **Memon College of Nursing (MCON)**, operating under the **Memon Medical Institute Hospital (MMIH)** campus in Safoora Goth / KDA Scheme 33, Karachi, is accepting online applications for admission to the **4-Year Generic Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) Degree Program (Academic Session 2026–2027)**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Key Admission Parameters & Deadlines:**
> - **Program:** BSN Generic (4-Year Professional Nursing Degree)
> - **Affiliating University:** **Dow University of Health Sciences (DUHS)**
> - **Statutory Accreditation:** **Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PNMC)**
> - **Clinical Training Hospital:** Memon Medical Institute Hospital (MMIH) — 332-bed tertiary care hospital
> - **Testing Agency:** **National Testing Service (NTS)**
> - **Application Mode:** Strictly online via NTS portal (`nts.org.pk`)
> - **NTS Test Processing Fee:** **Rs. 3,000** (Payable via 1Link 1Bill, EasyPaisa, JazzCash, ATM)
> - **Final Application Deadline:** **Friday, 30 October 2026**
> - **Admission Helpline:** `021-34546930` / `021-34691147`
### Eligibility Criteria for BSN (Generic)

- **Academic Qualification:** F.Sc (Pre-Medical) with minimum **50% marks** (Physics, Chemistry, and Biology mandatory) from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE).
- **Age Bracket:** **14 to 35 Years** as of the closing date, strictly conforming to PNMC regulatory guidelines.
- **Gender Allocation:** Open to both **Male and Female** candidates across Sindh and Pakistan.
- **Domicile:** Sindh domicile preferred; national applicants welcome subject to open-merit allocation.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Access NTS Portal:** Visit the official National Testing Service portal at [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/).
2. **Locate Admission Project:** Click on **Memon College of Nursing, Karachi - BSN Generic (Session 2026-27)**.
3. **Candidate Registration:** Sign up using your CNIC/B-Form number and create a candidate password.
4. **Fill Application Profile:** Enter your personal information, Matriculation science marks, and F.Sc Pre-Medical marks.
5. **Generate 1Link 1Bill Fee Voucher:** Download the system-generated fee voucher of **Rs. 3,000**.
6. **Deposit Fee:** Pay via any 1Bill-supported banking app, ATM, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or TCS express counter.
7. **Final Submission:** Confirm your payment status on the NTS portal and print your completed application confirmation page before **Friday, 30 October 2026**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Admission Safeguards:**
> - Handwritten or manual paper admission forms are **strictly rejected** by MCON and NTS.
> - Candidates awaiting F.Sc supplementary or re-checking results must present verified provisional result sheets.
> - Appearing in the NTS aptitude test is mandatory for consideration in final merit lists.
### Selection Framework & Clinical Training Advantages

Admissions follow a transparent, merit-driven sequence:
1. **Written Aptitude Test (via NTS):** English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and General Knowledge.
2. **Panel Interview:** Personal interview and behavioral evaluation conducted at the MMIH campus.
3. **Medical Fitness:** Comprehensive medical screening through MMIH clinical diagnostics.
4. **Hospital Rotations:** Enrolled students complete clinical clerkships in ICU, CCU, Emergency, Pediatrics, and Surgery wards at Memon Hospital.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Memon College of Nursing BSN 2026?**
The official deadline for online form submission on NTS is **Friday, 30 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the NTS test fee?**
The application and test fee is Rs. 3,000 payable via 1Bill banking channels.

**Q3: Is Memon College of Nursing recognized by PNMC and DUHS?**
Yes. MCON is recognized by the Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PNMC) and affiliated with Dow University of Health Sciences (DUHS).

**Q4: Can male students apply for BSN Generic?**
Yes. The program is open to both male and female candidates.

content: ### Official Status Update: NTS NAT-XI (November 2026)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Registration Closed — Examination Schedule Active:**
> - **Online Registration Window:** Officially **CLOSED on Monday, 26 October 2026** (23:59 PST).
> - **Project Code:** 2611311 (NAT-XI 2026)
> - **E-Roll Number Slip Upload Date:** **Tuesday, 3 November 2026** on `nts.org.pk`
> - **Nationwide Test Date:** **Sunday, 15 November 2026**
> - **Result Declaration Date:** **Monday, 23 November 2026**
>
> Fresh online applications and new fee challan generation are no longer accepted for the November NAT session. Registered applicants should prepare for admit card downloads on 3 November.
### Official NTS NAT-XI Examination Calendar 2026
According to the official **National Testing Service (NTS) Schedule 2026**, the key operational milestones for NAT-XI are confirmed as follows:

| OPERATIONAL MILESTONE | OFFICIAL NTS SCHEDULE DATE | STATUS |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Official Announcement Date** | Monday, 12 October 2026 | Completed |
| **Online Form Submission Deadline** | **Monday, 26 October 2026** | **CLOSED** |
| **Issuance of E-Roll Number Slips** | **Tuesday, 3 November 2026** | **Upcoming** |
| **Nationwide Written Test Date** | **Sunday, 15 November 2026** | **Confirmed** |
| **Official Result Announcement** | **Monday, 23 November 2026** | **Scheduled** |
### How to Download NTS NAT-XI Roll Number Slip (Available 3 Nov)

Registered candidates can download their individualized test admit card on or after **3 November 2026** by following these steps:
1. Visit the official NTS portal at [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/).
2. Navigate to the **Roll Number Slip** / **Candidate Portal** section.
3. Select **NAT-XI (2026) - Project 2611311** from the active test list.
4. Enter your 13-digit **CNIC Number** (without dashes).
5. Enter the security captcha and click **Search / Download**.
6. Print your colored or black-and-white admit card containing your test center, reporting time, and roll number.
### Test Day Rules & Mandatory Checklist

- **Original Identity Proof:** Bring your original Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC), Juvenile Card, or original Passport. Photocopies are strictly rejected.
- **Printed Admit Card:** A clear printed copy of the NTS Roll Number Slip.
- **Writing Material:** Black or blue ballpoint pens and a clean clipboard. Lead pencils and markers are barred.
- **Electronic Gadgets Prohibited:** Cellphones, smartwatches, digital calculators, and Bluetooth accessories are barred from all testing halls.
### NAT Paper Structure & Discipline Categories

The 90-minute examination carries 90 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) structured across four core sections:
- **Verbal Reasoning (20 MCQs):** Synonyms, antonyms, sentence completion, analogies, and reading comprehension.
- **Analytical Reasoning (20 MCQs):** Analytical deduction, scenario puzzles, and logical relations.
- **Quantitative Reasoning (20 MCQs):** Basic arithmetic, algebra, percentages, ratios, and geometry.
- **Subject-Specific Knowledge (30 MCQs):** Discipline-based questions based on intermediate academic background:
  - *NAT-IE:* Pre-Engineering (Physics, Chemistry, Math)
  - *NAT-IM:* Pre-Medical (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
  - *NAT-IA:* Arts & Humanities (Civics, Economics, Islamiyat)
  - *NAT-ICS:* Computer Science (Physics, Math, Computer Science)
  - *NAT-ICOM:* General Commerce (Accounting, Commerce, Economics)
  - *NAT-IGS:* General Science (Math, Statistics, Computer/Physics)
### Next Available Session: NAT-XII (December 2026)

Candidates who missed the 26 October deadline for NAT-XI can apply for the final session of the calendar year:
- **Upcoming Session:** NAT-XII (December 2026)
- **Registration Window:** Expected to open in mid-November 2026 on `nts.org.pk`.
- **December Test Date:** Scheduled for mid-December 2026 for Spring 2027 late admissions.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can I still apply for NTS NAT-XI November 2026?**
No. The application deadline closed on Monday, 26 October 2026. You can register for the upcoming NAT-XII December session.

**Q2: When will NAT-XI roll number slips be released?**
E-roll number slips will be available for download starting Tuesday, 3 November 2026 on the NTS website.

**Q3: When is the NAT-XI test date?**
The nationwide test will take place on Sunday, 15 November 2026.

**Q4: How long is the NTS NAT score valid?**
NAT results remain valid for exactly **one calendar year** from the date of result declaration for admissions across all participating universities.
### Official Links & Verification Resources

- **Official NTS Website:** [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/)
- **NTS Schedule Calendar:** [nts.org.pk/Schedule](https://www.nts.org.pk/)

content: ### Executive Opportunity Overview: National Bank of Pakistan Head Office

The **National Bank of Pakistan (NBP)**, known as *"The Nation’s Bank"* and the largest public-sector commercial bank in the country, has officially launched its October 2026 executive recruitment drive. The bank is expanding its technical, operational, and strategic leadership teams at its **Karachi Head Office** to accelerate institutional modernization, digital transformation, and sustainable banking governance.

Published on **18 October 2026**, this major hiring campaign encompasses over **14 strategic leadership vacancies** spanning the grades of **Assistant Vice President (AVP), Vice President (VP), Senior Vice President (SVP), and Executive Vice President (EVP)**.

**Crucial Candidate Notice:** These positions are strictly **experienced executive appointments** requiring between **5 and 12+ years of specialized corporate, commercial banking, or advanced technology experience**. These vacancies are **strictly not open to fresh graduates**. Fresh graduates interested in banking careers should monitor entry-level programs such as the [State Bank Officer Training Scheme (SBOTS)](/jobs/state-bank-officer-training-scheme-sbots-batch-27) or [Bank Alfalah Counter Service Officer Roles](/jobs/bank-alfalah-jobs-internships-2026).
### Official Recruitment Platform Verification Disclosure

In compliance with CareerDost’s rigorous editorial and security standards, our research desk has verified the recruitment engine powering this campaign:
- **Official Integration:** NBP’s current online career portal is hosted via **RozeeGPT** at `https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/`.
- **Authorized Channel:** NBP officially designates `nbp.rozeegpt.ai` in its national press advertisements published across major Pakistani daily newspapers (including *Daily Jang* and *DAWN*), providing a secure, verified application gateway directly integrated with NBP Human Resources.
- **Direct Link:** Candidates can safely apply through the verified portal at [nbp.rozeegpt.ai](https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/) or verify corporate policies via [nbp.com.pk](https://www.nbp.com.pk/).
### Quick Summary Table: NBP Karachi Executive Recruitment

| Metric / Parameter | Official Specification |
|:---|:---|
| **Hiring Institution** | National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) |
| **Corporate Slogan** | The Nation's Bank |
| **Available Grades** | AVP, VP, SVP, EVP (Executive & Unit Head Levels) |
| **Primary Work Location** | Karachi Head Office (Select documentation role in Lahore) |
| **Education Benchmark** | Minimum Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree from an HEC-recognized institution |
| **Experience Benchmark** | 5 to 12+ Years in Commercial Banking, IT, Risk, or ESG Governance |
| **Publication Date** | 18 October 2026 |
| **Application Deadline** | **30 October 2026** (Strict 10-day application window) |
| **Authorized Application Link** | [nbp.rozeegpt.ai](https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/) |
### Detailed List of Active Executive Openings (Karachi Head Office)
The following senior requisitions are currently active and accepting online applications through **30 October 2026**:

1. **Wing Head – Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) (SVP / EVP) — Karachi:** Lead the bank’s overarching ESG framework, green banking guidelines compliance with State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) directives, and sustainable finance policy.
2. **Wing Head – Automation & MIS (VP / SVP) — Karachi:** Direct enterprise data pipeline automation, regulatory management information systems, and core banking reporting infrastructure.
3. **Wing Head – Process & Documentation Improvement (VP / SVP) — Karachi:** Optimize operational workflows, standardize banking standard operating procedures (SOPs), and drive internal efficiency.
4. **Wing Head – BI Operations (VP / SVP) — Karachi:** Oversee enterprise business intelligence dashboards, predictive analytics, and executive decision-support platforms.
5. **Wing Head – Leadership Development (VP / SVP) — Karachi:** Formulate executive succession planning, talent management architecture, and high-impact leadership training initiatives.
6. **Wing Head – Portfolio Management & SBP Coordination (VP) — Karachi:** Manage regulatory alignment, statutory correspondence, and prudential compliance coordination with the State Bank of Pakistan.
7. **Unit Head – Data Science (AVP / VP) — Karachi:** Build and deploy machine learning models, credit scoring algorithms, and customer churn analytics.
8. **Unit Head – Data Architect (AVP / VP) — Karachi:** Design modern enterprise data warehouse architecture, data governance pipelines, and database scalability standards.
9. **Unit Head – Project Management Office (PMO) (AVP / VP) — Karachi:** Champion Agile and waterfall project management methodologies across enterprise strategic initiatives.
10. **Unit Head – Strategy Design (AVP / VP) — Karachi:** Support corporate five-year strategic roadmaps, competitive market intelligence, and institutional business modeling.
11. **Unit Head – DBG Strategy & Business Planning (AVP / VP) — Karachi:** Spearhead strategic digital banking initiatives, branchless channels, and mobile app growth vectors.
12. **Unit Head – Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) (AVP / VP) — Karachi:** Operationalize carbon footprint tracking, social risk screenings, and green credit appraisals.
13. **MIS & Analytics Executive (AVP) — Karachi:** Manage portfolio performance reporting, financial metric aggregation, and ad-hoc managerial queries.
14. **Unit Head Documentation – Corporate CAD (AVP / VP) — Lahore:** Supervise corporate credit administration documentation, security perfection, and facility charge legal compliance.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Guide
Follow these official instructions to lodge your application via the authorized portal before the closing date:

1. **Access the Portal:** Navigate to [https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/](https://nbp.rozeegpt.ai/).
2. **Review Detailed Job Descriptions:** Locate your target position from the active jobs table and click the job title to review mandatory qualifications, certifications (such as CFA, FRM, PMP, or ESG accreditations), and specific years of experience.
3. **Complete Candidate Profile:** Click the **Apply** button, register your account or log in via Rozee, and ensure your professional history, employment dates, and educational credentials accurately reflect your official records.
4. **Upload Documentation:** Attach an updated professional CV and any required supporting credential summaries.
5. **Submission Confirmation:** Submit your form online before **11:59 PM on 30 October 2026**. Early submission is strongly recommended to prevent portal congestion.
### Editorial & Anti-Fraud Advisory

The National Bank of Pakistan maintains a merit-based, transparent recruitment process:
- **Zero Application Fees:** NBP **never charges any application fee, registration cost, or deposit** for corporate recruitment.
- **Direct Communications:** Official hiring communications originate strictly through official corporate domains (`@nbp.com.pk`). Disregard unsolicited SMS, personal email, or WhatsApp messages demanding payments.
- **Editorial Integrity:** Learn more about our editorial and source verification standards by visiting the [CareerDost Editorial Policy](/about#editorial-policy).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Can fresh university graduates apply for these NBP roles?**  
No. All listed positions are senior executive roles (AVP to EVP) requiring a minimum of 5 to 12 years of demonstrable corporate banking or specialized domain experience.

**Q2: Is the website nbp.rozeegpt.ai legitimate and safe?**  
Yes. NBP officially partners with RozeeGPT to manage candidate intake, and this specific URL is officially published in NBP's employment advertisements in national newspapers.

**Q3: What is the deadline to apply for NBP October 2026 openings?**  
The online portal will close applications for this batch on **30 October 2026**.
