content: # Sindh Job Portal 2026: Junior Clerk Vacancies Aur Online Application Ka Tarika

> [!WARNING]
> **Editorial Hold — Verification Notice:**
> While the Government of Sindh has established the centralized **Sindh Job Portal (`sjp.gos.pk`)** to streamline provincial hiring, active recruitment schedules for Junior Clerk (BPS-11) positions are announced independently by individual government departments (such as Population Welfare, School Education, Labour, and Law).
> 
> **Candidates are strongly advised to verify current department-specific advertisements and closing dates on the live portal before paying any testing or application fees.** This guide explains the official application workflow and standard statutory requirements.
## Overview of the Sindh Job Portal (sjp.gos.pk)

The Government of Sindh launched the **Sindh Job Portal** at [sjp.gos.pk](https://sjp.gos.pk/) to unify provincial recruitment across public departments. The platform allows job seekers residing in Sindh to create an official candidate profile, upload their educational credentials, and apply electronically for advertised positions.
## Standard Eligibility Criteria for Junior Clerk (BPS-11)

While specific advertisements govern each hiring cycle, provincial civil service rules for Junior Clerk (BPS-11) in Sindh typically require:

1. **Academic Qualification:**
   - Higher Secondary School Certificate (Intermediate, 12 years of education) in at least 2nd Division, OR
   - Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) from an HEC-recognized university (preferred by several departments).
2. **Computer Proficiency:**
   - Mandatory minimum 6-month Certificate in **MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)** from an institute recognized by the **Sindh Board of Technical Education (SBTE)** or Trade Testing Board (TTB).
3. **Typing Speed:**
   - Minimum typing speed of **30 words per minute (wpm)** on computer keyboard, tested during post-screening skill assessments.
4. **Screening Test Qualification:**
   - For departments utilizing third-party testing services (such as **Sukkur IBA Testing Service - STS**), candidates must meet the minimum passing threshold (typically 40% or 50% in the relevant category).
5. **Domicile & Age Limit:**
   - Must hold a valid Domicile and Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC / Form D) of Sindh.
   - Age limit generally ranges from **18 to 28 years**, with standard upper age relaxation applicable under Sindh Government rules.
## Step-by-Step Online Application Workflow on sjp.gos.pk

When active positions are notified on the portal, follow these steps to submit your application:

1. **Register on the Portal:** Visit [sjp.gos.pk](https://sjp.gos.pk/) and create a new account using your CNIC, email address, and mobile number.
2. **Build Your Candidate Profile:**
   - Enter personal details, domicile district (Urban/Rural), and mailing address.
   - Add educational qualifications starting from Matriculation to highest degree.
   - Upload technical certificates (MS Office diploma) and typing credentials.
3. **Upload Mandatory Scanned Documents:**
   - CNIC front and back.
   - Domicile and PRC (Form D).
   - Passport-sized photograph with blue/white background.
   - Academic marksheets and certificates.
4. **Browse Active Departmental Openings:** Go to the 'Jobs' section on the dashboard to locate open Junior Clerk listings.
5. **Apply & Submit:** Confirm eligibility against the department's requirements, submit the application, and retain the generated application tracking ID.
## Important Precaution Against Unofficial Advertisements

> [!CAUTION]
> **Avoid Fake Recruitment Agents:**
> - The Sindh Government does not hire through private agents or unverified WhatsApp groups.
> - Always cross-check vacancy notices published in daily newspapers against listings on `sjp.gos.pk` or the recruiting department's official website.
> - Never hand over original educational certificates or unverified cash payments.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the official website for Sindh Job Portal?**
The official address is [sjp.gos.pk](https://sjp.gos.pk/).

**Q2: What is the basic pay scale for Junior Clerk in Sindh?**
Junior Clerk is categorized under **Basic Pay Scale 11 (BPS-11)** in provincial government departments.

**Q3: Is a computer certificate compulsory for Junior Clerk?**
Yes. A recognized certificate in MS Office (at least 6 months) from an SBTE/TTB recognized technical institute and a minimum 30 wpm typing speed are statutory requirements.

**Q4: How do I know if a specific department's clerk jobs are currently open?**
Check the live vacancies tab directly on [sjp.gos.pk](https://sjp.gos.pk/) or monitor official departmental advertisements.
## Official Sources & Related CareerDost Articles

- **Official Sources:** [Government of Sindh](https://www.sindh.gov.pk/), [Sindh Job Portal](https://sjp.gos.pk/).
- **Related Provincial Opportunities:** [SPSC Jobs 2026 - 54 Vacancies](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-jobs-2026-54-vacancies), [Sindh Courts Jobs 2026 BPS 1-4](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-courts-bps-1-4-jobs-2026).

content: ### Official Call for Research Proposals: Sindh HEC SRSP 2026–27

The **Sindh Higher Education Commission (Sindh HEC)** has formally invited competitive research proposals from eligible faculty members under its flagship **Sindh Research Support Programme (SRSP) for the financial session 2026–27**.
The programme is specifically designed to provide competitive project financing to address strategic scientific, educational, technological, socioeconomic, and environmental challenges facing Sindh.
Eligible researchers may seek project funding of **up to Rs. 5 million (Rs. 5,000,000)** for a project duration of **two years**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Faculty Opportunity Only:** This programme is strictly intended for regular faculty members at Sindh's public sector universities and degree-awarding institutions. It is **not** an individual student scholarship for undergraduate or general BS students.
### Programme Overview Summary

- **Funding Agency:** Sindh Higher Education Commission (SHEC), Government of Sindh
- **Programme Title:** Sindh Research Support Programme (SRSP) 2026–27
- **Maximum Grant Amount:** Up to Rs. 5,000,000 per approved research project
- **Project Duration:** Two (2) Years
- **Application Deadline:** **23 October 2026**
- **Target Beneficiaries:** Regular PhD and qualified clinical faculty of public-sector universities in Sindh
- **Official Programme Notice:** [sindhhec.gov.pk/sindh-research-support-programme](https://sindhhec.gov.pk/sindh-research-support-programme/)
- **Official Application Form:** [Download SRSP Application Form PDF](https://sindhhec.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/APPLICATION-FORM-SRSP-2026-27-UPDATED-FINAL-1.pdf)
- **Official Advertisement:** [View SRSP 2026–27 Advertisement](https://sindhhec.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/SRSP-26-27.webp)
### Eligible Thematic & Research Disciplines

The official Sindh HEC circular covers a broad spectrum of research domains, with explicit funding allocations for:
- **Natural & Physical Sciences:** Physics, Chemistry, Earth Sciences, Mathematics
- **Medical & Health Sciences:** Clinical studies, epidemiology, diagnostics, pharmaceutical development
- **Engineering & Emerging Technology:** Civil, electrical, mechanical, renewable energy systems
- **Computing & Information Technology:** Artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, software engineering
- **Social Sciences & Management:** Economics, public policy, governance, education emergency strategies
- **Agriculture, Food & Environmental Sciences:** Sustainable agriculture, water conservation, climate resilience

> [!NOTE]
> **Provincial Priority Areas:** In accordance with the official notice, preferential evaluation will be given to proposals directly addressing **Climate Change, Food Security, Water Management, Disaster Rehabilitation in Flood-affected areas, Public Health, Waterborne Diseases**, and initiatives with clear commercialization potential aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
### Eligibility Criteria for Principal Investigators (PI)

Applicants must meet all regulatory parameters specified in the official circular:
1. Must be a regular, full-time faculty member at a public-sector university or chartered degree-awarding institution (DAI) located in Sindh.
2. Must hold an earned PhD degree or recognized clinical terminal qualification (**FCPS, MCPS, FRCS** or equivalent).
3. Must not currently be holding another active research grant from Sindh HEC as Principal Investigator.
4. Faculty members who successfully received an SRSP award within the preceding two financial years are restricted from re-applying until completion.
### Step-by-Step Submission Procedure

1. Download the prescribed **SRSP 2026–27 Application Form** directly from the official Sindh HEC portal.
2. Formulate your detailed project proposal including abstract, project background, methodology, work packages, equipment requirements, and itemized budgetary justification.
3. Secure formal endorsement from your university's **Office of Research, Innovation & Commercialization (ORIC)** and head of institution (Vice Chancellor/Registrar).
4. Assemble all mandatory supporting documentation including institutional endorsement certificate, CV of PI and Co-PI, and price quotations for major equipment.
5. Submit the complete application dossier with the signed PDF in strict accordance with the official submission guidelines before **23 October 2026**.
### Important Editorial Caveat

The maximum grant of Rs5 million represents the upper funding ceiling per project, not an automatic grant disbursement. All submissions undergo technical peer review, ethical scrutiny, and competitive budgetary evaluation by the Sindh HEC Scientific Committee.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to submit research proposals for Sindh HEC SRSP 2026–27?**
The official deadline is **23 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can faculty members from private universities in Sindh apply?**
No. As per the official advertisement, SRSP 2026–27 is restricted to regular faculty members of public-sector universities and degree-awarding institutions in Sindh.

**Q3: What is the maximum funding duration?**
The funding period is for up to two years.

**Q4: Where can I obtain the official application form?**
The application form is available directly on the Sindh HEC portal: `sindhhec.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/APPLICATION-FORM-SRSP-2026-27-UPDATED-FINAL-1.pdf`.

content: ### Official Admission Announcement: SZABIST Hyderabad Spring 2027

**Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST) University, Hyderabad Campus**, has officially published its **Spring 2027 Admission Schedule** across undergraduate, graduate, and postgraduate faculties.
The online admission portal opened on **12 October 2026**, and candidates may complete and submit their electronic applications until the published deadline of **10 December 2026**.
SZABIST is chartered by the Government of Sindh and recognized by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan.
### Key Admission Milestones & Official Schedule

- **Applications Opening Date:** **12 October 2026**
- **Last Date to Apply:** **10 December 2026**
- **On-Campus Entry Test Dates:** **14 & 15 December 2026**
- **Interviews for Shortlisted Candidates:** **18 to 21 December 2026**
- **Merit & Waiting Lists Announcement:** **22 December 2026**
- **Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 2,000** (Pakistani applicants to Bachelor's/Master's programmes)

- **Online Application Portal:** [admissionshyd.szabist.edu.pk](https://admissionshyd.szabist.edu.pk/)
### Programmes Offered & Eligibility Criteria

SZABIST Hyderabad offers degree paths across business, computing, and social sciences:

| Programme | Duration | Minimum Academic Requirement |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)** | 4 Years | Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent A-Level qualifications. |

content: ### Official Recruitment: LUMS Laboratory for Nanophysics

**Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)** has advertised a contractual **Research Associate (PPS-7)** position at its **Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL)** within the National Centre for Nano-science and Nanotechnology (NCNN).
The role is funded through a government-approved **PSDP project** focused on advanced experimental, theoretical, and computational nanoscience.
Applications are being received via direct email submission to the project Principal Investigator.
### Position Summary

- **Hiring Institution:** Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), DHA, Lahore
- **Position Title:** Research Associate (Project Pay Scale PPS-7)
- **Laboratory:** Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL) – NCNN
- **Nature of Appointment:** Contractual, PSDP Project-Based
- **Target Deadline:** **19 October 2026** (Editorial baseline; official LUMS HR listing accepts CVs through **22 October 2026**)

- **Official Careers Page:** [hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us](https://hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us)
### Key Roles & Responsibilities

The Research Associate will assist the research group in:
- Conducting experimental, theoretical, or computational research in nano-optics, spintronics, quantum materials, and scientific computing.
- Designing and executing laboratory trials, operating optical and laser characterization equipment, and recording data.
- Performing data analysis using specialized analytical and numerical simulation tools.
- Maintaining laboratory notebooks, managing experimental documentation, and contributing to scholarly peer-reviewed papers.
### Minimum Eligibility Requirements

1. **Academic Qualification:** Bachelor’s degree (16 years of education) in **Physics, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Materials Science, Nanoscience & Nanotechnology, Computer Science**, or a related discipline.
2. **Experience:** Minimum **one (1) year** of demonstrable research or scientific laboratory experience.
3. **Preferred Skills:** Hands-on exposure to optics, lasers, cryogenic instrumentation, condensed-matter physics, scientific computing, or machine learning applications in quantum technologies.
### How to Apply

1. Prepare an updated Curriculum Vitae highlighting your academic coursework, laboratory techniques, research publications, and software proficiencies.
2. Send your CV via email to **`adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk`**.
3. Strictly format the email subject line as instructed by LUMS HR: **`"Research Assistant - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`**.
4. Submit your application prior to the closing deadline.

> [!NOTE]

**Q1: What is the application deadline for the LUMS Research Associate position?**

Apply by emailing your CV directly to `adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk` with the subject line `"Research Assistant - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`.

content: ### Official Technical Vacancy: LUMS Laboratory for Nanophysics

**Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)** is hiring a qualified **Electronic Technician (PPS-6)** for its **Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL)** within the National Centre for Nano-science and Nanotechnology (NCNN).
The technician will be responsible for installing, assembling, maintaining, and calibrating advanced electronic, optical, and scientific equipment supporting research projects.
The role is contractual and linked to a government-sponsored **PSDP research project**.
### Position Profile

- **Employer:** LUMS, Lahore
- **Role Title:** Electronic Technician (Project Pay Scale PPS-6)
- **Department:** Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL) – NCNN
- **Target Deadline:** **19 October 2026** (Editorial baseline; official LUMS HR listing accepts CVs through **22 October 2026**)

- **Required Email Subject:** `"Electronic Technician - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`
- **Official LUMS Careers Page:** [hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us](https://hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us)
### Duties & Technical Responsibilities

- Install, operate, maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and repair laboratory instruments and electronic systems.
- Assemble, test, and integrate electronic circuits, power supplies, signal-conditioning units, sensors, and data-acquisition interfaces.
- Assist with the maintenance of vacuum systems, electromagnets, cooling apparatus, and optical instruments.
- Maintain equipment logs, circuit schematics, calibration reports, and preventive maintenance records.
- Ensure strict compliance with laboratory electrical and laser safety protocols.
### Eligibility Standards

1. **Educational Qualification:** Recognized diploma (DAE or equivalent) in **Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Physics**, or a closely related technical field.
2. **Professional Experience:** Minimum **one (1) year** of hands-on experience in electronic equipment repair, circuit testing, or scientific laboratory maintenance.
3. **Practical Skills:** Demonstrated skill in circuit soldering, cable fabrication, equipment testing with oscilloscopes and multimeters, and component inventory control.
### How to Apply

1. Assemble an updated CV clearly outlining your technical diploma, hands-on instrumentation background, and previous work history.
2. Email your CV to **`adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk`**.
3. Use the mandatory email subject line: **`"Electronic Technician - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`**.
4. Send your email prior to the closing deadline.

> [!NOTE]
> **No Estimated Salary:** The vacancy notice does not state a numerical monthly stipend or wage. CareerDost adheres to verified reporting and does not estimate compensation.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What qualification is needed for the Electronic Technician role?**
A diploma in electrical, electronics, instrumentation, physics, or a related discipline with at least one year of experience.

**Q2: What is the application deadline?**
The baseline deadline is 19 October 2026, with LUMS HR listing open until 22 October 2026.

**Q3: Is this a permanent university position?**
No. The official announcement clarifies that this is a contractual, PSDP project-based position.

Alongside the Electronic Technician (PPS-6) position, the **LUMS Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL)** within the National Centre for Nano-science and Nanotechnology (NCNN) also advertised a contractual **Research Associate (PPS-7)** post under the same PSDP-funded nanoscience initiative:

- **Academic Qualification:** MS / MPhil (18 years) or BS (4-year) in **Physics, Applied Physics, Materials Science, Photonics, or Electrical Engineering** from an HEC-recognized university.

content: ### Executive Opportunity Overview: RSU Sindh ASPIRE-AF Project 2026

The **Reform Support Unit (RSU)**, operating under the **School Education & Literacy Department (SELD), Government of Sindh**, has officially published an Expression of Interest (EOI) inviting applications from qualified and experienced professionals for multiple individual consultancy positions under the World Bank-assisted **Actions to Strengthen Performance for Inclusive and Responsive Education (ASPIRE-AF)** project.

Headquartered in **Karachi**, the Reform Support Unit serves as the strategic policy coordination and implementation backbone of Sindh's educational reform portfolio. Through the ASPIRE Additional Financing framework, the department is deploying specialized technical expertise to accelerate foundational literacy and numeracy, strengthen school monitoring, and enforce social and environmental safeguard standards across public schools in Sindh.

**Important Experience Notice:** These vacancies are senior individual consultancy roles classified under Project Pay Scales **PPS-8 and PPS-9**. They require a minimum of **5 years of post-qualification professional experience** in development projects, education reform, or social safeguard compliance. These positions are strictly **not suitable for fresh graduates**.
### Quick Summary Table: RSU Sindh Consultant Vacancies

| Metric / Parameter | Official Specification |
|:---|:---|
| **Executing Agency** | Reform Support Unit (RSU), School Education & Literacy Department, Sindh |
| **Project Name** | ASPIRE-AF (World Bank Assisted) |
| **Positions Offered** | Social Safeguard Specialist / Consultant & Foundational Learning Specialist / Consultant |
| **Pay Scale / Grade** | Project Pay Scale PPS-8 / PPS-9 (Market Competitive) |
| **Job Location** | Karachi (RSU Sindh Head Office, PECHS Block-6) |
| **Minimum Education** | 16-Year Master’s Degree in Social Sciences, Public Policy, Education, or related fields |
| **Experience Required** | Minimum 5 Years of Relevant Post-Qualification Experience |
| **Domicile Requirement** | Sindh Province |
| **Advertisement Date** | 11 October 2026 |
| **Application Deadline** | **25 October 2026** |
| **Application Method** | By Post / Hand Submission to Chief Program Manager Office, RSU Karachi |
### Detailed Breakdown of Vacancies & Key Responsibilities
#### 1. Social Safeguard Specialist / Consultant (PPS-8 / PPS-9)

The Social Safeguard Specialist is responsible for ensuring that all civil works, educational support initiatives, and community engagement interventions under the ASPIRE-AF project comply with World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) guidelines and provincial statutory regulations.

- **Core Mandate:** Oversee the implementation of the Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF), manage grievance redress mechanisms (GRM) for communities, and ensure inclusive access for marginalized students and female teachers.
- **Eligibility Criteria:** At least a 16-year Master’s degree in Social Sciences, Sociology, Public Policy, Anthropology, or Development Studies from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Required Experience:** Minimum 5 years of verifiable experience in managing social safeguards, stakeholder engagement, or social risk assessments in public sector or multilateral donor-assisted projects (World Bank, ADB, or UNICEF).
#### 2. Foundational Learning Specialist / Consultant (PPS-8 / PPS-9)

The Foundational Learning Specialist will lead technical assistance aimed at reversing pandemic learning losses and improving Early Grade Reading Assessment (EGRA) and early mathematical competencies across primary schools in Sindh.

- **Core Mandate:** Provide strategic policy inputs to the School Education & Literacy Department, coordinate with the Provincial Institute of Teacher Education (PITE) and the Directorate of Curriculum, Assessment & Research (DCAR), and design pedagogical support frameworks for primary educators.
- **Eligibility Criteria:** Master’s degree (16 years) in Education, Educational Leadership, Curriculum Development, or Social Sciences from an HEC-recognized institution. Advanced M.Phil or Ph.D. credentials represent a strong advantage.
- **Required Experience:** At least 5 years of demonstrated expertise in early childhood education, foundational literacy programs, teacher training design, or large-scale student learning assessments in Pakistan.
### Step-by-Step Application Procedure
Candidates meeting the eligibility and experience benchmarks must submit their applications through the formal administrative channels specified by the department:

1. **Download Official Documents:** Visit the official [RSU Sindh Careers Portal](https://rsusindh.gov.pk/careers.php) to review the detailed Terms of Reference (TORs) and the [Official Advertisement PDF](https://rsusindh.gov.pk/contents/jobs/Advertisement.pdf).
2. **Prepare Application Dossier:** Compile an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) emphasizing relevant project experience, along with attested copies of educational degrees, HEC equivalence certificates, CNIC, domicile/PRC of Sindh, and experience letters.
3. **Envelope Marking:** Clearly mark the target position title on the top-right corner of the envelope (e.g., *"Application for the Post of Foundational Learning Specialist (ASPIRE-AF)"*).
4. **Submission Address:** Deliver or dispatch the sealed package by registered courier to:

> **Office of the Chief Program Manager (CPM)**  
> Reform Support Unit (RSU), School Education & Literacy Department  
> Government of Sindh, 47-E/1, 48th Street, Block-6, PECHS  
> Near Nursery, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi, Pakistan  
> Official Portal: [rsusindh.gov.pk](https://rsusindh.gov.pk)

5. **Closing Date:** Applications must reach the RSU Secretariat on or before **25 October 2026** during official working hours. Incomplete dossiers or submissions received after the deadline will not be entertained.
### Editorial & Anti-Fraud Advisory

CareerDost maintains strict verification standards. Please observe the following safeguards:
- **No Recruitment Fees:** The Reform Support Unit and the Government of Sindh **do not charge any application processing, test, or interview fees** for these consultancy positions. Never transfer money to any individual or mobile account claiming to facilitate appointments.
- **Direct Inquiries:** Official notifications and TOR clarifications are posted exclusively on the [RSU Sindh Official Website](https://rsusindh.gov.pk/). For editorial questions, consult CareerDost's verified [Editorial & Verification Policy](/about#editorial-policy).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Can fresh graduates apply for these RSU consultant positions?**  
No. Both the Social Safeguard Specialist and Foundational Learning Specialist roles require a minimum of 5 years of specialized post-qualification professional experience in relevant development or educational projects.

**Q2: What is the age limit for RSU individual consultants?**  
Consultancy appointments under Project Pay Scales typically follow standard provincial project hiring guidelines, with upper age limits aligned with market requirements and health fitness for field duties.

**Q3: Is an online application portal available for RSU Sindh?**  
Applications for this specific EOI must be delivered in physical hard-copy format along with attested supporting documents to the RSU Secretariat in PECHS, Karachi by 25 October 2026.

content:
> [!WARNING]
> **URGENT DEADLINE REMINDER — Closing Tomorrow (Friday, 23 October 2026):**
> Online applications for **SPSC Consolidated Advertisement No. 05/2026 (54 Gazetted Vacancies)** close strictly at **11:59 PM on 23 October 2026**. Eligible candidates across Sindh are advised to generate their 1Link / 1Bill PSID challan (Rs. 500 per post) and submit their final online applications immediately at [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk/). Hardcopy submissions are not accepted.
> *(Important Note: The Sindh Cabinet's recently approved CCE policy reforms on age limit and screening marks apply specifically to the Combined Competitive Examination and do not modify the closing deadline or criteria of Advertisement 05/2026).*
### Official Recruitment Notice: SPSC Advertisement No. 05/2026

The **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)**, Thandi Sarak, Hyderabad, has officially issued its **Consolidated Advertisement No. 05/2026 (Dated: 25.09.2026)** inviting online applications for **54 permanent government vacancies** across various provincial departments.

The positions range from **Basic Pay Scale 16 (BPS-16)** to **Basic Pay Scale 18 (BPS-18)** and cover the Enquiries & Anti-Corruption Establishment, Home Department, Information Department, Planning & Development Department, and Law, Parliamentary Affairs & Criminal Prosecution Department.

Eligible male, female, and minority candidates holding Sindh domicile (Rural and Urban quotas) can apply exclusively online through the SPSC portal before the closing deadline of **23 October 2026 at 5:00 PM**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Manual Applications Barred:** As stated in the official circular, manual hardcopy applications will **NOT** be entertained under any circumstances. All applicants must submit their application electronically via the official SPSC candidate portal (`spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/`).
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Recruiting Body:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), Hyderabad
- **Advertisement Number:** Consolidated Advertisement No. 05/2026
- **Issue Date:** 25 September 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **23 October 2026 (Strictly by 5:00 PM)**
- **Total Vacancies:** **54 Positions**
- **Job Categories:** 8 Distinct Posts (BPS-16 to BPS-18)
- **Application Fee:** **Rs. 500 per post** (Payable via PSID 1Bill)
- **Eligible Domicile:** Sindh (Rural & Urban Quotas as specified)
- **Official Notification PDF:** [spsc.gov.pk Adv 05/2026](https://spsc.gov.pk/advertisement/2026/adv-05-2026.pdf)
- **Online Registration Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/)
### Detailed Vacancy Breakdown & Quota Comparison Table

The 54 advertised vacancies are distributed across departments and quota categories as follows:

| Sr | Department | Post Name with Scale | Total Posts | Rural | Urban | Age Limit | Minimum Qualification & Experience |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| 1 | Enquiries & Anti-Corruption Establishment | **Deputy Director (I.T) / Senior Manager I.T (BPS-18)** | 01 | 01 | 00 | 28–35 | 16-Year Bachelor in IT or CS (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA) from HEC recognized university + 5 years relevant experience in IT project implementation and management. |
| 2 | Enquiries & Anti-Corruption Establishment | **Assistant Director (I.T) / System Analyst (BPS-17)** | 01 | 01 | 00 | 21–28 | 16-Year Bachelor in IT or CS (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA) from HEC recognized university. |
| 3 | Home Department | **Medical Officer (Male) (BPS-17)** | 32 | 19 | 13 | 21–28 | MBBS from HEC recognized university, PM&DC registration, and completion of 1-year house job. (Rural: 17 Open, 1 Disabled, 1 Minority; Urban: 11 Open, 1 Disabled, 1 Minority). |
| 4 | Home Department | **Lady Medical Officer (BPS-17)** | 04 | 02 | 02 | 21–28 | MBBS from HEC recognized university, PM&DC registration, and completion of 1-year house job. (All Open Merit). |
| 5 | Information Department | **Information Officer (BPS-17)** | 04 | 02 | 02 | 18–30 | Master's in Mass Communication / Journalism from HEC recognized university + 3 to 5 years relevant experience. (Rural: 1 Open, 1 Female Minority; Urban: 1 Open, 1 Male Differently Abled). |
| 6 | Planning & Development Department | **Assistant Director (BPS-17)** | 01 | 00 | 01 | 21–28 | Master's / 16-Year Degree in Public Administration / Human Resource Management / M.A Economics / Public Policy (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA). (Urban Open Merit). |
| 7 | Planning & Development Department | **Programme Officer (BPS-17)** | 01 | 00 | 01 | 21–28 | 16-Year Graduation in Computer Science / IT / Software Engineering (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA). (Urban Open Merit). |
| 8 | Law, Parliamentary Affairs & Criminal Prosecution | **Assistant (BPS-16)** | 10 | 06 | 04 | 21–31 | Graduate at least in 2nd Division from HEC recognized university. (Rural: 5 Open, 1 Female; Urban: 3 Open, 1 Female). |
### Age Relaxation Guidelines

> [!NOTE]
> General upper age relaxation is admissible in accordance with Government of Sindh Notification **NO.SOII (SGA&CD) 5-64/2011(Part-II) Dated 06.03.2025** across provincial posts, providing qualified candidates appropriate relief as per Sindh civil servant rules.
### Online Application Procedure & PSID Fee Generation

1. **Access the Official Portal:** Navigate to [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk/) and enter the Candidate Portal at `https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/`.
2. **Account Registration:** Register using your Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) number and valid mobile/email contacts.
3. **Profile Setup:** Fill in your personal bio-data, academic qualifications, PRC Form-D, and district domicile.
4. **Select Advertised Job:** Click on **Available Jobs** and choose your desired position under Advertisement No. 05/2026.
5. **Generate PSID:** Generate your individual **1Bill / PSID** invoice for the application fee of **Rs. 500/-** per post.
6. **Deposit Challan Fee:** Pay electronically through 1Bill using any Mobile Banking app (Easypaisa, JazzCash, 1Link banking apps, ATM, or over-the-counter).
7. **Final Submit:** Complete verification and submit your form before the portal locks at **5:00 PM on 23 October 2026**.
### Mandatory Documents for Candidate Verification

Candidates qualifying the written test will be called for interview and document scrutiny, where they must present:
- Original CNIC / NADRA Smart Card
- Original Domicile Certificate & PRC on Form-D
- Degree certificates and marks sheets (Matriculation to Terminal Degree)
- PM&DC Registration Certificate (for Medical Officers)
- Valid Experience Certificates where required by the service rules
- Departmental NOC for existing government employees
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SPSC Advertisement 05/2026?**
The closing deadline is **23 October 2026 at 5:00 PM (Office Hours)**.

**Q2: What is the application fee per post in SPSC?**
The application fee is **Rs. 500 per post**, payable online through 1Bill invoice/PSID.

**Q3: Can candidates with non-Sindh domicile apply?**
No. All posts under SPSC Adv 05/2026 require a valid Sindh Domicile and PRC (Form-D) under either Rural or Urban quotas.

**Q4: Can one candidate apply for multiple positions?**
Yes. Candidates eligible for more than one post may submit separate online applications with separate PSID payments.

**Q5: Is house job mandatory for Medical Officer (BPS-17) posts?**
Yes. Medical Officer and Lady Medical Officer posts strictly require completion of a one-year regular house job alongside valid PM&DC registration.

content: ### Official Notification: SPSC Departmental Examination Slips Released

The **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)** has issued official **Press Release No. PSC/EXAM-II/2026/93 (Dated: 09-10-2026)** informing all concerned departmental officers and candidates that **Admission Slips for Departmental Examinations commencing from 12th October 2026** are now available for online download.
The examinations commence on **Monday, 12 October 2026**, across designated examination halls in Sindh. All appearing officers must print their admission slips and carry them to the exam venue.
### Privacy & Candidate Protection Notice

> [!NOTE]
> **Candidate Privacy Commitment:** In strict compliance with digital privacy standards, **CareerDost does NOT collect, store, or process candidates' CNIC numbers.**
>
> To retrieve your official admission slip safely, visit the authorized SPSC portal directly: `https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips`.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Issuing Authority:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), Hyderabad
- **Press Release Reference:** No. PSC/EXAM-II/2026/93
- **Press Release Date:** 9 October 2026
- **Examinations Commencement:** **Monday, 12 October 2026**
- **Admission Slip Status:** **Live and Available Online**
- **Official Slip Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips)
- **Official Press Release Image:** [spsc.gov.pk PR Image](https://spsc.gov.pk/recent-announcements/Oct2026/PR_Departmentalonlineadmissionslip.jpg)
### Revolutionary Exam Hall Guidelines: Electronic Tablets for Reference Books

In a major technological advancement for provincial examinations, the SPSC examination branch has implemented new paper rules:

1. **No Physical Books Permitted:** No physical printed books or law manuals will be allowed inside the examination hall, nor will SPSC provide any printed books.
2. **Digital Reference Facility on SPSC Electronic Tablets:** All prescribed reference books will be provided in digital format on **electronic tablets supplied by SPSC**.
3. **Interactive Search & Navigation:** Candidates can select the relevant Paper and Book on the tablet, navigate forward/backward through pages, and utilize **advanced keyword search** to locate rules, legal sections, and statutory material rapidly.
4. **No Supplementary Answer Sheets:** The Commission has explicitly notified that **no additional or supplementary answer sheets will be provided** under any circumstances. Candidates must organize their handwriting and time within the sufficient pages provided in the original Answer Copy.
### Mandatory Center Instructions

> [!WARNING]
> - **Mandatory Slip:** No candidate shall be allowed to sit in the examination hall without presenting a clear printed copy of their official Admission Slip.
> - **Original CNIC:** Candidates must also present their original NADRA CNIC alongside the admission slip.
> - **Strict Ban on Personal Gadgets:** Personal smartphones, smartwatches, recording devices, or personal tablets are strictly banned in the exam center.
### Step-by-Step Guide to Download SPSC Admission Slips

1. Open the official SPSC portal: [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips).
2. Enter your valid 13-digit Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) number without hyphens.
3. Select your designated departmental examination category from the dropdown.
4. Click **Search / Download Admission Slip**.
5. Print your admission slip on clean A4 white paper and verify your center location and roll number.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When do the SPSC Departmental Examinations 2026 begin?**
The examinations commence on **Monday, 12 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can candidates bring their own law books or bare acts to the hall?**
No. SPSC has strictly prohibited physical books. Prescribed reference books will be accessible via SPSC-provided digital tablets.

**Q3: Will supplementary answer copies be provided if pages run out?**
No. SPSC has confirmed that no supplementary sheets will be issued, and candidates must utilize the available answer book pages carefully.

**Q4: Where can I download my departmental admission slip?**
Admission slips can be downloaded directly from the official portal at `https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips`.

content: ### Official Recruitment Circular: Criminal Prosecution Services Department, Sindh

The **Criminal Prosecution Services Department, Government of Sindh**, through the **Office of the Prosecutor General Sindh** (located at 4th Floor, Administration Block, High Court of Sindh, Karachi), has officially published **Circular No. 000000221 (Advertisement INF-KRY No. 4363-26)** announcing walk-in interviews for regular **BPS-01 to BPS-04 vacancies**.

Walk-in interviews across designated divisional centers continue through **Saturday, 31 October 2026**.

The base age limit is 18 to 28 years. Under the general 15-year age relaxation notification issued by the Government of Sindh, candidates up to 43 years are eligible.

No. Candidates must hold a permanent domicile and PRC (Form-D) of Sindh province.

No. The Criminal Prosecution Services Department does not charge any application or testing fee.

content: ### Official Admission Announcement: Postgraduate Admissions (Phase-II)

**Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah**, has officially announced admissions for the **17th Batch of Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)** and **26th Batch of Master of Engineering (ME) / Master of Science (MS)** for the Phase-II cycle.
Degree tracks are offered under both **Course Work Only** and **Course Work + Research Work (Mixed Mode)** across engineering, computing, mathematics, and linguistics faculties.

> [!IMPORTANT]

content: ### Official Notification: Special Supplementary Examination Schedule Released

**Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah**, has officially notified the complete timetable and center distribution for the **Special Supplementary Examination of First Semester First Year (1st Semester) BE/BS/Tech for 20-, 21- & 22-Batches (Notification No. /QUEST/NH/EXAM/-856, Dated: 05.10.2026)**.
The theory examinations will be conducted from **Monday, 12 October 2026, to Monday, 19 October 2026**, covering eligible students of the QUEST Main Campus (Nawabshah) and Larkano Campus (Old).
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah
- **Notification Number:** No. /QUEST/NH/EXAM/-856
- **Notification Date:** 05 October 2026 (Published: 07 October 2026)
- **Examination Start Date:** **Monday, 12 October 2026**
- **Examination End Date:** **Monday, 19 October 2026**
- **Eligible Batches:** **20-, 21-, and 22-Batches (BE / BS / Technology)**
- **Semester Covered:** **First Semester - First Year (Theory)**
- **Campuses:** Nawabshah Main Campus & Larkano Campus (Old)
- **Official Notice Link:** [quest.edu.pk/news/291](https://www.quest.edu.pk/news/291/)
### Official Examination Centers (Annexure A)

The Controller of Examinations has established designated departmental examination centres as follows:

| Examination Centre | Assigned Departments |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Civil Centre** | Civil Engineering, Building & Architectural Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology |
| **Mechanical Centre** | Mechanical Engineering, Industrial & Manufacturing Engineering, Mathematics |
| **Electrical Centre** | Electrical Engineering, Electrical (Automation Control), Electronic & Bio-Medical Engineering |
| **Computer Systems Centre** | Computer Systems Engineering, Software Engineering |
| **Environment Centre** | Environment Engineering, Energy System, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Food |
| **Telecommunication Centre** | Telecommunication Engineering, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence |
| **English Centre** | English Department |
| **Computer Science Centre** | Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science |
### Daily Paper Timetable Schedule

Theory examinations will be held in the afternoon session:
- **Monday, 12.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Civil Engineering Materials, Applied Physics, Engineering Materials, Engineering Mechanics.
- **Tuesday, 13.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Functional English across engineering and computing disciplines.
- **Wednesday, 14.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Applied Calculus, Calculus & Analytical Geometry, Linear Algebra & Analytical Geometry, Basic Mathematics / Biology.
- **Thursday, 15.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Pakistan Studies, History of Building Technology, Introduction to Bio-Medical Engineering.
- **Friday, 16.10.2026 (02:00 PM – 05:00 PM):** Islamic Studies / Ethics, Engineering Drawing, Engineering Statics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Computer Programming, Programming Fundamentals.
- **Monday, 19.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Engineering Mechanics, Introduction to Computing, Computing Fundamentals, Introduction to ICT, Introduction to Computers.
### Mandatory Candidate Guidelines

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 1. **Early Arrival:** Candidates must reach their designated examination hall at least **15 minutes prior** to the scheduled paper time.
> 2. **Mandatory Admit Slip:** Candidates will **NOT** be permitted to appear without their official Admit Slip.
> 3. **Strict Ban on Electronics:** Bringing mobile phones, unauthorized written papers, or recording gadgets into the hall is strictly prohibited.
> 4. **Ineligible Candidate Warning:** Any appearance by an ineligible candidate will be declared illegal and the result of the concerned subject will stand cancelled automatically.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When do the QUEST Special Supplementary Exams begin?**
Examinations start on **Monday, 12 October 2026** and conclude on **Monday, 19 October 2026**.

**Q2: Which student batches are eligible for this special exam?**
Only students belonging to the **20-, 21-, and 22-Batches** appearing for First Semester First Year subjects.

**Q3: What are the examination timings on Friday?**
On Friday, 16 October 2026, papers will be conducted from **02:00 PM to 05:00 PM** (standard weekday timing is 01:00 PM to 04:00 PM).

**Q4: Is the examination center the same for all students?**
No. Center allocations are organized department-wise according to Annexure A.

excerpt: SPSC officially issued Advertisement No. 06/2026 and notice confirming the CCE-2026 Screening Test for Saturday, 28 November 2026, with online applications extended to 11 November 2026 under revised 33-year age limit, 5-attempt provision, and 33% qualifying criteria.
content:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official SPSC Notification — Verified Dates & Historic Reform Parameters:**
> - **Statutory Authority:** Advertisement No. 06/2026 (issued 23 October 2026 amending Consolidated Advt. No. 04/2026) and Official Notice dated 26 October 2026.
> - **Online Application Deadline:** **Wednesday, 11 November 2026** (23:59 PST).
> - **Rescheduled Screening Examination Date:** **Saturday, 28 November 2026** (Postponed from the earlier 24 October schedule).
> - **Upper Age Limit:** Relaxed to **33 Years** for general candidates (reckoned as of 11 November 2026). Lower age limit remains **21 Years**.
> - **Lifetime Permissible Attempts:** Enhanced to **Five (05) Attempts** across a notified 3-year transition window.
> - **Qualifying Screening Threshold:** Lowered to **33% (66 marks out of 200 total marks)**, replacing the earlier 50% cutoff.
> - **Negative Marking:** **0.25 marks deducted** for each incorrect MCQ answer.
> - **Existing Applicants Safeguard:** Candidates who already submitted valid applications under Advt. No. 04/2026 **do not need to apply again**; their applications remain fully valid, though portal login is available to rectify document deficiencies until 11 November.

### Official SPSC CCE-2026 Revised Schedule
The **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)**, Head Office at Thandi Sarak, Hyderabad, officially promulgated Advertisement No. 06/2026 on **23 October 2026** followed by the formal examination schedule notice on **26 October 2026**. These regulatory notifications execute the policy reforms approved by the Sindh Provincial Cabinet, providing thousands of provincial aspirants a revitalized pathway into Sindh's premier executive cadres, including Assistant Commissioner (BPS-17), Section Officer (BPS-17), and Excise & Taxation Officer (BPS-17).

### Quick Summary Table: SPSC CCE-2026 Schedule & Criteria
- **Recruiting Commission:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)
- **Examination:** Combined Competitive Examination (CCE-2026)
- **Governing Advertisements:** Advt. No. 04/2026 & Amending Advt. No. 06/2026 (Dated 23 October 2026)
- **Official Screening Notice Date:** 26 October 2026
- **Online Application Deadline:** **Wednesday, 11 November 2026**
- **Screening Test Date:** **Saturday, 28 November 2026**
- **Permissible Age Bracket:** 21 to 33 Years (General provincial merit)
- **Maximum Lifetime Attempts:** Five (05) attempts
- **Screening Qualifying Score:** 33% (66 Marks out of 200)
- **Negative Marking Penalty:** 0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer
- **Examination Centers:** Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana
- **Official Application Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/)
- **Official Commission Website:** [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk)

### Instructions for Existing & Fresh Applicants
> [!NOTE]
> **Important Guidelines for Candidates:**
> - **Already Applied under Advt 04/2026?** You do **not** need to submit a duplicate application or pay another fee. Your existing submission is automatically transferred to the CCE-2026 roster under the revised 33% cutoff and 5-attempt rules.
> - **Document Rectification:** Existing applicants who received portal deficiency notices (e.g., blurred domicile or degree transcript) can log into their candidate profile on `spsc.gov.pk` and upload clean scanned documents on or before **11 November 2026**.
> - **Fresh Applicants (Age 30 to 33 or Availing 4th/5th Attempt):** Must create a profile on [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk/), generate a 1Link 1Bill fee voucher (Rs. 1,000 challan), deposit the fee via online banking/ATM/EasyPaisa, and submit their complete online form before **11 November 2026**.

### Screening Examination Syllabus & Paper Pattern
The SPSC CCE Preliminary Screening Examination is a 200-mark comprehensive multiple-choice paper conducted across major divisional centers (Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana):
1. **English General & Comprehension (50 Marks):** Sentence structuring, grammar mechanics, idioms, synonyms/antonyms, contextual vocabulary, and reading comprehension.
2. **General Science & Everyday Ability (50 Marks):** Environmental science, physics and chemistry principles, logical deductions, numerical ability, and scientific reasoning.
3. **Pakistan Affairs & History (40 Marks):** Historical progression from 1857, Pakistan Movement milestones, constitutional evolution, and post-1947 state institutions.
4. **Current Affairs & Contemporary Issues (30 Marks):** Global geopolitical dynamics, foreign relations, domestic economic policies, and contemporary international crises.
5. **Sindh Affairs, Culture & Heritage (30 Marks):** Provincial geography, administrative structure, historical governance, archaeology, and literature of Sindh.

*Passing Criterion:* Candidates must secure at least **66 marks (33%)** taking into account the 0.25 negative marking deduction to qualify for the Written Comprehensive Examination.

### Admit Cards (Roll Number Slips) Schedule
Individualized admit cards indicating test center allocation, reporting shift, and roll number will be generated on the **SPSC Candidate Portal** approximately one week prior to the **28 November 2026** screening test. Candidates must download and print their slips and bring their original CNIC to the examination hall.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SPSC CCE-2026?**
The official online registration window closes on **Wednesday, 11 November 2026** at 23:59 PST.

**Q2: What is the confirmed date for the CCE-2026 Screening Test?**
Per SPSC official notice issued on 26 October 2026, the screening test will be conducted on **Saturday, 28 November 2026**.

**Q3: Do candidates who applied earlier need to apply again?**
No. Candidates registered under Advertisement 04/2026 are already enrolled. They only need to log in if they need to upload missing documents or correct profile errors before 11 November.

**Q4: What is the revised passing score and negative marking?**
Passing marks are officially 33% (66 marks out of 200). Each incorrect answer incurs a penalty deduction of 0.25 marks.

**Q5: What are the examination centers?**
Divisional centers are established in **Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, and Larkana**.

## Official Verification Links
- **Official SPSC Website:** [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk)
- **SPSC Candidate Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/)
- **Government of Sindh SGA&CD:** [sindh.gov.pk](https://sindh.gov.pk/)

content: ### Official Announcement: Naushahro Feroze Sub-Campus Pre-Entry Test

**Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad**, has officially confirmed the Pre-Entry Test schedule for regular admissions to the **Naushahro Feroze (NF) Campus (Admission Batch 2027)**.

>
> 1. **SBBU Naushahro Feroze Sub-Campus Entry Test:** Scheduled for **17 & 18 October 2026**. This test is specifically for candidates who applied for degree programs taught directly at the SBBU NF Sub-Campus.
> 2. **SBBU Affiliated Colleges Admissions:** The online application deadline for public/private affiliated degree colleges is **28 October 2026**, with their separate entrance test for District NF and Dadu colleges to be conducted later on **7 November 2026**.

- **BS Information Technology (BS IT)**

> - **Printed Admit Card:** Candidates must present their original online Pre-Entry Test Admit Card downloaded from `admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk`.

> - **Electronics Prohibited:** Mobile phones, calculators, smartwatches, and study notes are strictly forbidden inside the testing hall.
### Useful University Contacts

- **Directorate of Admissions SBBU:** Tel: 0244-9370524
- **NF Campus Administrative Office:** Contact via main university helpdesk or visit the sub-campus admissions desk.
- **Official Portal:** `admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk`
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When will the SBBU Naushahro Feroze Campus Entry Test be conducted?**
The entry test will take place on **17th and 18th October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the difference between this test and the 7 November test?**
The 17–18 October test is for the university's own Naushahro Feroze Sub-Campus programs. The 7 November test is for undergraduate admissions at affiliated degree colleges in NF and Dadu districts.

**Q3: What is the last date to apply for affiliated degree colleges?**
The online application deadline for affiliated colleges is **28 October 2026**.

**Q4: Where do I download my entry test slip for the NF campus?**
Log in to your profile at `https://admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk/` to download your computerized admit card.

content: ### Official Recruitment Announcement: Maritime Sector Careers at PNSC

The **Pakistan National Shipping Corporation (PNSC)**, the national flag carrier operating under the **Ministry of Maritime Affairs, Government of Pakistan**, has announced high-level technical, maritime, and managerial vacancies at its Head Office in Karachi.

Listed officially through the **National Jobs Portal (NJP)** and the PNSC corporate career portal, these contractual appointments offer market-competitive compensation packages for experienced maritime and corporate professionals.
The application window closes on **25 October 2026**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Specialized Professional Positions:** These are senior technical and managerial appointments requiring certified maritime competencies or extensive post-qualification experience. They are **NOT** entry-level positions.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Employer:** Pakistan National Shipping Corporation (PNSC)
- **Ministry:** Ministry of Maritime Affairs, Government of Pakistan
- **Head Office:** PNSC Building, Moulvi Tamizuddin Khan (M.T.) Road, Karachi, Sindh
- **Application Portal:** [National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search)
- **Official PNSC Website:** [pnsc.com.pk](https://www.pnsc.com.pk/home)
- **Announcement Date:** 04 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **25 October 2026**
- **Employment Nature:** Contract-based appointment with market-based remuneration
### Advertised Vacancy Breakdown Table

| Post Title | Grade | Max Age | Prescribed Qualifications & Experience |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Superintendent Engineer (Tanker)** | Grade-12 | 57 Years | Certificate of Competency (CoC) Class 1 (Motor) with at least 1 year sailing experience as Chief Engineer in the last 7 years on Foreign Going (FG) Tanker vessels. |
| **Superintendent Engineer (Bulk Carrier)** | Grade-12 | 57 Years | Certificate of Competency (CoC) Class 1 (Motor) with at least 1 year sailing experience as Chief Engineer in the last 7 years on Foreign Going (FG) General Cargo / Container / Tanker vessels. |
| **Superintendent Fleet** | Grade-12 | 57 Years | Certificate of Competency (CoC) Class 1 (Deck) with at least 1 year sailing experience as Chief Officer or Master in the last 7 years on Foreign Going vessels. |
| **Incharge / Deputy Manager (PMO)** | Deputy Manager | 55 Years | Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Marine Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering + 10 years relevant experience (with at least 5 years in ship design, shipyard supervision, FATs/HATs, and sea trials). |
| **Deputy Manager (Ship Personnel)** | Deputy Manager | 50 Years | Class I / II CoC (Deck / Engineer) with sailing or shore experience OR MBA / MPA / BBA (HRM) from HEC recognized university with at least 5 years HR experience. |
| **Incharge / Deputy Manager (DPP & CPP – Tanker)** | Deputy Manager | 55 Years | Relevant technical / commercial maritime qualification with proven tanker operations experience. |
### Step-by-Step Online Application via National Jobs Portal

1. Go to the official National Jobs Portal: [njp.gov.pk/jobs/search](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search).
2. Search for employer **Pakistan National Shipping Corporation**.
3. Create or sign in to your verified candidate profile on NJP.
4. Complete all professional resume sections, educational degrees, and maritime certifications (CoC details).
5. Select your desired vacancy (e.g. *Superintendent Engineer*, *Deputy Manager PMO*, or *Deputy Manager Ship Personnel*).
6. Review your application and submit online before **25 October 2026**.
7. Only shortlisted applicants will be called for interviews in Karachi.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for PNSC jobs?**
The application deadline is **25 October 2026**.

**Q2: How do I submit my application?**
Applications must be submitted online through the National Jobs Portal at `njp.gov.pk`.

**Q3: Are these jobs open for fresh graduates?**
No. These positions are senior technical roles requiring Certificate of Competency (CoC Class 1) or 5 to 10 years of specialized shipyard, tanker, or HR experience.

**Q4: Where will the job posting be located?**
All executive roles are based at the PNSC Head Office in Karachi, Sindh.

content: ### Official Announcement: HEC IRSIP Batch 60 Applications Open
The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan** has officially invited applications for **Batch 60** of its flagship **International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP)**.

IRSIP provides a **fully funded 6-month research fellowship** at world-class laboratories and research facilities abroad for outstanding full-time doctoral scholars enrolled in Pakistani universities.

The program aims to elevate doctoral research standards in Pakistan, expose scholars to cutting-edge global methodologies, and build lasting institutional linkages between Pakistani universities and top international institutions.
The official deadline for Batch 60 online applications is **30 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Funding Agency:** Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan
- **Program Name:** International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP)
- **Cycle:** **Batch 60**
- **Fellowship Duration:** **6 Months Abroad**
- **Eligibility Cohort:** PhD enrolment date between **Spring 2023 and Spring 2025 (Inclusive)**
- **Application Deadline:** **30 October 2026**
- **Application Portal:** [scholarship.hec.gov.pk](https://scholarship.hec.gov.pk/)
- **HEC Program Guidelines:** [hec.gov.pk/IRSIP](https://www.hec.gov.pk/english/scholarshipsgrants/IRSIP)
### Detailed Eligibility Criteria for Batch 60

As verified from the official HEC eligibility regulations:
1. **Nationality & Enrolment:** The applicant must be a Pakistani or Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK) national enrolled as a **full-time PhD student** at an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
2. **Enrolment Date Requirement:** For **Batch 60**, the applicant's official PhD enrolment date must fall strictly between **Spring 2023 and Spring 2025**, inclusive.
3. **Coursework Completion:** The applicant must have completed at least **18 credit hours of PhD coursework**.
4. **Program Duration Window:** The applicant must have completed at least **18 months of PhD enrolment** and must **not have exceeded 3.5 years** in the doctoral program at the time of application.
5. **Entry Test Standard:** The scholar must have passed either the local GAT Subject Test or the recognized University Admission Test at the time of PhD enrolment.
6. **Approved Synopsis:** The candidate must hold an approved PhD research topic and synopsis endorsed by the Board of Advanced Studies and Research (BASR) or Directorate of Advanced Studies and Research (DASR).
7. **Foreign Acceptance Letter:** The scholar must possess an official acceptance / invitation letter from an advanced research laboratory or university abroad.
### Host Institution & Supervisor Requirements

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Host University Ranking:** The host institution must be located in a developed country and ranked among the **top world universities** (overall or subject-wise) according to the Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings or QS World University Rankings.
> - **Foreign Supervisor Status:** The proposed foreign supervisor must be a full-time faculty member ranked Assistant Professor or above.
> - **Independence Rule:** The foreign supervisor must **not** be a former supervisor of the scholar's local PhD supervisor.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. Navigate to the official HEC scholarship portal: [scholarship.hec.gov.pk](https://scholarship.hec.gov.pk/).
2. Create or log in to your verified HEC e-portal account.
3. Complete your personal, academic, and doctoral enrolment information.
4. Select **International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP) - Batch 60**.
5. Upload your approved BASR synopsis, coursework transcripts, foreign acceptance letter, CV of the foreign supervisor, and local university endorsement.
6. Submit your application online before **30 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline for HEC IRSIP Batch 60?**
The application deadline for Batch 60 is **30 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the duration of the IRSIP research fellowship?**
The fellowship is awarded for a strict duration of **6 months** at a foreign university.

**Q3: Which PhD batches are eligible for Batch 60?**
Only PhD scholars whose enrolment date falls between **Spring 2023 and Spring 2025** and who have completed at least 18 credit hours of coursework.

**Q4: Can scholars already availing an HEC scholarship apply?**
Yes. Scholars holding other HEC scholarships are eligible provided they obtain and submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their designated HEC project officer.

content: ### Official Federal Recruitment Announcement: STC-PSDP Project

The **Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination (MoCC&EC), Government of Pakistan**, has announced high-level contractual vacancies under its Federal PSDP Project titled **"Strengthening Technical Capacities of Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination" (STC - PSDP Project)**.

Published officially on **04 October 2026**, the recruitment drive invites qualified professionals across Pakistan to apply online through the **National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk)** before the closing deadline of **19 October 2026**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Mid-to-Senior Professional Roles:** These are competitive project positions requiring 6 to 8+ years of professional post-qualification experience. They are **NOT** fresh-graduate entry-level posts.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Ministry:** Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Islamabad
- **Project Name:** Strengthening Technical Capacities (STC - PSDP Project)
- **Announcement Date:** 04 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **19 October 2026**
- **Project Pay Scales:** PPS-10 & PPS-09
- **Employment Type:** Contractual Project Appointment
- **Official Ministry Portal:** [mocc.gov.pk/Jobs](https://www.mocc.gov.pk/Jobs)
- **Online Application Portal:** [National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search)
- **Terms of Reference PDF:** [mocc.gov.pk TORs PDF](https://www.mocc.gov.pk/SiteImage/Jobs/tors-02.10.2026.pdf)
### Advertised Vacancy Breakdown Table

| Post Title | Project Pay Scale | Max Age | Prescribed Qualifications & Experience |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **IT and Data Specialist** | PPS-10 | 52 Years | 16 years of education in IT, Computer Science, or Software Engineering from an HEC recognized university + At least 08 years of relevant post-qualification experience in IT operations, cybersecurity, database management, systems, and digital solutions. Experience with Python/Java/PHP, network administration, and e-Office is required. |
| **Motion Design Lead / Senior Animator** | PPS-09 | 45 Years | Bachelor’s degree in Animation, Multimedia Arts, Graphic Design, or related field + Minimum 6 years of professional experience in motion design, animation, or visual storytelling. Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects (2.5D, expressions), Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro (optional 3D tools Blender/Cinema 4D). A professional creative portfolio is mandatory. |
### Core Responsibilities & Terms of Reference (TORs)

1. **IT and Data Specialist (PPS-10):**
   - Initiate and lead the establishment of a centralized climate data repository for the ministry.
   - Provide technical leadership for climate data management, environmental monitoring, and E-Governance.
   - Manage and maintain ministerial IT infrastructure, servers, network policies, security firewalls, and hardware inventory.
   - Upgrade and maintain the official MoCC&EC website, e-office system, and project dashboards.

2. **Motion Design Lead / Senior Animator (PPS-09):**
   - Lead creative visual storytelling, animation styles, and mood boards for national climate campaigns.
   - Conceptualize and produce motion graphics, animated explainers, and infographic videos explaining complex climate data (e.g. rainfall anomalies, temperature shifts, flood mitigation).
   - Optimize motion content for social channels (YouTube Shorts, Reels, presentations, TV spots).
   - Execute bilingual (Urdu & English) animations ensuring accessibility, regional diversity, and cultural inclusivity.
### Step-by-Step Online Application via NJP

1. Navigate to the official National Jobs Portal: [njp.gov.pk/jobs/search](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search).
2. Search for employer **Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination** or project **STC - PSDP Project**.
3. Log in to your candidate account and verify your CNIC, education, and detailed work experience.
4. For Animator candidates, ensure a clickable URL to your digital portfolio or demo reel is provided.
5. Select your desired vacancy and submit online before **19 October 2026**.
6. Applications submitted through postal mail or directly to the ministry will not be entertained.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Ministry of Climate Change jobs?**
The closing deadline is **19 October 2026**.

**Q2: What pay scales are offered for these positions?**
The IT and Data Specialist is offered at **PPS-10**, while the Motion Design Lead / Senior Animator is offered at **PPS-09**.

**Q3: Where can I submit my application?**
Applications must be submitted online through the National Jobs Portal at `https://njp.gov.pk/`.

**Q4: Is a portfolio required for the Animator post?**
Yes. A professional portfolio demonstrating quality and range in animated work and visual storytelling is mandatory.

content: ### Official Examination Notice: Sunday, 11 October 2026 Tests

The **National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan** has issued official **Roll Number Slips and Candidate Lists** for two major nationwide standardized tests scheduled to be conducted on **Sunday, 11 October 2026**:

1. **National Aptitude Test — NAT 2026-X** (for undergraduate admissions)
2. **Graduate Assessment Test — GAT General 2026-VII** (for MS / M.Phil admissions and scholarships)

Registered candidates across Pakistan and Azad Jammu & Kashmir can now log in to the official NTS candidate portal to verify their test center allocation, reporting time, and download their printed admit card.
### Privacy & Direct Access Protocol

> [!NOTE]
> **Safe Access Notice:** CareerDost does **NOT** collect, request, or process candidates' CNIC numbers or personal credentials.
>
> Applicants must log into the official NTS secure portal directly at `https://portal.nts.org.pk/login` to retrieve their personalized examination admit slips.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Testing Organization:** National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan
- **Upcoming Test Date:** **Sunday, 11 October 2026**
- **Undergraduate Test:** **National Aptitude Test (NAT 2026-X)**
- **Postgraduate Test:** **Graduate Assessment Test (GAT General 2026-VII)**
- **Roll Number Slip Status:** **Available for Download Online**
- **Portal Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/login](https://portal.nts.org.pk/login)
- **Candidate List Directory:** [nts.org.pk/new/candidates.php](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/candidates.php)
### Mandatory Documents for Test Day Entry

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Candidates will **NOT** be permitted to enter the examination center without the following mandatory documents:
>
> 1. **Printed NTS Roll Number Slip** (with candidate photograph clearly visible).
> 2. **Original Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC)**, Smart Card, or Original Valid Passport. *(Under-18 candidates without CNIC must present their Original NADRA Smart Card or Original B-Form along with a photographic educational identity card / matric certificate).* 
> 3. Clean transparent writing clipboard, black or blue ballpoint pens, and HB pencils.
> 
> **Strict Warning:** Photocopies of CNIC or expired identity documents are strictly **NOT** acceptable.
### Strict Prohibitions & Center Rules

> [!WARNING]
> The following items are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall:
> - Mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, and recording gadgets
> - Calculators, mathematical tables, and electronic storage media
> - Bags, weapon replicas, and unauthorized study notes
>
> Any candidate found possessing a mobile phone or unauthorized electronic device will be disqualified immediately and blacklisted from future NTS examinations.
### Reporting Times & Exam Sessions

- NTS tests are conducted in morning and afternoon sessions depending on your specific category (NAT-IA, NAT-IE, NAT-IM, NAT-ICS, NAT-IG, or GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, GAT-D).
- Candidates must reach their designated test center at least **45 minutes prior** to the reporting time stated on their individual roll number slips.
- Entry gates close strictly 15 minutes before the test begins, and late arrivals will not be accommodated under any circumstances.
### How to Download Your NTS Roll Number Slip

1. Navigate to the official NTS candidate login portal: [portal.nts.org.pk/login](https://portal.nts.org.pk/login).
2. Enter your registered CNIC number (without dashes) and password.
3. Access the **Active Applications / Admit Slips** section on your dashboard.
4. Select your registered project (NAT 2026-X or GAT General 2026-VII).
5. Click **Download Roll Number Slip** and print a clean copy on A4 white paper.
6. Verify your test center address, roll number, and session timings carefully.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the date of the NAT 2026-X and GAT General 2026-VII tests?**
Both tests will be conducted nationwide on **Sunday, 11 October 2026**.

**Q2: How can I download my roll number slip?**
You can download it by logging into your profile on the official NTS portal (`portal.nts.org.pk/login`).

**Q3: Can I sit in the exam if I only have a photocopy of my CNIC?**
No. You must carry your original, valid CNIC/Smart Card or original passport. Photocopies are strictly rejected.

**Q4: Are calculators allowed in GAT General?**
No. Calculators of any type are prohibited in both NAT and GAT General examinations.

**Q5: How long is the NTS test score valid?**
NAT scores are valid for **1 year**, while GAT General scores remain valid for **2 years** for admissions across associated universities.

content: ### Official Admission Notice: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) Class of 2031

**Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University (STMU), Islamabad**, has announced admissions for its prestigious **Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) Program — Class of 2031** at the **Shifa College of Pharmaceutical Sciences (SCPS)**.

The pre-admission entrance examination is administered in collaboration with the **National Testing Service (NTS)** under **Project Code: 2608102**. Online registrations are currently open and will conclude on **15 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University (STMU) Islamabad
- **College:** Shifa College of Pharmaceutical Sciences (SCPS)
- **Degree Awarded:** Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D)
- **Graduating Batch:** **Class of 2031** (5-Year Professional Degree)
- **Accreditation:** Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (PCP) & Higher Education Commission (HEC)
- **Application Deadline:** **15 October 2026**
- **Tentative Admission Test Date:** **8 November 2026**
- **NTS Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 5,300 + Rs. 10 Service Charges = Rs. 5,310/=**
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMjk1](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMjk1)
- **Apply Online Portal:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Crucial Distinction: Admission Test Registration vs Final Admission Selection

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Academic Advisory:** Candidates must recognize that **registration for the NTS Admission Test does NOT guarantee final admission selection at Shifa University.**
>
> Appearing in the NTS entry test is the initial mandatory screening requirement. Final admission selection will be conducted by STMU based on aggregate merit (Matric, F.Sc, Entry Test score, and formal interview).
### Program Overview & Academic Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Minimum Qualification:** Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / F.Sc Pre-Medical) or equivalent with Biology, Chemistry, and Physics from a recognized Pakistani board, OR an equivalent foreign qualification (A-Levels / American High School Diploma) with an official IBCC Equivalence Certificate.
> - **Minimum Marks:** At least **60% aggregate marks** in F.Sc Pre-Medical in accordance with Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (PCP) regulations.
> - **Program Duration:** **5 Academic Years** of comprehensive didactic instruction, advanced laboratory training, and clinical pharmacy rotations at Shifa International Hospital Islamabad.
### Application Processing Fee & Payment Mode

- The non-refundable application test processing fee is **Rs. 5,300 + Rs. 10 service charges (Total Rs. 5,310/=)**.
- Fee payment can be executed through 1Link 1Bill using:
  - Mobile Banking apps (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Bank apps)
  - 1Link participating ATM kiosks
  - Over-the-counter banking branches across Pakistan
### Admission Test Structure & Schedule

- The NTS Admission Test is tentatively scheduled for **Sunday, 8 November 2026**.
- The test syllabus comprises Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English, and General Aptitude matching the standard F.Sc Pre-Medical curriculum.
- Roll number slips indicating assigned test centers (Islamabad and major regional cities) will be issued online a week prior to the examination date.
### Step-by-Step Online Registration Guide

1. Visit the NTS project page: `https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMjk1`.
2. Click on **Apply Now** to open the registration system (`portal.nts.org.pk/register`).
3. Register with your CNIC/B-Form and password.
4. Enter personal information, parent details, and educational background.
5. Select **Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) — Class of 2031**.
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill payment invoice and pay the fee of Rs. 5,310.
7. Verify payment confirmation on your dashboard and download your application summary before **15 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for Shifa University PharmD admissions?**
The application deadline on the NTS portal is **15 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the minimum percentage required for PharmD eligibility?**
Candidates must have secured at least **60% marks in F.Sc Pre-Medical** or equivalent.

**Q3: When will the admission test take place?**
The admission test is tentatively scheduled for **8 November 2026**.

**Q4: What is the application fee amount?**
The application test fee is **Rs. 5,310** (Rs. 5,300 fee + Rs. 10 service charges).

**Q5: Is Shifa College of Pharmaceutical Sciences recognized by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan?**
Yes. SCPS is fully recognized by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (PCP) and the Higher Education Commission (HEC).
