content: ### Official Schedule & Status Update: NTS GAT Subject 2026-VI (Project Code: 2611906)

The **National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan** is conducting the **Graduate Assessment Test — GAT Subject 2026-VI (Project Code: 2611906)** on **Sunday, 15 November 2026** across major examination centers nationwide. GAT Subject is the national standardized assessment required by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) and recognized Pakistani universities for **admission into PhD degree programs**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Registration & Schedule Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Initial Registration Deadlines Passed:** The initial annual calendar closing date (**12 October 2026**) and first extended deadline (**19 October 2026**) have passed. *(Note: The live NTS candidate portal entry at [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy) displays a final portal cut-off date of **30 October 2026**; per the official [NTS GAT Subject Schedule (`nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php`)](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php), standard fee is **Rs. 2,210/-** and late fee is **Rs. 3,010/-**)*.
> - **Scheduled E-Roll Number Slip Date:** **Tuesday, 27 October 2026** (or ~7–10 days prior to the test on `portal.nts.org.pk` following the extended portal window).
> - **Confirmed Written Test Date:** **Sunday, 15 November 2026**.
> - **Result Announcement Date:** **Monday, 23 November 2026**.
### Critical Distinction: GAT Subject vs GAT General

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Candidate Advisory:** Confirm the exact test requirement of your target university:
>
> - **GAT General:** Designed for **MS / M.Phil admissions** and assesses general aptitude across Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical Reasoning.
> - **GAT Subject:** Designed specifically for **PhD admissions** and assesses advanced subject-specific knowledge in the candidate's chosen discipline (70% subject specialization).
### Verified GAT Subject 2026-VI Schedule & Summary Table

| PARAMETER | OFFICIAL NTS SPECIFICATION (GAT-SUB-VI) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Testing Authority** | National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan |
| **Project Title & Code** | Graduate Assessment Test (`GAT Subject 2026-VI` — Code: `2611906`) |
| **Announcement Date** | Monday, 14 September 2026 |
| **Registration Window** | Regular deadlines (12 Oct / 19 Oct 2026) passed; portal final cut-off listed as **30 October 2026** |
| **E-Roll Number Slip Date** | Scheduled from **Tuesday, 27 October 2026** on `portal.nts.org.pk` |
| **Written Test Date** | **Sunday, 15 November 2026** |
| **Result Declaration Date** | **Monday, 23 November 2026** |
| **Registration Fee** | **Rs. 2,210/-** (Regular: Rs. 2,200 + Rs. 10) / **Rs. 3,010/-** (With Late Fee per `GAT-S.php`) |
| **Scorecard Validity** | **2 Years** for PhD Admissions Nationwide |
| **Official NTS Portal** | [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy) & [nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php) |
### How to Download NTS GAT Subject 2026-VI Roll Number Slip

Registered candidates appearing in the **15 November 2026** examination can download their E-Roll Number Slip online as soon as NTS uploads center allocations (scheduled from **27 October 2026** onwards):

1. Visit the official NTS Candidate Portal ([portal.nts.org.pk](https://portal.nts.org.pk/)) or the NTS Open Applications / List of Candidates section on [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/).
2. Log into your candidate dashboard using your registered **CNIC number** and password.
3. Locate **Graduate Assessment Test (GAT Subject 2026-VI — Code: 2611906)** and download/print your **E-Roll Number Slip**.
4. **Mandatory Test Day Items (15 November 2026):** Bring your printed Roll Number Slip and original **NADRA CNIC** (or valid Passport). Mobile phones, smartwatches, and calculators are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall.
5. For detailed guidance on NTS slip lookup and result checking, see our [NTS NAT & GAT Roll Number Slip Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-nat-gat-roll-number-slip-2026) and [NTS Latest Results & Answer Keys Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-latest-results-answer-keys-2026).
### Test Pattern & Examination Structure (100 MCQs / 120 Minutes)

The GAT Subject examination comprises **100 multiple-choice questions (MCQs)** with a total duration of **120 minutes (2 Hours)**, formatted as follows:

1. **Subject Specialization:** **70%** (70 MCQs covering advanced core undergraduate and master's level concepts in the chosen academic field)
2. **English (Verbal Reasoning):** **15%** (15 MCQs covering academic vocabulary, sentence completion, and reading comprehension)
3. **Analytical Reasoning:** **15%** (15 MCQs covering logical deduction, analytical problem solving, and data inference)
### Academic Disciplines Offered in GAT Subject

GAT Subject is offered across major PhD academic faculties, including:
- **Biological Sciences:** Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Botany, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Zoology, Environmental Sciences
- **Physical Sciences:** Chemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics
- **Engineering & Technology:** Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering
- **Social Sciences & Humanities:** Economics, Management Sciences, Education, English (Literature/Linguistics), International Relations, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology
- **Medical & Pharmacy:** Pharmacy (Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics), Veterinary Sciences
### Minimum Qualifying Score & Validity

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Passing Threshold:** A minimum cumulative score of **60%** is mandatory to qualify the GAT Subject test for HEC-recognized PhD program enrollment.
> - **Validity:** The official GAT Subject scorecard remains valid for **2 years** from the test date.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When is the NTS GAT Subject 2026-VI test date?**
The written test for GAT Subject 2026-VI (Project Code 2611906) will be held on **Sunday, 15 November 2026**, and results are scheduled for **Monday, 23 November 2026**.

**Q2: When and how can I download the GAT Subject 2026-VI roll number slip?**
Per the official NTS GAT Subject 2026 schedule, E-Roll Number Slips are scheduled from **Tuesday, 27 October 2026** (or following completion of the extended portal window). Candidates can download and print their slip by logging into `portal.nts.org.pk` with their CNIC.

**Q3: What is the qualifying score for PhD admission in GAT Subject?**
A minimum score of **60% marks** is required to qualify GAT Subject for PhD admissions under HEC regulations, and the result card remains valid for **2 years**.
### Official Sources & Related NTS Guides

- **Official NTS Project Page:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy)
- **Official NTS GAT Subject Annual Schedule:** [nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php)
- **Related CareerDost Guides:**
  - [NTS GAT General VIII 2026 Registration & Schedule](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-gat-general-viii-2026-registration-schedule-eligibility)
  - [NTS NAT 11 (NAT-XI) November 2026 Test Date & Schedule](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-nat-xi-2026-november-registration-guide)
  - [NTS NAT & GAT Roll Number Slip Download Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-nat-gat-roll-number-slip-2026)

content: ### URGENT ADMISSION NOTICE: LAST DATE TODAY — 9 OCTOBER 2026

> [!WARNING]
> **CRITICAL DEADLINE ALERT:** Today, **9 October 2026**, is officially the final extended deadline to submit online admission applications for the **Fall 2026 Academic Session** at **Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK), Bagh**.
>
> Prospective female students across Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan, and all provinces of Pakistan must submit their electronic admission forms via the official university portal (`umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM`) before midnight tonight.
### About Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK)

Established to empower women through high-quality higher education, **Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK)** is a premier public-sector higher education institution situated in the scenic district of Bagh, AJ&K. The university offers career-oriented degree programs approved by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan across natural sciences, social sciences, management studies, computing, and allied health sciences.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK), Bagh
- **Intake Session:** **Fall 2026**
- **Programs Offered:** BS (4-Year), Lateral Entry (5th Semester), MS / MPhil, and PhD
- **Extended Application Deadline:** **TODAY, 9 October 2026**
- **Tentative Entry Test Date:** **12 October 2026**
- **Mode of Application:** Strictly Online via UMIS Admission Portal
- **Official News Notification:** [wuajk.edu.pk News 848](https://wuajk.edu.pk/news/view/848)
- **Online Admission Portal:** [umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM](https://umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM)
- **Fee Challan Generator:** [wuajk.edu.pk Challan System](https://wuajk.edu.pk/welcome/generate_challan_common)
### Offered Academic Programs Across Faculties

WUAJK Bagh offers comprehensive degree programs across three distinguished faculties:

1. **Faculty of Science & Technology:**
   - Computer Science (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Information Technology (BS)
   - Biotechnology (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Botany (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Chemistry (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Mathematics (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Physics (BS, MS)
   - Zoology (BS, MS, PhD)

2. **Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences:**
   - Economics (BS, MS)
   - Management Sciences / BBA (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Education / B.Ed 1.5, 2.5 & 4 Years (BS, MS, PhD)
   - English Literature & Linguistics (BS, MS)
   - International Relations (IR) & History (BS, MS)
   - Health & Physical Education / Sports Sciences (BS)

3. **Faculty of Medicine, Dentistry and Allied Health Sciences:**
   - Allied Health Sciences / Medical Laboratory Technology (BS)
### Program-Wise Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **BS Programs (4 Years):** Minimum 45% to 50% marks in Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate / FA / FSc / ICS) or IBCC equivalent from a recognized education board.
> - **Lateral Entry (5th Semester):** 14 years of relevant prior education (Associate Degree Program ADP / BA / BSc) with at least 45% marks or 2.0/4.0 CGPA.
> - **MS / MPhil Programs:** Minimum 16 years of education (BS 4-Year or MA/MSc) in the relevant subject with at least 2.50/4.00 CGPA (semester system) or 50% marks (annual system) from an HEC-recognized university, plus qualifying the university entry test.
> - **PhD Programs:** Minimum 18 years of education (MS/MPhil) in the relevant field with minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA or 60% marks, plus clearance of university subject entry test and interview.
### Tentative Entry Test Schedule

According to the official WUAJK notification, the tentative entry test for postgraduate (MS/MPhil/PhD) and specified undergraduate programs is scheduled to be held on **12 October 2026** at the main university campus in Bagh. Applicants must bring their printed admit cards and original CNIC/B-Form to the examination center.
### Required Documents for Online Admission Form

Applicants must upload scanned, legible copies of the following documents during online registration:
1. Recent passport-sized photograph (white background)
2. CNIC / Form-B of candidate
3. CNIC of Father or Guardian
4. SSC / Matriculation Certificate & Marksheet
5. HSSC / Intermediate Marksheet / Result Card
6. Terminal Degree Transcript & Certificate (for Lateral, MS, or PhD applicants)
7. State Subject Certificate / Domicile Certificate (AJ&K / Provincial Quota)
8. Paid Admission Fee Challan receipt
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Open the official university admission portal: [umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM](https://umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM).
2. Register a new student account using your CNIC/B-Form and valid email address.
3. Log in and select your desired program level (Undergraduate, Lateral Entry, MS/MPhil, or PhD).
4. Enter personal, guardian, and domicile details carefully.
5. Fill in academic qualifications from Matric onwards along with marks obtained.
6. Generate and print the prescribed admission processing fee challan from the bank voucher link.
7. Deposit the fee at the designated bank branch or online channel, and upload the paid receipt.
8. Verify all entered data and click **Submit Application** before the deadline closes tonight, **9 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for WUAJK Fall 2026 admissions?**
The official extended deadline is strictly **TODAY, 9 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will the entry test be conducted?**
The entry test is tentatively scheduled to take place on **12 October 2026** at WUAJK Bagh.

**Q3: Can male candidates apply for admission at WUAJK?**
No. Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir is exclusively dedicated to female higher education.

**Q4: Is lateral entry into the 5th semester offered?**
Yes. Graduates holding a 2-year Associate Degree (ADP), BA, or BSc are eligible for 5th-semester lateral admission in relevant disciplines.

**Q5: What financial assistance is available for deserving students?**
WUAJK provides HEC Need-Based Scholarships, Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarships, and University Student Welfare Fund concessions to deserving students.

content: ### Official Recruitment Announcement: Security Papers Limited (SPL)

**Security Papers Limited (SPL), Karachi**, a national industrial manufacturer operating under strict security protocols to produce banknote paper and security documents for the State Bank of Pakistan and commercial banks, has announced vacancies under its **Non-Management Program (Project Code: 2610502)** through the National Testing Service (NTS).

This recruitment campaign provides well-remunerated industrial technical career pathways for young diploma holders and intermediate candidates, offering attractive monthly compensation packages ranging from **Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 75,000** along with fringe benefits.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** Security Papers Limited (SPL), Karachi
- **Project Name:** SPL Non-Management Positions (Code: 2610502)
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Work Location:** Jinnah Avenue, Malir Halt, Karachi, Sindh
- **Monthly Salary Range:** **Rs. 45,000/= to Rs. 75,000/=** (commensurate with post and experience)
- **Maximum Age Limit:** **25 Years** (as of application closing date)
- **Application Deadline:** **11 October 2026**
- **Tentative Test Date:** **20 October 2026**
- **Submission Mode:** Strictly Online via NTS Candidate Portal
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx)
- **Online Application Form:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Specialized Technical Disciplines Advertised

Positions under the SPL Non-Management Program are open in four core engineering and manufacturing streams:

1. **Production & Mechanical:**
   - Machine operators, paper manufacturing technicians, and mechanical maintenance crews.
2. **Electrical & Electronics:**
   - Power distribution maintenance, electric motor technicians, and industrial electronics troubleshooting.
3. **Instrumentation & Process Control:**
   - Calibration, sensor diagnostics, automated control systems, and SCADA instrumentation.
4. **Mould & Cylinder:**
   - Security paper watermarking, cylinder mould preparation, and precision tooling operations.
### Detailed Eligibility & Qualification Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Education:** Diploma of Associate Engineering (DAE) in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation & Process Control from a recognized Board of Technical Education (PBTE/SBTE/KP BTE), OR Intermediate (FSc Pre-Engineering / ICS) with technical aptitude.
> - **Experience:** Minimum **1 to 5 years** of practical hands-on experience in a reputed manufacturing, industrial, or process plant environment.
> - **Age Ceiling:** Candidates must **NOT exceed 25 years of age** on 11 October 2026.
> - **Fitness & Integrity:** Stringent security clearance and physical medical fitness are mandatory prerequisites.
### Salary Package & Corporate Benefits

Security Papers Limited offers one of the most competitive remuneration structures in the national manufacturing sector:
- Starting monthly consolidated salary ranging between **Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 75,000**.
- Medical coverage for self and family as per institutional policy.
- Group life insurance and provident fund benefits.
- Subsidized transport and factory cafeteria facilities in Karachi.
### Selection Process & Written Screening Test

1. **Written Screening Test:** NTS will administer a specialized screening test tentatively on **20 October 2026**. Official sample papers are available for download directly on the NTS portal.
2. **Practical Skills Assessment:** Shortlisted candidates will undergo practical trade tests at SPL facilities.
3. **Panel Interview:** High-scoring applicants will appear before the SPL Departmental Selection Committee.
4. **Medical Examination & Background Check:** Final appointment is subject to comprehensive security vetting.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process on NTS

1. Visit the NTS portal project link: [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx).
2. Click on **Apply Now** or navigate to the registration portal (`portal.nts.org.pk/register`).
3. Register using your CNIC and secure password.
4. Fill in academic credentials, technical diploma records, and industrial work experience.
5. Upload recent passport-size photograph and scanned CNIC.
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice for application fee payment.
7. Pay the fee via ATM, Internet Banking, Easypaisa, or JazzCash before **11 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SPL Jobs 2026?**
The deadline to submit online applications on NTS is **11 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the salary range for these non-management posts?**
The advertised salary ranges from **Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 75,000 per month**, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.

**Q3: What is the maximum age limit?**
The upper age limit is strictly **25 years**.

**Q4: Where will the appointed candidates be posted?**
Selected candidates will be posted at the Security Papers Limited manufacturing complex in **Karachi**.

**Q5: Is there a physical form submission required?**
No. Applications are accepted strictly online via the NTS candidate portal. Do not send postal packages to NTS or SPL.

content: ### FINAL APPLICATION COUNTDOWN: 3 Days Remaining (Closes 23 October 2026)

> [!WARNING]
> **Urgent Deadline Reminder:**
> The online registration window for **Gujranwala Electric Power Company (GEPCO) Assistant Manager IT vacancies** closes on **Friday, 23 October 2026 at 11:59:59 PM**.
> - **NTS Project Code:** **2610202**
> - **NTS Portal ID:** `MTAxMzcz` ([Direct Project Detail Link](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcz))
> - **Tentative Test Date:** **30 October 2026**
> - By-hand form submission is strictly prohibited. Applications must be completed online via the NTS Candidate Portal.
### Recruitment Context: Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Project

Operating under the Ministry of Energy (Power Division), Government of Pakistan, **GEPCO** is rapidly modernizing its power distribution infrastructure across central Punjab. The utility has established a dedicated **Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Project Directorate** to eliminate electricity theft, automate meter readings, and deploy real-time smart grid telemetry.

This targeted recruitment drive, published under **Notice Ref: DMPR 12-2026-27**, invites applications from experienced Pakistani IT professionals for three specialized Assistant Manager requisitions on an initial **3-year contractual basis**.
### Active Vacancies & Position Details

All three positions are open on a nationwide merit quota with competitive lump-sum monthly remuneration:
1. **Assistant Manager (Database Administration) — 01 Post (Open Merit):** Responsible for Oracle / SQL enterprise database management, automated backup routines, database clustering, and high-availability operations for smart metering data.
2. **Assistant Manager (Network Support) — 01 Post (Open Merit):** Oversees wide-area network (WAN) architecture, optical fiber connectivity, VPN tunnels, firewall security, and cellular APN gateways connecting field AMI meters.
3. **Assistant Manager (Meter Data Management) — 01 Post (Open Merit):** Directs the enterprise Meter Data Management System (MDMS), automated billing integration, time-of-use (TOU) data feeds, and outage reporting engines.
### Minimum Eligibility & Age Limits

- **Educational Benchmark:** 4-year Bachelor’s degree (BS/BSc Engg) or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Computer Software Engineering from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Professional Experience:** Minimum of **2 years post-qualification demonstrable experience** in database administration, network engineering, or enterprise software management.
- **Age Bracket:** **21 to 33 years** (inclusive of the federal government’s general 5-year age relaxation).
- **Special Age Relaxations:** Regular employees of WAPDA / DISCOs / GENCOs with at least 2 years continuous service are eligible up to **43 years**. Candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes and Buddhist communities receive an additional 3 years relaxation.
### Subsidized Test Fee Structure & Payment

- **Total Assessment Fee:** Rs. 540/- per applicant.
- **GEPCO Subsidy:** GEPCO subsidizes 50% of the cost. **The candidate pays only Rs. 270/- + Rs. 10 portal fee = Rs. 280/-**.
- **Fee Exemption for Persons with Disabilities:** Candidates possessing a valid NADRA Disability Certificate are entitled to **100% fee exemption (Rs. 0)**.
- **Payment Method:** Generated 1Link 1Bill invoice payable through ATM, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking Apps (EasyPaisa, JazzCash, Nayapay, SadaPay), or TCS Express Counters.
### Clarification Regarding Non-IT & Field Positions

> [!NOTE]
> **Candidate Advisory:** CareerDost's research desk confirms that there are currently **no general recruitment vacancies** active for Assistant Line Man (ALM), Commercial Superintendent, Revenue Officer, or Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) in this specific GEPCO batch. Candidates are cautioned against misleading social media notices claiming mass field recruitment.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Visit the verified NTS Candidate Portal at [portal.nts.org.pk](https://portal.nts.org.pk/).
2. Register a new user account using your CNIC and active personal mobile number (do not use ported SIMs to ensure SMS alerts).
3. Navigate to **Project Code: 2610202 (GEPCO Career Opportunities)**.
4. Select your target Assistant Manager discipline and upload a recent passport-sized photograph and CNIC copy.
5. Generate the 1Bill fee invoice and submit payment before **23 October 2026**.

content: ### Official Recruitment Notice: Engineering Development Board (EDB)

The **Engineering Development Board (EDB)**, an apex technical organization operating under the **Ministry of Industries and Production, Government of Pakistan**, has advertised **19 contractual vacancies** across **8 professional roles** to drive national industrialization, electric vehicle (EV) policy implementation, and global engineering exports.

The positions carry attractive **Project Pay Scales (PPS-6, PPS-7, and PPS-11)** and are published live on the official **National Job Portal (NJP)**. The application window is open until **21 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** Engineering Development Board (EDB) Pakistan
- **Supervising Ministry:** Ministry of Industries & Production, Federal Government
- **Total Advertised Vacancies:** **19 Positions**
- **Number of Job Profiles:** 8 Distinct Professional Roles
- **Pay Scales:** PPS-6, PPS-7, and PPS-11
- **Application Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Work Location:** Islamabad, Pakistan
- **Official Application Portal:** [National Job Portal (njp.gov.pk)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search?q=Engineering+Development+Board)
### Complete Vacancy & Eligibility Matrix

The complete breakdown of all 19 positions advertised on the National Job Portal is detailed below:

| Position Title | Vacancies | Grade / Scale | Required Qualification | Minimum Experience | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: | 
| **Research Assistant** (Job #9817) | 6 | PPS-6 | 16-Year Degree in Business Admin, Management Sciences, Marketing, Engineering, or Economics | 2+ Years Experience (EV / Battery manufacturing preferred) | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Accounts Officer / DDO** (Job #9816) | 1 | PPS-7 | 16-Year Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or Economics | 5+ Years Experience in public sector accounting, budgeting & audit | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Business Development Manager** (Job #9815) | 2 | PPS-7 | 16-Year Degree in Business Admin, Management Sciences, Marketing/PR, or Economics | 5+ Years Experience in stakeholder coordination & event management | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Consultants** (Job #9814) | 6 | PPS-11 | B.Sc. / B.E. Engineering (Chemical, Steel, Electrical, Heavy Engg, Industrial Process) | 16 Years (B.Sc.) / 12 Years (MS) / 8 Years (PhD) in relevant engineering field | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Business Development / Marketing Outreach** (Job #9813) | 1 | PPS-11 | Master’s / MS / PhD in Business Admin, Marketing, PR, or related field | 16 Years (Master's) / 12 Years (MS) / 8 Years (PhD) professional experience | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Economist** (Job #9812) | 1 | PPS-11 | Master’s / MS / PhD in Economics or Development Economics | 16 Years (Master's) / 12 Years (MS) / 8 Years (PhD) economic modeling experience | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Cost Accountant** (Job #9811) | 1 | PPS-11 | CA / ACMA / ACCA or Master's in Finance from recognized institution | 10 to 15 Years post-qualification experience as Cost Accountant | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Financial Analyst** (Job #9810) | 1 | PPS-11 | CA / ACMA / ACCA or Master's in Finance from recognized institution | 10 to 15 Years post-qualification experience as Financial Analyst | 21 Oct 2026 |
### Critical Advisory on Senior vs Fresh Roles

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Career Advisory:** Candidates must note that **the majority of these positions (PPS-7 and PPS-11) are strictly senior-level and mid-career specialist roles requiring between 5 and 16 years of post-qualification experience.**
>
> Fresh graduates are **NOT eligible** for PPS-7 or PPS-11 roles. Junior professionals holding 16 years of education with at least 2 years of relevant experience may apply for the **Research Assistant (PPS-6)** position.
### How to Apply Online on National Job Portal (NJP)

1. Navigate to the official National Job Portal: `https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search?q=Engineering+Development+Board`.
2. If you already have an NJP profile, click **Login**; otherwise, create a new candidate account with your CNIC.
3. Complete your digital CV, including basic details, academic qualifications, and verified employment history.
4. Open the specific job listing you qualify for (Job IDs 9810 through 9817).
5. Review the specific eligibility criteria and click **Apply Now**.
6. Confirm your submission. No physical hard copies or postal applications need to be submitted to EDB or NJP.
### Selection Procedure

- Shortlisting of candidates will be based strictly on merit, academic records, and relevant post-qualification experience verified through NJP.
- Only shortlisted candidates will be summoned for test/interview at Islamabad.
- No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in test/interview.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for EDB Jobs 2026?**
The application deadline is **21 October 2026** on the National Job Portal.

**Q2: How many total vacancies are advertised?**
There are **19 total vacancies** distributed across 8 different professional roles.

**Q3: Are fresh graduates eligible for all positions?**
No. Only the Research Assistant position accepts candidates with a minimum of 2 years of experience. All other positions require between 5 and 16+ years of post-qualification experience.

**Q4: Where will the appointed officers work?**
Selected professionals will be posted at the Engineering Development Board (EDB) Headquarters in **Islamabad**.

**Q5: Is there any application fee on NJP?**
Applications through the National Job Portal (NJP) for these federal project positions are free of application processing charges.

content: ### Official Announcement: University of Malakand Postgraduate Admissions

The **University of Malakand (UOM)**, a leading public university situated in Chakdara, Dir Lower, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, has formally announced the commencement of admissions for **MS, MPhil, and PhD Programs (Fall 2026-I Admission Test)**.

In collaboration with the **National Testing Service (NTS)** under **Project Code: 2609401**, the university will conduct standardized screening tests (GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, and PhD Subject Tests) for all eligible candidates seeking postgraduate admission.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** University of Malakand (UOM), Chakdara Dir Lower, KP
- **Intake Session:** Fall 2026-I Postgraduate Admissions
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Project Code:** 2609401
- **Application Deadline:** **12 October 2026**
- **Tentative Test Date:** **18 October 2026**
- **NTS Application Fee:** **Rs. 1,300 + Rs. 10 Service Charges = Rs. 1,310/=**
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzY0](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzY0)
- **Online Registration:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Test Categories & Offered Academic Disciplines

The NTS screening test is structured into specific GAT test categories according to academic faculty:

#### 1. GAT-A (MS / MPhil Programs):
- **Management Studies** (Finance, Human Resource Management, Marketing)

#### 2. GAT-B (MS / MPhil Programs):
- **Sociology**
- **Social Work**
- **Pashto**
- **Journalism & Mass Communication**

#### 3. GAT-C (MS / MPhil Programs):
- **Computer Science**
- **Pharmacy** (Pharmaceutics, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology)
- **Mathematics**
- **Biotechnology**
- **Geology**

#### 4. PhD Subject Admission Tests:
- Computer Science
- Mathematics
- Pharmacy
- Biotechnology
- Management Studies
- Sociology
- Social Work
### Program-Specific Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **MS / MPhil Eligibility:**
>   - Minimum 16 years of education (BS 4-Year or Master's 2-Year degree) in the relevant field from an HEC-recognized university.
>   - Minimum 2.50/4.00 CGPA under the semester system, or 50% marks under the annual examination system.
>   - Valid NTS GAT General / University Admission Test score of at least 50%.
> - **PhD Eligibility:**
>   - Minimum 18 years of education (MS / MPhil degree with thesis) in the relevant field.
>   - Minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA under the semester system, or 60% marks under the annual system.
>   - Valid NTS Subject Test / University Subject Admission Test score of at least 60%.
### NTS Application Fee & Payment Guidelines

- The test fee for each candidate is **Rs. 1,300 + Rs. 10 service charges (Total: Rs. 1,310/=)**.
- After filling out the online application form, generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice.
- Pay through any mobile banking application (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Upaisa, bank apps), ATM, or bank branch.
- Keep your transaction receipt safe; manual deposit slips are not required to be posted to NTS.
### Test Format & Preparation Guidance

- **GAT-General (MS/MPhil):** Covers Verbal Reasoning (English vocabulary, comprehension), Analytical Reasoning (logical deduction, pattern recognition), and Quantitative Reasoning (basic mathematics, algebra, arithmetic).
- **PhD Subject Test:** Focuses primarily on advanced subject knowledge (70% subject-specific content, 15% English, and 15% analytical reasoning).
- Candidates should review standard NTS past papers and syllabus guidelines available on the NTS portal.
### Step-by-Step Online Registration Guide

1. Open the official NTS project portal: `https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzY0`.
2. Click **Apply Now** for your respective category (GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, or PhD Subject Test).
3. Register a new candidate profile with your CNIC and mobile number.
4. Complete academic background details and upload a recent passport-style photograph.
5. Select your preferred test center (e.g., Chakdara, Peshawar, Islamabad).
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice and pay the fee of Rs. 1,310 before **12 October 2026**.
7. Download and print the confirmation page for your records.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for UOM MS/MPhil/PhD admissions?**
The deadline to register for the NTS admission test is **12 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will the NTS admission test be held?**
The tentative test date is **18 October 2026**.

**Q3: What is the test fee amount?**
The fee is **Rs. 1,310** (Rs. 1,300 test fee + Rs. 10 service charges).

**Q4: Can I apply for both MS and PhD at the same time?**
Candidates must possess 18 years of education (completed MS/MPhil) to be eligible for PhD. You can apply for the program matching your completed qualification.

**Q5: Is physical submission of the NTS form required?**
No. The application is completely paperless and submitted online via the NTS candidate portal.

content: ### Official Announcement & Provisional Merit List Release
**Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad (SBA)**, has officially released the **Provisional Merit List for BS Programs (Admission Batch 2027)**.
The provisional merit list was published on **7 October 2026**, covering all undergraduate academic disciplines at the **SBBU Main Campus, Nawabshah**.

Candidates who appeared in the pre-entry test and submitted their admission applications can now verify their selection online. Successful candidates are directed to collect their admission fee challans from the Facilitation Centre and complete their payment process within the prescribed schedule.
### Privacy & Candidate Verification Notice

> [!NOTE]
> **Candidate Privacy Commitment:** In accordance with personal data privacy guidelines, **CareerDost does NOT scrape, reproduce, or republish personal student records, names, marks, parent names, or form IDs.**
>
> Candidates must verify their individual results directly on the official university portal at `https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/first-merit-list_bs_program_sbbu.html`.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad
- **Campus Covered:** **SBBU Main Campus, Nawabshah**
- **Admission Intake:** BS Programs Admission Batch 2027
- **List Status:** **Provisional Merit List (Subject to Document Scrutiny & Fee Payment)**
- **Provisional List Release Date:** 7 October 2026
- **Fee Challan Collection Venue:** Facilitation Centre, SBBU Main Campus
- **Fee Submission Period:** **12 October 2026 to 22 October 2026**
- **General BS Programs Fee:** **Rs. 68,500/=**
- **BS AI & Cyber Security Fee:** **Rs. 88,500/=**
- **Departmental Copy Submission Deadline:** **22 October 2026**
- **Official University Website:** [sbbusba.edu.pk](https://sbbusba.edu.pk/)
- **Direct Merit List Link:** [mail.sbbusba.edu.pk](https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/first-merit-list_bs_program_sbbu.html)
### Important Fee Structure & Due Dates

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Candidates are advised to collect the official fee challan from the **Facilitation Centre** and pay their admission fees within the verified timeframe:
>
> - **All General BS Program Departments:** **Rs. 68,500/=**
> - **BS Cyber Security & BS Artificial Intelligence:** **Rs. 88,500/=**
> - **Payment Schedule:** **12 October 2026 to 22 October 2026**
>
> **Critical Warning:** In case of non-payment of fee within the due date, the candidate's name will be permanently removed from the merit list, and the seat will be offered to the next candidate on waiting.
### Mandatory Submission of Paid Departmental Copy

Paying the fee at the bank is not enough to finalize your seat:
- It is **mandatory to submit the paid departmental copy of the fee challan** to the Admission Office latest by **22 October 2026** for the final confirmation of admission.
- Failure to submit the paid departmental copy will result in the forfeiture of admission, and no subsequent claims will be entertained.
### Mandatory Documents Required at Facilitation Centre

Admission fee challans will **NOT** be issued without verification of the following documents:

#### 1. Original Documents:
1. **HSC (Intermediate) Original Marksheet**
2. **Original Affidavit** (on prescribed judicial stamp paper)

#### 2. Required Attested Photocopies:
1. HSC (Intermediate) Marksheet (Photocopy)
2. CNIC or B-Form (Photocopy)
3. Domicile & PRC (Form C) Certificate (Photocopy)
4. SSC (Matriculation) Marksheet (Photocopy)
5. Two Passport-Size Recent Photographs
6. No Objection Certificate (NOC) if employed, or for candidates domiciled in other provinces
### University Disclaimers & Rectification Rights

> [!WARNING]
> **Provisional Admission Notice:** Do not describe or treat this as a final merit list. The university reserves the absolute right to rectify errors or omissions.
>
> In case any candidate’s documents are found forged, counterfeit, or if incorrect information was provided at any stage, their provisional admission is liable to immediate cancellation, and legal proceedings may be initiated.
### Step-by-Step Guide to Check Your Name on the Merit List

1. Visit the official SBBU merit portal: [mail.sbbusba.edu.pk](https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/first-merit-list_bs_program_sbbu.html).
2. Use the on-page search box or press `Ctrl + F` on your computer.
3. Enter your assigned **Form ID** or your **Full Name** to locate your record.
4. Verify your Department, Test Score, and merit allocation status.
5. If selected, prepare your original HSC marksheet and affidavit.
6. Visit the Facilitation Centre at SBBU Main Campus Nawabshah between **12 and 22 October 2026** to obtain your fee voucher.
7. Pay the fee (Rs. 68,500 or Rs. 88,500) at the designated bank branch.
8. Submit the paid departmental copy back to the Admission Office before **22 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Is this the final merit list for SBBU BS Admissions Batch 2027?**
No. This is strictly a Provisional Merit List. Final admission is subject to physical verification of original documents and submission of the paid fee challan by 22 October 2026.

**Q2: What is the fee submission deadline?**
The fee submission window is from **12 October 2026 to 22 October 2026**.

**Q3: What is the admission fee amount for BS programs?**
The admission fee is **Rs. 68,500** for general BS departments, and **Rs. 88,500** for BS Artificial Intelligence and BS Cyber Security.

**Q4: Which documents must I present to collect the fee challan?**
You must present your original HSC marksheet and affidavit, along with photocopies of HSC marksheet, Matric marksheet, CNIC/B-Form, Domicile, PRC, and 2 passport photos.

**Q5: Can I claim my seat if I pay the fee but do not submit the departmental copy?**
No. Submitting the paid departmental copy to the Admission Office by 22 October 2026 is mandatory. Unsubmitted receipts will lead to cancellation of provisional admission.

content: ### URGENT RECRUITMENT NOTICE: LAST DATE TODAY — 8 OCTOBER 2026

> [!WARNING]
> **CRITICAL DEADLINE NOTICE:** Online applications for recruitment at the **Independent System & Market Operator (ISMO) Pakistan** close strictly **TODAY, 8 October 2026**.
>
> Eligible candidates must submit their electronic application forms on the official National Testing Service (NTS) portal before midnight. The online registration portal will close once the deadline expires.
### About Independent System & Market Operator (ISMO)

The **Independent System & Market Operator (ISMO)** is a landmark state-owned corporate entity established by the Government of Pakistan to oversee national transmission system operations and operate the competitive wholesale electricity market (CTBCM) in Pakistan.
To strengthen its technical, regulatory, and corporate workforce, ISMO invited applications from qualified Pakistani professionals nationwide through the National Testing Service (NTS).
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** Independent System & Market Operator (ISMO) Pakistan
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Recruitment Type:** Professional Contractual Appointments
- **Work Location:** Islamabad Head Office / Regional Operational Centers
- **Application Deadline:** **TODAY, 8 October 2026**
- **Submission Mode:** Strictly Online via NTS Website
- **Payment Method:** 1Link 1Bill (Banks, ATM, Internet/Mobile Banking, Easypaisa, JazzCash)
- **Biometric Requirement:** Updated NADRA Fingerprint Registration Mandatory
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [nts.org.pk ISMO Project](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/06_26/ISMO_June2026_Online/ISMO.php)
- **Online Application Form:** [nts.org.pk Online Form](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/06_26/ISMO_June2026_Online/index.php)
### Advertised Positions & Professional Categories

The ISMO recruitment drive encompasses key technical and corporate disciplines:

1. **Engineering Wing:**
   - **Senior Engineers (Power Systems / Electrical):** Minimum 16-Year Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from an HEC-recognized university with active Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) registration and 5+ years relevant power utility/transmission experience.
   - **Engineer-I & Engineer-II:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with valid PEC registration; 1–3 years experience in power system dispatch, protection, or grid operations.

2. **Finance & Regulatory Wing:**
   - **Assistant Manager (Sales Tax / Taxation):** Master’s degree in Commerce/Finance, CA Inter, CMA, or ACCA with 3+ years corporate tax compliance experience.
   - **Assistant Manager (Business & Regulatory Finance):** Master’s/BS in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration with power market regulatory modeling expertise.
   - **Senior Analyst (Tariff Analysis & Financial Modelling):** Qualified financial analyst with hands-on experience in financial modeling, power purchase tariffs, and cash flow forecasting.

3. **Information Technology & Systems Wing:**
   - **System Administrator & Network Administrator:** BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology with certifications (CCNA, CCNP, MCSE) and 3+ years data center/network operations experience.
   - **Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer:** BS in Computer Science/SE with software quality assurance and automation testing background.
   - **Senior Analyst (IT Governance & Compliance):** BS/MS in CS/IT with knowledge of ISO 27001, cybersecurity frameworks, and IT audit.

content: ### Healthcare Recruitment Notice: NICVD Karachi

The **National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (NICVD), Karachi**, the country’s flagship tertiary cardiac healthcare institution, has announced career opportunities across medical, nursing, allied health, and administrative departments.

The positions are open to candidates possessing a valid **Sindh Domicile**. Depending on the position, applications are being processed through the **National Testing Service (NTS)** and the official NICVD careers portal.
The final closing date for application submission is strictly **11 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Institution:** National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (NICVD), Karachi
- **Administering Authority:** NICVD Sindh / NTS Testing Services
- **Vacancies Announced:** Staff Nurses, Trainee Staff Nurses, Medical Faculty & Technical Staff
- **Regional Eligibility:** Candidates holding valid Sindh Domicile
- **Application Deadline:** **11 October 2026**
- **NTS Written Test Fee:** **Rs. 800 (for Nursing positions)**
- **Payment Method:** 1Link 1Bill (Banks, ATM, Easypaisa, JazzCash)
- **Helpline Numbers:** 021-34546930 & 051-8444441
- **Official NTS Portal:** [nts.org.pk NICVD Portal](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/09_26/NICVD_Sep2026_Online/NICVD.php)
- **NICVD Institutional Careers:** [nicvd.org/careers](https://nicvd.org/careers)
### Verified Vacancy Table (Current Advertisement)

The following positions are officially advertised in the current recruitment cycle with closing date of **11 October 2026**:

| Position Title | Prescribed Qualification | Minimum Experience | Application Channel & Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Staff Nurse** | 4-Year Generic BSN Degree or 3-Year General Nursing Diploma + 1-Year Midwifery; Valid PNC Registration | 1–2 Years Clinical Hospital Experience | **Apply via NTS** (Deadline: 11 Oct 2026) |
| **Trainee Staff Nurse** | 4-Year Generic BSN or 3-Year General Nursing Diploma; Valid PNC Registration | Fresh Graduates / Entry Level | **Apply via NTS** (Deadline: 11 Oct 2026) |
| **Consultant Interventional Radiologist** | MBBS with FCPS in Radiology + Certified Sub-Specialty Fellowship in Interventional Radiology | 3+ Years Post-Fellowship Clinical Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Assistant Professor (Paeds Critical Care / Emergency)** | MBBS with FCPS / MS in Paediatrics or Paediatric Critical Care | 2+ Years Post-Fellowship Teaching/Hospital Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Senior Registrar (Paeds Cardiac Surgery)** | MBBS with FCPS Part-II / MS in Cardiac Surgery | Completed Residency in Cardiac Surgery | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Senior Registrar (Cardiac Imaging / Critical Care)** | MBBS with FCPS in Cardiology / Radiology / Critical Care | 1+ Year Senior Resident Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Dietitian** | BS / M.Sc in Food & Nutrition / Clinical Dietetics from HEC-recognized institute | 1–2 Years Hospital Clinical Nutrition Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |

| **Echo Technologist** | BS in Cardiac Technology / Allied Health Sciences | 1–2 Years Adult/Paediatric Echocardiography Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Echo Technician / CSSD Technician** | Diploma in Cardiac / OT / CSSD Technology from Sindh Medical Faculty | 1+ Year Relevant Practical Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Surgical Assistant** | Diploma / BS in Surgical Technology / Operation Theatre Sciences | 1–2 Years Cardiac OT Practical Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Multimedia Specialist** | Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Multimedia Arts, or Graphic Design | 2+ Years Video Production & Medical Media Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
| **Junior Assistant (Human Resources)** | BBA / Bachelor’s in Public Administration / Commerce | 1–2 Years Clerical / HR Operations Experience | Apply via NICVD Careers (11 Oct 2026) |
### Application Channels & Fee Payment Details

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Candidates must apply through the designated portal according to their target position:
>

>    - Applications must be submitted online exclusively through the **NTS portal** at `https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/09_26/NICVD_Sep2026_Online/NICVD.php`.
>    - The NTS written test fee is **Rs. 800/-**, payable via 1Link 1Bill participating banks, ATMs, Internet/Mobile Banking, Easypaisa, or JazzCash.
>    - Only online-filled application forms are entertained. Handwritten or posted forms will be rejected.
>
> 2. **For Medical, Specialist & Administrative Positions:**
>    - Candidates should submit their detailed CV and application through the official **NICVD careers portal** at `www.nicvd.org/careers` before **11 October 2026**.
### Eligibility Guidelines & Sindh Domicile Requirement

- **Domicile:** All advertised positions are reserved for candidates holding a valid Domicile and PRC of Sindh Province.
- **Council Registrations:** Medical doctors must possess valid PMDC registration; Nurses must hold valid registration with the Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PN&MC).
- **Age Relaxation:** Admissible under Government of Sindh service rules where applicable.

Candidates applying for **Staff Nurse** and **Trainee Staff Nurse** positions must apply online through the NTS portal.

Candidates applying for medical faculty, consultant, registrar, technologist, and HR roles should apply via the official NICVD careers portal at `www.nicvd.org/careers`.

The written test fee is Rs. 800, payable via 1Link 1Bill.

No. The advertised positions strictly require a valid Sindh Domicile.

content: ### Comprehensive Admissions Overview: Generic BS Nursing 2026–27

Admissions for the **BS Nursing (Generic) 4-Year Degree Program (Session 2026–2027)** are now officially open across **five prominent recognized nursing colleges in Sindh**, with the **National Testing Service (NTS)** administering the centralized online registration and entrance testing process.
The program offers recognized nursing education accredited by the **Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PN&MC)** and affiliated with leading public medical universities in Sindh.
The closing deadline for online application submission for all five institutions is **Friday, 30 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Academic Program:** BS Nursing (Generic) 4-Year Degree Program
- **Academic Intake:** Session 2026–2027
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Regulatory Body:** Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PN&MC)
- **Number of Participating Colleges:** 5 Recognized Nursing Institutions across Sindh
- **Application Deadline:** **Friday, 30 October 2026**
- **Minimum Eligibility:** F.Sc Pre-Medical (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) with at least **50% Marks**
- **Age Limit:** 14 to 35 Years (as per PN&MC Regulations)
- **Gender Eligibility:** Male & Female (as per college-specific quota)
- **Fee Payment Channel:** 1Link 1Bill (Banks, ATM, Mobile Banking, Easypaisa, JazzCash, TCS)
- **Official NTS Admissions Hub:** [nts.org.pk Projects Page](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/projectsnew.php)
### College-by-College Comparison Table

Below is the verified comparative breakdown of all five nursing colleges currently admitting candidates through NTS:

| College Name | Location | Affiliation & Recognition | Test Center City | Application Deadline | Official NTS Portal |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Memon College of Nursing** | Karachi, Sindh | Recognized by PN&MC | Karachi | **30 October 2026** | [Apply for Memon](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/10_26/Memon_Oct2026_Online/Memon.php) |
| **National Institute of Allied Health Sciences (NIAH)** | Hyderabad, Sindh | Recognized by PN&MC | Hyderabad | **30 October 2026** | [Apply for NIAH](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/NIAH_Hyd_Aug2026_Online/NIAH.php) |
| **Leaders Institute of Medical & Allied Health Sciences** | Khairpur Mir’s, Sindh | Recognized by PN&MC | Sukkur / Khairpur | **30 October 2026** | [Apply for Leaders](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/Leaders_Aug2026_Online/Leaders.php) |
| **Visionary Institute of Nursing & Allied Health Sciences** | Sukkur, Sindh | Recognized by PN&MC | Sukkur | **30 October 2026** | [Apply for Visionary](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/Visionary_Sukkur_Aug2026_Online/Visionary.php) |
| **Lareb Mustafa Institute of Nursing** | Gambat, Sindh | Recognized by PN&MC | Gambat / Sukkur | **30 October 2026** | [Apply for Lareb](https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/LaraibMustafa_Aug2026_Online/Lareb.php) |
### Strict Eligibility Criteria & PN&MC Standards

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Applicants must satisfy the statutory admission standards prescribed by the Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PN&MC):
>
> 1. **Academic Qualification:** Candidates must have passed the **Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / F.Sc Pre-Medical)** with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, securing a minimum of **50% unadjusted marks** from a recognized BISE board.
> 2. **Matriculation Standard:** SSC (Matric) with Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) with at least 50% marks.
> 3. **Age Requirement:** Candidates must be between **14 and 35 years of age** on the closing date (30 October 2026).
> 4. **Gender Eligibility:** Both male and female candidates are eligible, subject to individual institute quota distributions.
> 5. **Domicile:** Preference and seat quotas are allocated to candidates holding Sindh Domicile and PRC.
### NTS Admission Screening Test Format

The NTS written pre-admission test comprises multiple-choice questions (MCQs) structured as follows:
- **Biology:** 40%
- **Chemistry:** 20%
- **Physics:** 20%
- **English Language Comprehension:** 10%
- **General Knowledge & Analytical Reasoning:** 10%

Test date and venue will be communicated via NTS Roll Number Slips dispatched to candidates' registered accounts prior to the test.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Visit the NTS portal and locate the specific college project link:
   - **Memon College Karachi:** `https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/10_26/Memon_Oct2026_Online/Memon.php`
   - **NIAH Hyderabad:** `https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/NIAH_Hyd_Aug2026_Online/NIAH.php`
   - **Leaders Institute Khairpur:** `https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/Leaders_Aug2026_Online/Leaders.php`
   - **Visionary Institute Sukkur:** `https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/Visionary_Sukkur_Aug2026_Online/Visionary.php`
   - **Lareb Mustafa Gambat:** `https://nts.org.pk/Test&Products/Announced/08_26/LaraibMustafa_Aug2026_Online/Lareb.php`
2. Click on **Online Application Form** and log in or register a new candidate account.
3. Enter your personal details, intermediate pre-medical marks, and upload a passport-size photo.
4. Generate the 1Link 1Bill fee invoice and deposit the test fee through mobile banking, Easypaisa, JazzCash, or bank branch.
5. Confirm payment on the candidate dashboard and submit before **30 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for BS Nursing admissions in Sindh?**
The deadline for all five colleges on NTS is **Friday, 30 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the minimum F.Sc percentage required for BS Nursing?**
A minimum of **50% marks in F.Sc Pre-Medical** (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) is mandatory per PN&MC regulations.

**Q3: Can male students apply for these nursing programs?**
Yes. Both male and female candidates can apply, subject to the quota policy of each individual institution.

**Q4: How do I pay the NTS admission test fee?**
Fees can be paid online via 1Link 1Bill using any bank app, ATM, Easypaisa, JazzCash, or TCS Express counters.

**Q5: Can I apply to more than one college?**
Yes. Candidates can apply to multiple institutions by submitting separate online application forms and test fees on NTS.

content: ### Program Overview: SZABIST Need-Based Scholarship 2026–27

**SZABIST University Karachi** has officially invited applications for the **SZABIST Need-Based Scholarship (SNBSP) 2026–27**, dedicated to supporting newly registered students facing financial hardship.

Administered by the **External Relations & Financial Assistance (ERFA) Department**, the scholarship provides tuition fee coverage to ensure talented students can pursue higher education without financial distress.
The final deadline to complete the online application, schedule an appointment, and submit the physical form along with all supporting financial documents is **21 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Administering Body:** ERFA Department, SZABIST University Karachi
- **Scholarship Name:** SZABIST Need-Based Scholarship 2026–27 for New Students
- **Target Students:** Newly Registered Undergraduate and Graduate Students
- **Excluded Programs:** **PhD Students are strictly NOT eligible**
- **Income Eligibility Ceiling:** Maximum Annual Family Income **Rs. 1,500,000/- (Rs 1.5 Million)**
- **Academic Criterion:** Enrolled students in good standing (CGPA > 2.5 where applicable)
- **Physical Submission Venue:** Room No. 5, ERFA Department, 153 Campus, SZABIST University, Karachi
- **Submission Days & Timings:** Monday to Thursday | 10:00 AM to 3:15 PM
- **Application Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Official Announcements Portal:** [szabist.edu.pk/announcements](https://szabist.edu.pk/announcements/)
- **ERFA Department Contact:** `erfa@szabist.edu.pk` | Phone: 021-35823433 (Ext: 371)
### Financial Need Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Prospective applicants must fulfill the following mandatory criteria:
>
> 1. **Enrollment Status:** Must be a newly registered student in any undergraduate or graduate degree program at SZABIST Karachi for the current academic session.
> 2. **PhD Ineligibility:** PhD students are strictly not eligible for this need-based assistance.
> 3. **Family Income Ceiling:** Total gross annual family income from all sources must **not exceed Rs. 1,500,000/-**.
> 4. **Academic Standing:** Must maintain satisfactory academic standing (minimum 2.5 CGPA where applicable).
> 5. **Award Value Clarification:** The exact scholarship quantum is evaluated case-by-case by the Financial Assistance Committee based on demonstrated financial need. No fixed or uniform sum is pre-guaranteed.
### Mandatory Supporting Financial Documents

Applicants must attach complete verified photocopies of the following records to their physical application:
1. Salary slips / income certificate / pension book of parent(s) or guardian (for self-employed parents, an affidavit declaring business income on legal stamp paper).
2. Bank statements of all active family bank accounts for the last six months.
3. Copies of paid utility bills (Electricity, Gas, Water, and Telephone/Internet) for the last six months.
4. Copy of rental agreement (if residing in a rented house).
5. Paid fee receipts of siblings currently studying in schools, colleges, or universities.
6. Medical bills or prescription records (in case of serious or chronic medical illness of any family member).
7. Copy of CNIC of applicant and parents/guardian.
8. Death certificate of father/guardian (if applicable).
### Two-Tier Application Submission Procedure

Applying for the scholarship requires completing both an online form and a physical form by appointment:

1. **Step 1 – Download the Physical Form:**
   - Download the official physical application form: [https://bit.ly/SNBSPPhysicalForm](https://bit.ly/SNBSPPhysicalForm) (or [https://bit.ly/SNBSP26PForm](https://bit.ly/SNBSP26PForm)).
   - Fill out the form completely and attach all mandatory supporting documents listed above.

2. **Step 2 – Submit the Online Form:**
   - Access the online form: [https://bit.ly/SNBSPOnlineForm](https://bit.ly/SNBSPOnlineForm) (or [https://bit.ly/SNBSP26OnlineForm](https://bit.ly/SNBSP26OnlineForm)).
   - **Important:** The online form can only be accessed using your official SZABIST student email address ending with `@szabist.pk`.

3. **Step 3 – Book an In-Person Appointment:**
   - Once your online form is submitted, the ERFA Department will email you a dedicated appointment booking link.
   - Select an available date and time slot.

4. **Step 4 – Physical Submission at ERFA Department:**
   - Visit **Room No. 5, ERFA Department, 153 Campus, SZABIST University Karachi** on your scheduled appointment date.
   - Hand over the completed physical form and all original and photocopied supporting documents.
### Critical Appointment Rules & Submission Warnings

> [!WARNING]
> - **Strict Appointment Policy:** Physical forms will strictly **NOT be accepted without a prior appointment**.
> - **No Walk-Ins:** Walk-in submissions will be turned away immediately.
> - **Single Booking Rule:** Each student is allowed to book **only one appointment**. Multiple bookings will result in the immediate cancellation of all appointments, and the student will forfeit the opportunity to apply.
> - **Punctuality:** Students must arrive at least 5 minutes before their scheduled appointment time.
> - **Completeness:** Both online and physical submissions are mandatory. Missing either step will result in immediate disqualification.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SZABIST Need-Based Scholarship 2026–27?**
The final deadline for form submission is **21 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the maximum family income limit?**
The total annual gross family income must not exceed **Rs. 1,500,000/-** (1.5 Million PKR).

**Q3: Are PhD students eligible for this scholarship?**
No. As per official SZABIST policy, PhD students are strictly not eligible for this need-based assistance.

**Q4: Can I submit the physical form without booking an appointment?**
No. Physical forms will strictly not be accepted without a prior appointment. Walk-in submissions are prohibited.

**Q5: Can I access the online application form with a personal Gmail account?**
No. The online form can only be accessed using your official university student email address ending with `@szabist.pk`.

**Q6: What is the contact email for the ERFA Department?**
You can contact the department at `erfa@szabist.edu.pk` or call 021-35823433 (Ext 371).

The university is admitting students into both **1st Semester (4-Year BS)** and **5th Semester (Lateral Entry)** programmes across key faculties:
- **Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)**
- **BS Computer Science (BSCS)**
- **BS Information Technology (BSIT)**
- **BS Mathematics**
- **BS Commerce**
- **BS English Literature & Linguistics**
- **B.Ed. (Hons.) 4-Year Elementary Education**
### Eligibility Criteria

1. **1st Semester (BS Programmes):** Relevant Intermediate (HSSC) qualification with at least 50% marks from a recognized intermediate board.
2. **5th Semester (Lateral Entry):** Relevant 2-Year Associate Degree (ADA, ADS, ADC) or equivalent qualification with at least 50% marks.
3. **Merit Determination Formula:** Merit calculation comprises **80% weightage for the Pre-Entry Test** and **20% weightage for Intermediate / qualifying examination marks**.
### How to Apply Online

1. Open the university admissions portal at `admissions.saus.edu.pk/admissions`.
2. Register a new user account with your CNIC/B-Form and active mobile number.
3. Fill in your personal profile and academic qualifications.
4. Download and print the **Rs. 2,500 admission processing challan**.
5. Deposit the challan fee at any designated bank branch.
6. Upload the stamped paid challan copy onto the portal and finalize submission before **17 October 2026**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Preservation of Existing Applications:** Candidates who previously submitted their online applications and uploaded paid challans do not need to resubmit. This extension is intended for new applicants and those completing fee uploads.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the new deadline for Shaikh Ayaz University Admissions 2027?**
The revised deadline to apply online is **17 October 2026**.

**Q2: Has the entry test date changed?**
No. The pre-entry test remains scheduled for **7 November 2026**.

**Q3: What is the application processing fee?**
The application fee is Rs. 2,500 payable via bank challan.

**Q4: When will merit lists be published?**
The first merit list is scheduled for publication on **11 November 2026**.
### Offered BS Undergraduate Degree Programmes & Eligibility

The Shaikh Ayaz University, Shikarpur (SAUS) offers 4-year undergraduate admissions across the following departments:
- **BS Computer Science, BS Information Technology & BS Artificial Intelligence:** Intermediate (HSSC Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical with additional Math/deficiency course, or ICS) with minimum **50% marks**.
- **BBA (Hons) 4-Year & BS Commerce:** Intermediate (HSSC / I.Com / A-Levels) in any discipline with at least **45%–50% aggregate marks**.
- **BS English (Language & Literature), BS Mathematics & B.Ed (Hons) 4-Year Elementary:** HSSC or equivalent with minimum **45%–50% marks** as per HEC & NCTE curriculum rules.

excerpt: Punjab School Education Department opens online applications for School Teacher Interns (STI) 2026–27. Monthly stipends: Primary Rs 38,000, Elementary Rs 40,000, High Rs 45,000. Apply online at sti.pesrp.edu.pk by 18 October 2026.
content: ### Official Announcement & Program Overview

The **School Education Department (SED), Government of the Punjab**, under the **Punjab Education Sector Reforms Programme (PESRP)**, has officially initiated the online recruitment cycle for the **School Teacher Internship (STI) Program 2026–27**.

The program engages educated youth as temporary **School Teacher Interns** to address teacher shortages in government schools across all 36 districts of Punjab. Selected interns will be placed in **Primary, Elementary, High, and Higher Secondary Schools** for the duration of the current academic session.

Online applications must be submitted directly through the centralized official STI portal at `https://sti.pesrp.edu.pk/` on or before the closing deadline of **18 October 2026 (Wednesday) up to 11:59 P.M.**
### Quick Summary Table

- **Administering Authority:** School Education Department (SED) / PESRP, Punjab
- **Program Title:** School Teacher Internship (STI) Program 2026–27
- **Target Institutions:** Primary, Elementary, High, and Higher Secondary Schools
- **Placement Scope:** All 36 Districts of Punjab (Strictly within candidate's own Tehsil)
- **Online Application Deadline:** **18 October 2026 (Wednesday) – 11:59 PM**
- **Preliminary Merit List:** **23 October 2026** (On School Notice Boards)
- **Grievance Redressal:** **26–27 October 2026** (Tehsil Committee by DEO)
- **Interview Schedule:** **29–30 October 2026**
- **Final Merit List Display:** **31 October 2026 (10:00 AM)**
- **Issuance of Agreement Letters:** **2 November 2026**
- **Internship Engagement Period:** **3 November 2026 to 31 May 2027**
- **Official Application Portal:** [sti.pesrp.edu.pk](https://sti.pesrp.edu.pk/)
- **Official Helpline:** 042-111-11-20-20 | Email: `Support@pesrp.edu.pk`
### Important Notice on Total Vacancy Figures

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Vacancy Clarification:** Multiple unofficial blogs and social media pages report speculative figures such as *"25,000 vacancies"* or *"30,000 seats."*
>
> The School Education Department allocates vacancies on an **actual need basis per school**, not through a single centralized arbitrary total. Every government school lists its specific vacant STI spots directly inside the portal (`sti.pesrp.edu.pk/available_internships`). Applicants must search by their district and tehsil to view the verified vacancies in their immediate neighborhood.
### Verified Monthly Stipend Breakdown

Stipends are fixed by the Government of the Punjab according to the school category and instructional tier:

| Internship Category | School Placement Level | Prescribed Monthly Stipend | Payment Disbursal Mode |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary STI** | Government Primary Schools (GPS / GGPS) | **Rs. 38,000 / month** | Monthly Bank Disbursal |
| **Elementary STI** | Government Elementary Schools (GES / GGES) | **Rs. 40,000 / month** | Monthly Bank Disbursal |
| **High & Higher Secondary STI** | Government High / Higher Sec Schools (GHS / GHSS) | **Rs. 45,000 / month** | Monthly Bank Disbursal |

*Note: No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance (TA/DA) is admissible for applying, appearing in interviews, or joining duties.*
### Nature of Engagement & Contract Duration

> [!NOTE]
> **Temporary Internship Notice:** School Teacher Intern positions are strictly **temporary, contractual internships** running from **3 November 2026 to 31 May 2027**.
> 
> Engagement concludes automatically upon completion of the academic session or when a regular teacher is posted by the department. This internship does not confer any legal right, title, or claim to regular government employment or service regularization under the Punjab Civil Servants Act.
### Strict Eligibility Criteria

1. **Tehsil Residence Rule (Mandatory):** Candidates are eligible to apply **only for schools situated within their own Tehsil** (permanent address tehsil as verified on CNIC). Applications submitted for schools outside the candidate’s residential tehsil will be rejected during preliminary verification.
2. **Gender Allocation Rule:** Male candidates can apply only to Boys' schools; Female candidates can apply only to Girls' schools.
3. **Age Limits (Calculated as of 18 October 2026):**
   - **Male Candidates:** 20 to 50 Years
   - **Female Candidates:** 20 to 55 Years
4. **Academic Qualifications:**
   - **Primary Level:** Minimum Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / I.Com / ICS or 12 years HSSC equivalent) with at least 2nd Division.
   - **Elementary Level:** Minimum Bachelor's Degree (BA / B.Sc / B.Com or 14 years equivalent) with at least 2nd Division.
   - **High & Higher Secondary Level:** Minimum Master's Degree (MA / M.Sc or 16-Year BS 4-Year degree in relevant disciplines: English, Urdu, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Pakistan Studies, Islamiyat) with at least 2nd Division.
5. **Professional Qualifications:** Candidates with B.Ed, M.Ed, or Associate Degree in Education (ADE) will receive additional marks in the merit calculation formula.
### Merit Calculation Formula & Selection Procedure

- **Academic Weightage:** Marks obtained across Matric, Intermediate, Graduation, and Master's are calculated on percentage weightage set by the School Education Department.
- **Professional Teaching Qualification:** Additional bonus marks are granted for verified B.Ed / M.Ed qualifications from HEC-recognized universities.
- **Interview Score:** Shortlisted applicants appear before the Tehsil-Level School Management Committee for interview assessment covering subject command, communication, and teaching pedagogical approach.
- **Merit Lists:** Preliminary lists are pasted on school notice boards on **23 October 2026**. Grievances can be lodged before the DEO Tehsil Committee on **26–27 October 2026**. Final merit lists will be published on **31 October 2026 at 10:00 AM**.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

Follow these verified steps to submit your application on the official portal:
1. Visit the official portal: [sti.pesrp.edu.pk](https://sti.pesrp.edu.pk/).
2. Click on **Register** at the top right corner.
3. Enter your valid 13-digit CNIC number, mobile number, and active email address.
4. Log in and navigate to the **Profile Builder** section. Complete all 4 tabs:
   - Personal Information
   - Academics (Matriculation, Intermediate, Graduation, Master's)
   - Work Experience (if any)
   - Professional Teaching Qualification (B.Ed / M.Ed / ADE)
5. Review your profile data thoroughly to ensure accuracy.
6. Click on **Available Internships** to browse schools within your Tehsil.
7. Select the school and grade level matching your academic qualifications and click **Apply**.
8. Track your application status using the **Track Application** module before **18 October 2026 at 11:59 PM**.
### Official Contact & Helpline Support

- **Official Portal:** [https://sti.pesrp.edu.pk/](https://sti.pesrp.edu.pk/)
- **Official Policy Document:** [sti.pesrp.edu.pk/assets/user/dist/images/sti_policy.pdf](https://sti.pesrp.edu.pk/assets/user/dist/images/sti_policy.pdf)
- **Helpline Phone:** 042-111-11-20-20
- **Email Support:** Support@pesrp.edu.pk
- **Administering Authority:** School Education Department Punjab, Lahore
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Punjab STI 2026–27?**
The deadline to apply online through `sti.pesrp.edu.pk` is strictly **18 October 2026 (Wednesday) up to 11:59 P.M.**

**Q2: What is the monthly stipend for School Teacher Interns?**
Stipends are fixed by the Punjab Government: Rs. 38,000 for Primary level, Rs. 40,000 for Elementary level, and Rs. 45,000 for High / Higher Secondary level.

**Q3: Can I apply for schools located outside my residential Tehsil?**
No. According to STI rules, candidates can apply only to schools situated within their permanent address Tehsil as listed on their CNIC.

**Q4: Is there an application fee for the STI program?**
No. Applying online through the official PESRP STI portal is 100% free of charge.

**Q5: Can male candidates apply for vacancies in girls' schools?**
No. Male candidates can apply only to boys' schools, and female candidates can apply only to girls' schools.

**Q6: What is the duration of the internship?**
The internship runs from 3 November 2026 until 31 May 2027. It is purely temporary and does not guarantee permanent government employment.
