content: ### Official Admission Announcement & Session Details

The **National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS)**, Pakistan’s leading federally chartered military and public medical university located in Rawalpindi, has officially opened online admissions for **Postgraduate Degree Programs, Diplomas, and Clinical Certifications** for the **Spring 2027** academic session.

Admissions opened formally on **6 October 2026**. Qualified medical practitioners, dental surgeons, allied health specialists, and natural science graduates can apply across diverse specializations spanning PhD, MPhil, MS, MSc, and specialized clinical credentials.
Applications must be completed exclusively via the official NUMS Postgraduate Admission Portal (`pgadmissions.numspak.edu.pk`). Hardcopy forms dispatched via courier or post will not be accepted.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Awarding University:** National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS), Rawalpindi
- **Academic Intake:** Spring Semester 2027
- **Admissions Opening Date:** 6 October 2026
- **Regular Application Deadline:** **30 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM PKT**
- **Regular Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 3,000 (Non-refundable)**
- **Late Registration Deadline:** **4 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 4:00 PM PKT**
- **Late Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 5,000 (Non-refundable)**
- **NUMS Entry Test Schedule:** **17–18 November 2026**
- **Mode of Submission:** 100% Online via `pgadmissions.numspak.edu.pk`
- **Official Admission Portal:** [pgadmissions.numspak.edu.pk](https://pgadmissions.numspak.edu.pk/forms/SignIn.aspx)
- **Official Information Desk:** 051-9270686 | Email: `pg.admissions@numspak.edu.pk`
### Comprehensive List of Offered Postgraduate Programs

NUMS offers advanced academic and clinical programs grouped across the following specialized categories:

1. **Doctor of Philosophy (PhD Programs):**
   - PhD Biochemistry
   - PhD Molecular Medicine
   - PhD Pharmacology
   - PhD Public Health
   - PhD Dental Materials

2. **Master of Philosophy (MPhil Programs):**
   - MPhil Anatomy
   - MPhil Physiology
   - MPhil Biochemistry
   - MPhil Pharmacology
   - MPhil Molecular Medicine
   - MPhil Community Medicine
   - MPhil Oral Pathology
   - MPhil Chemical Pathology
   - MPhil Microbiology
   - MPhil Hematology
   - MPhil Psychology

3. **Master of Science & Clinical Master’s Programs:**
   - Masters in Health Professions Education (MHPE)
   - MS Clinical Psychology
   - MS Transfusion Medicine
   - MSc Cardiac Anesthesia
   - Master of Science in Nursing (MSN – *Exclusively for female candidates*)

4. **Postgraduate Diplomas & Clinical Certifications:**
   - Diploma in Cardiology (Dip Card)
   - Clinical Certification in Interventional Radiology
   - Clinical Certification in Hybrid Imaging (PET-CT Scan)
### Program-Specific Eligibility Criteria & Test Requirements

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **CRITICAL TEST NOTICE:** Admission test and qualification requirements are program-specific. Do not assume every program follows the same admission test or criteria. Review your specific discipline carefully below:
>
> - **PhD Programs:** Candidates must hold an MS/MPhil/FCPS or 18-year equivalent degree in the relevant discipline from an HEC/PMDC-recognized institution with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0 (or first division). Applicants must present a valid GAT Subject / GRE Subject test score (minimum 60% percentile) or qualify the NUMS PhD Subject Entrance Test with at least 70% aggregate marks.
> - **MPhil Basic Medical Sciences:** MBBS or BDS degree registered with PMDC/PMC with completed one-year house job. Must qualify the NUMS Entry Test or possess a valid GAT General score (minimum 50% cumulative).
> - **MPhil Biological & Psychological Sciences:** 16 years of education (BS 4-Year or MSc) in relevant discipline with minimum 2.5/4.0 CGPA or 50% marks, plus qualifying the NUMS Entry Test / GAT General (50%).
> - **MS Clinical Psychology:** 16-year BS Psychology or MSc Applied Psychology from an HEC-recognized university with at least 2.50 CGPA or 50% marks, followed by the NUMS departmental written test and interview.
> - **MHPE:** MBBS or BDS with valid PMDC registration and minimum 2 years of teaching or clinical experience in a recognized healthcare institute.
> - **MSN (Master of Science in Nursing):** 4-Year BSN or Post-RN BSN with valid Pakistan Nursing & Midwifery Council (PN&MC) registration and minimum 1 year of clinical experience post-graduation (*Female applicants only*).
> - **Diploma in Cardiology & MSc Cardiac Anesthesia:** MBBS with valid PMDC registration and one-year completed house job with requisite clinical rotations.
> - **Clinical Certifications in Interventional Radiology & Hybrid Imaging:** MBBS with FCPS Part-I / completed residency or post-fellowship clinical training in Radiology or relevant imaging field.
### Important Academic & Admission Schedule

- **Admissions Opened:** 6 October 2026
- **Regular Application Deadline:** 30 October 2026 (4:00 PM PKT)
- **Late Fee Application Deadline:** 4 November 2026 (4:00 PM PKT)
- **NUMS Entry Test Conducted:** 17 and 18 November 2026
- **Departmental Interviews:** Early December 2026
- **Display of Merit Lists:** Mid-December 2026
- **Commencement of Classes:** Spring Semester 2027 (February 2027)
### Application Fee Structure & Payment Modes

- **Regular Application Fee:** Rs. 3,000 (Non-refundable)
- **Late Registration Fee:** Rs. 5,000 (Non-refundable)
- **Payment Method:** The fee challan is automatically generated by the portal upon completing the online application form. It can be paid at any Habib Bank Limited (HBL) branch across Pakistan or through online banking / 1Link channels as indicated on the challan. Upload the paid receipt before final submission.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Navigate to the official NUMS Postgraduate Admission portal: `https://pgadmissions.numspak.edu.pk/forms/SignIn.aspx`.
2. Click on **New Registration** and create an account with your CNIC number, full name, and active email address.
3. Log in to your candidate dashboard and fill in personal, contact, and academic details.
4. Select your target program category (PhD, MPhil, MS, MSN, Diploma, or Certification).
5. Generate and download the bank challan voucher.
6. Pay the processing fee at HBL and upload the scanned copy of the paid challan.
7. Upload scanned copies of all academic degrees, PMDC / PN&MC registration certificates, and house job certificates.
8. Verify all entries, click **Submit Application**, and download your completed application PDF for your records.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the regular deadline for NUMS Spring 2027 Admissions?**
The regular deadline is **30 October 2026 at 4:00 PM PKT** with a fee of Rs. 3,000.

**Q2: Can I apply after 30 October 2026?**
Yes. Late applications are accepted until **4 November 2026 at 4:00 PM PKT** with a late processing fee of Rs. 5,000.

**Q3: Can male candidates apply for the MSN Nursing program?**
No. As per NUMS official criteria, the Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) program is open exclusively to female applicants.

**Q4: When will the NUMS postgraduate admission tests be held?**
The NUMS entry test is scheduled for **17–18 November 2026** at designated test centers.

**Q5: Are foreign degree holders eligible to apply?**
Yes, provided they submit an official Equivalence Certificate issued by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) or PMDC.

content: ### Official Result Announcement Overview
The **National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS)** has officially announced the results of the **NUMS MDCAT 2026** entrance examination.

The nationwide test, conducted on **Sunday, 13 September 2026** across examination centers in Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Islamabad, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, and designated international overseas centers, determines admission eligibility for **MBBS and BDS** degree programs for the academic session **2026–2027**.
Candidates can now view their subject-wise marks and download their official electronic result card directly through the official NUMS MDCAT result portal: `https://mdcat.numspak.edu.pk/`.
### Candidate Privacy & Verification Commitment

> [!NOTE]
> **Strict Privacy Policy:** In compliance with national data privacy standards and ethical reporting guidelines, **CareerDost does NOT scrape, aggregate, or publish personal lists of candidates, CNICs, roll numbers, or individual marks.**
>
> Candidates must verify their individual results privately by entering their confidential credentials directly on the official NUMS verification portal.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Administering Authority:** National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS), Rawalpindi
- **Examination Name:** NUMS MDCAT 2026 (Medical & Dental College Admission Test)
- **Test Conduct Date:** Sunday, 13 September 2026
- **Result Declaration Status:** **Officially Announced & Live Online**
- **Result Retotaling Window:** Concluded on 6 October 2026 (4:00 PM PKT)
- **Official Result Verification Portal:** [mdcat.numspak.edu.pk](https://mdcat.numspak.edu.pk/)
- **Required Credentials:** Roll Number & 13-digit CNIC / B-Form / Passport Number
- **Target Programs:** MBBS and BDS (Session 2026–2027)
- **Constituent Medical College:** Army Medical College (AMC), Rawalpindi
- **Affiliated Medical Colleges:** CMH Lahore, CMH Multan, QIMS Quetta, CMH Kharian, HITEC Taxila, KIMS Karachi, etc.
### Step-by-Step Procedure to Check Your Result Online

To check your individual score and download your official result card, follow these steps:
1. Open the secure NUMS MDCAT result portal: [mdcat.numspak.edu.pk](https://mdcat.numspak.edu.pk/).
2. Locate the search form on the homepage.
3. Enter your **Examination Roll Number** in the specified field.
4. Enter your **CNIC / Form-B / Passport Number** (enter digits without hyphens).
5. Type the visual **CAPTCHA code** displayed on your screen.
6. Click on the **Submit / Search Result** button.
7. Your verified score card displaying subject-wise marks in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and English, along with total marks and percentage, will be shown.
8. Click on **Print / Download Result Card** and save a high-resolution PDF for your admission portfolio.
### PMDC Minimum Passing Criteria & Aggregate Weightage

As governed by Pakistan Medical & Dental Council (PMDC) and NUMS admission regulations, the following weightage applies to medical and dental college admissions:

- **Minimum Passing Percentage:**
  * **MBBS Programs:** Minimum **55% marks** in MDCAT
  * **BDS Programs:** Minimum **50% marks** in MDCAT

- **Official Merit Aggregate Formula:**
  * **NUMS MDCAT Score:** **50% Weightage**
  * **HSSC / F.Sc Pre-Medical (or A-Level Equivalence):** **40% Weightage**
  * **SSC / Matriculation (or O-Level Equivalence):** **10% Weightage**

$$\text{Aggregate Percentage} = \left(\frac{\text{MDCAT Marks}}{150} \times 50\right) + \left(\frac{\text{F.Sc Marks}}{1100} \times 40\right) + \left(\frac{\text{Matric Marks}}{1100} \times 10\right)$$
### What Candidates Should Do Next: Admissions Roadmap

1. **Download & Preserve Multiple Copies:** Print at least 3 color copies of your NUMS MDCAT 2026 Result Card. It will be required during physical interview and document verification.
2. **Verify F.Sc Equivalence / Marks:** Ensure your official F.Sc Pre-Medical or IBCC Equivalence Certificate is attested and meets the minimum 60% eligibility requirement.
3. **Monitor NUMS Admission Schedule:** Online admission preference forms for **Army Medical College (AMC) Rawalpindi** and affiliated military/private medical institutions will be announced shortly on `numspak.edu.pk`.
4. **Document Preparation:** Prepare your Domicile certificate, CNIC/B-Form, Father's CNIC, Matric/F.Sc certificates, and verified passport-size photographs.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Where can I check my NUMS MDCAT 2026 result?**
You can check your official result exclusively at `https://mdcat.numspak.edu.pk/`.

**Q2: What information is needed to check the result?**
You need your assigned Exam Roll Number and your 13-digit CNIC, Form-B, or Passport number.

**Q3: Can I apply for re-totaling now?**
No. The official window for submission of re-totaling applications closed on **6 October 2026 at 4:00 PM PKT**.

**Q4: Is the NUMS MDCAT accepted for admission in provincial government medical colleges (e.g. UHS Punjab, DUHS Sindh)?**
No. Provincial government medical colleges admit candidates based on provincial MDCATs. The NUMS MDCAT is valid specifically for Army Medical College (AMC) and NUMS affiliated medical and dental colleges across Pakistan.

**Q5: What is the minimum passing score required for MBBS?**
Per PMDC regulations, candidates must secure at least 55% marks in NUMS MDCAT to be eligible for MBBS admissions.

**Sindh Agriculture University (SAU), Tandojam**, Pakistan’s premier institution for agricultural and allied sciences education, has announced the commencement of online admissions for **Undergraduate Programs (Academic Session 2027)**.

The admission campaign covers programs offered at the **SAU Main Campus Tandojam**, **Khairpur College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology (KCAMS), Khairpur Mir’s**, and the **Sub-Campus Umerkot**.
Applications officially commenced on **15 September 2026** and will remain open until **30 October 2026**. The centralized Pre-Entry Test will be held on **8 November 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Institution:** Sindh Agriculture University (SAU), Tandojam
- **Constituent Campuses:** Main Campus Tandojam, KCAMS Khairpur Mir’s, Sub-Campus Umerkot
- **Target Intake:** Undergraduate Academic Session 2027
- **Application Commencement Date:** 15 September 2026
- **Application Submission Deadline:** **30 October 2026**
- **Pre-Entry Test Date:** **8 November 2026 (Sunday)**
- **Minimum Academic Eligibility:** **Minimum 50% Marks in Intermediate (HSSC) or Equivalent**
- **Official Online Portal:** [applyonline.sau.edu.pk](https://applyonline.sau.edu.pk/)
- **Student Login Portal:** [applyonline.sau.edu.pk/login.php](https://applyonline.sau.edu.pk/login.php)
- **Regional Target Audience:** Hyderabad, Tandojam, Mirpurkhas, Khairpur, Sukkur, Shaheed Benazirabad, Badin, Larkana, and all Sindh Districts
### Undergraduate Faculties & Degree Programs Offered

Candidates can seek admission across the following recognized faculties and specialized undergraduate degree programs:

1. **Faculty of Crop Production:**
   - B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Agronomy, Horticulture, Soil Science, Plant Breeding & Genetics)

2. **Faculty of Crop Protection:**
   - B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Entomology, Plant Pathology)

3. **Faculty of Agricultural Social Sciences:**
   - B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Agricultural Economics, Rural Sociology, Agricultural Extension)

4. **Faculty of Agricultural Engineering:**
   - B.E. Agricultural Engineering
   - B.E. Energy & Environment

5. **Faculty of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Sciences:**
   - Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM – 5-Year Professional Degree)
   - BS Poultry Science
   - BS Animal Science

6. **Faculty of Information Technology & Allied Sciences:**
   - BS Computer Science (BSCS)
   - BS Information Technology (BSIT)
   - BS Software Engineering (BSSE)
   - BS Food Science & Technology

7. **KCAMS Khairpur Mir’s Campus:**
   - B.E. Agricultural Engineering
   - BS Agro-Industrial Technology
### Minimum Eligibility Criteria

- **Academic Benchmark:** Candidates must have secured at least **50% unadjusted marks** in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent qualification from any recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE).
- **Subject Group Eligibility:**
  * **DVM & Crop Sciences:** Pre-Medical (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) or Pre-Agriculture.
  * **Agricultural Engineering (B.E.):** Pre-Engineering (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics).
  * **Computer Science, IT & Software Engineering:** Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical with Additional Math, or ICS (Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science).
- **Domicile & Quota Allocation:** Admissions are distributed across district-based open merit quotas for Sindh province (Hyderabad, Tandojam, Mirpurkhas, Khairpur, Sukkur, Sanghar, Badin, Larkana, Dadu, etc.), alongside reserved seats for self-finance, other provinces, and sports categories.
### Pre-Entry Test & Merit Calculation

- The centralized pre-entry test is scheduled for **8 November 2026** at the SAU Tandojam main campus and designated regional centers.
- The test evaluates candidates on English comprehension, General Science, Mathematics/Biology fundamentals, and Analytical Reasoning.
- Merit list calculation aggregate combines intermediate examination percentage with the pre-entry test score.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Navigate to the official admission portal: [applyonline.sau.edu.pk](https://applyonline.sau.edu.pk/).
2. Click on the **Student** box and access `login.php`.
3. Create your student account using your CNIC / B-Form number and a functional email address.
4. Complete your applicant profile with personal details, district domicile, and academic records (Matriculation and Intermediate marks).
5. Generate the official bank challan voucher.
6. Deposit the non-refundable processing fee at designated bank branches.
7. Upload the scanned copy of the paid challan along with your photograph and academic mark sheets.
8. Submit your admission form before **30 October 2026** and download your test admit slip.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for SAU Tandojam Admissions 2027?**
The last date to submit online applications on `applyonline.sau.edu.pk` is **30 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will the SAU Pre-Entry Test take place?**
The pre-entry test is scheduled for **8 November 2026**.

**Q3: What is the minimum percentage required for admission?**
A minimum of **50% marks** in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent is required to be eligible.

**Q4: Which degree programs are offered at KCAMS Khairpur Mir’s?**
KCAMS Khairpur Mir's offers B.E. Agricultural Engineering and BS Agro-Industrial Technology.

**Q5: Can Pre-Engineering students apply for DVM?**
No. The Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) program strictly requires Intermediate Pre-Medical with Biology.

content: ### URGENT DEADLINE NOTICE: LAST DATE TODAY — 6 OCTOBER 2026

> [!WARNING]
> **CRITICAL DEADLINE WARNING:** Applications for the Chevening Scholarship 2027–28 for Pakistani applicants close strictly **TODAY, Tuesday, 6 October 2026 at 11:00 UTC**.
>
> In Pakistan Standard Time (PKT), **11:00 UTC corresponds exactly to 16:00 PKT (4:00 PM PST)**.
>
> The official Chevening application system (`asams.chevening.org/apply`) will automatically lock precisely at 11:00 UTC. Unsubmitted draft applications will be permanently archived and cannot be recovered or considered under any circumstances. Submit your application immediately before servers experience peak traffic loads.
### Overview of the Chevening Scholarship Programme

The **Chevening Scholarship** is the UK Government’s prestigious global scholarship programme, funded by the **Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)** and partner organisations. Chevening offers future leaders, innovators, and decision-makers from Pakistan the unique opportunity to pursue a **fully funded, one-year taught Master's degree** at any accredited university across the United Kingdom.

Chevening scholars return to Pakistan equipped with advanced subject knowledge, specialized professional networks, and international exposure, enabling them to drive tangible socio-economic impact in their respective sectors.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Administering Body:** UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)
- **Programme:** Chevening Master's Scholarship (2027–28 Academic Intake)
- **Eligible Country:** Pakistan (Pakistani citizens)
- **Study Destination:** Any accredited higher education institution in the United Kingdom
- **Target Degree:** One-Year Taught Postgraduate Master's Degree (MSc / MA / LLM / MRes / MBA)
- **Final Submission Deadline:** **6 October 2026 at 11:00 UTC (16:00 PKT / 4:00 PM PST)**
- **Work Experience Prerequisite:** Minimum 2,800 Hours (Equivalent to 2 Years)
- **Undergraduate Requirement:** Upper Second-Class 2:1 UK Equivalent (typically 3.0+ CGPA or 60%+ in 4-Year BS / 16-Year Education)
- **Total Financial Coverage:** 100% Tuition Fees + Monthly Living Stipend + Return Flights + Visa
- **Official Country Portal:** [chevening.org/scholarship/pakistan](https://www.chevening.org/scholarship/pakistan/)
- **Official Application Portal:** [asams.chevening.org/apply](https://asams.chevening.org/apply)
### Comprehensive Scholarship Benefits & Financial Coverage

The Chevening Scholarship provides complete, comprehensive financial support throughout the 12-month study duration in the UK:
- **Full Tuition Fees:** 100% of university tuition fees are covered. (Note: A standard fee cap applies to master's in business administration (MBA) programmes, requiring applicants to fund the residual balance independently).
- **Monthly Living Stipend:** A tax-free monthly subsistence allowance designed to comfortably cover accommodation, meals, utilities, local commuting, and essential personal expenses.
- **Round-Trip Airfare:** Economy-class flight tickets from Pakistan to the United Kingdom and return flight to Pakistan upon graduation, booked via Chevening's authorized travel management partners.
- **Arrival Allowance:** A lump-sum arrival stipend provided upon touchdown in the UK to assist with initial setup costs, room supplies, and essential bedding.
- **Departure Allowance:** A homeward departure grant provided at the conclusion of studies to assist with excess luggage and travel repatriation.
- **UK Visa Application Fee:** Reimbursement covering the cost of one UK Student Visa application.
- **Travel Grants:** Travel subsidies to attend mandatory and optional Chevening events, leadership conferences, and academic workshops across the UK.
### Strict Eligibility Criteria for Pakistani Applicants

To be deemed eligible for the Chevening Scholarship 2027–28, prospective candidates must fulfill all of the following statutory requirements:
1. **Pakistani Citizenship:** Must be a citizen of Pakistan and hold a valid Pakistani passport or National Identity Card (CNIC).
2. **Two-Year Return Obligation:** Candidates must commit to returning to Pakistan for a minimum of **two consecutive years** immediately following the completion of their scholarship in the UK.
3. **Completed Undergraduate Degree:** Must have completed all academic components of an undergraduate degree (16 years of education: BS 4-Year, B.E., MBBS, or Master's following a 2-year Bachelor's) that enables admission into a postgraduate taught course at a UK university. Typically, this equates to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree in the UK (approx. 3.00/4.00 CGPA or 60%+ marks from an HEC-recognized institution).
4. **Work Experience Requirement:** Must demonstrate at least **two years of work experience** (equivalent to exactly **2,800 hours**). Work experience can be accumulated across full-time employment, part-time employment, voluntary work, paid or unpaid internships, and freelance assignments completed before or after undergraduate graduation.
5. **Three Eligible University Choices:** Candidates must choose **three different eligible UK university courses** and must secure at least one unconditional admission offer from one of these three course choices before the unconditional offer deadline (**8 July 2027**).
### Who Is Ineligible for Chevening?

Applications will be automatically rejected if an applicant:
- Holds British or dual British citizenship (unless applying under British National Overseas status where applicable).
- Is an employee, former employee (within the last two years), or relative of an employee of His Majesty's Government (including the FCDO, British High Commission Islamabad, British Council, or Department for Business and Trade).
- Is an employee, former employee, or relative of an employee of Chevening Partner organisations (within the past two years).
- Has previously received funding from a UK Government-funded scholarship to study in the United Kingdom.
### Required Application Materials & Written Essays

The online Chevening portal requires applicants to construct their profile and submit four detailed essays (maximum 500 words each):
1. **Leadership and Influence Essay:** Evidence of how you have led teams, influenced positive change, and demonstrated resilience in your workplace or community.
2. **Relationship Building & Networking Essay:** Demonstration of how you build and maintain professional relationships, network across diverse groups, and how you intend to engage with the global Chevening alumni network.
3. **Studying in the UK Essay:** Clear academic rationale for selecting your three specified UK master's courses and how they align with your academic background.
4. **Career Plan Essay:** A practical, well-defined career roadmap outlining short-term goals (immediately upon returning to Pakistan) and long-term ambitions (5–10 years post-scholarship).
### Official Selection Timeline & Next Steps

- **6 October 2026 (11:00 UTC / 16:00 PKT):** Applications close strictly.
- **November – December 2026:** Independent Academic Reading Committees evaluate eligible applications against Chevening assessment rubrics.
- **Mid-February 2027:** Shortlisted candidates are formally notified via email and invited to schedule an interview.
- **February – March 2027:** Shortlisted applicants upload two reference letters and academic degree transcripts.
- **2 March – 25 April 2027:** In-person or virtual interview panels conducted by the British High Commission in Islamabad and Karachi.
- **Mid-June 2027 Onwards:** Official final selection results released (Conditional Offer, Reserve, or Unsuccessful).
- **8 July 2027 (17:00 BST):** Final deadline to upload at least one unconditional offer from a chosen UK university.
- **September / October 2027:** Scholars depart Pakistan and commence Master's studies in the United Kingdom.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the exact deadline today for Pakistani applicants?**
The deadline is strictly **6 October 2026 at 11:00 UTC**, which equals **16:00 PKT (4:00 PM Pakistan Standard Time)**.

**Q2: Do I need an IELTS or English language test result to submit my application today?**
No. Chevening removed its centralized English language requirement. You do NOT need to upload an IELTS score to submit your Chevening application today. However, you must satisfy your chosen UK universities' English language requirements to obtain an unconditional offer by 8 July 2027.

**Q3: Can final-year students currently awaiting results apply?**
No. Applicants must have completed all components of their undergraduate degree and hold provisional or final transcripts at the time of submission.

**Q4: How do I calculate the 2,800 hours of work experience?**
Work experience is calculated by multiplying total weeks worked by weekly hours (e.g., 35 hours per week for 80 weeks = 2,800 hours). Internships, freelance work, and voluntary engagements are fully eligible.

**Q5: Does CareerDost guarantee scholarship selection?**
No. CareerDost is an independent career guidance platform and does not promise admission or scholarship awards. Selection is conducted exclusively by the British High Commission and Chevening Secretariat based on merit.
### Final Submission Instructions

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Log in to [asams.chevening.org/apply](https://asams.chevening.org/apply) now, thoroughly review all essay word counts, click **Submit**, and save your PDF submission confirmation receipt before 16:00 PKT.

content: ### Executive Recruitment Notice & Official Announcement

The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan**, the apex statutory federal regulatory body governing higher education in Pakistan, has released its official recruitment advertisement for **9 government vacancies** across federal project scales and regular basic pay scales. Qualified professionals from across Pakistan are invited to submit digital applications via the official HEC recruitment portal (`careers.hec.gov.pk`).
All nine positions are currently active and accepting online submissions until the strict closing deadline of **14 October 2026**.
### Comprehensive Breakdown of 9 Active Positions

Below is the complete, officially verified summary table specifying each of the 9 positions, quota allocation, required qualifications, exact monthly salary scales, and closing deadlines:

| Position Title | Vacancies | Regional Quota | Prescribed Qualification & Experience | Monthly Salary Scale | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| **Project Director** | 01 | Open Merit | PhD / Master's (16/18 Years) in Management Sciences, Engineering, or Social Sciences with 10+ years executive project management experience | **PPS-10 (Rs. 350,000 – Rs. 398,130 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Manager** | 01 | Open Merit | Master's degree or 16-year BS in Management, CS, or Engineering with minimum 5 years proven project administration experience | **PPS-08 (Rs. 175,000 – Rs. 218,970 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Manager** | 01 | Punjab Quota | Master's degree or 16-year BS in relevant discipline with minimum 5 years project coordination experience | **PPS-08 (Rs. 175,000 – Rs. 218,970 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Manager** | 01 | Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KPK) | Master's degree or 16-year BS with 5 years project monitoring & execution experience | **PPS-08 (Rs. 175,000 – Rs. 218,970 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Law Officer** | 01 | Open Merit | Bachelor of Laws (LLB) from an HEC-recognized university with active Bar Council enrollment and 2–3 years corporate/court litigation experience | **BPS-17 (Rs. 75,000 – Rs. 95,000+ / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Accountant** | 01 | Sindh (Urban) Quota | B.Com / BBA Finance / M.Com / BS Accounting & Finance with 2+ years public/private financial accounting and audit experience | **Project Pay Scale (Rs. 80,000 – Rs. 110,000 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Office Assistant** | 01 | Punjab Quota | Bachelor's Degree (BA / B.Sc / B.Com / BBA) with proven computer literacy (MS Office) and minimum typing speed | **BPS-15 (Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 65,000+ / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Office Assistant** | 01 | Sindh (Rural) Quota | Bachelor's Degree (BA / B.Sc / B.Com / BBA) with MS Office proficiency and clerical management skills | **BPS-15 (Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 65,000+ / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Attendant** | 01 | Open Merit / Punjab Quota | Primary / Matriculation with physical fitness, reliability, and office dispatch/hospitality experience | **BPS-01 (Rs. 40,700 / month basic + allowances)** | 14 October 2026 |
### Verified Salary & Scale Structure Breakdown

> [!NOTE]
> **Official Pay Scale Structure:** The advertised positions fall within the verified salary spectrum of **Rs. 40,700 up to Rs. 398,130 per month**:
> - **Executive Leadership (PPS-10):** Fixed Project Pay Scale offering total monthly emoluments ranging from Rs. 350,000 to Rs. 398,130 based on candidate experience.
> - **Mid-Level Project Management (PPS-08):** Fixed Project Pay Scale offering total monthly emoluments between Rs. 175,000 and Rs. 218,970.
> - **Officer & Specialized Roles (BPS-17 & Project Accountant):** Ranging between Rs. 75,000 and Rs. 110,000 including standard federal allowances.
> - **Secretarial & Support Roles (BPS-15):** Basic Pay Scale 15 with allowances totaling Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 65,000.
> - **Office Attendant (BPS-01):** Entry-level federal basic pay scale with cost of living and utility allowances totaling Rs. 40,700 per month.
### Contract Nature & Age Limit Specifications

- **Nature of Appointments:** Project positions (PPS-10, PPS-08, and Project Accountant) are contractual appointments for an initial period of one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and project duration. Regular BPS positions (BPS-17, BPS-15, BPS-01) follow standard federal employment rules.
- **Age Limits (Calculated as of 14 October 2026):**
  * Project Director: 35 to 50 Years
  * Project Managers: 25 to 40 Years
  * Law Officer & Project Accountant: 22 to 35 Years
  * Office Assistants: 18 to 30 Years
  * Attendant: 18 to 30 Years
  * Standard general age relaxation of 5 years is admissible under Federal Government rules.
### Provincial & Regional Representation Focus

The recruitment strictly enforces constitutional provincial quota allocations:
- **Sindh Representation:** 1 position of Office Assistant is exclusively reserved under **Sindh (Rural)** quota, and 1 position of Project Accountant is reserved under **Sindh (Urban)** quota.
- **Punjab Representation:** 2 positions (1 Office Assistant, 1 Project Manager) and 1 Attendant are allocated under Punjab quota.
- **Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Representation:** 1 Project Manager position is exclusively reserved for KPK domicile holders.
- **Open Merit:** Project Director, 1 Project Manager, and Law Officer are open to all Pakistani nationals regardless of provincial domicile.
### Application Fee & Payment Mode

- A non-refundable application processing fee is prescribed:
  * **BPS-01 to BPS-15:** Rs. 600
  * **BPS-17 and PPS Roles:** Rs. 1,000
- Fee must be deposited online through **1Link 1Bill Invoice** via ATM, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking Apps (Easypaisa/JazzCash/Bank apps), using the dedicated consumer number generated automatically upon submitting the profile on `careers.hec.gov.pk`.
- Retain the transaction ID and paid receipt for interview verification.
### Selection Process & Testing Criteria

1. **Initial Screening:** Shortlisting of candidates based on academic credentials, domicile eligibility, and requisite years of experience.
2. **Written Screening Test:** Eligible candidates for clerical and officer posts will appear in a screening test conducted by the Education Testing Council (ETC) or HEC testing committee.
3. **Interview Panel:** Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview at HEC Head Office, Sector H-9, Islamabad.
### Required Documents for Online Upload

- CNIC Copy (Front & Back)
- Provincial Domicile Certificate
- All Academic Certificates, Degrees, and Detailed Marks Certificates (DMCs) from Matric to highest degree
- Verified Experience Letters from past and present employers
- Valid Bar Council License / Enrollment Certificate (Mandatory for Law Officer)
- Recent passport-size photograph with blue or white background
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Navigate to the official HEC recruitment portal: `https://careers.hec.gov.pk/`.
2. Click on **Sign Up** to create an account using your 13-digit CNIC number and a valid email address.
3. Complete your digital profile: Personal Details, Educational History, and Employment Experience.
4. Browse the active vacancies list and choose the position aligned with your qualification and quota.
5. Generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice and pay the fee through your mobile banking application.
6. Confirm payment status on the portal, review all entered records, and click **Submit Application**.
7. Download and print the electronic application form before **14 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for HEC Jobs 2026?**
The final deadline for digital application submission on `careers.hec.gov.pk` is **14 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can I apply for more than one vacancy?**
Yes. Candidates possessing the required eligibility criteria for multiple posts can submit separate applications and pay the respective processing fees for each position.

**Q3: Is hardcopy submission to HEC Islamabad required?**
No. Do not dispatch physical application copies by post. Only candidates shortlisted for test or interview will be asked to present original verified documents.

**Q4: Are government employees eligible to apply?**
Yes, serving government employees can apply online but must obtain a Departmental Permission Certificate (NOC) from their parent department before appearing for the interview.

content: ### Official Undergraduate Admissions Announcement 2027

**Habib University (HU) Karachi**, Pakistan’s premier dedicated liberal arts and sciences institution, has officially opened undergraduate admissions for the **Class of 2027** (Session 2027–2031). Operating on a global interdisciplinary curriculum anchored by its signature Liberal Core, Habib University invites aspiring leaders to apply in its **October Series Admission Round**.

The official admissions calendar published on the Habib University portal (`habib.edu.pk/admissions/international-examination-board/admission-schedule/`) confirms that the digital application submission and financial aid portal is active, with the October round deadline set for **21 October 2026**.
### October Series Official Schedule Breakdown

Below is the verified timeline for the ongoing October Admissions Series:
- **Admissions Form Submission Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Scholarship & Financial Aid Application Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Habib University Entrance Examinations (HAT):** **23 & 26 October 2026**
- **Admission Interviews:** **30 October 2026 onwards**
- **Admission Decisions:** Rolling Admissions (Decisions communicated sequentially following interviews)
- **Special Information Session:** Prospective applicants and parents are invited to attend the **Admission Information Session on 9 October 2026** (registration available via the admissions portal) to explore degree faculties, campus life, and funding options.
### Subsequent Admission Rounds (For Future Reference)

For students unable to sit the October test, subsequent admission series deadlines are scheduled as follows:
- **November Series:** Deadline 20 November 2026 | Exams 24 & 25 November 2026
- **December Series:** Deadline 23 December 2026 | Exams 29 & 30 December 2026
- **January Series:** Deadline 21 January 2027 | Exams 25–27 January 2027
- **February Series:** Deadline 16 February 2027 | Exams 18–24 February 2027
### Academic Programs Offered Across Two Flagship Schools

Habib University offers six world-class undergraduate degree programmes across its two distinguished schools:

1. **Dhanani School of Science and Engineering (DSSE):**
   - **BS Computer Science (BSCS):** Focused on software systems, artificial intelligence, data engineering, and modern theoretical computation.
   - **BS Computer Engineering (BSCE):** Bridging computer architecture, embedded hardware design, and robotics.
   - **BS Electrical Engineering (BSEE):** Specializing in energy systems, telecommunications, and digital electronics.

2. **School of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (AHSS):**
   - **BSc (Honours) Social Development & Policy (SDP):** Pioneering interdisciplinary studies in South Asian development, urban ecology, governance, and public policy.
   - **BSc (Honours) Comparative Humanities (CH):** Critical exploration of world literatures, philosophy, history, and religious studies.
   - **BA (Honours) Communication and Design (CND):** Integrating visual design, moving image, digital media, typography, and creative narrative.
### Academic Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must meet the following minimum academic standards based on their educational background:
- **Intermediate (HSC / Board of Intermediate Education):** Minimum aggregate of **60% marks** in Pre-Engineering, Computer Science, Pre-Medical (with additional mathematics where required for engineering), or General Science.
- **A Levels (Cambridge / Pearson Edexcel):** Minimum of **2 B's and 1 C** across three principal academic A-Level subjects. (General Paper, Thinking Skills, and Urdu as a second language do not fulfill primary requirements).
- **International Baccalaureate (IB) / High School Diploma:** Minimum of **28 IB Diploma points** or an accredited US High School Diploma with official Equivalence Certificate issued by the Inter Board Coordination Commission (IBCC).
### Entrance Examination & Test Exemption Criteria

Candidates must complete the **Habib University Entrance Examination (HAT)** scheduled for **23 & 26 October 2026**:
- **DSSE Test Modules:** Advanced Mathematics & English Language Comprehension & Critical Writing.
- **AHSS Test Modules:** Quantitative Reasoning & English Language Comprehension & Critical Writing.
- **SAT / ACT Exemption:** Applicants who have achieved a minimum composite score of **1250 on the SAT (Reasoning)** or a composite score of **28 on the ACT** are eligible for an exemption from the HU Entrance Examination.
### Clarification on Scholarships vs. Need-Based Financial Aid

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Financial Support Transparency:** Habib University does NOT characterize all financial assistance as a fully funded scholarship. Funding is distinctly separated into merit-based awards and need-based financial aid:
> - **Merit Scholarships:** Awarded purely based on academic distinction and entrance examination results. Merit tiers cover **25%, 50%, 75%, and up to 100% of tuition fees** for all four years of study.
> - **Need-Based Financial Aid:** Graded financial grants calculated solely based on the applicant's assessed family financial circumstances. Over **85% of admitted Habib students** receive financial aid or merit scholarships.
> - **HU TOPS (Talent Outreach, Promotion and Support):** A specialized 100% fully funded scholarship program dedicated exclusively to high-achieving Intermediate Board students from public and affiliated colleges.
> - **Yohsin Scholarship:** Flagship prestigious award granted to extraordinary candidates exemplifying intellectual passion and community leadership.
### Required Application Documents

- Scanned copy of CNIC / B-Form / Passport
- Secondary School Certificate (SSC / Matric) or Cambridge O-Level Statement of Results
- Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC Part-I / Pre-Board) or Cambridge AS-Level / A-Level Statement of Results
- Statement of Purpose / Personal Essay highlighting intellectual interests and community engagement
- Financial Aid Application Form accompanied by proof of family income, utilities, and tax returns (if applying for aid by 21 October 2026)
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. Visit the official Habib University admissions portal at `https://eapplication.habib.edu.pk/`.
2. Create a new user account with your active email address and phone number.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

content: ### Prestigious Academic Research Opportunities in Switzerland

The **Swiss Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS / ESKAS)**, in direct coordination with the **Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad**, has formally opened applications for the **Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for the Academic Year 2027–28**. This premier European initiative provides exceptional Pakistani scholars and researchers the opportunity to pursue advanced doctoral and postdoctoral research at Switzerland’s world-renowned cantonal universities, research institutes, and federal institutes of technology (**ETH Zurich** and **EPFL**).
All applications must be submitted directly through the official Swiss ESKAS electronic portal (`go.eskas.ch/LoginServlet`) before the strict closing deadline of **31 October 2026**.
### Critical Institutional Clarification: HEC Role vs. ESKAS

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **HEC Role & Financial Clarification:** The Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan advertises this opportunity solely for public awareness and student facilitation (`hec.gov.pk/english/services/students/swiss-scholarship`).
>
> - **Zero Financial Liability:** HEC bears absolutely NO financial liability or funding commitment for this scholarship.
> - **Direct Swiss Application:** HEC does NOT conduct screening, shortlisting, or nominations. Candidates must apply directly to ESKAS / the Embassy of Switzerland.
> - **No HEC Portal Submission:** Submissions made solely on HEC portals will not be forwarded to the Swiss government. You must apply directly through the official Swiss portal.
### Eligible Programs & Clear Ineligibility Notice

For Pakistani applicants, the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are strictly restricted to the following postgraduate research tracks:
1. **PhD Scholarships:** Full doctoral degree research (up to 36–48 months) leading to a doctorate awarded by an accredited Swiss university.
2. **Research Fellowships:** 12-month non-degree research projects intended for enrolled PhD students or junior researchers wishing to conduct field or laboratory research in Switzerland.
3. **Postdoctoral Scholarships:** 12-month advanced scientific research for scholars who hold a recognized PhD degree.

> [!WARNING]
> **Undergraduate & Taught Master's Exclusion:** Bachelor's degree and taught Master's (MA / MSc / MBA) programmes are **STRICTLY NOT OFFERED** for Pakistan under the Swiss Government Excellence framework. Applications for taught courses will be rejected immediately.
### Mandatory Prerequisite: Host Professor Acceptance Letter

The single most critical prerequisite for obtaining the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship is securing an **Academic Host Professor Confirmation Letter** prior to submitting your application:
- Applicants must independently contact a tenured professor or faculty member at an eligible Swiss cantonal university or federal institute (e.g., ETH Zurich, EPFL, University of Zurich, University of Geneva, University of Basel, University of Bern, EPFL).
- The professor must issue a formal, signed written letter explicitly agreeing to supervise your research project and confirming that adequate laboratory space, computing infrastructure, and departmental facilities are available for your tenure.
### Comprehensive Financial Coverage & Monthly Stipends

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship covers all essential living and academic expenses in Switzerland:
- **Monthly Living Stipend:**
  * **PhD and Research Fellows:** **CHF 1,920 per month** (tax-free living allowance).
  * **Postdoctoral Fellows:** **CHF 3,500 per month**.
- **Mandatory Swiss Health Insurance:** Full coverage of mandatory Swiss health and accident insurance premiums, paid directly by the Federal Commission for Scholarships.
- **Housing Allowance Lump-Sum:** A one-time relocation grant of **CHF 300** disbursed upon arrival in Switzerland to assist with housing lease deposits and furniture essentials.
- **Swiss Public Transport Half-Fare Card:** A prepaid Swiss Halbtax card providing 50% discount on all Swiss public trains, buses, and ferries for the entire duration of stay.
- **Return Economy Airfare:** Return flight ticket subsidy paid at the conclusion of the fellowship to cover repatriation back to Pakistan.
### Detailed Eligibility Checklist

- **Nationality:** Must hold Pakistani citizenship.
- **Academic Profile:** Must possess a recognized Master's degree (MS / MPhil with minimum 17–18 years of education) for PhD/Research applications, or an accredited PhD degree completed within the last 3 years for Postdoctoral applications.
- **Age Ceiling:** For PhD and Research Fellowships, candidates must have been born after **31 December 1991**.
- **Language Competence:** Strong proficiency in English or the language of instruction (German, French, or Italian) required by the host laboratory.
- **Dual Residency Clause:** Candidates who have already resided in Switzerland for more than one year prior to September 2027 are ineligible.
### Required Application Dossier (Triplicate Submissions)

Applicants must assemble their complete application package consisting of:
1. Official FCS Application Form (with photograph)
2. Comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) including publication records
3. Detailed Research Proposal (maximum 5 pages) outlining methodology, literature review, and academic timeline
4. Formal Host Professor Acceptance Letter and Professor's short CV
5. Two confidential letters of recommendation from academic referees
6. Attested copies of academic transcripts and degree certificates (HEC / IBCC verified)
7. Medical Health Certificate signed by a certified physician
8. Clear scanned copy of valid Pakistani Passport
### Step-by-Step Direct Application Procedure

1. Secure written acceptance from an eligible Swiss host professor.
2. Access the official Swiss electronic scholarship portal at `https://www.go.eskas.ch/LoginServlet`.
3. Request and download the standardized FCS application package and reference templates.
4. Complete all digital forms, compile required supporting documents into organized PDF dossiers, and submit online.
5. Print three complete hardcopy sets (1 original with original signatures + 2 copies) and submit them to the **Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad** before **31 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the final deadline to apply for Swiss Government Scholarships 2027–28?**
The application deadline is **31 October 2026**.

**Q2: Does HEC provide any funding for this scholarship?**
No. HEC has zero financial liability and does not provide matching grants or stipends for this program. All funding is borne by the Swiss Federal Government.

**Q3: Can I apply without an acceptance letter from a Swiss professor?**
No. Applications lacking a formal written commitment from a Swiss host professor are considered incomplete and will not be evaluated by the Federal Commission for Scholarships.

**Q4: Can I apply for a Master's degree under this scholarship?**
No. The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship for Pakistan is restricted exclusively to Research Fellowships, PhD, and Postdoctoral studies.

content: ### National Call for HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27

The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan**, through its **Research and Development (R&D) Division**, has issued the national call for applications for the **HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27**. Instituted to recognize, encourage, and reward scientific ingenuity and research excellence, these premier state awards confer national prestige alongside cash prizes of **up to Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 1 Million)** and citation shields.

Eligible university faculty members, active research scholars, and independent scientists across Pakistan are invited to submit digital applications via the official HEC Research Portal (`research.hec.gov.pk`) before the strict national deadline of **31 October 2026**.
### Categorical Clarification: Exact Cash Prizes per Award Track

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Crucial Cash Prize Breakdown:** Please note that cash rewards are categorized strictly by award title. **Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 1 Million)** is awarded exclusively for the **Best Publication Award**, while other award tracks carry **Rs. 500,000** each:
>
> 1. **Best Publication Award:** Cash prize of **Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 1 Million)** + Gold Plaque & Certificate. Conferred for groundbreaking original research articles published in premier high-impact international journals indexed in Web of Science (WOS) / Scopus.
> 2. **Best Researcher Award:** Cash prize of **Rs. 500,000 (Rs. 500k)** + Citation Plaque & Certificate. Conferred upon active senior or mid-career faculty demonstrating consistent, high-impact research output, exceptional citation metrics, H-index, research grants, and commercialized patents.
> 3. **Best Young Researcher Award:** Cash prize of **Rs. 500,000 (Rs. 500k)** + Citation Plaque & Certificate. Specially reserved for promising early-career scholars **aged 40 years or below** who demonstrate remarkable scientific productivity.
### Three Broad Academic Disciplines

Applications are invited across three recognized disciplinary clusters:
- **Domain 1: Biological, Medical, Health & Agricultural Sciences:** Encompassing Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Pharmacology, Clinical Sciences, Agronomy, Veterinary Sciences, and Environmental Biology.
- **Domain 2: Physical Sciences, Engineering, Technology, Computer Science & Mathematics:** Covering Physics, Chemistry, Material Science, Electrical/Mechanical/Civil Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and Pure & Applied Mathematics.
- **Domain 3: Social Sciences, Humanities, Management Sciences & Arts:** Encompassing Economics, Public Policy, Governance, Business Administration, Sociology, Law, Education, Literature, and Creative Arts.
### Strict Eligibility Criteria & Age Ceiling

- **Citizenship:** Applicants must be Pakistani or Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK) nationals.
- **Institutional Affiliation:** Must be regular, contract, or tenure-track faculty members, researchers, or post-doctoral fellows serving in HEC-recognized public or private higher education institutions or public R&D establishments.
- **Young Researcher Age Limit:** Candidates competing for the **Best Young Researcher Award** must be strictly **40 years of age or below** on the application cutoff date (**January 1, 2026**).
- **Originality & Plagiarism Standards:** All submitted publications and research claims must adhere strictly to HEC's Policy on Research Ethics and Plagiarism. Articles previously awarded an HEC national prize or state civil award are ineligible.
### Required Documentation & Institutional Endorsement

Applicants must compile and upload the following digital documents to the HEC portal:
- Scanned copy of CNIC / Passport
- Official Appointment Order and Institutional Identity Card proving current employment
- Comprehensive Academic CV highlighting Scopus Author ID, Web of Science ResearcherID, and Google Scholar profile
- Full-text PDF copies of candidate research papers, book chapters, or patent grant letters
- Proof of Journal Impact Factor and JCR quartile ranking for the year of publication
- **Head of Institution Endorsement Form:** Formal endorsement signed and stamped by the Vice Chancellor, Rector, or Head of the R&D Institution.
### Step-by-Step Portal Application Process

1. Navigate to the official HEC Research Portal at `https://research.hec.gov.pk/`.
2. Log in using your existing HEC e-portal CNIC credentials or register a new user account.
3. Navigate to **Faculty Services** and select **HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27**.
4. Complete the candidate profile and select your category (Best Publication, Best Researcher, or Best Young Researcher).
5. Enter publication bibliographic citations (DOI, ISSN, Journal Name, Impact Factor) and upload PDF reprints.
6. Generate the formal summary endorsement form, obtain the signature of your Vice Chancellor / Rector, and upload the signed copy.
7. Review all data fields and click **Submit Application** before **31 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for HEC Research Awards 2026–27?**
The deadline for online submissions on `research.hec.gov.pk` is **31 October 2026**.

**Q2: Does every award recipient receive Rs 1 Million?**
No. The Rs 1,000,000 (Rs 1 Million) prize is awarded exclusively to the recipient of the Best Publication Award. Best Researcher and Best Young Researcher awardees receive Rs 500,000 each.

**Q3: What is the age limit for the Young Researcher category?**
Applicants must be 40 years of age or younger on **1 January 2026**.

**Q4: Can researchers from private universities apply?**
Yes. Faculty members and researchers from both public and private HEC-recognized universities are fully eligible.

content: ### Executive Opportunity Overview: Bank of Punjab Karachi Region

**The Bank of Punjab (BOP)**, one of Pakistan's premier scheduled commercial banking institutions operating with over 800 branches nationwide, announced specialized managerial vacancies for its **Karachi Regional Office**. These openings are situated within the bank’s **Digital Banking Group (Cards & Payment Division)** and the **Treasury & Capital Markets Group (Projects and Governance Division)**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Official Application Status Notice (Updated 29 October 2026):**
> - **Regional Manager Alliances (Band-9 to Band-7):** **Closing today — 29 October 2026** . The official listing gives 29 October 2026 as the closing date, but does not specify an exact cutoff time. Check the official BOP portal for current submission availability.
> - **Manager - Projects and Governance (Band-9):** Official closing date was **20 October 2026** (Closed).
> - **Fresh Opportunities:** Candidates seeking new banking positions are advised to monitor the official [BOP Available Jobs Portal](https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs) and [BOP Rozee Portal](https://bop.rozee.pk/) where new commercial, retail, and corporate banking roles are regularly advertised.
### Summary Table: BOP Karachi Manager Openings

| METRIC / PARAMETER | OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Hiring Institution** | The Bank of Punjab (BOP) |
| **Designations** | Regional Manager Alliances & Manager - Projects and Governance |
| **Corporate Groups** | Digital Banking Group (Cards & Payments) & Treasury & Capital Markets |
| **Corporate Grades** | Band-9 to Band-7 (Mid to Senior Management) |
| **Job Location** | Karachi, Sindh |
| **Minimum Qualification** | 16-Year Bachelor’s Degree (Master’s preferred) from HEC-recognized university |
| **Experience Requirement** | Minimum 4 Years of Relevant Banking or Corporate Sector Experience |
| **Maximum Age Limit** | Up to 55 Years as of Closing Date |
| **Application Deadlines** | **Closing today — 29 October 2026** (Alliances) / **20 October 2026** (Projects & Governance - Closed) |
| **Official Career Portal** | [bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs](https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs) |
### Detailed Role Profiles & Responsibilities

#### 1. Regional Manager Alliances — Digital Banking Group (Band-9 to Band-7)
- **Location:** Karachi  
- **Closing Date:** **Closing today — 29 October 2026**  
- **Core Functions:** Spearhead strategic commercial partnerships, merchant acquisition, loyalty discount alliances, and payment brand integrations across Sindh and Southern regions. Manage relationships with major retail brands, e-commerce platforms, and digital payment aggregators to drive debit/credit card usage and acquiring revenue.
- **Eligibility Criteria:** Minimum Bachelor’s degree (16 years education) in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or Commerce from an HEC-recognized institution. Minimum 4 years of proven experience in card alliances, merchant sales, or consumer banking partnerships.

#### 2. Manager - Projects and Governance — Treasury & Capital Markets Group (Band-9)
- **Location:** Karachi  
- **Closing Date:** **20 October 2026** (Closed)  
- **Core Functions:** Departmental project governance, portfolio implementation tracking, statutory reporting, and audit compliance across Treasury & Capital Market operations in accordance with State Bank of Pakistan prudential regulations.
- **Eligibility Criteria:** Minimum Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Commerce. Minimum 4 years of solid banking experience with exposure to treasury operations, internal controls, or project management.
### How to Check Live BOP Career Opportunities

1. Visit the Bank of Punjab official careers page: [https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs](https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs) or [https://bop.rozee.pk/](https://bop.rozee.pk/).
2. Filter vacancies by province (**Sindh**) and city (**Karachi**).
3. Review the job description, eligibility parameters, and closing date for open vacancies.
4. Complete the candidate profile and attach your structured resume directly on the portal.
### Anti-Fraud & Regulatory Notice

The Bank of Punjab strictly observes merit-based recruitment and State Bank of Pakistan governance codes:
- **No Processing Fees:** BOP **never requests any registration fee, security deposit, or cash payment** at any stage.
- **Verification:** Always verify employment notices on `bop.com.pk`.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can fresh graduates apply for these managerial positions?**
No. Both positions carry corporate rankings of Band-9/Band-7 and require at least 4 years of relevant post-qualification professional banking experience.

**Q2: Is the Regional Manager Alliances position still open?**
The official listing gives 29 October 2026 as the closing date, but does not specify an exact cutoff time. Check the official BOP portal for current submission availability.

**Q3: Where can I find new Bank of Punjab jobs?**
Active openings are posted directly on [bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs](https://www.bop.com.pk/Available-Jobs).
### Official Links & Verification Resources

content: ### Comprehensive Fall 2026 Admission Schedule

The **Virtual University of Pakistan (VU)**—Pakistan’s pioneering federal public sector university based on modern information and communication technology—has published its official **Admission Schedule for Fall 2026** on `vu.edu.pk/Admissions/AdmissionProcedure`. Prospective students across Pakistan and overseas communities can pursue fully recognized higher education with world-class digital flexibility.

> [!WARNING]
> **CRITICAL DEADLINE DIFFERENTIATION:**
> - **MS / M.Phil Programmes & Need-Based Scholarships:** Close **TODAY, 05 October 2026**.
> - **Undergraduate BS, Associate Degrees (AD), B.Ed & Diplomas:** Close on **10 October 2026**.
> - **Commencement of Fall 2026 Classes:** Scheduled for **12 October 2026**.
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Institution:** Virtual University of Pakistan (Federal Chartered Public University)
- **Intake Session:** Fall 2026 Admissions
- **MS / M.Phil Application Deadline:** 05 October 2026 (Closes Today!)
- **Need-Based Scholarship Deadline:** 05 October 2026 (Closes Today!)
- **General Undergraduate & Diploma Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Course Exemption / Credit Transfer Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Processing Fee Deposit Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Change of Study Program Deadline:** 11 October 2026
- **Commencement of Academic Classes:** 12 October 2026
- **Course Selection (Add/Drop) Deadline:** 21 October 2026
- **Admission Processing Fee:** Rs. 500/- (Payable online or via bank challan)
- **Study Modes:** Campus-Based (over 200 campuses) or Home-Based (Distance e-Learning)
- **Official Application Portal:** [www.vu.edu.pk/apply](https://www.vu.edu.pk/apply)
### Program Portfolio Offered in Fall 2026

1. **Faculty of Computer Science & Information Technology:**
   - BS Computer Science (BSCS), BS Software Engineering (BSSE), BS Information Technology (BSIT), BS Data Science, and BS Cyber Security.
   - 2-Year Associate Degrees in Computer Science, Database Management Systems, and Web Design & Development.

2. **Faculty of Management & Business Studies:**
   - Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA - 4 Years), BS Accounting & Finance, BS Banking & Finance, and BS Commerce.
   - 2-Year Associate Degrees in Accounting, Islamic Banking, Human Resource Management, and Sales & Marketing.

3. **Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences:**
   - BS English (Applied Linguistics), BS Psychology, BS Mass Communication, BS Sociology, and BS Economics.

4. **Faculty of Education:**
   - B.Ed (Honours) 4-Year, B.Ed 1.5-Year (for Master's holders), and B.Ed 2.5-Year (for 14-year degree holders).

5. **Postgraduate & Specialization Diplomas:**
   - 1-Year Diplomas in Applied Psychology, Computer Science, Banking, Big Data Analytics, and Human Resource Management.
### Eligibility Prerequisite Overview

- **For 4-Year BS Programs:** Minimum 45% to 50% marks in Intermediate (FA, FSc, ICS, I.Com) or equivalent from a recognized board.
- **For Computing Programs:** Mathematics at Intermediate level is mandatory for BSCS and BSSE as per NCEAC guidelines.
- **For Associate Degree Programs:** Minimum 45% marks in Intermediate (12 years of education).
- **For B.Ed (1.5 Years):** Minimum 16 years of education (MA/MSc/BS) with at least 45% aggregate or 2.00 CGPA.
- **Zero Semester Option:** Candidates who do not meet the minimum percentage criteria for specific programs can qualify by passing the VU Zero Semester.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Portal Registration:** Navigate to `https://www.vu.edu.pk/apply` and click *New Registration* using your valid CNIC / B-Form and email address.
2. **Select Study Track:** Choose your preferred study program and mode of education (Home-Based with digital access or Campus-Based at your nearest VU campus).
3. **Enter Educational Profile:** Input your Matriculation and Intermediate grades, roll numbers, and passing boards.
4. **Upload Scanned Documents:** Attach passport-sized photograph, CNIC/B-Form copy, and academic transcripts (DMC/Certificates).
5. **Generate & Pay Processing Fee:** Print the computerized **Rs. 500 Admission Processing Fee** challan voucher. Deposit via 1Link, ATM, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or any designated commercial bank branch.
6. **Finalize Submission:** Confirm fee deposit on the portal before **10 October 2026** (or **05 October 2026** for MS/MPhil applicants).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Virtual University Fall 2026 admissions?**
General undergraduate, Associate Degree, B.Ed, and Diploma admissions close on **10 October 2026**. However, MS/M.Phil programs and Need-Based Scholarships close **TODAY, 05 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will classes start for Fall 2026?**
Academic classes for the Fall 2026 semester officially commence on **12 October 2026**.

**Q3: What is the admission processing fee at VU?**
The admission processing fee is **Rs. 500/-**, payable through bank challan or mobile banking.

**Q4: Can I study completely from home at Virtual University?**
Yes. VU offers a fully accredited Home-Based study mode where lectures, assignments, and study materials are accessed online through the Learning Management System (LMS).

**Q5: What is the deadline for credit transfer or course exemptions?**
The last date to submit applications for course exemption and transfer of credits is **10 October 2026**.

**Q6: What is the last date to add or drop courses?**
Students can add, drop, or replace courses through course selection until **21 October 2026**.

content: ### Understanding Reciprocal Engineering Admissions

Under inter-provincial educational exchange treaties, public engineering universities in Pakistan allocate a designated quota of seats for students from other provinces on a mutual **reciprocal basis**. The **University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore** coordinates and administers the selection process for all **Punjab domicile holders** aspiring to secure admission into undergraduate engineering programs in sister universities located in Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, and Balochistan for **Entry Session 2026**.

According to the official announcement released on the UET Lahore Admissions portal (`apply.uet.edu.pk/news/83`), a total of **40 reserved engineering seats** are available across six prominent engineering institutions.
### Quick Information Summary Table

- **Administering University:** University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore
- **Intake Category:** Undergraduate Admissions on Reciprocal Basis (Entry Session 2026)
- **Total Reserved Seats:** 40 Engineering Seats
- **Eligible Candidates:** Punjab Domicile Holders Only
- **Mandatory Entrance Exam:** UET Combined Entry Test (ECAT 2026 — March/April or June Session)
- **Minimum Academic Qualification:** Intermediate Pre-Engineering / DAE with at least 60% Marks
- **Application Processing Fee:** Rs. 3,000/- per University Preference
- **Application Form Availability:** Online at [admission.uet.edu.pk](https://admission.uet.edu.pk/)
- **Submission Mode:** In-Person Submission at Students Section, UET Lahore Main Campus (No Postal / Courier)
- **Application Deadline:** 09 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM
- **Hafiz-e-Quran Test Date:** 15 October 2026 at 10:00 AM
- **Official Notification Source:** [apply.uet.edu.pk/news/83](https://apply.uet.edu.pk/news/83)
### Complete Breakdown of 40 Reciprocal Engineering Seats

The 40 reciprocal seats are strictly divided among the following six prestigious universities:

1. **NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi (04 Seats):**
   - Electrical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 02 Seats

2. **Mehran University of Engineering and Technology (MUET), Jamshoro (03 Seats):**
   - Civil Engineering: 01 Seat
   - Chemical Engineering: 02 Seats

3. **University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Peshawar (10 Seats):**
   - Civil Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Electrical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Mining Engineering: 03 Seats
   - Agricultural Engineering: 01 Seat

4. **Mirpur University of Engineering & Technology (MUST), Mirpur, AJK (11 Seats):**
   - Electrical Engineering: 03 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Computer System Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Civil Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Software Engineering: 02 Seats

5. **Balochistan University of Engineering and Technology (BUET), Khuzdar (09 Seats):**
   - Civil Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Electrical Engineering: 03 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 04 Seats

6. **Dawood University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi (03 Seats):**
   - Electronics Engineering: 01 Seat
   - Telecommunication Engineering: 01 Seat
   - Energy & Environmental Engineering: 01 Seat
### Academic Eligibility & Merit Formula

To qualify for admission consideration against the reciprocal seat quota, candidates must satisfy the following criteria:
- **Entrance Test Requirement:** Candidates must have appeared in either the First Combined Entry Test 2026 (held from 30 March to 03 April 2026) or the Second ECAT (held from 16 to 21 June 2026) administered by UET Lahore.
- **Intermediate / DAE Marks:** Minimum **60% aggregate marks** in FSc (Pre-Engineering), relevant Diploma of Associate Engineering (DAE), or equivalent qualification recognized by IBCC.
- **Official Merit Calculation Weightage:**
  - **Intermediate / Equivalent Marks:** 70% Weightage
  - **UET Entry Test (ECAT) Marks:** 30% Weightage
- **Hafiz-e-Quran Assessment:** Candidates claiming Hafiz-e-Quran additional marks who did not appear in the test on 17 or 18 July 2026 must appear for the test on **15 October 2026 at 10:00 AM**.
### Step-by-Step Application Procedure

> [!WARNING]
> **In-Person Submission Only:** UET Lahore explicitly mandates that application forms must be submitted by hand at the UET Lahore Administration Block. Submissions sent via Pakistan Post, courier, or delivery services **will NOT be entertained**.

1. **Online Form Generation:** Visit `https://admission.uet.edu.pk/` and fill out the reciprocal admission application form.
2. **Generate Bank Challan:** Print the computerized bank challan for the preference fee of **Rs. 3,000/- per university** and deposit the amount at designated bank branches.
3. **Print Completed Form:** Print a physical copy of the filled application form and sign the declarations.
4. **Attach Required Documents:** Attach certified copies of Punjab Domicile, Matric certificate, Intermediate DMC / DAE transcript, ECAT result card, and original bank payment slip.
5. **Submit at UET Lahore:** Visit the **Students Section (Administration Block), UET Lahore**, on any working day between **9:00 AM and 3:30 PM**.
6. **Submission Deadline:** Ensure your application is deposited before **09 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to submit the UET Reciprocal Admission form?**
The final closing date and time for receipt of applications at UET Lahore is **09 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM**.

**Q2: Can applicants from other provinces apply through this quota?**
No. This reciprocal quota is exclusively reserved for candidates holding a valid **Punjab domicile**.

**Q3: Can I send my application by courier or post?**
No. UET Lahore strictly requires physical in-person submission at the Students Section, Administration Block, UET Lahore.

**Q4: How many reciprocal engineering seats are available in total?**
Exactly **40 seats** are available across six universities (NED, MUET, UET Peshawar, MUST, BUET Khuzdar, and Dawood UET).

**Q5: What is the processing fee per university preference?**
The application fee is **Rs. 3,000/- per university** applied for.

**Q6: What is the aggregate merit formula for reciprocal seats?**
Merit is calculated based on **70% Intermediate marks** and **30% UET Entry Test (ECAT) score**.

excerpt: Sindh Employees' Social Security Institution (SESSI) announces 30 structured internship positions at its Head Office in Karachi. Open for fresh graduates holding Sindh domicile across 6 key disciplines. Apply online before 10 October 2026.
content: ### Overview & Official Announcement

The **Sindh Employees' Social Security Institution (SESSI)**, operating under the Labour & Human Resource Department, Government of Sindh, has officially launched the **SESSI Structured Internship Programme 2026** (Advertisement Reference: `SESSI/INT/2026/01`). This prestigious provincial initiative provides **30 structured internship positions** designed to furnish fresh graduates and postgraduates with practical, training-oriented experience in public sector social security governance and healthcare administration.

All selected interns will be posted at the **SESSI Head Office, Karachi**, where they will work under the direct mentorship of seasoned civil administrators, legal officers, and technical specialists.
### Quick Information Summary Table

- **Administering Body:** Sindh Employees' Social Security Institution (SESSI)
- **Programme Title:** SESSI Structured Internship Programme 2026
- **Reference Number:** SESSI/INT/2026/01
- **Total Positions:** 30 Vacancies
- **Primary Location:** SESSI Head Office, Karachi
- **Target Group:** Fresh / Recent Graduates and Postgraduates
- **Opening Date:** 01 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** 10 October 2026 (5 Days Remaining)
- **Maximum Age Limit:** 28 Years (Calculated on closing date)
- **Domicile Prerequisite:** Sindh Domicile & Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC)
- **Application Fee:** Free of Cost (No application processing fee)
- **Official Career Portal:** [jobs.sessi.gov.pk/opportunities/1](https://sessi.gov.pk/jobs.sessi.gov.pk/opportunities/1)
- **Direct Application Link:** [jobs.sessi.gov.pk/apply/1](https://sessi.gov.pk/jobs.sessi.gov.pk/apply/1)
### Available Disciplines & Categorical Allocation

The 30 internship openings are distributed across six specialized professional tracks. Prospective candidates must note that **applications are permitted in one discipline only**:

1. **Finance / Accounting / Audit:** BBA Finance, BS Accounting & Finance, M.Com, or equivalent.
2. **Computer Science / IT / Data Science / Software Engineering:** BSCS, BS Software Engineering, BSIT, BS Data Science, or related computing degrees.
3. **Procurement / Supply Chain:** BBA or Master's specializing in Supply Chain Management or Public Procurement.
4. **Law:** LLB degree holders seeking practical experience in corporate labour laws and statutory governance.
5. **Human Resource Management:** MBA in Human Resource Management (HRM) or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
6. **Civil Engineering:** Bachelor of Civil Engineering (BE / BS Civil) exclusively allocated to the SESSI Engineering & Works Department.
### Eligibility Criteria & Academic Requirements

Applicants must strictly satisfy the following eligibility criteria stipulated in the official SESSI charter:
- **Recent Graduate Status:** The candidate's qualifying degree must have been completed within the **preceding two (02) years** from the application closing date.
- **Completed Degree Mandatory:** Candidates must have already completed their qualifying degree. Students awaiting their final examination results or thesis defence are **strictly not eligible**.
- **Age Ceiling:** Not more than **28 years of age** on 10 October 2026. Age calculation is performed automatically through the portal using the candidate's date of birth.
- **Provincial Domicile:** Candidates must possess a valid **Sindh Domicile** and **PRC (Form D)**.
- **Work Experience:** No prior professional work experience is required. This programme is designed exclusively as an entry-level capacity building opportunity.
### Required Documents for Online Upload

Before initiating the online application, applicants should prepare clear scanned copies (in PDF, JPG, or PNG format, maximum 5.00 MB per file) of the following mandatory documents:
1. Recent passport-size photograph with white background
2. Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) — Front side
3. Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) — Back side
4. Sindh Domicile Certificate
5. Degree or Provisional Degree Certificate from an HEC-recognized university
6. Final Academic Transcript / Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC)
7. Relevant Professional Training Certificates (Optional)
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Access the Official Portal:** Navigate to the official SESSI Recruitment & Internship portal at `https://sessi.gov.pk/jobs.sessi.gov.pk/apply/1`.
2. **Select Your Track:** Choose your qualifying discipline from the six eligible tracks. Remember, candidates can apply for only one discipline.
3. **Fill Personal Credentials:** Enter your full name, CNIC number, date of birth, domicile district, mobile contact, and active email address.
4. **Provide Academic Credentials:** Enter your university name, graduation passing year, total marks/CGPA, and degree title.
5. **Upload Mandatory Documents:** Attach your photograph, CNIC, domicile, degree certificate, and final transcript.
6. **Review and Submit:** Verify all entered data and click Submit. Download and save the electronic acknowledgement slip and Application ID for future reference.
### Important Statutory Instructions

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Training Placement Clause:** The SESSI Structured Internship Programme is exclusively a temporary, training-oriented initiative. Participation shall not confer any legal right or claim for regular appointment, absorption, seniority, pension, or continuation of service within SESSI or the Government of Sindh.

- Applications received through postal mail, courier, email, or by hand will be rejected without processing.
- Only one application per CNIC is accepted by the digital system.
- Incomplete applications lacking mandatory document attachments will be disqualified automatically.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for the SESSI Internship Programme 2026?**
The final deadline for online application submission is **10 October 2026** at 11:59 PM PST.

**Q2: What is the maximum age limit for SESSI Internship applicants?**
The maximum age limit is **28 years** as of the closing date, 10 October 2026.

**Q3: Can candidates with a pending result apply?**
No. Candidates must possess their completed degree or provisional degree certificate. Result-awaiting applicants are not eligible.

**Q4: Is there an application fee for the SESSI Internship?**
No, there is no application processing fee. Registration is completely free on the official SESSI portal.

**Q5: Can non-Sindh domicile holders apply?**
No. Only candidates holding a valid Sindh Domicile and Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) are eligible.

**Q6: Can I apply for multiple disciplines?**
No. The system restricts candidates to a single discipline application per CNIC.
