content: ### Program Overview & Authority Mandate

The **Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (PCBDDA)**, prominently known as **CBD Punjab**, is the statutory government body driving Pakistan’s premier master-planned smart urban district and global financial hub. Under its youth empowerment charter, CBD Punjab has officially launched the **Youth Career Program 2026 (YCP 2026)** to recruit ambitious fresh university graduates for an immersive, **up to 3-month paid internship placement**.

Interns will gain direct exposure to mega-infrastructure engineering projects, commercial asset management, advanced GIS mapping, and corporate strategic management at the authority’s headquarters in Lahore.
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Administering Authority:** Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (CBD Punjab / PCBDDA)
- **Initiative Title:** CBD Punjab Youth Career Program 2026 (YCP 2026)
- **Placement Type:** Paid Graduate Internship
- **Program Duration:** Up to 3 Months
- **Office Location:** CBD Punjab Complex, Yasir Shaheed Road, Lahore
- **Academic Requirement:** Minimum 16 Years of Education (BS / BE / BBA / MA / MSc / LLB)
- **Minimum CGPA:** 3.0 out of 4.0 (or equivalent 1st Division)
- **Maximum Age Limit:** 25 Years on application closing date
- **Target Group:** Fresh Graduates Only
- **Financial Remuneration:** Monthly Paid Internship Stipend
- **Application Deadline:** 12 October 2026 (7 Days Remaining)
- **Official Information Portal:** [cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026](https://cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026)
- **Official Online Application System:** [careers.accelerec.com/career/pcbdda](https://careers.accelerec.com/career/pcbdda)
### Directorates & Eligible Academic Disciplines

Applicants can compete for placement within specific directorates based on their academic qualification:

1. **Finance & Accounting Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: BBA Finance, BS Accounting & Finance, BSc/MSc Finance, ACCA, CMA, or specialized financial management degree.

2. **IT & Human Resources Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or Human Resource Management.

3. **Legal & Contracts Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Bachelor of Laws (LLB), Master of Laws (LLM), or Contracts Management specialization.

4. **Procurement & Supply Chain Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Procurement Operations.

5. **Land & Estate Management Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree holders in relevant management or property administration disciplines.

6. **Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: BS / MSc in GIS, Geomatics, Space Sciences, or Remote Sensing.

7. **Audit & Internal Governance Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Accounting & Finance, Auditing, Commerce, or professional certifications (ACCA, CA, CMA, CIMA).

8. **Business Development, PR & Marketing:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Public Relations, Communication Studies, Media Studies, Journalism & Mass Communication, Sales & Marketing.

9. **Engineering & Architecture Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, and Urban & Regional Planning.
### Comprehensive Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill the rigorous standards set by PCBDDA:
- **Educational Threshold:** Minimum 16 years of completed formal education from an HEC-recognized institution in Pakistan or accredited foreign university.
- **Academic Performance:** Minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average of **3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent 1st Division).
- **Age Criterion:** Maximum **25 years** as of the closing date, 12 October 2026.
- **Fresh Graduate Status:** Designed strictly for candidates who have recently completed their degree and are seeking their first career-defining professional immersion.
### Key Benefits & Professional Deliverables

- **Financial Remuneration:** Monthly competitive stipend throughout the 3-month duration.
- **Official Certificate:** Formal PCBDDA Experience Certificate detailing projects delivered and skills mastered.
- **Executive Mentorship:** Practical on-site coaching by senior project directors, civil architects, and corporate executives.
- **Networking Platform:** Direct engagement with multidisciplinary consultants, financial institutions, and contracting consortiums.
### Step-by-Step Application Guide

1. **Visit Official Recruitment Portal:** Access the PCBDDA digital portal at `https://careers.accelerec.com/career/pcbdda`.
2. **Locate YCP 2026 Listing:** Select **Youth Career Program 2026**.
3. **Create Account:** Register with your email address and create a secure login.
4. **Complete Profile Data:** Fill in your academic credentials, degree title, university name, final CGPA, and date of birth.
5. **Upload Credentials:** Attach an updated curriculum vitae (CV), clear copy of CNIC, and official final transcript showing CGPA 3.0 or above.
6. **Submit Application:** Finalize submission prior to the official deadline of **October 12, 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the closing date for CBD Punjab Youth Career Program 2026?**
The last date to submit online applications is **12 October 2026**.

**Q2: Is the CBD Punjab internship paid?**
Yes. Selected candidates receive a monthly paid stipend during the 3-month internship tenure.

**Q3: What is the minimum CGPA required?**
Candidates must have a minimum **CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent 1st Division).

**Q4: What is the maximum age limit?**
The maximum age limit is **25 years** on the application closing date.

**Q5: Are result-awaiting candidates eligible?**
No. Only candidates who have successfully graduated with a minimum 16-year degree and available transcript are eligible.

**Q6: Where is the internship located?**
The internship takes place at the CBD Punjab Complex, Yasir Shaheed Road, Lahore.

excerpt: Cadet College Kohat (CCK) invites online applications for Class 8th 63rd Entry admissions (Session 2027). Normal registration deadline is 15 October 2026. Written test will be held nationwide on 25 October 2026.
content: ### Executive Summary & 63rd Entry Admission Release

**Cadet College Kohat (CCK)**, the premier boarding institution in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, has officially announced the commencement of online registration for admission into **Class 8th (63rd Entry — Academic Session 2027)**. Young male candidates from across Pakistan and Azad Jammu & Kashmir seeking elite military and academic schooling can now register via the official admission portal (`admissions.cck.edu.pk`).

The normal registration window closes on **15 October 2026**. The nationwide written entrance examination is officially scheduled to take place on **Sunday, 25 October 2026** across nine major testing centres in Pakistan.
### Quick Information Summary Table

- **College:** Cadet College Kohat (CCK), Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
- **Entry Class:** Class 8th (63rd Entry Admission — Academic Session 2027)
- **Normal Registration Deadline:** **15 October 2026**
- **Written Test Date:** **25 October 2026**
- **Age Bracket:** Strictly between **12 and 14 years** of age as of **31 March 2027**
- **Academic Eligibility:** Candidates currently studying in Class 7th or 8th (must pass 7th class before admission)
- **Registration Processing Fee:** **Rs. 4,000/-** (Non-Refundable)
- **Challan Bank:** Askari Bank Limited (Challan generated in applicant's own name)
- **Test Format:** Written Test in English (cum General Awareness), Mathematics, and Urdu (cum Islamiyat)
- **Official Application Portal:** [admissions.cck.edu.pk](https://admissions.cck.edu.pk/)
### Age Limit & Academic Eligibility Criteria

Parents and guardians must verify that the applicant fulfills the following strict institutional eligibility rules:
- **Age Criteria:** The candidate must be **between 12 and 14 years of age on 31 March 2027**. A physical age waiver is subject only to strict institutional regulations.
- **Academic Level:** The boy must be currently enrolled in **Class 7th or Class 8th** at a recognized English medium school. He must have successfully cleared the 7th class final examination before joining the college in April 2027.
- **Physical Fitness:** Candidates must be medically fit with standard physical development and eyesight according to cadet college standards.
### Written Examination Subjects & Syllabus

The competitive entrance exam will assess candidates based on the standard federal and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa textbook curriculum for Class 7th:
1. **Mathematics:** Arithmetic, Algebra, and Geometry fundamentals.
2. **English:** Essay writing, grammar, vocabulary, sentence structuring, and general awareness.
3. **Urdu & Islamiyat:** Urdu composition, grammar, comprehension, and fundamental Islamic studies (Ethics for non-Muslim candidates).
### Nationwide Examination Centres

To ensure convenient access for applicants from all provinces, the written entrance test on **25 October 2026** will be held simultaneously in nine cities:
- **Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Centres:** Kohat (Cadet College Campus), Peshawar, Swabi, Swat, Bannu, and Dera Ismail Khan (DIK).
- **Punjab & Federal Centres:** Rawalpindi, Multan, and Sialkot.
*(Note: Overseas Pakistani candidates may appear at any of these designated domestic centres during their stay in Pakistan.)*
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Visit Admission Portal:** Navigate to `https://admissions.cck.edu.pk/`.
2. **Account Sign Up:** Register an account using your active mobile number and candidate's B-Form number.
3. **Complete Student Profile:** Fill in personal details, father's particulars, school details, and select your preferred written test centre.
4. **Generate Askari Bank Challan:** Download the computerized fee challan of **Rs. 4,000/-** generated in the candidate's own name.
5. **Fee Deposit:** Pay the fee at any branch of Askari Bank Limited.
6. **Upload Documents & Challan:** Upload clear scanned images of the paid bank challan, candidate's B-Form, school certificate, and passport-size photograph.
7. **Final Submit:** Confirm and submit the application before **15 October 2026**.
8. **Download Roll Number Slip:** Print your official roll number slip from the portal prior to test day.
### Required Documentation Checklist

- Candidate's Computerized B-Form / Birth Certificate
- Father's / Guardian's Computerized CNIC Copy
- School Enrollment Certificate (signed and stamped by school Headmaster/Principal)
- 4 Passport-size photographs (sky blue background)
- Paid Askari Bank Challan Receipt (College copy)
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Cadet College Kohat 63rd Entry?**
The normal registration deadline is **15 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will the CCK written entrance test take place?**
The written test will be conducted nationwide on **Sunday, 25 October 2026**.

**Q3: What is the age requirement for Class 8th admission?**
The candidate must be between 12 and 14 years of age as of **31 March 2027**.

**Q4: What is the registration fee for Cadet College Kohat?**
The non-refundable registration fee is **Rs. 4,000/-**, payable through any branch of Askari Bank via the official system-generated challan.

**Q5: Which cities have CCK test centres?**
Test centres are established in Kohat, Peshawar, Swabi, Swat, Bannu, Dera Ismail Khan, Rawalpindi, Multan, and Sialkot.

content: ### Official Admission Announcement for Affiliated Colleges

**Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU)**, Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah), has officially announced the revised admissions and entry-test schedule for undergraduate programmes across all **Affiliated Public and Private Degree Colleges** for the 2026 academic session.

> [!NOTE]
> **Distinct Affiliated-Colleges Schedule:** Please note that this announcement pertains exclusively to the **CURRENT AFFILIATED-COLLEGES admission cycle**. It should not be confused with the earlier admissions process conducted for the university's main Nawabshah campus.

As per the official notification issued by the Directorate of Admissions, candidates can submit their online admission forms through the university portal (`admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk`) up to the deadline of **28 October 2026**.
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Degree Awarding University:** Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU SBA)
- **Admission Category:** Affiliated Degree Colleges (Undergraduate Programs)
- **Participating Districts:** Sanghar, Naushehro Feroze (NF), Dadu, and Shaheed Benazirabad
- **Online Application Deadline:** 28 October 2026
- **Online Portal:** [admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk](https://admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk/)
- **Official University Website:** [sbbusba.edu.pk](https://www.sbbusba.edu.pk/)
- **Eligibility Criteria:** Intermediate (HSSC) with minimum 45% to 50% marks
- **Test Nature:** Centralized District Entry Tests conducted at respective university campuses
### District-Specific Entry Test Schedule

To facilitate candidates residing in surrounding interior Sindh divisions, SBBU will conduct centralized entry tests at designated regional campuses according to the following verified schedule:

1. **District Sanghar Affiliated Colleges:**
   - **Entry Test Date:** **31 October 2026**
   - **Test Venue:** SBBU Sanghar Campus
2. **District Naushehro Feroze & Dadu Affiliated Colleges:**
   - **Entry Test Date:** **7 November 2026**
   - **Test Venue:** SBBU Naushehro Feroze (NF) Campus
3. **District Shaheed Benazirabad Affiliated Colleges:**
   - **Entry Test Date:** **13 & 14 November 2026**
   - **Test Venue:** SBBU Main Campus, Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah)
### Academic Programmes & Admission Eligibility

Admissions are open across affiliated colleges for 4-year BS and Associate Degree programs:
- **Commerce & Business:** BS Commerce, BBA, and Associate Degree in Commerce (ADC).
- **Computer Science & IT:** BS Information Technology and BS Computer Science.
- **Arts & Social Sciences:** BS English, BS Sindhi, BS Urdu, BS Economics, and BS Islamic Studies.
- **Eligibility Standard:** Applicants must have passed Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, ICS, I.Com, or Humanities) with at least 45% aggregate marks from any recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Sindh.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. **Visit Admission Portal:** Access `https://admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk/`.
2. **Register Profile:** Sign up with your CNIC / B-Form and valid mobile number.
3. **Select Affiliated College Track:** Ensure you select the *Affiliated Colleges* category and pick your desired college and program.
4. **Fill Academic Credentials:** Enter your Matriculation and Intermediate marks.
5. **Generate Bank Voucher:** Print the computerized fee voucher and deposit the processing fee at designated bank branches.
6. **Finalize Submission:** Upload the paid fee receipt and submit your application prior to **28 October 2026**.
7. **Download Admit Card:** Download your district-specific entry test admit card before your designated examination date.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SBBU Affiliated Colleges Admissions?**
The last date for online application submission is **28 October 2026**.

**Q2: Does this notification apply to the SBBU main campus?**
No. This announcement applies strictly to affiliated degree colleges located across Sanghar, Naushehro Feroze, Dadu, and SBA districts.

**Q3: When is the entry test for Sanghar district colleges?**
The entry test for District Sanghar affiliated colleges will be held on **31 October 2026** at the SBBU Sanghar Campus.

**Q4: Where will candidates from Naushehro Feroze and Dadu take the test?**

content: ### Executive Summary & Project Recruitment Announcement

The **Auqaf & Religious Affairs Department, Government of the Punjab**, has officially advertised **New Recruitment on a Contract Basis** for qualified IT and administration professionals. These positions are created under the provincial ADP development project titled *“Integrated Operations Management and Establishment of Centralized Command and Control Room in the Punjab Auqaf Organization”*.

The recruitment is strictly on a contract basis under the Government of Punjab's Contract Appointment Policy. Interested male and female candidates possessing Punjab domicile must submit their prescribed application forms to the Director Estate Office in Lahore on or before **15 October 2026**.
### Official Vacancies Breakdown Table

Below is the verified detail of the new contract positions officially published by the Punjab Auqaf Department:

| Post Title | Total Posts | Minimum Qualification Required | Relevant Experience | Age Limit | Monthly Salary | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Administrator-IT / Software Development Specialist** | 01 | 16 Years Education in IT / Computer Science / Software Engineering from HEC-recognized university | At least 5 years post-qualification software & IT operations experience | 25–35 Years | **Rs. 300,000/-** per month | 15 October 2026 |
| **System Operator / Software Data Entry Operator** | 02 | Intermediate (ICS / FA / F.Sc) with minimum 6-month diploma/course in Computer Application/IT • Typing speed 30 WPM in English | At least 1 year post-qualification practical computer experience | 20–35 Years | **Rs. 70,000/-** per month | 15 October 2026 |
### Eligibility, Quota & Domicile Terms

- **Domicile Requirement:** Applicants must hold a valid **Punjab Province Domicile**.
- **Gender Eligibility:** Both Male and Female candidates meeting the educational and experience qualifications are encouraged to apply.
- **Contract Nature:** The appointments are purely project-based and contractual for the duration of the Command and Control Room project, governed by Punjab Government rules.
- **Government Servants:** Candidates already working in government or semi-government organizations must apply through the proper channel along with an official NOC.
### Required Documentation Checklist

Candidates must submit an organized dossier containing the following attested credentials:
- Prescribed Punjab Auqaf Application Form (downloaded from `auqaf.punjab.gov.pk`)
- Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) with contact details
- Attested copies of Educational Degrees, Certificates, and Transcripts
- Attested copies of Experience Certificates from previous employers
- Attested copy of Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC)
- Attested copy of Punjab Domicile Certificate
- Two recent passport-size photographs
### Step-by-Step Application Submission Method

1. **Download Official Form:** Visit the official website at `https://auqaf.punjab.gov.pk/jobs` and download the official recruitment application form.
2. **Complete the Form:** Fill out all columns regarding educational credentials, division/CGPA, and professional IT experience.
3. **Attach Attested Documents:** Compile all attested photocopies of CNIC, domicile, degrees, and photographs.
4. **Envelope Labeling:** Place the application in an envelope and clearly write the **“Name of Post Applied For”** on the top-right corner of the envelope.
5. **Postal Dispatch:** Send the application package via registered post or courier to the following official address before **15 October 2026**:
   > **Office of the Director Estate, Auqaf Punjab**

Only shortlisted candidates fulfilling the criteria will be called for the written test/interview. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in tests. Candidates must present original degrees, CNIC, and experience certificates at the time of the interview.

No online portal submission is available. Candidates must download the application form from `auqaf.punjab.gov.pk` and send it via postal mail or courier.

**Q5: What is the typing speed requirement for System Operators?**
Applicants must have a minimum typing speed of 30 words per minute (WPM) in English along with a 6-month IT diploma.

content: ### Urgent Admissions Notice: Deadline Extended

> [!WARNING]
> **LAST DATE TOMORROW – 5 OCTOBER 2026:** The University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (UAJK), Muzaffarabad, has officially extended the application submission deadline for **Fall 2026 Admissions**. All prospective applicants must finalize their online submissions and deposit the required bank challan by tomorrow, **Monday, 5 October 2026**.

The Directorate of Student Affairs and Admission Committee issued this final extension to facilitate students awaiting intermediate transcripts and certificate verifications across Azad Kashmir and Pakistan.
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **University:** The University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (UAJK), Muzaffarabad
- **Intake Session:** Fall 2026 Admissions
- **Extended Application Deadline:** 5 October 2026 (Last Date Tomorrow!)
- **Application Mode:** Online via [admissions.uajk.edu.pk](https://admissions.uajk.edu.pk/)
- **Admission Processing Challan:** Rs. 3,000/- (Payable at any HBL branch)
- **Additional Programme Fee:** Rs. 1,000/- per additional choice
- **Departmental Entry Test Fee:** Rs. 1,000/- (Where applicable, + Rs. 200 per extra program)
- **Financial Support:** Merit-Based Tuition Fee Rebates (Top 3 students in each program receive 50%, 40%, and 30% rebates)
- **Campuses:** City Campus Muzaffarabad, Chehla Campus, Neelum Campus, and Jhelum Valley Campus
### Academic Programmes Offered in Fall 2026

UAJK offers 4-year undergraduate BS degree programmes across diverse faculties:
1. **Computing & Information Technology:** BS Computer Science (BS CS), BS Software Engineering (BS SE), and BS Information Technology (BS IT).
2. **Sciences & Health:** BS Biotechnology, BS Biochemistry, BS Botany, BS Zoology, BS Chemistry, BS Physics, and BS Mathematics.
3. **Allied Health Sciences:** Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) and Medical Lab Technology.
4. **Social Sciences & Humanities:** BS English, BS Psychology, BS International Relations, BS Sociology, and BS Economics.
5. **Business & Commerce:** BBA (Honors), BS Commerce, and BS Public Administration.
### Eligibility & Minimum Marks Requirement

- **BS Programmes (General):** Minimum 45% aggregate marks in HSSC (FA / F.Sc / ICS / I.Com) from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education.
- **BS Computing & Engineering Disciplines:** Minimum 50% marks in F.Sc Pre-Engineering, ICS, or Pre-Medical with additional mathematics.
- **State Subject / Domicile:** Open on merit and reserved quotas for candidates possessing Azad Jammu & Kashmir State Subject or provincial domicile certificates.
### Merit Scholarships & Tuition Fee Rebates

UAJK maintains a structured tuition assistance program for high-achieving admitted students:
- **Undergraduate Merit Rebate:** In each degree program, the top 3 semester merit-holders are awarded direct tuition fee rebates of **50% for 1st position**, **40% for 2nd position**, and **30% for 3rd position**.
- **Need-Cum-Merit Support:** Low-income students meeting specified income thresholds may also apply through the Directorate of Students' Affairs (DSA) for partner welfare scholarships such as Muslim Hands Scholarships (MHS). *Note: These assistance schemes provide structured partial or merit rebates and should not be confused with unconditional full-ride funding.*
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Access Admissions Portal:** Visit `https://admissions.uajk.edu.pk/`.
2. **Create Applicant Account:** Register using your active mobile number and CNIC / B-Form number.
3. **Fill Profile & Preferences:** Enter your academic records (SSC and HSSC marks) and select your desired degree choices.
4. **Generate Bank Challan:** Print the computerized admission processing challan of **Rs. 3,000** (plus Rs. 1,000 for each additional program applied for).
5. **Bank Deposit:** Pay the challan fee at any online branch of Habib Bank Limited (HBL) before bank closing hours on **5 October 2026**.
6. **Upload Paid Challan & Submit:** Upload a clear scanned copy of the paid bank receipt onto the portal and click final submit.
### Required Documentation Checklist

- Matriculation (SSC) Certificate & Detailed Marks Sheet (DMC)
- Intermediate (HSSC) Part-1 / Part-2 DMC
- State Subject Certificate / Domicile Certificate
- CNIC of Candidate or Computerized B-Form
- Father's / Guardian's CNIC Copy
- 4 Recent Passport-Size Photographs (with blue background)
- Paid Bank Challan Receipt (Original HBL copy)
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the extended last date for UAJK Fall 2026 admissions?**
The extended deadline is **5 October 2026 (Tomorrow)**.

**Q2: What is the admission challan fee?**
The application fee is Rs. 3,000 for the first program, and Rs. 1,000 for each additional program applied for.

**Q3: Where can the admission fee be paid?**
The computerized challan is payable at any online branch of Habib Bank Limited (HBL) across Pakistan and Azad Kashmir.

**Q4: Does UAJK provide scholarships?**
Yes. UAJK offers merit-based tuition fee rebates (50%, 40%, and 30% for top 3 students in each program) along with need-cum-merit financial support programs.

**Q5: Can pre-medical students apply for computer science?**
Yes, pre-medical students with at least 50% marks in F.Sc can apply for BS Computer Science as per revised HEC and university guidelines.

excerpt: NUST NET 2027 Series 1 registration officially opens today, 4 October 2026. Submit your online application at ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk before 14 November 2026. Computer-based tests begin 17 November in Islamabad.
content: ### Executive Summary & Official Schedule Announcement

Online registration for the **NUST Entry Test (NET) 2027 Series-1** officially commences today, **4 October 2026**, for admission into all undergraduate degree programmes at the **National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)**. Students aspiring for undergraduate engineering, computing, business, applied sciences, and architecture programmes can register via the official NUST admissions portal (`ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk`).

According to the official schedule published on NUST's *Dates to Remember* portal, the online application deadline for Series-1 is **14 November 2026**. The **Computer-Based NUST Entry Test (CBNET)** will commence from **17 November 2026 onwards** exclusively at the NUST Main Campus in Islamabad.
### Quick Information Summary Table

- **Conducting Authority:** National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)
- **Test Name:** NUST Entry Test (NET 2027 Series-1)
- **Admission Intake:** Fall 2027 Undergraduate Admissions
- **Online Registration Commences:** 4 October 2026 (Starts Today)
- **Registration Deadline:** 14 November 2026
- **CBNET Test Commencement:** 17 November 2026 onwards
- **Series-1 Test Location:** NUST Main Campus, Sector H-12, Islamabad
- **Test Format:** Computer-Based Test (CBNET) • 200 MCQs • 3 Hours • No Negative Marking
- **Registration Fee:** Rs. 5,000 (Pakistani / Dual Nationals) • USD 80 / Rs. 10,000 (Foreign Nationals)
- **Official Portal:** [ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk](https://ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk/)
### Undergraduate Programmes Accepting NET 2027

NUST Entry Test scores are accepted for admission across all premier schools and faculties of the university, including:
1. **Engineering Disciplines:** Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace & Avionics Engineering, Mechatronics, and Environmental Engineering.
2. **Computing & AI Tracks:** Computer Science (CS), Software Engineering (SE), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Science, and Computer Engineering.
3. **Business & Social Sciences:** Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), BS Accounting & Finance, BS Economics, BS Psychology, and BS Public Administration.
4. **Architecture & Design:** Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) and Bachelor of Industrial Design (BID).
5. **Applied & Natural Sciences:** BS Biotechnology, BS Chemistry, BS Physics, and BS Mathematics.
### Comprehensive Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for NET 2027 registration and subsequent NUST undergraduate admission, candidates must satisfy the following academic prerequisites:
- **Minimum Academic Aggregate:** Candidates must have secured a minimum of **60% aggregate marks** in both SSC (Matriculation) and HSSC (Intermediate Part-1 / Complete) or equivalent examinations.
- **O/A Level Candidates:** O/A Level candidates must possess an official equivalence certificate issued by the **Inter Boards Coordination Commission (IBCC)** with at least 60% marks in relevant science/mathematics subjects.
- **Result Awaiting Students:** Students currently studying in HSSC Part-2 or A2 are fully eligible to apply on the basis of their Part-1 / O-Level results.
### NET Test Structure & Subject Weightage

The NUST Entry Test is a 3-hour computer-based exam consisting of 200 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs). There is **strictly no negative marking** on any section of the test.

- **Engineering & Computing Stream:** Mathematics (50% — 100 MCQs), Physics (30% — 60 MCQs), Chemistry / Computer Science (15% — 30 MCQs), and English (5% — 10 MCQs).
- **Business & Social Sciences Stream:** Quantitative Mathematics (50% — 100 MCQs), English (40% — 80 MCQs), and Intelligence (10% — 20 MCQs).
- **Applied Sciences & Biotechnology:** Biology (50% — 100 MCQs), Chemistry (30% — 60 MCQs), Physics (15% — 30 MCQs), and English (5% — 10 MCQs).
- **Architecture & Industrial Design:** Design Aptitude (50% — 100 MCQs), Mathematics (30% — 60 MCQs), and English (20% — 40 MCQs).
### Separate Registration Rule & Multiple Series Policy

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Crucial Rule on NET Series Attempts:** NUST conducts four distinct NET series (Series 1, 2, 3, and 4) throughout the academic year. A **separate online registration form and separate application fee** must be submitted for each individual series. Candidates are permitted to appear in multiple series; NUST's admission system automatically retains your **highest / best score** for final merit determination.
### Official Merit Calculation Formula

For undergraduate Engineering and Computing disciplines, the composite aggregate merit is calculated according to the officially confirmed formula:
- **NUST Entry Test (NET):** 75% weightage
- **HSSC / Intermediate Part-1 (or O-Level):** 15% weightage
- **SSC / Matriculation:** 10% weightage
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Visit Admission Portal:** Go to `https://ugadmissions.nust.edu.pk/`.
2. **Account Registration:** Click on *New Registration*, enter your active email address, and verify your account credentials.
3. **Profile & Academic Information:** Fill in your personal details, Matric/O-Level grades, and Intermediate college credentials.
4. **Select Programme & Test Stream:** Choose your desired discipline stream (Engineering, Computing, Business, etc.).
5. **Generate Fee Challan:** Download the computerized fee invoice of Rs. 5,000 and deposit it via 1Link, ATM, online banking, or designated commercial bank branches.
6. **Schedule Test Slot:** Upon payment verification on the portal, select your preferred examination date and morning/afternoon session for CBNET in Islamabad before **14 November 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When does NUST NET 2027 Series-1 registration start and close?**
Registration opens today, **4 October 2026**, and closes on **14 November 2026**.

**Q2: When will Series-1 tests be conducted?**
Computer-based tests (CBNET) will commence from **17 November 2026 onwards**.

**Q3: Where is the test centre for Series-1?**
NET Series-1 is conducted exclusively as a computer-based test at the NUST Main Campus (Sector H-12), Islamabad.

**Q4: Is there negative marking in NUST NET?**
No. There is no negative marking in any section of the NUST Entry Test.

**Q5: Can I appear in more than one NET series?**
Yes. You can appear in multiple series. You must submit a separate form and fee for each series, and your best score will be counted for final merit.

**Q6: What is the fee for NET 2027 Series-1?**
The application fee is Rs. 5,000 for Pakistani and dual-nationality candidates, and USD 80 (Rs. 10,000) for foreign nationals.

Candidates looking for the **PHSA Paramedic Diploma General Merit List 2026–2028** can directly access and download the official institute-wise candidate lists published under **Notice #40** on the **Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA)** portal at [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Critical Clarification: General Provisional List vs. Final Selection List:**
> - **Current Release (Provisional General List):** Contains all received applications, verified matric/science scores, and quota tags for public review and discrepancy correction.
> - **Action Required:** Check your name, marks calculation, and district allocation using `Ctrl + F`.
> - **Objection Window:** Any errors in marks, names, or quotas must be formally lodged with the respective admission committee before final list generation.
> - **Final Selection / Call List:** Will be published separately following the resolution of objections for candidate interviews and fee deposits.
### Notice Board Update: BS Paramedics General List & Document Header Clarification (26 October 2026)

> [!NOTE]
> **PHSA Notice Board Release & Document Header Discrepancy Advisory:**
> - **Official Notice Board Entry:** On **26 October 2026**, the official PHSA Notice Board published a new document entry titled **"General List - BS Paramedics - ZAB PGPI"**, valid for candidate scrutiny and grievance submission through **1 November 2026**.
> - **Attached PDF Document Header Discrepancy:** While the portal notice title specifically labels the file for *ZAB PGPI*, the heading inside the attached official PDF (`phsa-general-list-bs-paramedics-20261026-1456.pdf`) reads **"Institute: All Institutes"** and displays the processing annotation **"Status: Returned for Correction, Document verified"**.
> - **Provisional Scrutiny Status:** This document is a preliminary scrutiny/data verification list rather than an exclusive or final selection list. Candidates must not treat this release as a definitive interview call list.
> - **Candidate Verification Guidance:** In light of the heading variance between the portal notice board and the document header, allied health candidates across all participating institutions are advised to check their entries on the [PHSA Notice Board](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details) and directly confirm institutional scope with the PHSA Admissions Directorate before **1 November 2026**.
> - **Privacy Notice:** In strict compliance with candidate personal data security standards, CareerDost does not mirror applicant names, CNIC numbers, or personal scorecards. Please consult the official PHSA portal directly.
### Quick Summary: PHSA Paramedic Admissions 2026–2028

- **Administering Authority:** Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA), Department of Health, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
- **Programs Offered:** 2-Year Paramedic Diplomas across 8+ specialized clinical tracks
- **Participating Institutes:**
  - Post Graduate Paramedical Institute (PGPI) Peshawar
  - Paramedical Institute of Medical Technologies (PIMT) Abbottabad
  - Paramedical Institute of Medical Technologies (PIMT) Swat
  - Paramedical Institute of Medical Technologies (PIMT) D.I. Khan
- **Official Notice Reference:** Notice #40 (Dated 01-Oct-2026)
- **Direct Notice Portal:** [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details)
- **Official PHSA Domain:** [phsa.edu.pk](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/)
### Paramedic Diploma Disciplines Covered in Merit Lists

The published provisional lists encompass applicants across major allied health clinical diplomas:
1. **Cardiology Technology:** Electrocardiography, catheterization lab support, and cardiac telemetry.
2. **Pathology / Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT):** Diagnostic pathology, hematology, and clinical microbiology.
3. **Surgical / Operation Theater (OT) Technology:** Pre-operative sterilization, surgical assistance, and instrumentation.
4. **Radiology / X-Ray & Imaging Technology:** Diagnostic radiography and CT/MRI imaging workflows.
5. **Dental Health Technology:** Maxillofacial assistance, dental hygiene, and chairside clinical support.
6. **Anesthesia Technology:** Anesthetic workstation setup, gas monitoring, and recovery patient care.
7. **Dialysis / Nephrology Technology:** Hemodialysis machine preparation and patient monitoring.
8. **Pharmacy Technician / Dispenser Diploma:** Pharmaceutical compounding, hospital dispensary, and stock control.
### Step-by-Step Guide to Locate Your Name on the PDF

1. Open the official PHSA portal: [https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details).
2. Navigate to **Notice #40: General Lists – Paramedic Diploma Programs (2 Years)**.
3. Click on your respective institute PDF link (PIMT Abbottabad, PIMT Swat, PIMT D.I. Khan, or PGPI Peshawar).
4. Download and open the PDF file on your computer or mobile device.
5. Press `Ctrl + F` (or the search magnifying glass on mobile) and search by your **Application Form Number**, **CNIC / B-Form Number**, or **Full Name**.
6. Review your Matric Science marks percentage, total calculated score, and allocated category quota.
### Official Objection Filing Procedure

If you identify any discrepancy in your name, father's name, matriculation marks calculation, district of domicile, or quota classification:
- **Filing Location:** Contact the Admission Cell of the respective training institute (PIMT Peshawar, Abbottabad, Swat, or D.I. Khan).
- **Required Documentation:** Submit a written application along with attested photocopies of your Matric Science Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC), Domicile certificate, CNIC/B-Form, and paid application fee voucher.
- **Resolution:** Valid objections will be corrected before the compilation of the final merit selection list.
### Candidate Privacy & Security Notice

In strict adherence to official privacy and candidate security protocols, **CareerDost does NOT host or mirror private candidate marks sheets, personal phone numbers, or CNIC databases**. Candidates are directed exclusively to official PHSA Khyber Pakhtunkhwa portals.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: How can I download the PHSA Paramedic Merit List 2026 PDF?**
Visit [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details), locate Notice #40, and select the PDF download link for your respective training institute.

**Q2: What should I do if my name is missing from the list?**
If you submitted a complete application and paid fee before the deadline but your name is omitted, visit your respective institute admission desk with your original paid fee voucher and submission receipt immediately.

**Q3: When will the Final Selection List be announced?**
PHSA publishes the Final Selection Call List following the scrutiny and resolution of all candidate objections. The call list includes interview dates and semester fee submission deadlines.
### Official Verification Links

- **Official PHSA Notice Board:** [phsa.edu.pk/notice-details](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/notice-details)
- **PHSA Main Website:** [phsa.edu.pk](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/)
- **Related KP Health Coverage:** [KP Government BS Nursing Admissions 2026–2030](/jobs/phsa-kp-bs-nursing-admissions-2026)

qualification: 16 Years Education (Master's) / 17-18 Years (PhD) • HEC HAT Score ≥ 60

imageAlt: Commonwealth Scholarships 2027–28 for Pakistani Students – Master’s & PhD — HEC Pakistan & Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (CSC) UK Official Notic
excerpt: HEC Pakistan announces Commonwealth Scholarships 2027–28 for Pakistani and AJ&K citizens to pursue fully funded Master's and PhD degrees in the UK. Dual application on HEC and CSC portals required by October 20, 2026.
content: ### Executive Summary & Official Announcement

The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan**, in partnership with the **Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (CSC) UK**, has officially opened applications for the **Commonwealth Scholarships 2027–28**. This prestigious program enables high-achieving Pakistani and AJ&K citizens to pursue fully funded **Master's** (1-year taught) and **PhD** (3-year research) degree programs at top-ranked universities across the United Kingdom.
Applicants must complete a mandatory **dual application process** on both the HEC Online Portal and the CSC Electronic Application System (EAS) before the official deadline of **October 20, 2026**.
### Quick Information Overview Table
- **Awarding Bodies:** Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (CSC) UK & HEC Pakistan
- **Target Audience:** Pakistani National & AJ&K Permanent Residents
- **Degree Levels:** 1-Year Master's Degree & 3-Year PhD Degree
- **Financial Coverage:** 100% Fully Funded (Tuition, Monthly Stipend, Airfare, Allowance)
- **HEC HAT Requirement:** Minimum **60 out of 100** score in HEC Higher Education Aptitude Test (HAT)
- **HEC Nomination Quota:** **26 Master's Nominations** & **30 General PhD Nominations**
- **Dual Application Mandate:** Submissions required on BOTH HEC & CSC portals
- **Application Deadline:** **October 20, 2026**
- **Official HEC Notice Page:** [hec.gov.pk Announcements](https://www.hec.gov.pk/english/HECAnnouncements/Pages/CW-Scholarship.aspx)
### Scholarship Financial Benefits
Commonwealth Scholarships cover full financial costs for successful awardees:
- **Full Tuition Fees:** Direct payment of 100% university tuition fees.
- **Monthly Living Stipend:** £1,347 per month (or £1,652 per month for universities in the London metropolitan area).
- **International Airfare:** Return economy class flights from Pakistan to the UK.
- **Warm Clothing & Study Allowance:** Additional grants for arrival expenses, thesis preparation, and study travel.
### Mandatory Eligibility Criteria
1. **Nationality:** Must be a citizen or permanent resident of Pakistan or Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJ&K).
2. **Academic Background:**
- For Master's: 16 years of education (BS 4-Year / MA / MSc / BE / BBA) from an HEC-recognized university.
- For PhD: 17/18 years of education (MS / MPhil / ME) with strong research proposal alignment.
3. **HEC HAT Score:** Must have achieved a minimum valid score of **60/100** in HEC HAT test.
4. **Financial Need:** Must certify inability to afford studying in the UK without scholarship support.
### The Six Commonwealth Development Themes
Applicants must align their study plan and future career goals with one of the six strategic development themes:
1. Science and technology for development
2. Strengthening health systems and capacity
3. Promoting global prosperity
4. Strengthening global peace, security and governance
5. Strengthening resilience and response to crises
6. Access, inclusion and opportunity
### Step-by-Step Dual Application Guide
Candidates must complete BOTH applications sequentially:
#### Part A: CSC UK Application System (EAS)
1. Visit the CSC Online Application System (EAS) for Master's or PhD.
2. Register, fill out personal statement, study plan, development impact essay, and upload academic documents.
3. Submit the CSC application before **October 20, 2026**.
#### Part B: HEC Online Portal
1. Visit `https://scholarship.hec.gov.pk`.
2. Select *Learning Opportunities Abroad (LOA) -> Commonwealth Scholarships 2027–28*.
3. Enter HEC HAT test details, upload CSC application confirmation, and submit fee payment.
4. Complete submission prior to **October 20, 2026**.
### CRITICAL RULE: Nomination vs Final Selection

**Important Clarification:** Being nominated by HEC Pakistan does **NOT** guarantee final selection for the Commonwealth Scholarship. HEC submits 26 Master's and 30 PhD nominations to the UK Commonwealth Scholarship Commission. The final selection decision rests exclusively with the CSC UK selection panel based on global merit evaluation.
### Official Links & Verification Portals
- **Official HEC Announcement:** [HEC Commonwealth Page](https://www.hec.gov.pk/english/HECAnnouncements/Pages/CW-Scholarship.aspx)
- **HEC Scholarship Portal:** [HEC Online Admissions Portal](https://scholarship.hec.gov.pk)
- **UK CSC Official Guide:** [BridgeUSA & International Opportunities](https://j1visa.state.gov/programs/teacher/)
- **Local Research Awards:** Explore the [HEC Research Awards 2026–27](/jobs/hec-outstanding-research-awards-2026-27).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to submit Commonwealth Scholarship applications for 2027–28?**
The closing deadline for both HEC and CSC portal submissions is **October 20, 2026**.

**Q2: Is HEC HAT test mandatory?**
Yes. Candidates must have a minimum HAT score of 60 out of 100 to qualify for HEC nomination.

**Q3: Does HEC nomination guarantee a scholarship?**
No. HEC nominates shortlisted candidates, but final selection is determined solely by the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK.

**Q4: Can I apply without an IELTS score?**
While CSC does not require IELTS at initial application, target UK universities may require English proficiency proof upon conditional admission.

content: ### Executive Summary & Program Announcement

The **Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (PCBDDA)**, prominently known as **CBD Punjab**, has officially launched the **Youth Career Program (YCP 2026)**. This paid internship initiative is designed to provide fresh, high-achieving university graduates with hands-on professional experience, mentorship, and practical training in high-impact urban development projects.

The program offers structured corporate exposure across engineering, technology, finance, legal, and urban planning disciplines. Eligible fresh graduates across Punjab can submit online applications at `cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026` before the official deadline of **October 12, 2026**.
### Quick Information Overview Table
- **Organization:** Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (PCBDDA / CBD Punjab)
- **Program Name:** Youth Career Program (YCP 2026) Paid Internship
- **Internship Duration:** Up to 3 Months (Hands-on Corporate Training)
- **Remuneration:** Market Competitive Paid Monthly Stipend + Official Certificate
- **Education Requirement:** Minimum 16 Years Higher Education (BS / BE / BBA / MA / MSc / LLB)
- **Minimum Academic Standing:** CGPA $\ge$ 3.0 out of 4.0 (or equivalent first division)
- **Age Limit:** Maximum 25 Years as of Application Closing Date
- **Job Location:** CBD Punjab Headquarters, Lahore
- **Application Deadline:** **October 12, 2026**
- **Official Application Portal:** [cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026](https://www.cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026)
### Available Internship Disciplines
CBD Punjab is offering internship placements across diverse specialized departments:
1. **Engineering & Technical Services:** Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture, Urban & Regional Planning, Electrical / Mechanical Engineering.
2. **Information Technology & GIS:** Software Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Data Analytics, Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
3. **Finance, Commercial & Real Estate:** Financial Analysis, Accounting, Corporate Finance, Commercial Strategy, Real Estate Asset Management.
4. **Human Resources & Corporate Governance:** HR Management, Public Relations, Operations, Legal Affairs (LLB graduates).
5. **Marketing & Media Communication:** Digital Marketing, Content Strategy, Graphic Design, Brand Communications.
### Mandatory Eligibility Criteria
Applicants must meet all specified conditions to qualify for shortlisting:
- **Qualification:** Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS / BE / BBA / LLB) or Master's degree (16 years of education) from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Academic Performance:** Minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of **3.0 out of 4.0**.
- **Fresh Graduate Status:** Open to recently graduated candidates seeking practical industry induction.
- **Age Limit:** Upper age limit of **25 years** on the closing date of applications (**October 12, 2026**).
- **Domicile:** Open to candidates holding valid Punjab Domicile.
### Program Benefits & Learning Outcomes
- **Market Competitive Stipend:** Paid monthly financial stipend during the internship tenure.
- **Real-World Project Exposure:** Work directly on mega infrastructure, commercial development, and smart city initiatives in Lahore.
- **Professional Mentorship:** Executive guidance from top industry leaders, engineers, and financial strategists.
- **Career Certification:** Official PCBDDA Certificate of Completion enhancing future employment prospects.
### Step-by-Step "How to Apply Online" Guide
1. **Access Portal:** Open the official CBD Punjab YCP portal at `https://www.cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026`.
2. **Form Registration:** Enter basic personal details, CNIC number, email address, and phone number.
3. **Academic Data Entry:** Fill in degree title, university name, completion year, and exact CGPA.
4. **Department Selection:** Choose your preferred department / discipline aligned with your degree.
5. **Upload Resume & Credentials:** Attach your updated CV, transcript copy, and CNIC scan.
6. **Review & Submit:** Double-check all information and submit the application prior to **October 12, 2026**.
### Required Documentation Checklist
- Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Copy of CNIC
- Official University Transcript / Final Degree Certificate showing CGPA $\ge$ 3.0
- Domicile Certificate of Punjab
### Official Application Portal & Sources
- **Official YCP Portal:** [CBD Punjab YCP 2026 Portal](https://www.cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026)
- **Main Authority Website:** [CBD Punjab Official Site](https://www.cbdpunjab.gov.pk/)
- **Explore Higher Research Opportunities:** Learn about the [HEC Research Awards 2026–27](/jobs/hec-outstanding-research-awards-2026-27).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the application deadline for CBD Punjab Internship 2026?**
The last date to apply online is **October 12, 2026**.

**Q2: What is the stipend amount for YCP 2026?**
CBD Punjab provides a market-competitive paid stipend to selected interns as determined by authority guidelines.

**Q3: Can students with CGPA below 3.0 apply?**
No. The official eligibility criteria strictly mandates a minimum CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0.

**Q4: Is the internship open to graduates from all over Pakistan?**
The program primary targets candidates holding Punjab domicile for placements at CBD Punjab headquarters in Lahore.

excerpt: PHSA Khyber Pakhtunkhwa has officially announced online admissions for 4-year BS Nursing (Session 2026-2030) across government nursing colleges. Check FSc Pre-Medical eligibility, KMU-CAT score, domicile rules, and application deadline of October 16, 2026.
content: ### Executive Summary & Official Admission Notice

The **Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA)**, operating under the Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, has officially announced the commencement of online admissions for the **4-Year BS Nursing Degree Program (Session 2026–2030)** across participating government nursing colleges in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

Online registration opened on **September 29, 2026**, and candidates seeking admission to government nursing institutions must submit their online applications via the official PHSA Applicant Portal before the closing date of **October 16, 2026**.
### Quick Information Overview Table
- **Degree Program:** Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BS Nursing – 4 Years)
- **Academic Session:** 2026–2030
- **Executing Body:** Provincial Health Services Academy (PHSA), Health Dept, Govt of KP
- **Target Institutions:** Affiliated Government College of Nursing (GCN) Campuses in KP
- **Basic Eligibility:** FSc Pre-Medical (Minimum 50% Marks) & Mandatory KMU-CAT Result
- **Domicile Requirement:** Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) & Merged Districts (FATA)
- **Online Application Opening Date:** September 29, 2026
- **Online Application Deadline:** **October 16, 2026**
- **Official Admission Portal:** [phsa.edu.pk/admissions](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/admissions)
### Academic Eligibility Criteria & Entry Test Requirements
Candidates applying for government nursing admissions in KP must satisfy the following criteria:

- **Educational Qualification:** Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / FSc Pre-Medical) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, securing a minimum of **50% unadjusted marks** from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE).

- **KMU-CAT Mandatory Test:** Candidates must have appeared in the **Khyber Medical University Centralized Admission Test (KMU-CAT)**. Entry test marks are integrated into the final merit calculation.
- **Domicile Criteria:** Applicants must possess a valid **Domicile Certificate of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa** or Merged Tribal Districts (FATA).
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years as of the closing date of application (or as specified in the official PHSA prospectus).
### Participating Government Nursing Colleges
Submissions allow applicants to rank participating public sector nursing colleges in KP during online form submission, including:
- College of Nursing, Post Graduate College of Nursing (PGCN), Peshawar
- Government College of Nursing (GCN), Hayatabad, Peshawar
- Government College of Nursing, Mardan
- Government College of Nursing, Swat
- Government College of Nursing, Abbottabad
- Government College of Nursing, Kohat
- Government College of Nursing, Bannu
- Government College of Nursing, D.I. Khan
- Government College of Nursing, Jamrud (Khyber District)
### Step-by-Step "How to Apply Online" Guide
1. **Step 1:** Access the official PHSA Applicant Portal at `https://www.phsa.edu.pk/admissions`.
2. **Step 2:** Create an applicant account using your CNIC/B-Form number, active mobile number, and personal email address.
3. **Step 3:** Generate and print the auto-generated bank application processing fee challan, deposit the fee at the designated bank, and upload a clear photo/scan of the paid receipt.
4. **Step 4:** Enter your Matric, FSc Pre-Medical, and KMU-CAT test marks exactly as printed on your official DMCs.
5. **Step 5:** Upload clear scanned copies of required documents (CNIC/B-Form, Domicile, FSc DMC, Matric Certificate, Photograph).
6. **Step 6:** Rank your preferred participating nursing colleges in order of preference.
7. **Step 7:** Review your profile carefully and submit before **October 16, 2026**.
### Required Documents Checklist
- Recent Passport-Size Photograph
- CNIC or B-Form copy
- KP / Merged Districts Domicile Certificate
- Matriculation (SSC) Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC)
- FSc Pre-Medical (HSSC) Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC)
- KMU-CAT Official Test Result Card
- Paid Application Fee Bank Voucher / Receipt
- Quota Certificate (if applying under Minority, Disability, or PHSA Network reserved seats)
### Selection & Merit List Procedure
- **Document Verification:** PHSA scrutinizes all online applications and mark entries.
- **Correction Window:** If any discrepancy is identified, the application is returned to the applicant portal with remarks for online correction before final lock.
- **Merit List Display:** Provisional and final merit lists will be published on the PHSA website.
- For 2-year paramedic lists, view [PHSA Paramedic Diploma General Lists 2026](/jobs/phsa-paramedic-general-list-2026).
### Official Source & Apply Links
- **Official Admission Portal:** [PHSA KP Admissions Portal](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/admissions)
- **PHSA Main Website:** [PHSA KP Official Website](https://www.phsa.edu.pk/)
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for PHSA KP BS Nursing Admissions 2026?**
The last date to submit online applications on the PHSA portal is **October 16, 2026**.

**Q2: Is KMU-CAT mandatory for KP BS Nursing admission?**
Yes, KMU-CAT entry test marks are mandatory for merit calculation in KP public sector nursing colleges.

**Q3: What is the minimum FSc percentage required?**
Applicants must have passed FSc Pre-Medical with at least 50% unadjusted marks.

**Q4: Can candidates from other provinces apply on open merit?**
No, admissions in KP government nursing colleges are open to candidates holding KP or Merged Districts (FATA) domicile.

excerpt: SZABIST University Karachi, in partnership with Ihsan Trust, has announced the Interest-Free Loan Facility (Qarz-e-Hasna) for the 2026–27 academic year. Students with minimum 2.5 CGPA can apply online through portal.ihsantrust.org by 16 November 2026.
content: ### Educational Financing Overview: Ihsan Trust & SZABIST Partnership

**SZABIST University Karachi**, in institutional collaboration with the **Ihsan Trust**, has officially opened applications for the **Ihsan Trust Interest-Free Loan Facility (Qarz-e-Hasna) for the Academic Year 2026–27**. Announced through SZABIST’s **External Relations and Financial Assistance (ERFA) Department**, this initiative is designed to ensure that no qualified student is forced to discontinue higher education due to temporary financial inability to pay semester tuition fees.
The Ihsan Trust is Pakistan's premier Shariah-compliant educational endowment organization, providing pure **Qarz-e-Hasna** to deserving students across leading universities nationwide.

**CRITICAL FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE:** This facility is strictly an **Interest-Free Loan (Qarz-e-Hasna)** and is **NOT a non-repayable grant, charity, or institutional scholarship**. Beneficiary students receive tuition assistance during their studies and commit to repaying the exact principal amount in affordable, interest-free monthly installments only after completing their degree and securing employment. Students seeking non-repayable grants should consult the [SZABIST Need-Based Scholarship (SNBSP) Guide](/jobs/szabist-scholarship-2026-27).
### Quick Summary Table: SZABIST Ihsan Trust Qarz-e-Hasna 2026–27

| Metric / Parameter | Official Facility Specification |
|:---|:---|
| **Facilitating Body** | Ihsan Trust in partnership with SZABIST University Karachi |
| **Coordinating Department** | External Relations & Financial Assistance (ERFA), SZABIST |
| **Facility Nature** | **100% Interest-Free Loan (Qarz-e-Hasna)** — Reimbursable post-graduation |
| **Target Audience** | Enrolled Undergraduate & Graduate Students experiencing tuition distress |
| **Academic Performance Requirement** | Minimum **2.50 CGPA** (or equivalent academic standing) |
| **Program Exclusions** | **Media Sciences Degree Programs are strictly excluded** |
| **Application Portal** | [portal.ihsantrust.org](https://portal.ihsantrust.org/) |
| **Announcement Date** | 01 October 2026 |
| **Final Application Deadline** | **16 November 2026** |
| **Helpdesk Contact** | erfa@szabist.edu.pk |
### Eligibility Benchmark & Strict Exclusions
To qualify for consideration by the joint SZABIST–Ihsan Trust Financial Assistance Committee, applicants must fulfill all institutional conditions:

1. **Enrolment Status:** Must be a currently registered, active student in an approved undergraduate or graduate degree program at SZABIST University Karachi.
2. **Academic Standing:** Must maintain a cumulative grade point average of at least **2.50 CGPA** on a 4.0 scale.
3. **Demonstrated Financial Need:** The applicant’s family must demonstrate genuine financial distress, evidenced through authentic utility bills, salary slips, or pension records.
4. **Excluded Disciplines:** Per specific endowment terms, students enrolled in **Department of Media Sciences programs (such as BS Media Studies or MS Media Studies) are NOT eligible** for this facility.
5. **Repayment Commitment:** The candidate and their guardian must execute a formal agreement committing to repay the interest-free principal balance in nominal monthly installments once gainfully employed post-graduation.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure via Ihsan Trust Portal
Applications for the 2026–27 academic cycle are processed exclusively online through the dedicated Ihsan Trust system:

1. **Navigate to the Portal:** Access the official application engine at [https://portal.ihsantrust.org/](https://portal.ihsantrust.org/).
2. **New Applicants (First-Time Registration):**
   - Click on **Register / Sign Up**.
   - Complete your student profile using your authentic CNIC number, SZABIST student registration ID, active email address, and mobile number.
   - Fill out the detailed family income, expense, and tuition fee breakdown.
   - Upload mandatory scanned documents (CNIC of student & parents, recent utility bills, rent agreement if applicable, fee challan, and latest official transcript).
3. **Existing Beneficiaries (Renewal / Re-application Cases):**
   - Students who previously availed Ihsan Trust assistance must log in using their previously registered email address.
   - Use your registered CNIC number (without dashes) as your default password.
   - Update your current CGPA, upload your latest semester fee voucher and grade sheet, and submit for renewal.
4. **Institutional Review:** After online submission, the SZABIST ERFA Department verifies institutional enrolment and schedules an evaluation interview before forwarding shortlisted files to Ihsan Trust Trustees for final approval.
5. **Application Cut-Off Date:** The portal will close on **16 November 2026**.
### Transparency & Anti-Fraud Advisory

CareerDost urges all applicants to heed the following precautions:
- **Direct Application:** Never use unauthorized third-party agents or social media brokers claiming to guarantee Ihsan Trust approvals. The application process on `portal.ihsantrust.org` is completely free.
- **No Commission:** Ihsan Trust and SZABIST never solicit fees, commissions, or processing deposits.
- **Official Helpdesk:** For legitimate guidance on application forms, reach out to the SZABIST ERFA desk in Karachi via `erfa@szabist.edu.pk` or review institutional policies on the [CareerDost Editorial Desk](/about#editorial-policy).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Is the Ihsan Trust facility at SZABIST a scholarship or a loan?**  
It is strictly an interest-free loan (Qarz-e-Hasna). Beneficiary students are required to repay the exact principal amount in flexible monthly installments after graduation and employment.

**Q2: Are Media Sciences students eligible to apply?**  
No. The Ihsan Trust policy specifically excludes students enrolled in Media Sciences programs from this funding scheme.

**Q3: What is the minimum CGPA required?**  
Applicants must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.50 to qualify for loan consideration.

content: ### Official Recruitment Notice & Overview

The **National Telecommunication and Information Security Board (NTISB)**, operating under the Cabinet Division, Government of Pakistan, has officially advertised high-level technical and cyber security vacancies.

Published on the federal **National Job Portal (NJP)**, these contract appointments (PPS-5 to PPS-11) are aimed at strengthening national cyber defense, FCERT operations, security operations center (SOC) monitoring, and critical telecom infrastructure protection.
Qualified Pakistani candidates must submit their electronic applications online at `njp.gov.pk` before **October 12, 2026**.
### Quick Summary of NTISB Recruitment
- **Organization:** National Telecommunication and Information Security Board (NTISB) / Cabinet Division
- **Job Category:** [Government Jobs](/category/government-jobs) / IT & Cyber Security
- **Scale / Pay:** Project Pay Scales (PPS-5 to PPS-11)
- **Job Location:** Islamabad, Pakistan
- **Application Mode:** Online via National Job Portal (NJP)
- **Closing Date:** **October 12, 2026**
- **Official NJP Portal:** [njp.gov.pk](https://njp.gov.pk/)
### Active Positions & Vacancy Breakdown Table (Verified 2026)
The following table lists active vacancies open for online applications on NJP:
| Position Title | Pay Scale | Minimum Qualification | Min. Experience | Official Deadline |
| Director FCERT | PPS-11 | BS / MS Cyber Security / CS / Telecom | 15+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Deputy Director (Integration) | PPS-10 | BS / BE Computer Engineering / CS / IT | 12+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Deputy Director (SOC) | PPS-10 | BS / MS Cyber Security / Computer Science | 10+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Assistant Director (Integration) | PPS-9 | BS-CS / BS-IT / Software Engineering | 6+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Database Administrator (DBA) | PPS-8 | BS Computer Science / Software Engineering | 5+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| SOC Analyst L3 / SIEM Engineer | PPS-8 | BS Cyber Security / CS / IT | 5+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| SOC Analyst L2 / Incident Responder | PPS-7 | BS Cyber Security / CS / IT | 4+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| SOC Analyst L1 | PPS-7 | BS Cyber Security / CS / IT | 3+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Network Engineer | PPS-7 | BS Computer Engineering / Telecom / CS | 3+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Procurement Officer / Specialist | PPS-7 | Master's / BS Supply Chain / Finance / MBA | 3+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
| Office Assistant | PPS-5 | Graduation (BA / BSc / BCom) / DAE | 4+ Years | Oct 12, 2026 |
### Detailed Job Responsibilities & Technical Roles

- **Director FCERT & Deputy Director SOC:** Leads National Computer Emergency Response Team (FCERT) operations, national threat intelligence sharing, incident response frameworks, and strategic SOC monitoring.

- **SOC Analysts (L1, L2, L3) & SIEM Engineers:** Monitors enterprise SIEM dashboards, investigates SIEM alerts, conducts triage analysis, coordinates incident response, and authors threat mitigation rules.
- **Database Administrator (DBA):** Manages Oracle/PostgreSQL/SQL Server database architecture, data security, backup recovery plans, and high-availability database clusters.
- **Network Engineer:** Configures enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, VPN tunnels, and network monitoring tools across secure government telecom networks.
### General Eligibility & Age Limit
- **Educational Degrees:** Degrees must be awarded by HEC-recognized universities or accredited boards.
- **General Age Relaxation:** Federal Government 5-year general age relaxation is included in the prescribed upper age limits as per NJP advertisement.
- **Quota & Domicile:** Provincial and regional quotas (Punjab, Sindh Urban/Rural, KP, Balochistan, AJ&K, GB) apply as detailed in individual NJP job listings.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Guide via NJP
1. **Step 1:** Access the official National Job Portal at `https://njp.gov.pk/`.
2. **Step 2:** Search for **"National Telecommunication and Information Security Board"** in the employer search bar.
3. **Step 3:** Select your desired position (e.g., Network Engineer, SOC Analyst, DBA).
4. **Step 4:** Log in to your NJP account or register a new candidate profile.
5. **Step 5:** Complete your online profile by adding educational degrees, work experience, CNIC, and domicile details.
6. **Step 6:** Submit your application electronically before midnight on **October 12, 2026**.
For other federal relief programs, read our article on the [PM Fuel Relief Scheme 2026](/jobs/pm-fuel-relief-scheme-2026-registration-eligibility).

No, submitting applications on the National Job Portal (NJP) is free of cost.

Positions are offered under Project Pay Scales (PPS-5 to PPS-11).

content: ### Academic Overview & Spring 2027 Notice

**The Shaikh Ayaz University, Shikarpur (SAUS)**, a premier public sector university in northern Sindh, has officially invited online applications for **Spring 2027 Admissions** across its undergraduate degree programs.

Prospective students across Sindh and nationwide can submit their online application forms on the university's official admissions portal by **October 10, 2026**. The official admission entry test is scheduled for **November 07, 2026**.
### Quick Information Overview Table
- **University Name:** The Shaikh Ayaz University, Shikarpur (SAUS), Sindh
- **Academic Session:** Spring 2027
- **Degree Level:** Undergraduate BS (4-Year) Degree Programs
- **Primary Disciplines:** Computer Science (BSCS), Information Technology (BSIT), Mathematics
- **Application Processing Fee:** Rs. 2,500
- **Online Application Deadline:** **October 10, 2026**
- **Admission Entry Test Date:** **November 07, 2026**
- **Official Apply Portal:** [admissions.saus.edu.pk](https://admissions.saus.edu.pk/admissions)
### Offered Undergraduate Degree Programs
- **BS Computer Science (BSCS):** 4-Year degree program focused on software engineering, algorithms, AI, and systems architecture.
- **BS Information Technology (BSIT):** 4-Year program covering network administration, web technologies, and database management.
- **BS Mathematics:** 4-Year pure and applied mathematical science program.
- **BS Business Administration (BBA) / BS Commerce:** Corporate management and accounting programs.
- **BS English Literature & Linguistics:** Advanced humanities and language studies.
### Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Marks

- **HSC / Intermediate Criteria:** Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC-II Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, ICS, I.Com, or General Science) with a minimum of **50% marks** from a recognized Intermediate board.
- **Domicile Requirement:** Admissions are open to candidates holding Sindh Domicile and PRC, with reserved seats for self-finance and open merit.
- **Entry Test Mandatory:** Applicants must appear in the SAUS Admission Entry Test on November 07, 2026.
### Merit Calculation & Selection Criteria
Final merit lists are compiled according to the university's approved weighted admission formula:
- **Matriculation (SSC):** 10% weightage
- **Intermediate (HSC):** 40% weightage
- **SAUS Entry Test:** 50% weightage
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure
1. **Step 1:** Visit the official SAUS Admissions Portal at `https://admissions.saus.edu.pk/admissions` (or `admission.saus.edu.pk`).
2. **Step 2:** Register a new applicant account with your CNIC/B-Form number and mobile number.
3. **Step 3:** Generate the prescribed **Rs. 2,500 Admission Processing Fee** challan voucher.
4. **Step 4:** Pay the processing fee at the designated bank branch and upload a clear scanned image of the paid voucher.
5. **Step 5:** Fill in your academic marks (SSC & HSC) and personal details.
6. **Step 6:** Upload scanned documents (CNIC, Domicile, PRC, SSC & HSC Marksheets, Photo).
7. **Step 7:** Submit your online application form prior to **October 10, 2026**.
For health education admissions in KP, explore our guide on [KP Government BS Nursing Admissions 2026](/jobs/phsa-kp-bs-nursing-admissions-2026).
### Required Documents Checklist
- Recent Passport-size Photograph
- Candidate's CNIC / B-Form
- Father's / Guardian's CNIC
- Sindh Domicile Certificate & PRC (Form D)
- SSC / Matriculation Pass Certificate & Marks Sheet
- HSC / Intermediate Pass Certificate & Marks Sheet
- Paid Rs. 2,500 Bank Processing Fee Receipt
### Official University Contact & Apply Links
- **Official Admission Portal:** [SAUS Online Admission Portal](https://admissions.saus.edu.pk/admissions)
- **Main University Website:** [The Shaikh Ayaz University Official Website](https://saus.edu.pk/)
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SAUS Spring 2027 Admissions?**
The application deadline is **October 10, 2026**.

**Q2: When will the SAUS entry test be conducted?**
The admission entry test will be held on **November 07, 2026**.

**Q3: What is the application processing fee?**
The admission processing fee is **Rs. 2,500**.

**Q4: What minimum marks are required for BSCS and BSIT?**
Applicants must have secured at least 50% marks in Intermediate (HSC Pre-Engineering / ICS).

**Q5: Where is Shaikh Ayaz University located?**
It is a public sector university located in Shikarpur, Sindh.

content: ### Official Scheme Overview & Purpose
The **Sindh Mass Transit Authority (SMTA)**, under the Transport and Mass Transit Department, Government of Sindh, has launched online registration for the **Sindh Pink Scooty / EV Scheme 2026**.

Aiming to promote gender mobility, economic empowerment, and safe, eco-friendly commuting, the provincial initiative provides subsidized electric scooters (EV scooties) to eligible women across Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana, Mirpurkhas, and all districts of Sindh.
### Quick Information Overview Table
- **Scheme Name:** Sindh Pink EV Scooty Scheme 2026
- **Sponsoring Body:** Sindh Mass Transit Authority (SMTA), Govt of Sindh
- **Target Beneficiaries:** Female Students, Working Women, Widows & Single Mothers
- **Primary Eligibility Requirement:** Permanent Resident of Sindh + Valid Motorcycle Driving License
- **Selection Method:** Transparent Open Balloting Process
- **Official Apply Portal:** [www.smta.gos.pk/pink-scooty-registration](https://www.smta.gos.pk/pink-scooty-registration)
- **Official Helpline:** 0309-1365354 | Toll-Free: 0800-07682
### Target Beneficiaries & Priority Categories
The scheme is exclusively for women. Priority in the evaluation and balloting process is assigned to:
- **Working Women:** Employed female professionals in public, private, corporate, or non-profit sectors.
- **Enrolled Female Students:** Regular female students pursuing higher education at recognized colleges and universities.
- **Widows & Single Mothers:** Female breadwinners managing households independently.
### Detailed Eligibility Criteria
Applicants must satisfy all official SMTA eligibility criteria:
1. **Gender & Residency:** Exclusively open to female citizens holding a valid **Sindh Domicile** and **Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC)**.

2. **Driving Licence Requirement:** Must possess a valid, permanent motorcycle/two-wheeler driving licence. While the government provides training and licensing support, a full permanent licence is mandatory for final allocation.
3. **Educational / Workplace Proof:** Active student card or workplace employment certificate.
4. **7-Year Retain Commitment:** Selected recipients must sign an undertaking committing to retain the scooter for at least **7 years** without selling, leasing, or transferring ownership.
5. **Exclusive Female Usage:** Scooters are strictly for the beneficiary's personal use. Misuse by male family members may lead to repossession.
### Important Clarification on the "50,000 Scooters" Target
Recent provincial statements outline a government roadmap to provide EV scooties to **50,000 women who obtain driving licences**.
⚠️ **CRITICAL FACTS:**
- Do **NOT** assume that "50,000 scooters are currently sitting ready for instant distribution".
- The 50,000 figure represents the government's overall target/expansion plan, implemented in structured phases across Sindh districts.
### Required Documents Checklist
Before filling out the online registration form, prepare scanned copies of the following documents:
- CNIC / Smart Card (Front and Back)
- Sindh Domicile Certificate & PRC (Form D)
- Valid Two-Wheeler Driving Licence
- Student ID Card OR Employment Letter / Pay Slip
- Passport-size Recent Photograph
### Step-by-Step Online Application Guide
1. **Step 1:** Visit the official SMTA portal at `https://www.smta.gos.pk/pink-scooty-registration` (or `smta.gos.pk/projects/pink-scooty-scheme`).
2. **Step 2:** Click **"Pink Scooty Registration"** and register your applicant profile.
3. **Step 3:** Enter personal details, CNIC number, Sindh domicile district, and driving licence details.
4. **Step 4:** Upload clear scanned images of your CNIC, Domicile, Driving Licence, and Student/Employee proof.
5. **Step 5:** Submit your application and save your tracking reference number.
### Application Tracking, Verification & Balloting
- **Tracking:** Applicants can check application status online by entering their CNIC on the official SMTA portal.
- **Verification:** Submitted details are verified against NADRA and driving licence branch databases.
- **Balloting:** Shortlisted candidates participate in a transparent computerised ballot. Successful applicants undergo a road safety driving assessment prior to scooter hand-over.
- For fuel subsidy details nationwide, read our article on the [PM Fuel Relief Scheme 2026](/jobs/pm-fuel-relief-scheme-2026-registration-eligibility).
### Official SMTA Contact & Help Information
- **Official Portal:** [SMTA Pink Scooty Registration](https://www.smta.gos.pk/pink-scooty-registration)
- **Project Page:** [SMTA Pink Scooty Project Details](https://smta.gos.pk/projects/pink-scooty-scheme)
- **Toll-Free Number:** `0800-07682`
- **Official Email:** `info@smta.gos.pk`
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Who is eligible for the Sindh Pink Scooty Scheme?**
Female residents of Sindh (holding Sindh Domicile and PRC) who are students, working women, widows, or single mothers with a valid motorcycle driving licence.

**Q2: Is a learner's permit sufficient for final scooter allocation?**
No. While training support is offered, candidates must possess a permanent valid motorcycle driving licence before final allocation.

**Q3: Can a recipient sell the scooter after receiving it?**
No. Beneficiaries must sign an undertaking committing to retain the vehicle for at least 7 years without selling or transferring it.

**Q4: How are beneficiaries selected?**
Selection is conducted through an open, transparent computerized balloting process following document verification.

**Q5: What is the official website to apply online?**
All applications must be submitted on the official SMTA website at `https://www.smta.gos.pk/pink-scooty-registration`.
