content:
## Official SBOTS Recruitment Status Verification (Verified 25 October 2026)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Historical Batch Status — Closed ([sbp.org.pk/careers/](https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/)):**
> - **SBOTS 27th & 28th Batches (Closed):** Recruitment and induction processes for the 27th and 28th batches are officially **completed and closed**.
> - **SBOTS 29th Batch (Closed):** Online applications for the 29th batch of Assistant Director (OG-2) closed on **14 September 2026**.
> - **Current Status:** No new SBOTS cycle is open for online registration today. Candidates researching **SBOTS eligibility criteria**, **OG-2 in bank salary** benefits, and **SBOTS careers** preparation can review the verified State Bank of Pakistan framework below and monitor [sbp.org.pk/careers/](https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/) for the next official advertisement.

## Overview of the State Bank Officer Training Scheme (SBOTS)

The **State Bank Officer Training Scheme (SBOTS)** is the flagship merit-based induction programme of the **State Bank of Pakistan (SBP)**—Pakistan's central bank—for recruiting entry-level **Assistant Directors (Officer Grade-2 / OG-2)**.

Selected candidates undergo rigorous residential classroom and applied central-banking training at the **National Institute of Banking and Finance (NIBAF)** in Islamabad before assuming permanent responsibilities across monetary policy, banking supervision, foreign exchange operations, financial stability, payment systems, and economic research at **SBP Head Office (I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi)** and SBP Banking Services Corporation (SBP-BSC) field offices nationwide.

## Verified SBOTS Eligibility Criteria (Assistant Director OG-2)

Based on official State Bank of Pakistan SBOTS recruitment notifications, candidates must fulfill the following academic, grade, and age requirements:

| ELIGIBILITY PARAMETER | OFFICIAL SBP SBOTS REQUIREMENT |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Eligible Disciplines** | Business Administration, Public Administration, Economics, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems & Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, Human Resources, Law, Media/Communications, or Agriculture |
| **Academic Qualification** | Minimum **16 years of education** (Master's or 4-year Bachelor's degree) from an **HEC-recognized** Pakistani university or an equivalent foreign degree with HEC equivalency |
| **Minimum Marks / CGPA** | At least **60% aggregate marks** where the percentage system applies, OR minimum **2.50 out of 4.00 CGPA** (or **3.50 out of 5.00 CGPA**) where the GPA system applies |
| **Maximum Age Limit** | **26 years** as of the closing date of applications |
| **Age Relaxation Rules** | Upper age limit is relaxed by **3 years (up to 29 years)** for candidates holding valid domicile of **FATA/Merged Districts, Gilgit-Baltistan (Northern Areas), Balochistan, and Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK)**, and by **5 years (up to 31 years)** for existing SBP employees fulfilling academic criteria |

## Competitive Examination, Selection Stages & NIBAF Training

Induction under SBOTS is strictly merit-based and follows provincial/regional quota allocations prescribed by the Federal Government:

1. **Phase 1 — Written Recruitment Test:** Administered nationwide by SBP's designated testing agency, evaluating **English Comprehension & Composition**, **Quantitative & Analytical Reasoning**, and **Pakistan Economy, Current Affairs & General Knowledge**.
2. **Phase 2 — Group Discussion & Psychometric Assessment:** Candidates qualifying the written cut-off are invited for group exercises and psychometric evaluations assessing leadership, policy analysis, and communication.
3. **Phase 3 — Final Panel Interview:** Conducted by senior SBP executives across regional centers.
4. **Phase 4 — Residential Training at NIBAF Islamabad:** Finalists join as **Trainee Assistant Directors (OG-2)** at the **National Institute of Banking and Finance (NIBAF), Sector H-8/1, Islamabad**, completing applied central-banking training prior to confirmation at SBP Karachi or SBP-BSC offices.

## OG-2 Salary Structure, Perks & Career Progression in SBP

Candidates searching for **OG-2 in bank salary** and central bank compensation under SBOTS receive a comprehensive package governed by State Bank of Pakistan service rules:

- **Consolidated Monetized Monthly Salary Scale:** SBP offers a competitive consolidated monetized monthly salary package in the **OG-2 pay scale** (the exact rupee figure is specified in each batch's official advertisement and is periodically revised by the SBP Board of Directors).
- **Central Bank Medical & Loan Benefits:** Comprehensive medical facility for self, spouse, children, and dependent parents; concessional staff house-building, motor-car, and personal loan schemes; Contributory Provident Fund; and Gratuity in accordance with SBP rules.
- **International Higher Education:** Confirmed SBP OG-2 officers are eligible to compete for fully sponsored international Master's and PhD scholarships at top global universities after completing the required service tenure.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the SBOTS eligibility criteria for Assistant Director (OG-2)?**
Applicants must hold a 16-year Master's or 4-year Bachelor's degree from an HEC-recognized university in an eligible discipline with at least **60% marks** (or **2.50/4.00 CGPA** / **3.50/5.00 CGPA**) and be no more than **26 years old** (relaxable by 3 years for Balochistan, AJK, Gilgit-Baltistan, and Ex-FATA domiciles, and 5 years for SBP employees).

**Q2: Are SBP SBOTS Batch 27, 28, or 29 applications currently open?**
No. Batches 27 and 28 have completed recruitment, and Batch 29 online registration closed on **14 September 2026**. Future SBOTS batches are announced exclusively on [sbp.org.pk/careers/](https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/).

**Q3: What does the OG-2 salary and benefits package at State Bank of Pakistan include?**
Assistant Directors (OG-2) receive a consolidated monetized monthly salary under the SBP OG-2 scale (announced in each cycle's official notice), plus family & parental medical coverage, concessional staff housing and vehicle loans, Provident Fund, and Gratuity.

## Official State Bank of Pakistan Portals & Related Guides

- **Official SBP Careers Portal:** [https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/](https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/)
- **NIBAF Training Institute:** [https://nibaf.sbp.org.pk/](https://nibaf.sbp.org.pk/)

  - [Meezan Bank Jobs 2026: Transaction Associates (Batch 01)](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/meezan-bank-transaction-associates-batch-01-jobs-2026)
  - [SBP Housing & Solar Financing Rules 2026 (Circular 06)](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sbp-housing-solar-financing-rules-circular-06-2026)

The Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) Lahore has officially declared the annual examination results for Secondary School Certificate (SSC Part-II / Matric) 2026. Hundreds of thousands of regular and private candidates who appeared across Lahore, Kasur, Sheikhupura, and Nankana Sahib districts can now access their provisional gazettes and subject-wise scorecards.

Candidates can check their examination status through the following verified methods:

Candidates unsatisfied with their marks can apply for paper rechecking within 15 days of the result declaration through the BISE Lahore online e-service portal. Rechecking consists of totaling re-verification, unmarked question checks, and script identification.

Official Detailed Marks Certificates (DMCs) with security barcodes and candidate holograms will be dispatched directly to schools for regular students and postal addresses for private candidates within 15 business days.

excerpt: Punjab HEC is offering fully funded PhD scholarships for study at top-ranked universities abroad in priority disciplines.
content: ### Overview & Programme Scope

The Punjab Higher Education Commission (PHEC) invites applications for its prestigious International PhD Scholarship Programme. Aimed at strengthening faculty and research capabilities in public sector universities across Punjab, this fully funded scholarship funds doctorate degrees at QS World Top 300 ranked universities worldwide in key strategic domains including Advanced Engineering, Agriculture, Healthcare & Biotechnology, Artificial Intelligence, and Social Policy.
### Coverage & Financial Benefits
The PHEC International PhD Scholarship provides comprehensive coverage for the entire degree duration (up to 4 years):
- **Tuition Fees:** 100% full tuition waivers paid directly to the host university.
- **Living Stipend:** Monthly living allowance benchmarked to the host country cost of living.
- **Travel Expenses:** Economy class return airfare from Pakistan to the host country.
- **Health Insurance:** Mandatory student health coverage throughout the study period.
- **Settlement Grant:** Initial one-time establishment allowance upon arrival.
### Eligibility Criteria & Academic Standards
- **Domicile:** Valid domicile certificate of Punjab Province.
- **Education:** MS / MPhil degree (18 years equivalent) in relevant discipline with minimum CGPA 3.5/4.0.
- **Age Limit:** Maximum 35 years for general candidates, 40 years for regular public university faculty.
- **Admission Offer:** Unconditional or conditional letter of acceptance from a QS Top 300 university.
- **Service Bond:** Selected scholars must execute a legal bond to return and serve in Punjab for at least 5 years.
### Step-by-Step Application Procedure
1. Review eligible priority fields on the official PHEC e-portal.
2. Secure an admission offer from an eligible overseas university.
3. Fill out the online application form and upload verified HEC degree certificates and research proposals.
4. Shortlisted applicants will undergo academic evaluation and panel interviews by the PHEC Selection Committee.
Find more fully funded opportunities on [CareerDost Scholarships](/category/scholarships).

The National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST) has announced its undergraduate admissions cycle for Fall 2026 across its premier campuses in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Risalpur, and Karachi. Known as Pakistan’s top-ranked engineering and multidisciplinary university, NUST offers bachelor’s degrees in Engineering, Computing, Applied Biosciences, Natural Sciences, Architecture, Business, and Social Sciences.

- **Computing & AI:** Software Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cyber Security.

excerpt: BISP has opened a new registration phase for eligible households to receive quarterly cash support under the Kafaalat programme.
content: ### Overview of BISP Dynamic Registry 2026

The Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP)—the Government of Pakistan’s flagship social safety net initiative—has initiated a nationwide re-registration and dynamic survey update drive. Under the Benazir Kafaalat and Taleemi Wazaif programmes, eligible low-income households and families experiencing economic hardship can register or update their socio-economic data at official BISP Tehsil Offices.
### Key Assistance Programmes Under BISP
- **Benazir Kafaalat:** Unconditional quarterly financial cash transfers provided directly to registered female household heads.
- **Benazir Taleemi Wazaif:** Conditional education stipends for school and college-going children with minimum 70% school attendance.
- **Benazir Nashonuma:** Health and nutrition cash support for pregnant women and infants under two years of age.
### Eligibility Criteria & Dynamic Registry Survey
- **Poverty Means Test (PMT):** Eligibility is determined through the National Socio-Economic Registry (NSER) poverty scorecard.
- **Mandatory CNIC:** The female applicant must possess an active, valid NADRA Computerised National Identity Card.
- **Child B-Form:** Children’s NADRA B-Form is mandatory to register for Taleemi Wazaif educational grants.
### Step-by-Step Registration Process at Tehsil Centers
1. Visit your local BISP Tehsil Registration Center with your original CNIC and children’s B-Forms.
2. Complete the biometric verification and answer dynamic socio-economic survey questions.
3. Receive an official confirmation SMS exclusively from the verified code **8171**.
**Caution:** BISP never sends registration messages or requests money from private mobile numbers. Disregard fraudulent SMS messages.

- Assistant Director (Commerce & Trade Administration) — Ministry of Commerce

content:
## Requisition Status & Rolling ATS Pipeline (Verified October 19, 2026)

> [!NOTE]
> **Current Status — October 15, 2026 QA Requisition Closed / Rolling Workable ATS Active:**
> The specific **QA Automation Engineer** requisition tracked on CareerDost closed on **October 15, 2026**. However, **Devsinc Pakistan** maintains a continuous recruitment pipeline across Quality Assurance, Associate Software Engineering, DevOps, AI/ML, and Business Development on its official **Workable Applicant Tracking System (ATS)** at [apply.workable.com/devsinc](https://apply.workable.com/devsinc/) and [devsinc.com/careers](https://www.devsinc.com/careers).

## About Devsinc Pakistan & Work Mode Policy

Founded in 2009, **Devsinc** is one of Pakistan's largest enterprise software development and IT staff-augmentation companies, employing over 2,000 engineers serving North American, European, and Middle Eastern clients.

- **Primary Engineering Delivery Hubs:** **Lahore** (Main Campus, Ghazi Road / DHA) and **Islamabad**.
- **Work Arrangement Clarification:** While Devsinc occasionally opens **project-specific remote or hybrid roles** for experienced mid-to-senior engineers across Pakistan (including Karachi, Rawalpindi, and Faisalabad), the majority of entry-level **Associate Software Engineer (ASE)** and **Junior QA** cohorts operate **on-site** at the Lahore and Islamabad campuses.

## Core QA Automation & Engineering Competency Matrix

Candidates applying for **Quality Assurance (QA) Automation** or **SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)** positions at Devsinc are evaluated against the following technical stack:

| COMPETENCY AREA | REQUIRED TOOLS, FRAMEWORKS & PRACTICES |
| :--- | :--- |
| **UI & End-to-End Test Automation** | Hands-on framework design using **Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium** (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java) |
| **API & Backend Verification** | RESTful and GraphQL API testing using **Postman, Newman, RestAssured, or SoapUI**; validating JSON schemas, status codes, and auth tokens |
| **CI/CD & DevOps Integration** | Integrating automated regression suites into **GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps** pipelines |
| **Database & Performance Testing** | Writing complex **SQL queries** (PostgreSQL / MySQL) for data integrity checks and conducting load testing via **Apache JMeter or k6** |
| **Agile / Scrum Defect Lifecycle** | Writing test plans, traceability matrices, and reproducible bug reports in **Jira, TestRail, or Zephyr** within 2-week Scrum sprints |

## Devsinc 4-Stage Technical Recruitment Process

Applications submitted through Devsinc's official Workable portal undergo a standardized four-stage assessment:

1. **Stage 1 — ATS Resume Screening & HR Discovery Call (15–20 mins):** Talent Acquisition specialists review your GitHub portfolio, degree background, and project experience, followed by a brief phone screening covering communication skills, notice period, and location preference.
2. **Stage 2 — Online Coding / QA Assessment:** Candidates complete an online technical test or practical automation assignment evaluating data structures, object-oriented programming (OOP), SQL joins, test-case design, and script debugging.
3. **Stage 3 — Deep-Dive Technical Panel Interview (45–60 mins):** Senior QA Architects or Engineering Leads assess framework architecture (Page Object Model), API mocking, asynchronous wait handling, CI/CD troubleshooting, and live problem-solving.
4. **Stage 4 — Cultural Fit & Compensation Offer:** Final discussion with Engineering Management and People Operations covering career growth tracks, medical insurance, provident fund, and bi-annual performance appraisals.

## How to Apply Safely via Devsinc's Official Workable Portal

1. **Browse Live Requisitions:** Visit [devsinc.com/careers](https://www.devsinc.com/careers) or go directly to Devsinc's verified job board at [apply.workable.com/devsinc](https://apply.workable.com/devsinc/).
2. **Filter by Department & Location:** Filter open roles by **Engineering**, **Quality Assurance**, **AI/Data**, or **Business Development**, and check whether the listing is tagged **On-site (Lahore/Islamabad)**, **Hybrid**, or **Remote**.
3. **Submit Your Resume & GitHub Profile:** Upload a clean PDF resume highlighting measurable engineering outcomes, test automation repositories, and live project links.
4. **Zero-Fee Safety Reminder:** Devsinc never charges candidates for job applications, coding assessments, or onboarding equipment.

content: ### Overview & FMCG Management Trainee Track

Unilever Pakistan invites graduating students and young professionals to apply for the Unilever Future Leaders Programme (UFLP). A world-class 3-year rotational management trainee program, UFLP offers hands-on leadership responsibilities across iconic household brands in Foods, Beauty, and Personal Care.
### Functional Tracks Offered
- **Supply Chain & Manufacturing:** Factory management, logistics, and sustainable operations.
- **Marketing & Brand Management:** Brand positioning, media planning, and consumer insights.
- **Customer Development (Sales):** Modern trade, key accounts, and rural distribution.
- **Finance & Business Strategy:** Financial planning, cost management, and commercial auditing.
- **Human Resources:** Organizational culture, talent development, and industrial relations.
### Eligibility Requirements
- Final-year undergraduate/master’s students or graduates with under 2 years of work experience.
- Exceptional leadership, analytical curiosity, and cross-functional problem-solving skills.
### Selection Sequence
Candidates progress through online profile submission, digital psychometric gaming assessments, on-demand video interviews, and an immersive Discovery Center day.

title: Türkiye Burslari Scholarship 2026 for Pakistani Students
qualification: Varies by degree level (Bachelor’s to PhD)
salary: Fully funded (tuition + stipend + accommodation)
imageAlt: Türkiye Burslari Scholarship 2026 for Pakistani Students — Government of Türkiye Official Notice CareerDost
excerpt: Türkiye Burslari is now accepting applications from Pakistani students for fully funded undergraduate, graduate and PhD study.
content: ### Overview of Türkiye Burslari Scholarship

The Government of Türkiye invites applications from Pakistani citizens for the annual Türkiye Burslari (Turkiye Scholarships) Programme. Funded directly by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB), this world-renowned scholarship offers full financial support for Undergraduate, Master’s, and PhD degree programs at top public universities across Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, and other Turkish cities.
### Financial Coverage & Scholar Benefits
Türkiye Burslari is one of the most generous international scholarship packages globally, covering:
- **Full Tuition Fees:** 100% academic tuition exemption for the entire duration of the degree.
- **Monthly Cash Stipend:** Regular monthly allowance to cover living and personal expenses.
- **Free University Accommodation:** Dedicated accommodation in state-run student dormitories.
- **One-Year Turkish Language Course:** Free preparatory Turkish language training prior to degree start.
- **Health Insurance Coverage:** Comprehensive national public health insurance.
- **Flight Tickets:** One-time round-trip flight tickets from Pakistan to Türkiye and return.
### Academic Eligibility Requirements
- **Undergraduate Applicants:** Minimum 70% academic marks in Intermediate / A-Levels; age under 21 years.
- **Master’s Degree Applicants:** Minimum 75% marks in 4-year Bachelor’s degree; age under 30 years.
- **PhD Candidates:** Minimum 75% marks in Master’s / MS degree; age under 35 years.
- **Health Sciences (Medicine/Dentistry/Pharmacy):** Minimum 90% academic score required.
### Application Guidelines & Timeline

Applications must be submitted exclusively via the official Turkiye Burslari online portal (tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr). Candidates need scanned copies of educational transcripts, certificates, passport/CNIC, recommendation letters, and a statement of purpose.
Find more international awards on [CareerDost Scholarships](/category/scholarships).

title: NADRA Data Entry Operator — Walk-in Test
qualification: Intermediate with typing speed of 30 WPM
imageAlt: NADRA Data Entry Operator — Walk-in Test Official Announcement CareerDost
excerpt: NADRA is hiring Data Entry Operators on contract basis in three major cities with a walk-in typing test.
content: ### Overview & Walk-In Recruitment Drive

The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) has announced walk-in test and interview schedules for Data Entry Operators (Junior Executive / Trainee) across regional headquarters in Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan. Successful candidates will be deployed at NADRA Registration Centers (NRCs) and mobile registration units.
### Core Responsibilities & Job Profile
- Verifying citizen identity documents and processing Computerised National Identity Cards (CNIC/NICOP).
- Capturing biometric fingerprints, facial iris scans, and demographic data on NADRA portal.
- Managing citizen token issuance and front-desk customer verification.
### Eligibility & Technical Criteria
- **Educational Qualification:** Intermediate (FA / FSc / ICS / I.Com) or Bachelor’s degree from a recognised educational board.
- **Typing Speed:** Minimum 30 to 35 words per minute (WPM) on standard QWERTY computer keyboards.
- **Age Limit:** 18 to 28 years (plus 5-year federal age relaxation, making upper age limit 33 years).
- **Domicile:** Relevant district domicile required for specific regional center quotas.
### Walk-In Test Schedule & Required Documents
Candidates must report directly to the specified NADRA Regional Office on the designated test date with original and attested copies of:
1. Original CNIC and two recent passport-size photographs.
2. Original Educational Certificates / Detailed Marks Certificates (Matric, Inter, Graduation).
3. Domicile Certificate and experience letters (if any).
Check more public authority opportunities on [CareerDost Government Jobs](/category/government-jobs).

excerpt: The Planning Commission is offering a three-month research internship for economics and public policy postgraduate students.
content: ### Overview & Federal Policy Internship

The Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives (Planning Commission of Pakistan) announces its Young Development Fellows & Research Internship Programme in Islamabad. Designed to involve young Pakistani scholars in national macroeconomic policymaking, this programme offers direct exposure to the Federal Public Sector Development Programme (PSDP).
### Research Sections & Wings
- Macroeconomic Policy and Fiscal Framework Wing
- CPEC (China-Pakistan Economic Corridor) & International Trade Section
- Social Sector Development, Education, and Health Planning
- Energy, Climate Change, Water, and Infrastructure Development
### Eligibility & Academic Profile
- Fresh graduates or postgraduate students holding degrees in Economics, Public Policy, Development Studies, Statistics, or Engineering.
- Minimum 1st Division or CGPA 3.0 from an HEC-recognised university.
- Strong quantitative research and academic writing skills.
### Fellowship Benefits
Interns receive a competitive monthly federal stipend, dedicated supervision from senior Chief Economists, and an official completion credential from the Government of Pakistan.
View more research schemes on [CareerDost Internships](/category/internships).

qualification: Intermediate Pre-Medical with MDCAT

excerpt: UHS Lahore has announced the merit schedule for MBBS and BDS admissions in Punjab’s public medical colleges for 2026.
content: ### Overview & Medical Admission Notice

The University of Health Sciences (UHS) Lahore—as the designated admission authority for the Government of Punjab—has issued the official admission guidelines for MBBS and BDS programmes in public and private medical colleges across Punjab for the 2026–2027 academic session.
### Colleges Covered in Centralized Induction

- **Public Medical Colleges:** King Edward Medical University (KEMU), Allama Iqbal Medical College (AIMC), Services Institute of Medical Sciences (SIMS), Rawalpindi Medical University (RMU), Nishtar Medical University Multan, and affiliated institutions.
- **Dental Colleges:** de'Montmorency College of Dentistry Lahore, Nishtar Dental College Multan, and Punjab Dental Hospital.
### Eligibility & Aggregate Calculation Formula
In accordance with PMDC regulations, admission aggregate is determined through:
- **MDCAT Score:** 50% weightage
- **HSSC / FSc Pre-Medical (or equivalent):** 40% weightage
- **SSC / Matriculation (or equivalent):** 10% weightage
- **Minimum Threshold:** Candidates must have scored at least 55% in MDCAT for MBBS and 50% for BDS.
### Application & Domicile Verification
Applications are processed through the UHS centralized online admission portal. Candidates must upload verified CNIC, domicile, Matric & FSc certificates, and MDCAT result cards.
Stay updated with medical admission schedules on [CareerDost Admissions](/category/admissions).

title: Punjab Rozgar Scheme — Interest-Free Business Loans
qualification: Punjab domicile, age 21–45
salary: Loans up to PKR 500,000
imageAlt: Punjab Rozgar Scheme — Interest-Free Business Loans — Government of Punjab Official Notice CareerDost
excerpt: The Punjab Rozgar Scheme offers interest-free small business loans to help young entrepreneurs start or expand a business.
content: ### Overview of Punjab Rozgar Scheme

The Government of Punjab, in partnership with the Punjab Small Industries Corporation (PSIC) and The Bank of Punjab (BOP), has opened applications for the Punjab Rozgar Scheme. Aimed at stimulating micro-entrepreneurship and employment generation across the province, this initiative provides subsidized, mark-up subsidized business loans to educated youth, skilled artisans, and startups.
### Loan Categories & Financing Limits
- **Micro Enterprise Loans:** From Rs 100,000 up to Rs 1,000,000.
- **Small Business Loans:** From Rs 1,000,000 up to Rs 10,000,000.
- **Mark-Up Rate:** Highly subsidized priority interest rates with easy 2-to-5-year repayment schedules and a 6-month grace period.
### Eligibility Criteria
- **Domicile:** Citizen residing in Punjab with valid CNIC.
- **Age Range:** 20 to 50 years.
- **Educational / Technical Profile:** University graduates, diploma holders (TEVTA / PBTE), skilled craftsmen, or existing micro-business owners.
### How to Apply Online

Applicants must register on the official Punjab Rozgar portal (`rozgar.psic.punjab.gov.pk`), submit their viable business project plan, upload national identity documents, and select their preferred Bank of Punjab branch for processing.
Check more welfare schemes on [CareerDost Government Schemes](/category/government-schemes).
